questions.question_en: Which of the following pairs of personality and the associated musical instrument is NOT matched correctly?
questions.explanation_en: Pandit Bhajan Sopori was a renowned santoor maestro from Kashmir, not a veena player, so pair 3 is wrongly matched. The others are correct: Zakir Hussain – tabla, Ustad Bismillah Khan – shehnai, Pandit Hari Prasad Chaurasia – bansuri (flute).

questions.question_en: Which Constitutional Amendment Act promoted the appointment of the same person as a Governor for two or more states?
questions.explanation_en: The Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 — enacted alongside the States Reorganisation Act — amended Article 153 to allow the same person to be appointed Governor of two or more states. It also reorganised states on a linguistic basis and abolished the Part A/B/C/D classification.

questions.question_en: Where is the India's first Dark Night Sky Reserve being established?
questions.explanation_en: India's first Dark Sky Reserve is being set up at Hanle in Ladakh, within the Changthang Wildlife Sanctuary, around the Indian Astronomical Observatory. It was announced in 2022 by the UT administration with the Indian Institute of Astrophysics to promote astro-tourism and protect the night sky from light pollution.

questions.question_en: Which of the following types of structures is NOT associated with Buddhist architecture in India?
questions.explanation_en: Buddhist architecture in India consists of stupas (relic mounds), chaityas (prayer halls with a stupa at one end) and viharas (monasteries where monks lived). 'Monkas' is not a Buddhist structure — it is simply a distractor word — so it is the correct choice.

questions.question_en: The first Indian to participate in NASA's International Air and Space Program was _____.
questions.explanation_en: Jahnavi Dangeti, a student from Andhra Pradesh, became the first Indian to complete NASA's International Air and Space Program (IASP) in 2022, held at the Kennedy Space Center, USA. The other names are not associated with this programme.

questions.question_en: Which of the following was the host country for the FIFA World Cup 2022?
questions.explanation_en: The FIFA World Cup 2022 was hosted by Qatar (20 November – 18 December 2022), the first World Cup held in the Middle East and the first played in November–December. Argentina won the final against France on penalties.

questions.question_en: Which of the following states has the highest number of operating mines (excluding fuels, atomic mineral and minor minerals), according to the Annual Report, 2021-22 of the Ministry of Mines?
questions.explanation_en: According to the Ministry of Mines Annual Report 2021-22, Madhya Pradesh had the highest number of reporting (operating) mines in the country, followed by Gujarat, Karnataka and Odisha. Odisha leads in the value of mineral production, but by number of mines Madhya Pradesh is first.

questions.question_en: As of December 2022, who was the Lieutenant Governor of Delhi?
questions.explanation_en: Vinai Kumar Saxena took over as the 22nd Lieutenant Governor of Delhi on 26 May 2022, succeeding Anil Baijal, and was therefore the LG in December 2022. Najeeb Jung and Tajendra Khanna were earlier LGs of Delhi.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a sexually transmitted disease?
questions.explanation_en: Amoebiasis (amoebic dysentery) is caused by the protozoan Entamoeba histolytica and spreads through contaminated food and water, not by sexual contact. AIDS (HIV), gonorrhoea and syphilis are all sexually transmitted diseases.

questions.question_en: The Battle of Khanwa (1527) was fought between the forces of Rana Sanga and _____.
questions.explanation_en: The Battle of Khanwa (17 March 1527) was fought near Fatehpur Sikri between Babur and the Rajput confederacy led by Rana Sanga of Mewar. Babur's victory, following Panipat (1526) against Ibrahim Lodi, consolidated Mughal rule in north India.

questions.question_en: Which of the following eras is considered as the age of the dinosaurs?
questions.explanation_en: The Mesozoic Era (about 252 to 66 million years ago, comprising the Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous periods) is called the 'Age of Reptiles' or age of the dinosaurs. The Cenozoic that followed is the age of mammals, while the Palaeozoic preceded the dinosaurs.

questions.question_en: 'Buiya' is a popular folk-dance form of which of the following states?
questions.explanation_en: Buiya is a folk dance of the Digaru Mishmi tribe of Arunachal Pradesh, performed on festive occasions. Other Arunachal dances include Ponung, Wancho and Bardo Chham.

questions.question_en: What name was given to the operation for liberation of Goa, in 1961, to make it a part of the Union of India?
questions.explanation_en: Operation Vijay (December 1961) was the Indian armed forces' action that liberated Goa, Daman and Diu from Portuguese rule. Operation Polo (1948) was the annexation of Hyderabad, and Operation Searchlight (1971) was a Pakistani army action in East Pakistan.

questions.question_en: The Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD), in partnership with the Ministry of Education, GOI and UNICEF, launched which of the following campaigns to bring back 'out of school' adolescent girls in India to the formal education and/or skilling system?
questions.explanation_en: Kanya Shiksha Pravesh Utsav was launched in March 2022 by the Ministry of Women and Child Development with the Ministry of Education and UNICEF, to bring out-of-school adolescent girls (11–14 years) back into formal education or skilling, using the Anganwadi network under Mission Shakti.

questions.question_en: National Action Plan for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) is a joint initiative of _____ and _____.

options.en: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment; Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of Environment and Climate Change; Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of Environment and Climate Change; Ministry of Minority Affairs
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment; Ministry of Environment and Climate Change

questions.explanation_en: NAMASTE (National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem), launched in 2022, is a joint initiative of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs. It aims to end hazardous manual cleaning of sewers and septic tanks by promoting mechanised sanitation and skilling sanitation workers.

questions.question_en: How many internal reflections do light rays undergo, inside a raindrop, to form a secondary rainbow?
questions.explanation_en: A primary rainbow forms by one internal reflection inside each raindrop, while a secondary rainbow forms by two internal reflections. The extra reflection makes the secondary bow fainter, larger and with its colour order reversed.

questions.question_en: As per the Census of India 2011, what percentage of Indians live in rural areas?
questions.explanation_en: As per Census 2011, about 68.8% of India's population (83.3 crore people) lived in rural areas and 31.2% in urban areas. The urban share rose from 27.8% in 2001, showing gradual urbanisation.

questions.question_en: The formula for calculating Net National Product (NNP) is _____.
questions.explanation_en: Net National Product (NNP) = Gross National Product (GNP) − Depreciation. Depreciation (consumption of fixed capital) is the wear and tear of capital goods; subtracting it from GNP gives the net value of output produced by a country's residents.

questions.question_en: Which of the following states had the highest growth rate for population according to the Census of India, 2011 as compared to that of 2001?
questions.explanation_en: According to Census 2011, Meghalaya recorded the highest decadal population growth rate among the given states, about 27.9% during 2001–2011 (Bihar ~25.4%, UP ~20.2%, Himachal ~12.9%). Nagaland was the only state to record negative growth in that decade.

questions.question_en: Who among the following was the first woman president of the Indian Olympic Association?
questions.explanation_en: Legendary sprinter P.T. Usha became the first woman president of the Indian Olympic Association, elected unopposed in December 2022. Known as the 'Payyoli Express', she finished fourth in the 400 m hurdles at the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following letters is the 7th to the left of the 11th letter from the right end of the series?
(Left) A D F G W R W S F G B C S X A D G H J K L Y O R E D H K H (Right)
questions.explanation_en: Count the series: it has 29 letters (A D F G W R W S F G B C S X A D G H J K L Y O R E D H K H). The 11th letter from the right end is at position 29 − 11 + 1 = 19 from the left, which is J. The 7th letter to the left of position 19 is at position 19 − 7 = 12, which is C.

questions.question_en:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.
19 * 23 * 221 * 17 * 89 * 361
questions.explanation_en: Try option 3: 19 × 23 + 221 ÷ 17 − 89 = 361. Apply BODMAS: 19 × 23 = 437 and 221 ÷ 17 = 13. Then 437 + 13 − 89 = 361, which equals the right-hand side, so the sequence ×, +, ÷, −, = balances the equation. The other options give values far from 361 (e.g. option 1: 19 ÷ 23 is a fraction).

questions.question_en:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the following equation.
45 * 45 * 45 * 45 * 45 * 1979
questions.explanation_en: Try option 1: 45 + 45 ÷ 45 = 45 × 45 − 1979. Left side: 45 ÷ 45 = 1, so 45 + 1 = 46. Right side: 45 × 45 = 2025, and 2025 − 1979 = 46. Both sides equal 46, so the combination +, ÷, =, ×, − is correct. Option 2 gives 45 − 1 = 44 on the left but 45 + 45 × 1979 on the right, which is far larger.

questions.question_en: In the evening, before sunset, X is facing towards the right hand side of the direction where his shadow is falling. He then turns right and walk 20 m. Then, he turns right again and walks 10 m. Then, he turns left and walks 10 m, and then turning right, he walks 20 m. Then, he turns right again and walks 30 m. At what distance and in which direction is X now from the starting point?
questions.explanation_en: In the evening the sun is in the west, so a shadow falls towards the east. The right-hand side of east is south, so X initially faces south. Turn right → west, walk 20 m; turn right → north, walk 10 m; turn left → west, walk 10 m; turn right → north, walk 20 m; turn right → east, walk 30 m. Net east-west movement: 20 + 10 west and 30 east = 0; net north movement: 10 + 20 = 30 m. So X is 30 m north of the start.

questions.question_en:
Study the given information, statement and conclusions carefully, and decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.
P # Q means P is greater than Q.
P $ Q means P is either greater than or equal to Q.
P = Q means P is smaller than Q.
Statement:
C $ E, F # C, D = E.
Conclusions:
I. C # D
II. E # D

options.en: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows

questions.explanation_en: Decode: C $ E means C ≥ E; F # C means F > C; D = E means D < E. Combining: F > C ≥ E > D. Conclusion I (C # D, i.e. C > D): since C ≥ E and E > D, C > D is definite — follows. Conclusion II (E # D, i.e. E > D): given directly — follows. Hence both conclusions follow.

questions.question_en: Four number-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.explanation_en: In each pair the second number is 4.5 times the first: 16 × 4.5 = 72, 24 × 4.5 = 108, 18 × 4.5 = 81. For 22, 22 × 4.5 = 99, but the pair gives 97, so 22 − 97 does not follow the pattern and is the odd one out.

questions.question_en:
What approximate value should come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?
23.87 ÷ 12.19 – 76.69 ÷ 29.89 × 17.37 = ?
questions.explanation_en: Round off the numbers: 23.87 ÷ 12.19 ≈ 24 ÷ 12 = 2; 76.69 ÷ 29.89 ≈ 77 ÷ 30 ≈ 2.57; 2.57 × 17.37 ≈ 44.6. As printed, 2 − 44.6 ≈ −43, which matches no option, so an operator has evidently been misprinted in the paper. The official key is 435; a form such as 23.87 × 17.37 + 12.19 … ≈ 415 + 12 + … lands near 435, so treat the official key as the reference. Note: question appears garbled; the method (round each number, then apply BODMAS) is what matters.

questions.question_en: In a row of a picture hall where all are facing north, Khalid is 25th from the left end and Kapil is 29th from the right end. They interchange their seats, and Sham who is sitting 34th from the left end is sitting at the 5th place to the left of Khalid new position. How many persons are there in one row of the picture hall?
questions.explanation_en: After the interchange, Khalid occupies Kapil's old seat, which is 29th from the right. Sham is 34th from the left and sits 5 places to the left of Khalid, so Khalid's new seat is 34 + 5 = 39th from the left. Total persons = (position from left) + (position from right) − 1 = 39 + 29 − 1 = 67.

questions.question_en: Four number-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.explanation_en: In every pair the second number is 3 times the first (13 × 3 = 39, 27 × 3 = 81, 23 × 3 = 69, 17 × 3 = 51), so the multiplication rule alone does not separate them. Look at the first numbers: 13, 23 and 17 are prime numbers, whereas 27 is composite (3 × 9). Hence 27 − 81 is the odd pair.

questions.question_en:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.
Statements:
A. Some dogs are goats.
B. All goats are peacocks.
C. All peacocks are eagles.
Conclusions:
I. Some peacocks are dogs.
II. All dogs are peacocks.
III. All eagles are peacocks.

options.en: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
All the conclusions, I, II and III, follow

questions.explanation_en: Draw the Venn picture: dogs partly overlap goats; goats sit entirely inside peacocks; peacocks sit entirely inside eagles. Conclusion I (some peacocks are dogs): the dogs that are goats are also peacocks — follows. Conclusion II (all dogs are peacocks): only some dogs are goats, so not definite — does not follow. Conclusion III (all eagles are peacocks): the statement is the reverse (all peacocks are eagles) — does not follow. Only I follows.

questions.question_en: In a row of 80 students, Ram is at the 15th position to the right of Rohit, who is at the 40th position from the right end. What will be the position of Ram from the left end?
questions.explanation_en: Rohit is 40th from the right in a row of 80, so from the left he is 80 − 40 + 1 = 41st. Ram is 15 places to his right (i.e. further from the left end), so Ram's position from the left = 41 + 15 = 56th.

questions.question_en:
If
P # Q means P is the brother of Q,
P @ Q means P is the father of Q, and
P & Q means P is the sister of Q,
then how is A related to E in the expression A # B @ C & D # E?
questions.explanation_en: Decode A # B @ C & D # E: A is the brother of B; B is the father of C; C is the sister of D; D is the brother of E. So B is the father of C, D and E (they are siblings). A is the brother of B, i.e. brother of E's father — A is E's paternal uncle.

questions.question_en:
AOPQRSTUVDEFMNWXBZGHIJKLYC
How many letters in the above string occupy the same position as they occupy in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation_en: Compare each letter's place in the string with its alphabet number. A is at position 1 (A = 1) ✓. M is at position 13 (M = 13) ✓, N at position 14 (N = 14) ✓, and Y at position 25 (Y = 25) ✓. No other letter matches (e.g. O at 2, D at 10, C at 26). So four letters — A, M, N, Y — occupy their natural alphabetical positions.

questions.question_en:
A statement is given, followed by two courses of action numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true, and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the suggested courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.
Statement:
False cases on dowry are on the increase in the last few years.
Courses of Action:
I. Government should instruct the local police administration to properly verify dowry complaints before registering an FIR.
II. Local police should take strict action on false cases of dowry.
questions.explanation_en: The problem is the rise in false dowry cases. Course I (proper verification of complaints before FIR) directly prevents false cases from being registered — it follows. Course II (strict action against those filing false cases) acts as a deterrent and is a practical, legal measure — it also follows. As both address the problem, the official key is that both I and II follow.

questions.question_en: A has a sum of ₹12,528, which is 16% more than what B has and 20% less than what C has. The amount that B and C together have is:
A varies directly as B and inversely as C. When B = 25 and C = 18, then A = 20. If B = 35 and C = 16, then what is the value of A?
6 years ago, the ratio of the ages (in years) of Renu and Raman was 5 : 11. After 6 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 11 : 17. What is the sum of their present ages (in years)?
questions.explanation_en: Let ages 6 years ago be 5x and 11x. Six years from now (12 years later) they are 5x + 12 and 11x + 12, and (5x + 12)/(11x + 12) = 11/17 gives 85x + 204 = 121x + 132, so x = 2. Present ages are 16 and 28, and their sum is 44.

questions.question_en: A man marks an article 60% above its cost price and sells it by giving two successive discounts of 25% and 5% on its marked price. What is his profit percentage?
questions.explanation_en: Let CP = 100, so MP = 160. After successive discounts of 25% and 5%: SP = 160 × 0.75 × 0.95 = 114. Profit = 114 − 100 = 14, i.e. 14%.

questions.question_en: The ratio of acid and water in solution A is 2 : 5 and the ratio of acid and water in solution B is 6 : 7. 7 L of A is mixed with 9 L of B. In 312 mL of the resulting solution, the quantity (in mL) of acid is:
questions.explanation_en: In 7 L of A (2 : 5), acid = 2 L. In 9 L of B (6 : 7), acid = 9 × 6/13 = 54/13 L. Total acid = 2 + 54/13 = 80/13 L in 16 L of mixture, so the acid fraction is 80/(13 × 16) = 5/13. Acid in 312 mL = 312 × 5/13 = 120 mL.

questions.question_en: If the 9-digit number 924x597y4 is divisible by 88, then the maximum possible value of (5x − 3y) is:
questions.explanation_en: 88 = 8 × 11. For 8, the last three digits 7y4 must be divisible by 8, so y = 0, 4 or 8 (704, 744, 784). For 11: (9+4+5+7+4) − (2+x+9+y) = 18 − x − y must be 0 or a multiple of 11, so x + y = 7 (x + y = 18 is impossible with valid digits). Pairs: (x, y) = (7, 0) gives 5x − 3y = 35; (3, 4) gives 3. Maximum = 35.

questions.question_en: By selling an article at 11/25 of its selling price, a shopkeeper loses 34%. If he sells it at 80% of its original selling price, then his profit percentage is:
questions.explanation_en: Selling at 11/25 of SP gives a 34% loss: (11/25)SP = 0.66 CP, so SP = 1.5 CP. Selling at 80% of SP gives 0.8 × 1.5 CP = 1.2 CP, i.e. a profit of 20%.

questions.question_en: A train passes two bridges of length 900 m and 420 m in 75 seconds and 50 seconds, respectively. The length (in m) of the train is:
questions.explanation_en: Speed is constant, so (L + 900)/75 = (L + 420)/50. Cross-multiplying: 50L + 45000 = 75L + 31500, so 25L = 13500 and L = 540 m.

questions.question_en: Pipe A can fill a tank in 20 hours and pipe B can empty the full tank in 40 hours. Both pipes were initially opened together for 30 hours, and then pipe B was closed and pipe A continued to fill the tank. In how much total time (in hours) was the tank filled completely?
questions.explanation_en: Net filling rate with both pipes open = 1/20 − 1/40 = 1/40 per hour, so in 30 hours 30/40 = 3/4 of the tank is filled. The remaining 1/4 is filled by A alone in (1/4) × 20 = 5 hours. Total time = 30 + 5 = 35 hours.

questions.question_en: A circle is inscribed in a square. Another circle concentric to this circle is drawn within the circle. The area of the ring formed by these two circles is 1540 cm^2 and the difference between their radii is 7 cm. What is the perimeter (in cm) of the square? (Use π = 22/7)
questions.explanation_en: Ring area = π(R² − r²) = 1540, so R² − r² = 1540 × 7/22 = 490. Since R − r = 7, R + r = 490/7 = 70, which gives R = 38.5 cm. The outer circle is inscribed in the square, so side = 2R = 77 cm and perimeter = 4 × 77 = 308 cm.

questions.question_en: An item is available for ₹1,600 cash or for ₹700 cash down payment, followed by three monthly instalments of ₹310 each. The rate of interest (simple) p.a. charged under the instalment plan is (approximate):
questions.explanation_en: Balance after down payment = 1600 − 700 = ₹900, repaid as 3 × 310 = ₹930. Equate amounts at the end of 3 months at r% p.a.: 900 + 900 × r × 3/1200 = 930 + 310 × r × (2 + 1)/1200. So 2700r − 930r = 36000, giving r = 36000/1770 ≈ 20.3%.

questions.question_en: A certain sum invested at simple interest for 3 1/2 years amounts to ₹6,747 and for 5 years amounts to ₹7,410 at the same rate per cent per annum. The rate of interest p.a. is:
Two solid metallic right circular cones of heights 31 cm and 53 cm and radii of their bases 21 cm each are melted and recast into a solid sphere. What is the surface area (in cm^2) of the sphere?
questions.explanation_en: Total volume of the cones = (1/3)π × 21² × (31 + 53) = (1/3)π × 441 × 84 = 12348π. Setting (4/3)πR³ = 12348π gives R³ = 9261, so R = 21 cm. Surface area of the sphere = 4πR² = 4π × 441 = 1764π cm².

questions.question_en: A can do a certain work in 14 days. B is 33 1/3 % less efficient than A. Both started to work together, but A left the work 2 days before the completion of the work and B continued to work till the work was over. In how many days was the whole work completed?
questions.explanation_en: A does 1/14 per day. B is 33⅓% less efficient, so B does (2/3)(1/14) = 1/21 per day. Let total time be T: A works T − 2 days and B works T days. (T − 2)/14 + T/21 = 1 gives 3(T − 2) + 2T = 42, so 5T = 48 and T = 9.6 = 9 3/5 days.

questions.question_en: A and B start a business by investing their capitals in the ratio of 2/3 : 3/8. After 4 months, A reduced his capital by 50% and B increased his capital by one-third. What will be the share (in ₹ lakhs) of B in a total profit of ₹ 39 lakhs, after 1 year?
questions.explanation_en: Capital ratio 2/3 : 3/8 = 16 : 9. A: 16 × 4 + 8 × 8 = 128 (halved after 4 months). B: 9 × 4 + 12 × 8 = 132 (raised by one-third). Profit ratio = 128 : 132 = 32 : 33, so B's share = 39 × 33/65 = ₹19.8 lakh.

questions.question_en: When 1529, 2178 and 2886 are divided by the greatest number n, the remainder in each case is r. What is the value of (3n – 2r)?
questions.explanation_en: n is the HCF of the differences: 2178 − 1529 = 649 = 59 × 11 and 2886 − 2178 = 708 = 59 × 12, so n = 59. The remainder is r = 1529 − 59 × 25 = 54. So 3n − 2r = 177 − 108 = 69.

questions.question_en: A car travels for 45 minutes at a speed of 80 km/h, the next 40 minutes at s speed of 48 km/h and the next 35 minutes at a speed of x km/h. If his average speed for the whole journey is 72 1/4 km/h, then what is the value of x ?
questions.explanation_en: Distances: 80 × 45/60 = 60 km and 48 × 40/60 = 32 km, and the third part is 35x/60 = 7x/12 km. Total time = 120 min = 2 h, so total distance = 72.25 × 2 = 144.5 km. Then 92 + 7x/12 = 144.5, so 7x/12 = 52.5 and x = 90 km/h.

questions.question_en: वाक्य-विन्यास की दृष्टि से शुद्ध वाक्य का चयन करें।

options.en: पालन करती है जनता शासक की आज्ञा का।
शासक की आज्ञा का जनता पालन करती है।
जनता शासक की आज्ञा का पालन करती है।
जनता आज्ञा का पालन करती है शासक की।

questions.explanation_en: Standard Hindi word order is subject - object (with its modifiers) - verb. 'Janta shasak ki agya ka palan karti hai' follows this order; the others misplace the verb or object.
questions.explanation_hi: हिंदी वाक्य-विन्यास का सामान्य क्रम है - कर्ता + कर्म (विशेषण/संबंधवाचक सहित) + क्रिया। 'जनता शासक की आज्ञा का पालन करती है' में कर्ता 'जनता' पहले, कर्म 'शासक की आज्ञा का पालन' बीच में और क्रिया 'करती है' अंत में है, अतः विकल्प 3 शुद्ध है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से किस वाक्य का प्रथमपद अशुद्ध है?
questions.explanation_en: By visarga sandhi, nih + rog gives 'neerog' (the visarga drops before r and the preceding i becomes long), just like 'neeras'. So 'nirog' is the incorrect form; the other words are correctly spelt.
questions.explanation_hi: विसर्ग संधि के नियम से 'निः' के बाद 'र' आने पर विसर्ग लुप्त हो जाता है और पूर्व का ह्रस्व स्वर दीर्घ हो जाता है - निः + रोग = नीरोग (जैसे नीरस, नीरव)। अतः 'निरोग' अशुद्ध है; सशक्त, निर्दोष और अतीन्द्रिय शुद्ध हैं।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: दिए गए शब्दों में से 'समंजित' के विलोमार्थी शब्द की पहचान करें।
questions.explanation_en: 'Samanjit' means adjusted or harmonised; its opposite is formed by adding the negative prefix 'a-': 'asamanjit'. 'Samayojit' is a synonym, and 'manjit/amanjit' drop the 'sam' root.
questions.explanation_hi: 'समंजित' का अर्थ है - ठीक से मेल बिठाया हुआ, सुव्यवस्थित। इसका विलोम 'अ' उपसर्ग जोड़कर 'असमंजित' बनता है। 'समायोजित' इसका पर्यायवाची है, अतः विकल्प 4 सही है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: 'ओस का पानी होना' – अशुद्ध मुहावरे के रेखांकित शब्द को सही शब्द से बदलें।
questions.explanation_en: The correct idiom is 'os ka moti hona', meaning something short-lived or perishable, as a dew drop shines like a pearl but vanishes quickly. Hence the underlined word should be replaced with 'moti'.
questions.explanation_hi: सही मुहावरा है 'ओस का मोती होना', जिसका अर्थ है - क्षणभंगुर होना या शीघ्र नष्ट हो जाना। ओस की बूँद मोती-सी चमकती है पर जल्दी उड़ जाती है, अतः 'पानी' के स्थान पर 'मोती' शब्द उचित है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: 'भास्कर' शब्द के शुद्ध सन्धि-विच्छेद का चयन कीजिये।
questions.explanation_en: 'Bhaskar' is a visarga sandhi: bhaah + kar = bhaskar, where the visarga before 'k' changes to 's'. So the correct split is 'bhaah + kar' (option 3).
questions.explanation_hi: 'भास्कर' विसर्ग संधि का उदाहरण है - भाः + कर = भास्कर। यहाँ 'क' से पहले विसर्ग 'स्' में बदल गया है (जैसे नमः + कार = नमस्कार)। अतः शुद्ध संधि-विच्छेद 'भाः + कर' है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से उस वाक्य का चयन करें जिसका पदक्रम शुद्ध हो?

options.en: अंगद ने रावण से दो टूक बात कही कि मेरे पैर जमीन से हटा कर दिखाओ तो राम बिना सीता के वापस चले जायेंगे।
दो टूक कह देना ही होगा आज कि नचाना नाच ठीक नहीं तुम्हें।
वह घर जाता ही नहीं कैसी पट्टी मेरे बेटे को पढाई तुमने।
निनानवे के फेर में दोपहर को दतुअन करता है जेठामल तीसरे पहर को नाश्ता।

questions.explanation_en: Option 1 follows the normal Hindi order of subject (Angad ne) - indirect object (Ravan se) - object (do took baat) - verb (kahi), followed by a proper 'ki' clause. The other sentences jumble the order of subject, object and verb.
questions.explanation_hi: विकल्प 1 में कर्ता (अंगद ने), गौण कर्म (रावण से), कर्म (दो टूक बात) और क्रिया (कही) अपने सही क्रम में हैं तथा 'कि' से आश्रित उपवाक्य भी उचित स्थान पर है। अन्य वाक्यों में कर्ता, कर्म और क्रिया का क्रम बिगड़ा हुआ है, अतः विकल्प 1 का पदक्रम शुद्ध है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: 'उसको ______ पसंद है।' –उपयुक्त तत्सम शब्द चुनकर वाक्य पूर्ति करें।
questions.explanation_en: 'Lashun' is the Sanskrit (tatsam) form of the everyday word 'lahsun'. Harad (from hareetaki), haldi (from haridra) and heeng (from hingu) are tadbhav words, so option 2 is the tatsam word.
questions.explanation_hi: 'लशुन' संस्कृत का तत्सम शब्द है, जिसका तद्भव रूप 'लहसुन' है। हरड़ (हरीतकी), हल्दी (हरिद्रा) और हींग (हिंगु) तद्भव शब्द हैं। अतः रिक्त स्थान में तत्सम शब्द 'लशुन' उपयुक्त है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
'श्रद्धा एक सामजिक ______ है।'
उपयुक्त शब्द चुनकर, उपरोक्त वाक्य में रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें।
questions.explanation_en: Shraddha (reverence) is an emotion or feeling, and Acharya Ramchandra Shukla famously described it as a social emotion ('samajik bhav'). Prabhav (influence), pravanchana (deceit) and apradh (crime) do not fit the sense.
questions.explanation_hi: श्रद्धा एक मनोभाव है; आचार्य रामचंद्र शुक्ल ने अपने निबंध 'श्रद्धा-भक्ति' में इसे सामाजिक भाव कहा है। 'प्रभाव', 'प्रवंचना' (छल) और 'अपराध' अर्थ की दृष्टि से उपयुक्त नहीं हैं, अतः 'भाव' सही है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से 'तलवार' शब्द के पर्याय का चयन करें।
questions.explanation_en: 'Khang' (khadg) is a synonym of 'talwar' (sword), along with asi, kripan and chandrahas. Chaap means bow, keer means parrot and kumbhil means crocodile.
questions.explanation_hi: 'खंग' (खड्ग) 'तलवार' का पर्यायवाची है; अन्य पर्याय हैं - असि, कृपाण, करवाल, चन्द्रहास। 'चाप' धनुष का, 'कीर' तोते का और 'कुम्भिल' मगरमच्छ का पर्याय है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: 'पीछे-पीछे चलने वाला' – इस वाक्यांश के लिए उपयुक्त शब्द का चयन करें।
questions.explanation_en: 'Anugami' (anu = after, gami = one who goes) means one who follows or walks behind. Mitra is a friend and sahyatri a co-traveller; anuvarti suggests an obedient follower of rules, so 'anugami' fits best.
questions.explanation_hi: 'अनुगामी' (अनु = पीछे + गामी = चलने वाला) का अर्थ है पीछे-पीछे चलने वाला। 'मित्र' का अर्थ दोस्त और 'सहयात्री' का अर्थ साथ यात्रा करने वाला है, अतः विकल्प 1 सही है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: 'मुझे ______ नहीं मिला।' निम्न में से विदेशज शब्द चुनकर उक्त वाक्य को पूर्ण करें।
questions.explanation_en: 'Mauka' (opportunity) comes from Arabic, so it is a foreign-origin (videshaj) word. Saath is tadbhav, while darshan and samay are tatsam words of Sanskrit origin.
questions.explanation_hi: 'मौका' अरबी भाषा से आया शब्द है, अतः यह विदेशज शब्द है। 'साथ' तद्भव तथा 'दर्शन' और 'समय' संस्कृत के तत्सम शब्द हैं।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: 'विषधर – वह जो विष को धारण करता हो'- उक्त विग्रह किस समास के अनुसार किया गया है? पहचान करें।
questions.explanation_en: 'Vishdhar' literally means one who holds poison, but it refers to a third entity - the snake - so it is a bahuvrihi compound. In bahuvrihi neither member is primary; together they point to something else.
questions.explanation_hi: 'विषधर' का विग्रह 'विष को धारण करता है जो' अर्थात् साँप है। जब दोनों पद मिलकर किसी तीसरे (अन्य) अर्थ की ओर संकेत करें, तो बहुव्रीहि समास होता है; अतः विकल्प 2 सही है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: 'पहले पैदा होने वाला' - इस वाक्यांश के लिए उपयुक्त शब्द का चयन करें।
questions.explanation_en: 'Agraj' (agra = before, ja = born) means one born earlier, i.e. an elder brother. Anuj is the younger one, purvaj means ancestor, and purvagami means one who went before.
questions.explanation_hi: 'अग्रज' (अग्र = पहले + ज = जन्मा) का अर्थ है पहले पैदा होने वाला, अर्थात् बड़ा भाई। 'अनुज' बाद में जन्मा, 'पूर्वज' पुरखे और 'पूर्वगामी' पहले जाने वाला होता है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
'सो सुन्दर मादक मदिरा सी।
खंजन-दृग सुख-प्रद प्रभुता सी।।'
उक्त पंक्तियाँ, निम्न में से किस अलंकार का उदाहरण हैं?
questions.explanation_en: The lines have a simile ('madira si', 'prabhuta si') which is an arthalankar, and also the repetition of sounds like 'm' and 's' (anupras), which is a shabdalankar. Since both types are present, it is an ubhayalankar.
questions.explanation_hi: इन पंक्तियों में 'मदिरा सी', 'प्रभुता सी' में उपमा (अर्थालंकार) है और 'म', 'स' वर्णों की आवृत्ति से अनुप्रास (शब्दालंकार) भी है। जहाँ शब्द और अर्थ दोनों के अलंकार एक साथ हों, वहाँ उभयालंकार होता है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
उपयुक्त विशेषण शब्द चुनकर निम्न वाक्य को पूर्ण करें।
'______ चिथड़े लपेटे रहो।'
questions.explanation_en: Rags (chithde) are naturally described as torn and old, so 'phate-purane' is the apt adjective. The other pairs (proper-improper, new-old, front-back) do not suit rags.
questions.explanation_hi: 'चिथड़े' फटे हुए पुराने कपड़ों को कहते हैं, अतः उनके लिए उपयुक्त विशेषण 'फटे-पुराने' है। अन्य विशेषण-युग्म अर्थ की दृष्टि से संगत नहीं हैं।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
Comprehension:
दिए गए गद्यांश को ध्यान से पढ़े और प्रश्न के उत्तर दें।

हिन्दी समीक्षकों में आचार्य रामचंद्र शुक्ल जी के बाद जिस आलोचक का नाम बड़े आदर से लिया जाता है वह हैं आचार्य नंददुलारे वाजपेई। उन्होंने छायावादी काव्य की विस्तृत समीक्षा करते हुए इस काव्यधारा को प्रतिष्ठित कराने में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान किया। उनके द्वारा रचित कुछ महत्वपूर्ण काव्य ग्रंथ हैं- आधुनिक साहित्य, नया साहित्य - नए प्रश्न, कवि निराला, प्रकीर्णिका तथा राष्ट्रीय साहित्य। वे काव्य में सौंदर्य विधायक तत्वों के उद्घाटन पर विशेष बल देते हैं। कथा साहित्य और नाटक की आलोचना वह इनके प्रभावकारी पक्ष को ध्यान में रखकर करते हैं। प्रसाद जी के नाटकों को वे स्वच्छंदतावादी तथा लक्ष्मीनारायण मिश्र के नाटकों को पुनरुत्थानवादी कहना उपयुक्त मानते हैं। वे मूलतः छायावादी एवं स्वच्छंदतावादी समीक्षक के रूप में हिन्दी समीक्षा में प्रतिष्ठित हुए हैं। दूसरी ओर हजारी प्रसाद द्विवेदी शुक्ल परंपरा के समीक्षक हैं, किंतु शुक्लजी की कई मान्यताओं से सहमत नहीं हैं। वे कबीर को एक उच्च कोटि का कवि और समाज सुधारक मानते हैं। कबीर की भाषा की शक्ति पर विचार करते हुए वे उन्हें 'वाणी का डिक्टेटर' कहते हैं। हिन्दी साहित्य की भूमिका, नाथ संप्रदाय, हिन्दी साहित्य, सूर साहित्य, कबीर आदि कृतियाँ उनके गंभीर चिंतन, मौलिक विवेचन को उजागर करती हैं। उनका दृष्टिकोण मानवतावादी अधिक है। मध्यकालीन धर्म साधना और तद्युगीन साहित्य का विश्लेषण करने में उन्हें विशेष सफलता प्राप्त हुई है।

SubQuestion No : 16
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द 'आलोचना' का पर्यायवाची नहीं है?
questions.explanation_en: Aalochana (criticism) has synonyms such as samiksha, mimansa and nirupan (critical analysis). 'Kathopakathan' means dialogue or conversation, so it is not a synonym.
questions.explanation_hi: 'आलोचना' के पर्याय हैं - समीक्षा, मीमांसा, निरूपण, विवेचन। 'कथोपकथन' का अर्थ है संवाद या वार्तालाप, अतः यह आलोचना का पर्यायवाची नहीं है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
Comprehension:
दिए गए गद्यांश को ध्यान से पढ़े और प्रश्न के उत्तर दें।

हिन्दी समीक्षकों में आचार्य रामचंद्र शुक्ल जी के बाद जिस आलोचक का नाम बड़े आदर से लिया जाता है वह हैं आचार्य नंददुलारे वाजपेई। उन्होंने छायावादी काव्य की विस्तृत समीक्षा करते हुए इस काव्यधारा को प्रतिष्ठित कराने में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान किया। उनके द्वारा रचित कुछ महत्वपूर्ण काव्य ग्रंथ हैं- आधुनिक साहित्य, नया साहित्य - नए प्रश्न, कवि निराला, प्रकीर्णिका तथा राष्ट्रीय साहित्य। वे काव्य में सौंदर्य विधायक तत्वों के उद्घाटन पर विशेष बल देते हैं। कथा साहित्य और नाटक की आलोचना वह इनके प्रभावकारी पक्ष को ध्यान में रखकर करते हैं। प्रसाद जी के नाटकों को वे स्वच्छंदतावादी तथा लक्ष्मीनारायण मिश्र के नाटकों को पुनरुत्थानवादी कहना उपयुक्त मानते हैं। वे मूलतः छायावादी एवं स्वच्छंदतावादी समीक्षक के रूप में हिन्दी समीक्षा में प्रतिष्ठित हुए हैं। दूसरी ओर हजारी प्रसाद द्विवेदी शुक्ल परंपरा के समीक्षक हैं, किंतु शुक्लजी की कई मान्यताओं से सहमत नहीं हैं। वे कबीर को एक उच्च कोटि का कवि और समाज सुधारक मानते हैं। कबीर की भाषा की शक्ति पर विचार करते हुए वे उन्हें 'वाणी का डिक्टेटर' कहते हैं। हिन्दी साहित्य की भूमिका, नाथ संप्रदाय, हिन्दी साहित्य, सूर साहित्य, कबीर आदि कृतियाँ उनके गंभीर चिंतन, मौलिक विवेचन को उजागर करती हैं। उनका दृष्टिकोण मानवतावादी अधिक है। मध्यकालीन धर्म साधना और तद्युगीन साहित्य का विश्लेषण करने में उन्हें विशेष सफलता प्राप्त हुई है।

गद्यांश के अनुसार नन्दुलारे वाजपेयी किस वर्ग के आलोचक हैं?
questions.explanation_en: The passage says Vajpeyi reviewed Chhayavadi poetry in detail and helped establish it, and calls him basically a Chhayavadi and romantic critic. So he was a supporter of Chhayavad.

questions.question_en: Select the option that contains no spelling error.

options.en: The horrizontal movements of ocean water are refferred to as currents, while the vertical changes are called upwelling or downwelling.
The horizontal movements of ocean water are refered to as currents, while the vertical changes are called upwelling or downwelling.

The horrizontal movements of ocean water are referred to as currents, while the vertical changes are called upwelling or downwelling.

source.section_printed: Test of English Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given proverb.
You can't have your cake and eat it too

options.en: Not to worry much about trivial matters
Encourage people to achieve at least one goal, if not two
To do two things that are similar to each other
Unable to do two things that are contradictory to each other

questions.explanation_en: 'You can't have your cake and eat it too' means you cannot enjoy two mutually contradictory advantages at once - once the cake is eaten, you no longer have it. Hence option 4, being unable to do two contradictory things, is the correct meaning.

source.section_printed: Test of English Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
1) Travellers should, however, realise that change cannot be brought by a single person, and we should join hands together and vow to follow the traffic rules.
2) Eight out of ten road accidents are caused by the people who don't follow the rules of the road.
3) Abiding by the traffic rules will only help us in having a smooth traffic flow and preventing road accidents.
4) Road safety rules are meant for public safety and to keep the traffic congestion in check.
questions.explanation_en: Sentence 4 introduces the topic (road safety rules), 2 gives the statistic on rule-breakers causing accidents, 1 adds 'however' that change needs collective effort, and 3 concludes with the benefit of following rules. So the order 4-2-1-3 (option 3) is coherent.

source.section_printed: Test of English Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word/ set of given words.
Garima has a propensity for being the attention seeker in the department.
She's inherited from her father a propensity to talk too much
questions.explanation_en: 'Propensity' means a natural tendency or inclination to behave in a certain way. Its opposite is 'disinclination' (unwillingness); aptness and disposition are near-synonyms and competence is unrelated.

source.section_printed: Test of English Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
One who believes in ruthless self-aggrandisement
questions.explanation_en: An egoist is a self-centred person who pursues his own interest and self-aggrandisement (enlarging his own power or importance). An altruist is the opposite, an introvert is shy, and an iconoclast attacks established beliefs, so 'Egoist' fits.

source.section_printed: Test of English Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The ideal detect dog / is extremely energetic / with an excessive / play drive.
questions.explanation_en: A noun used as a modifier here must be 'detection', not the verb 'detect': the correct phrase is 'The ideal detection dog'. The other segments ('is extremely energetic', 'with an excessive play drive') are grammatical, so segment 1 has the error.

source.section_printed: Test of English Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.
Barely has they won the match when the coach had a heart attack.
questions.explanation_en: 'Barely/Hardly/Scarcely ... when' expresses one past action immediately followed by another, so it takes the past perfect with inversion: 'Barely had they won the match when...'. 'Has' is wrong for a past context and 'did ... won' is ungrammatical, so option 4 is correct.

source.section_printed: Test of English Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The sparrows are / some of the few birds / that engage on / dust bathing.
questions.explanation_en: The verb 'engage' takes the preposition 'in' when it means to take part in an activity: 'engage in dust bathing'. 'Engage on' is incorrect, so segment 4 contains the error.

source.section_printed: Test of English Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank with the correct collocation.
If you read _____ you will clearly see what he means.
questions.explanation_en: 'Read between the lines' is a fixed collocation meaning to understand the hidden or implied meaning. The other prepositions do not form this idiom, so option 4 is correct.

Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.
No sooner had the company launch its new product than it went bankrupt.

options.en: No sooner had the company launched
No sooner did the company launched
No sooner have the company launched

questions.explanation_en: 'No sooner ... than' is followed by the past perfect with subject-auxiliary inversion: 'No sooner had + subject + V3'. So 'had the company launch' must become 'had the company launched' (option 2); 'did ... launched' and 'have the company' are ungrammatical.

Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
Blow off steam

options.en: To get rid of pent-up energy or strong emotion

questions.explanation_en: 'Blow off steam' means to release pent-up energy or strong emotions such as anger, often through activity. Option 2 states exactly this idiomatic sense.

questions.question_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
1) As one starts growing old, the lens of the eye hardens, loses its transparency and becomes opaque.
2) Cataract is the major cause of blindness, which is also caused by a damage to the cornea.
3) It obstructs the light rays from entering the eye.
4) It occurs more often in old age.
questions.explanation_en: Sentence 2 introduces cataract as a major cause of blindness, 4 says it occurs more often in old age, 1 explains that the eye lens hardens and becomes opaque with ageing, and 3 says this blocks light rays. Hence 2-4-1-3 (option 2).

Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
Study of various aspects of aging
questions.explanation_en: Gerontology is the scientific study of ageing and of the problems of old people (Greek geron = old man). Chronology is the order of events, genealogy the study of family lineage, and microbiology the study of microbes.

questions.explanation_en: 'Waves' fits both blanks with different meanings: 'she waves her hands' (verb: moves in greeting) and 'the huge waves of ocean' (noun: moving ridges of water). The other words do not suit both blanks.

questions.question_en:
Comprehension:
Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

When I was very little, I caught the travel bug. It started after my grandparents first brought me to their home in France and I have now been to twenty-nine different countries. Each has given me a unique learning experience.

At five, I marvelled at the Eiffel Tower in the City of Lights. When I was eight, I stood in the heart of Piazza San Marco feeding hordes of pigeons, then glided down Venetian waterways on sleek gondolas. At thirteen, I saw the ancient, megalithic structure of Stonehenge and walked along the Great Wall of China, amazed that the thousand-year-old stones were still in place.

It was through exploring cultures around the world that I first became interested in language.

It began with French, which taught me the importance of pronunciation. I remember once asking a store owner in Paris where Rue des Pyramides was. But when I pronounced it PYR–a–mides instead of pyr–A–mides, with more accent on the A, she looked at me bewildered.

In the eighth grade, I became fascinated with Spanish and aware of its similarities with English through cognates. Baseball in Spanish, for example, is béisbol, which looks different but sounds nearly the same. This was incredible to me as it made speech and comprehension more fluid, and even today I find that cognates come to the rescue when I forget how to say something in Spanish.

Then, in high school, I developed an enthusiasm for Chinese. As I studied Chinese at my school, I marvelled how if just one stroke was missing from a character, the meaning is lost. I loved how long words were formed by combining simpler characters, so Huǒ meaning fire and Shān meaning mountain can be joined to create Huǒshān, which means volcano. I love spending hours at a time practicing the characters and I can feel the beauty and rhythm as I form them.

SubQuestion No : 16
Identify the tone of the given passage.
questions.explanation_en: The writer narrates personal experiences in chronological order and describes places and languages in detail, without sadness or pretence. Hence the tone is narrative and descriptive (option 3).

The author was fascinated by which of the following when he was thirteen?
