questions.question_en: _____ does NOT have any child ClassLoaders.
questions.explanation_en: Java's class loaders form a parent-child chain: Bootstrap (also called Primordial) is the parent of the Extension loader, and Extension is the parent of the System (Application) class loader. The System ClassLoader sits at the bottom of the built-in chain, so it has no child loaders of its own. Bootstrap/Primordial is the root, so it does have a child (Extension).

questions.question_en: The lowest cost solution to developing a KM system is:
questions.explanation_en: Per standard KM texts (Awad & Ghaziri), in-house development uses the organisation's existing IT staff, tools and knowledge of its own processes, so no vendor licence, consultancy or customisation fees are paid; this is treated as the lowest-cost route. An off-the-shelf solution looks cheap but adds licence cost plus the expense of adapting a generic product, while outsourcing pays an external firm's margin. End-user development is cheap to start but usually yields poorly integrated systems.

questions.question_en: _____ is a set of interrelated components that collect (or retrieve), process, store and distribute information to support decision-making and control in an organisation.

options.en: Mini model of a processed system
Max model of a processed system

questions.explanation_en: An information system is a set of interrelated components (people, hardware, software, data, procedures) that collect, process, store and distribute information to support decision-making and control in an organisation. Information technology is only the hardware/software part of such a system, not the complete set of components. The 'mini/max model' options are not standard terms.

questions.question_en: Which of the following services is NOT provided by the operating system?
questions.explanation_en: An operating system provides services such as program execution, resource management, I/O, file handling and inter-process communication. Translating source code into machine code is done by a compiler/interpreter (a language processor), not by the OS. Hence option 3 is the service the OS does NOT provide.

questions.question_en: How to write the dot net server control?
questions.explanation_en: An ASP.NET server control is written as <asp:ControlType ID="..." runat="server" .../>. The runat="server" attribute tells ASP.NET to process the control on the server instead of sending it to the browser as plain HTML. 'runin', 'runas' and 'run' are not valid attributes.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a type of computer architecture?
questions.explanation_en: Computer (hardware) architecture is classified into types such as Instruction Set Architecture (ISA), micro-architecture (implementation of the ISA), Harvard and von Neumann architectures. Software architecture describes the high-level structure of a software system and belongs to software engineering, not computer hardware architecture.

questions.question_en: A network on the internet has a subnet mask of 255.255.240.0. What is the maximum number of hosts it can handle?
questions.explanation_en: The mask 255.255.240.0 has 20 one-bits (8+8+4), which leaves 32 - 20 = 12 host bits. Usable hosts = 2^12 - 2 = 4096 - 2 = 4094, because the all-zeros (network) and all-ones (broadcast) addresses cannot be given to hosts. 2048 or 1024 would come from using too few host bits.

questions.question_en: Which of the following statements is true?

options.en: Circuit setup is not required in both a datagram network and virtual-circuit network.
Circuit setup is required in both a datagram network and virtual-circuit network.
Circuit setup is required in a virtual-circuit network.
Circuit setup is required in a datagram network.

questions.explanation_en: A virtual-circuit network (connection-oriented) must set up a path before data transfer and tear it down afterwards. A datagram network is connectionless: each packet is routed independently and no setup phase is needed. So only option 3 is true; option 2 is wrong because datagram networks need no setup.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a risk management methodology?
questions.explanation_en: The standard ways of handling a risk are avoidance, transfer (for example insurance or outsourcing), mitigation/reduction and acceptance. 'Risk generation' is not a risk management method; creating risk is the opposite of managing it. Acceptance and avoidance are both valid strategies.

questions.question_en: The decimal equivalent of the binary number 111111 is:
questions.explanation_en: 111111 in binary = 32+16+8+4+2+1 = 63 (equivalently 2^6 - 1 = 63). None of the other values matches this positional sum.

questions.question_en: DSS is a computer program application used to improve a company's _____ capabilities.
questions.explanation_en: A Decision Support System (DSS) is an interactive computer system that analyses data and models to help managers make better decisions. Its main job is to improve decision-making, not marketing, delegation or resource utilisation, even though better decisions can help those areas too.

questions.question_en: _____ is a code that consists of CPU and platform-independent set of instructions, which can be easily converted to the native code.
questions.explanation_en: In .NET, source code is compiled into MSIL (Microsoft Intermediate Language), a CPU- and platform-independent instruction set. At run time the JIT compiler converts MSIL into native machine code. JIT is the converter, not the code itself, so MSIL is the answer.

questions.question_en: CMM stands for:
questions.explanation_en: CMM stands for Capability Maturity Model, developed by SEI (Carnegie Mellon). It rates an organisation's software process on five maturity levels: Initial, Repeatable, Defined, Managed and Optimizing. The other expansions are made-up combinations of these words.

questions.question_en: Marginal revenue is calculated by _____.

options.en: dividing the change in total output quantity by the change in total revenue
dividing the change in total cost by the change in total output quantity
dividing the change in total revenue by the change in total output quantity
dividing the change in total revenue by the change in total profit

questions.explanation_en: Marginal revenue is the additional revenue from selling one more unit: MR = ΔTR / ΔQ, i.e. change in total revenue divided by change in output quantity. Option 2 (ΔTC/ΔQ) is marginal cost, and option 1 is the inverted ratio.

questions.question_en: Which of the following statements is FALSE?

options.en: Burst Time: Time required by a process to start its execution
Turn Around Time: Time difference between the completion time and arrival time
Completion Time: Time at which a process completes its execution
Arrival Time: Time at which a process arrives in the ready queue

questions.explanation_en: Burst time is the CPU time a process needs to finish its execution, not the time it takes to start. So statement 1 is false. The other definitions are correct: TAT = Completion time - Arrival time, Completion time is when the process finishes, and Arrival time is when it enters the ready queue.

questions.question_en: In C++ language, the instruction 'ignore(x,y);' _______ .

options.en: skips the last x characters and stops if character y is encountered
skips the first y characters and stops if character x is encountered
skips the first x characters and stops if character y is encountered
skips the last y characters and stops if character x is encountered

questions.explanation_en: istream::ignore(n, delim) extracts and discards up to n characters from the input stream, stopping earlier if the delimiter character is encountered (the delimiter is also discarded). So ignore(x, y) skips the first x characters and stops at character y. It works on the next (first) characters in the stream, not the last ones.

questions.question_en: Page fault means:

options.en: accessing the page that is not currently in the memory
removing the page whenever it is needed
fetching the page whenever it is needed
an error that always occurs in the page

questions.explanation_en: A page fault happens when a program refers to a page that is not currently in main memory, so the OS must bring it in from disk. Fetching the page is the OS's response to the fault, not the fault itself. It is a normal event, not an error that always occurs.

questions.question_en: Any account or goods used by the owner of the business for his personal use is called as:
questions.explanation_en: Cash or goods withdrawn by the proprietor for personal use are recorded as Drawings, which reduce the owner's capital. They are not business expenses, because they do not help earn revenue for the business.

questions.question_en: Which of the following parameters is used to create a hyperlink in HTML?
questions.explanation_en: A hyperlink is made with the anchor tag and its href attribute, for example Link. href (hypertext reference) holds the destination URL. 'url', 'link' and 'path' are not attributes of the tag.

questions.question_en: Select the true statement about try-catch blocks.

options.en: A try block must have at least 1 catch to have a finally block.
A try block must have only 1 finally block for each catch block.
A try block can have many catches but only 1 finally block.
A try block can have many catches and many finally blocks.

questions.explanation_en: A try block may be followed by multiple catch blocks (one per exception type) but at most one finally block. Option 1 is false because try-finally without any catch is legal, and options 2 and 4 wrongly allow multiple finally blocks.

questions.question_en: A four-way set-associative cache memory unit with a capacity of 32 KB is built using a block size of 1 K. The word length is 8 bits. The size of physical address space is 32 GB. The number of bits for the TAG field is:
questions.explanation_en: The physical address space is 32 GB = 2^35 bytes, and since a word is 8 bits each byte is addressable, so the address is 35 bits. Block = 1 KB = 2^10, so offset = 10 bits. Lines = 32 KB / 1 KB = 32, and with 4-way sets there are 32/4 = 8 sets, so set index = 3 bits. Tag = 35 - 10 - 3 = 22 bits.

questions.question_en: Which of the following statements is true?

options.en: POST is the process performed by BIOS immediately after the system is shutdown.
The bootstrap program is stored in RAM.
CMOS chip is powered by the battery located in the mother board.
BIOS was developed by Charles Babbage.

questions.explanation_en: The CMOS chip stores BIOS settings and the real-time clock and is kept powered by a small coin-cell battery on the motherboard. POST runs at start-up, not after shutdown; the bootstrap loader is stored in ROM, not RAM; and BIOS has nothing to do with Charles Babbage.

questions.question_en: A body of mass 4.9 kg hangs from a spring and oscillates with a period of 0.6 sec. How much will the spring shorten when the body is removed?
questions.explanation_en: For a spring-mass system T = 2*pi*sqrt(m/k), and the static stretch is x = mg/k. So x = g*T^2/(4*pi^2) = 9.8 x 0.36 / 39.48 = about 0.089 m. When the body is removed the spring shortens by this stretch. The mass value is not needed because it cancels out.

questions.question_en: Which of the following statements is NOT true?

options.en: etc: It contains other additional commands that are related to system maintenance and administration.
usr: It contains temporary files created by Linux or other users.
bin: It contains executable files for the UNIX commands.
dev: It contains device drivers that control various peripherals that are connected with the system.

questions.explanation_en: /usr holds user programs, libraries and documentation; temporary files are kept in /tmp. /bin holds essential executable commands, /dev holds device files, and /etc holds configuration/administration files. So the statement about usr is NOT true.

questions.question_en: Elasticity of demand explains the _____ of the correlation between price and quantity.
questions.explanation_en: Price elasticity of demand measures the degree (how much) quantity demanded responds to a change in price, as % change in quantity divided by % change in price. It tells the strength of the relationship, not an 'angle' or 'level'.

questions.question_en: 'FORTRAN' stands for _____.
questions.explanation_en: FORTRAN stands for FORmula TRANslation, developed by John Backus's team at IBM (1957) for scientific and numeric computation. The other expansions are distractors.

questions.question_en: In a path-graph having 'n' vertices, where 'n' > 2, _____ is the number of vertices with degree 2.
questions.explanation_en: A path graph on n vertices is v1-v2-...-vn. The two end vertices have degree 1 and every inner vertex has degree 2, so n - 2 vertices have degree 2. The answer '2' is the number of vertices of degree 1, not degree 2.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a type of business?
questions.explanation_en: In knowledge management, businesses are categorised by what drives their value: expert-driven, experience-driven and efficiency-driven businesses. 'Expense driven' is not one of these categories, so it is the odd one out.

questions.question_en: The algebraic sum of deviations is zero when measured from the _____.
questions.explanation_en: A key property of the arithmetic mean is that the sum of deviations from it is zero: sum(x - mean) = sum(x) - n*mean = 0. The median minimises the sum of absolute deviations instead, and the geometric and harmonic means do not have this property.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT the application of Divide and Conquer?
questions.explanation_en: Binary search, quick sort and Strassen's matrix multiplication all split the problem into sub-problems and combine the results (divide and conquer). The all-pairs shortest path problem is solved by Floyd-Warshall, a dynamic programming algorithm, so it is not a divide-and-conquer application.

questions.question_en: The volume of the tetrahedron bounded by the surfaces x = 0, y = 0, z = 0 and x/a + y/b + z/c = 1 is:
questions.explanation_en: The plane x/a + y/b + z/c = 1 cuts the axes at a, b and c, forming a tetrahedron with three perpendicular edges a, b, c at the origin. Volume = (1/3) x base area x height = (1/3)(ab/2)c = abc/6. abc/2 would be a triangular prism, not a tetrahedron.

questions.question_en: Which of the following opens the linked document in the windows full body among the target values?
questions.explanation_en: target="_top" opens the linked document in the full body of the window, breaking out of all frames. _self opens in the same frame, _blank in a new window/tab, and _parent only in the immediate parent frame.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following is a conflict serializable schedule?
S1: R1(A); R1(B); R2(A); R2(B); W2(B); W1(A)
S2: R1(A); R2(A); R2(B); W2(B); R1(B); W1(A)

options.en: S1 is conflict serializable but S2 is not.
S1 is not conflict serializable but S2 is conflict serializable.

questions.explanation_en: Draw the precedence graph. In S1, R1(B) comes before W2(B), giving T1->T2, and R2(A) comes before W1(A), giving T2->T1. That is a cycle, so S1 is not conflict serializable. In S2, R2(A) before W1(A) and W2(B) before R1(B) both give T2->T1 and there is no edge back, so S2 is equivalent to the serial order T2, T1.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is the syntax to write an external CSS?
questions.explanation_en: An external stylesheet is attached in the <head> with <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="style.css">. The <style> tag is for internal CSS and has no href attribute, and <a> creates a hyperlink, not a stylesheet link.

questions.question_en: Which of the following methods is used to slide down an element?
questions.explanation_en: In jQuery, $(selector).slideDown(speed) shows a hidden element with a sliding-down animation, and slideUp()/slideToggle() are its partners. moveDown(), moveBelow() and slideBelow() are not jQuery methods.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a clipping algorithm?
questions.explanation_en: Liang-Barsky is a parametric line-clipping algorithm (like Cohen-Sutherland). Simple DDA, Bresenham's and the mid-point algorithm are scan-conversion algorithms used to draw lines/circles, not to clip them.

questions.question_en: According to the double entry system, every transaction will have _____ entries.
questions.explanation_en: In the double entry system every transaction affects two accounts: one is debited and the other is credited with the same amount. The option written as 'Debt and Credit' means Debit and Credit. Right and left only describe the sides of a ledger account, not the entries.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a default permission for the text file in Linux?
questions.explanation_en: A new regular file gets 666 masked by the usual umask 022, giving 644 = rw- r-- r--. Text files do not get execute permission by default, so rwx r-- r-- (744) is wrong.

questions.question_en: Which of the following statements is true about Home Location Register (HLR) and Visitor Location Register (VLR)?

options.en: VLR is not responsible for the MS (Mobile Station) to inform the MLR about location changes.
VLR is not responsible for the MS (Mobile Station) to inform the HLR about location changes.
VLR is responsible for the MS (Mobile Station) to inform the HLR about location changes.
HLR is responsible for the MS (Mobile Station) to inform the VLR about location changes.

questions.explanation_en: In GSM, the HLR is the permanent database of subscribers and the VLR holds temporary data for mobiles currently in its area. When a mobile station moves into a new area, the VLR updates the HLR about the new location. So the VLR is responsible for informing the HLR. Option 4 reverses the roles.

questions.question_en: An LED emits green light of wavelength λ = 5511.11 Å. Find the value of Eg.
questions.explanation_en: Eg = hc/λ. Using hc ≈ 12400 eV·Å, Eg = 12400 / 5511.11 ≈ 2.25 eV. Option 3 (3.606 eV) would correspond to about 3440 Å (ultraviolet), not green light.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT true about the Waterfall model?
questions.explanation_en: The Waterfall model is usually described as having a long duration, high risk (errors are found late) and low cost, because it is simple to plan and manage. So 'high cost' is the statement that is NOT true. High cost is a feature of models like Spiral, not Waterfall.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is the easiest to be transformed into a computer program?
questions.explanation_en: Pseudo-code is written in structured, programming-like statements (IF, WHILE, etc.), so it maps almost line-by-line to real code. An algorithm in plain prose or a flowchart needs more translation effort before coding.

questions.question_en:
Arrange the following in the order of growth.
O(n), O(n^2), O(2^n), O(log n), O(n log n), O(n^2 log n)

options.en: O(n), O(n^2), O(log n), O(2^n), O(n log n), O(n^2 log n)
O(n), O(2^n), O(2^n), O(log n), O(n^2 log n), O(n log n)
O(log n), O(n), O(n log n), O(n^2), O(n^2 log n), O(2^n)
O(n^2), O(n), O(2^n), O(log n), O(n log n), O(n^2 log n)

questions.explanation_en: For large n: log n < n < n log n < n^2 < n^2 log n < 2^n. Logarithmic grows slowest, polynomial terms grow next (multiplying by log n adds a little), and exponential 2^n eventually beats any polynomial. Only option 3 follows this order.

questions.question_en: How to change all images to black and white (100% grey)?
questions.explanation_en: The CSS filter property with the grayscale() function converts an image to grey: img { filter: grayscale(100%); }. There is no graycolor() function, and the value must not be quoted as a string (option 4).

questions.question_en: Grep command is used to:

options.en: search for a specific pattern from a specified file and display those lines containing the pattern
cut the columns/fields of a specified file
redirect the output of one command to another command

questions.explanation_en: grep (global regular expression print) searches a file for a pattern and prints the lines that match. Changing case is done by tr, cutting columns by cut, and sending one command's output to another by the pipe (|).

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT an XML Parser?
questions.explanation_en: DOM (tree-based), SAX (event-based) and JDOM (Java-oriented) are XML parsers/APIs. 'Shell' is a command interpreter, not an XML parser.

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT a parameter upon which the influence of lightning is based?
questions.explanation_en: In computer graphics, the lighting (illumination) at a point depends on the light source, the surface properties (normal, reflectivity) and the position of the observer (for specular highlights). The rendering algorithm only decides how that lighting is computed and drawn, so it is not a lighting parameter.

questions.question_en: Which of the following statements is NOT true?

options.en: 5 kilobytes is equal to 10,240 half bytes

questions.explanation_en: 1 KB = 1024 bytes, so 4 KB = 4096 bytes, not 4069; hence option 3 is NOT true. Checks: 5 KB = 5120 bytes = 10,240 nibbles (half bytes); 3 KB = 3072 × 8 = 24,576 bits; 2 KB = 2048 bytes = 4096 nibbles.

questions.question_en: What is the value of Δ^n e^(ax+b) ?
questions.explanation_en: With step h, delta e^(ax+b) = e^(a(x+h)+b) - e^(ax+b) = (e^(ah) - 1)e^(ax+b). Each further application multiplies by the same factor (e^(ah) - 1), so delta^n e^(ax+b) = (e^(ah) - 1)^n e^(ax+b). The exponent stays ax + b, so the options with ax - b are wrong.

questions.question_en: A Mod-6 counter and a Mod-8 counter in cascade give a _____ counter.
questions.explanation_en: When counters are cascaded, their moduli multiply: Mod-6 × Mod-8 = Mod-48 counter. Adding them (Mod-14) is the common mistake.

questions.question_en: A three-variable function (A ⊕ B ⊕ C)' = ?
questions.explanation_en: XNOR is the complement of XOR, so replacing one XOR with an XNOR complements the whole expression: A xor (B xnor C) = A xor (B xor C)' = (A xor B xor C)'. So option 4 gives the required function. Note: for an odd number of variables A xnor B xnor C equals A xor B xor C, so options 1 and 3 also simplify to the same function; the paper's key picks option 4 as the standard form.

questions.question_en: How to write the external DTD?
questions.explanation_en: An external DTD is referenced as <!DOCTYPE root-element SYSTEM "file-name">: the root element name comes first, then the keyword SYSTEM and the DTD file path. Options 1 and 3 omit or misplace the root element, and ROOT is not a DTD keyword.

questions.question_en: Consider the relation R (PQRSTU) with the set of functional dependencies F = {P → RT, Q → S, R → PS, QS → TU}. Find the closures of PQ.
questions.explanation_en: Start with PQ. P -> RT adds R and T, giving PQRT. R -> PS adds S (Q -> S also adds S), giving PQRST. Now QS -> TU adds U, giving PQRSTU. So the closure contains every attribute and PQ is a superkey. Option 1 stops before using QS -> TU.

questions.question_en: The values of x are 1, 3, 4 and those of f(x) are 1, 27, 64. What is the polynomial equation by using the Lagrange interpolation formula?
questions.explanation_en: Fit a quadratic through (1,1), (3,27), (4,64) using Lagrange's formula; simplifying gives f(x) = 8x^2 - 19x + 12. Check: x=1 gives 8-19+12 = 1; x=3 gives 72-57+12 = 27; x=4 gives 128-76+12 = 64. Option 3 (8x^2 - 9x + 12) gives 11 at x=1, so it fails.

questions.question_en: If two dice are thrown, find the probability that the sum is neither 5 nor 9?
questions.explanation_en: With two dice there are 36 outcomes. Sum 5 comes from (1,4),(2,3),(3,2),(4,1) = 4 ways, and sum 9 from (3,6),(4,5),(5,4),(6,3) = 4 ways. P(5 or 9) = 8/36 = 2/9, so P(neither) = 1 - 2/9 = 7/9. 5/9 would come from a counting mistake.

questions.question_en: The general solution of dy/dx = e^(x + y) is:
questions.explanation_en: dy/dx = e^x·e^y, so e^(-y) dy = e^x dx. Integrating: -e^(-y) = e^x + k, i.e. e^x + e^(-y) = c. Option 1 has the sign of e^(-x) wrong; differentiating it does not give back the original equation.

questions.question_en: What feature of the transport layer prevents data loss?
questions.explanation_en: Flow control (for example TCP's sliding window) stops a fast sender from overwhelming a slow receiver. Without it the receiver's buffer would overflow and data would be lost. Encryption gives confidentiality, and addressing and packet switching do not prevent loss.

questions.question_en: Descriptive attributes are used to:

options.en: record the information about participating entities

questions.explanation_en: Attributes attached to a relationship set (e.g. 'since' on works_for) are called descriptive attributes; they record information about the relationship itself, not about the participating entities. Information about entities is held by the entities' own attributes.

questions.question_en: Which of the following statements is FALSE about TCP (Transmission control protocol)?

options.en: It uses a three-way handshake to establish a connection.
It receives data from application as a single stream.

questions.explanation_en: TCP is a connection-oriented protocol: it sets up a connection with a three-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK) and treats application data as a byte stream. So the statement that it is connection-less is false. UDP is the connection-less transport protocol.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is FALSE about packages?

options.en: Packages are used to prevent naming conflicts.
Packages are used to prevent naming conflicts, and packages are considered data encapsulation.

questions.explanation_en: Packages DO provide controlled access through access modifiers (default/package-private and protected), so statement 1 is FALSE. Packages also prevent naming conflicts and support encapsulation by grouping related classes.

questions.question_en: Which of the following statements is true about slow start phase of the TCP congestion control?

options.en: Congestion window increases by 1 Maximum Segment Size every round trip time.
Congestion window approximately doubles every round trip time.
Congestion window increases by 2 Maximum Segment Size on every successful acknowledgement.
Congestion window approximately doubles on every successful acknowledgement.

questions.explanation_en: In slow start the congestion window grows by 1 MSS for every ACK received. Since a whole window's worth of ACKs arrives in one RTT, the window roughly doubles every round trip time (exponential growth). Option 1 (plus 1 MSS per RTT) describes congestion avoidance, which is linear growth.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT the purpose of knowledge management system?
questions.explanation_en: Knowledge management systems aim to drive strategy, integrate knowledge across the organisation, and enable sharing of knowledge to improve decisions and innovation. Portability is a software quality attribute (ability to run on different platforms), not a purpose of a KMS.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT true about software?

options.en: System software is written in a high-level language.
Application software is written in a high-level language.
System software plays a vital role for the effective functioning of a system.
System software is written in a low-level language.

questions.explanation_en: As per the classic textbook view, system software (OS, assemblers, drivers) is written in low-level language close to the hardware, while application software is written in high-level languages. So 'system software is written in a high-level language' is the statement that is NOT true here. Option 4 states the textbook view, so it is true.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a shell in Linux?
questions.explanation_en: Common UNIX/Linux shells are the Bourne shell (sh), C shell (csh), Korn shell (ksh) and Bourne-Again shell (bash). 'Alpha cell' is not a shell at all; it is a distractor.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is an example of the fifth-generation language?
questions.explanation_en: Fifth-generation languages solve problems by stating constraints and rules instead of writing step-by-step algorithms, and they are used in AI. Prolog (logic programming) is the standard example. Java and Python are third-generation (high-level procedural/OOP) languages, and COBOL is also 3GL.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a phase of the RAD model?
questions.explanation_en: The RAD model phases are business modelling, data modelling, process modelling, application generation, and testing & turnover. 'Development modelling' is not a phase of RAD.

questions.subtopic: Maths - Euler theorem for homogeneous functions
questions.question_en: If u = tan^(−1)(y/x), then x ∂u/∂x + y ∂u/∂y = ?
questions.explanation_en: u = tan^-1(y/x) is a function of y/x only, so it is homogeneous of degree 0. By Euler's theorem, x du/dx + y du/dy = n*u = 0. Directly: du/dx = -y/(x^2+y^2) and du/dy = x/(x^2+y^2), so x(-y) + y(x) = 0. sin 2u comes from a different function (like tan u homogeneous).

questions.question_en: Which of the following inflations describes how demand for goods and services can drive up their prices?
questions.explanation_en: Demand-pull inflation occurs when aggregate demand exceeds supply, pulling prices up. Cost-push inflation is caused by rising input costs (wages, raw materials), and built-in inflation comes from wage-price expectations. 'Demand-push' is not a standard term.

questions.question_en: Program links with other parts of the program in a flowchart are represented by _______.
questions.explanation_en: In a flowchart a small circle is the connector symbol. It joins parts of a flowchart that are far apart or on the same page without drawing long lines. Rectangles show processes, rhombuses (diamonds) show decisions, and parallelograms show input/output.

questions.question_en: _____ is the process of visiting different web sites on the internet hosted by various companies, organisations, educational institutions, magazines, individuals, etc.
questions.explanation_en: Web surfing (browsing) is moving from one website to another on the internet, usually by following hyperlinks. Searching means using a search engine to find specific information, and chatting is real-time messaging.

questions.question_en: The part of the firm's capital that is required for conducting day to day expenses is called:
questions.explanation_en: Working capital (current assets minus current liabilities) is the money a firm needs for daily operations such as wages, raw material and bills. Fixed capital is invested in long-term assets like land and machinery, so it is not used for day-to-day expenses.

questions.question_en: Who is the father of e-commerce in India?
questions.explanation_en: K. Vaitheeswaran, co-founder of Fabmall/Indiaplaza (1999), is widely called the father of e-commerce in India. Michael Aldrich invented online shopping in the UK (1979), so he is the father of e-commerce globally, not of Indian e-commerce.

questions.question_en: The advantage of SSTF (Shortest Seek Time First) is:

options.en: high variance of response time as SSTF favours only some requests
overhead to calculate seek time in advance

questions.explanation_en: SSTF always serves the request closest to the current head position, which reduces total head movement. So average response (seek) time decreases and throughput increases, which is its advantage. High variance (possible starvation) and the overhead of calculating seek times are its disadvantages.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is an addressing mode used in an instruction of the form ADD R1, [R2]?
questions.explanation_en: In ADD R1, [R2], the square brackets mean R2 holds the memory address of the operand, which is register indirect addressing. Plain register mode would use the contents of R2 itself as the operand (ADD R1, R2).

Integer and String are class names, not reserved keywords, so they can legally be used as variable names. The code prints the int 24 and then the char 'I' with print (no newline), so the output is 24I. There is no compiler error.

questions.question_en: An organisation structure establishes relationships between:
questions.explanation_en: An organisation structure defines authority and responsibility relationships among people, the work they do and the resources they use. The other options describe external relationships (environment, customers, society), which are not set by internal structure.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a symmetric-key cryptographic algorithm?
questions.explanation_en: RSA is an asymmetric (public-key) algorithm that uses a public key to encrypt and a private key to decrypt. AES and DES are symmetric block ciphers and RC4 is a symmetric stream cipher, so they all use the same secret key on both sides.

questions.question_en: _____ is a person who carries on business by himself/herself.
questions.explanation_en: A sole proprietorship is a business owned, managed and controlled by one person who bears all risks and profits. A partnership needs two or more persons and a cooperative is a voluntary association of members.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT true about NTFS?

options.en: It utilises the disk space efficiently by using a smaller size of clusters.
NTFS's attributes are read-only, hidden, system, archive, not content indexed, off-line, temporary and compressed.
It introduced improved performance, scalable in comparison with its precursor.
It does not support the compression of files and directories to optimise storage space.

questions.explanation_en: NTFS does support built-in compression of files and folders (and also encryption, ACLs and journaling). So the statement that it does not support compression is false. The other statements are true: it uses small clusters efficiently, has those attributes, and improved on FAT.

questions.question_en: The set of processes developed in an organisation to create, gather, store, transfer and apply knowledge best describes:
questions.explanation_en: Knowledge management is the set of processes to create, gather, store, transfer (share) and apply knowledge in an organisation. Organisational memory is only the stored knowledge, and a knowledge asset is the knowledge itself, not the processes.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is the execution engine for .NET applications and serves as the interface between .NET applications and the operating system.
questions.explanation_en: The Common Language Runtime (CLR) is the .NET execution engine. It loads managed code, compiles it with the JIT compiler, and handles memory (garbage collection), security and exceptions, acting between the application and the OS. FCL is the class library, and CTS/CLS are type and language rules, not runtimes.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a feature of ADO.net?
questions.explanation_en: Microsoft lists the key features of ADO.NET as interoperability (XML based), maintainability, programmability, performance and scalability. 'Reachability' is not one of them.

questions.question_en: Find the value of F = xy + x'z using distributive law.
questions.explanation_en: Apply distribution of OR over AND: xy + x'z = (xy + x')(xy + z) = (x + x')(y + x')(x + z)(y + z) = (x' + y)(x + z)(y + z). Since x + x' = 1, that factor drops out. The (y + z) term is the consensus term, so the product of sums still equals xy + x'z.

questions.question_en: The refractive index of the core of an optical fibre is greater than that of cladding because:

options.en: the light gets reflected at the entrance end of the optical fibre
the light gets totally internally reflected into the core
the light gets restricted at the entrance end of the optical fibre
the light gets refracted into cladding

questions.explanation_en: Light travels through an optical fibre by total internal reflection, which needs light to go from a denser medium (core) to a rarer medium (cladding) at more than the critical angle. Hence the core's refractive index is kept higher than the cladding's; option 4 is the opposite of what is desired.

questions.question_en: Which directive is used for binding the model data to the view?
questions.explanation_en: In AngularJS, ng-model binds the value of an input/select/textarea to a property on the scope (two-way data binding), so the view and the model stay in sync. ng-app starts the application, and 'ng-model-view', 'ng-model-app' and 'ng-app-model' do not exist.

questions.question_en: If μ is an averaging operator and δ^n is the n^th central difference operator, then what is the value of μ^2?
questions.explanation_en: μ = (E^(1/2) + E^(-1/2))/2 and δ = E^(1/2) - E^(-1/2). Then μ^2 = (E + 2 + E^(-1))/4 and δ^2 = E - 2 + E^(-1), so μ^2 = (δ^2 + 4)/4 = 1 + δ^2/4. The other options use wrong constants.

questions.question_en: For what minimum value of propagation delay in each FF will a 10-bit ripple counter skip a count when it is clocked at 10 MHz?
questions.explanation_en: At 10 MHz the clock period is 1/10 MHz = 100 ns. In a ripple counter the delays add up, so the total delay of 10 flip-flops is 10 x tpd. A count is missed when this delay reaches the clock period: 10 x tpd = 100 ns, so tpd = 10 ns. 100 ns would be the total delay, not the delay per flip-flop.

questions.question_en:
What are the solutions for the following sum of a subset problem?
w[1:5]={2,7,8,9,15}; Sum required = 17
1 means the item is included.
0 means the item is excluded.
questions.explanation_en: From {2,7,8,9,15} the subsets summing to 17 are {2,7,8} = 11100, {2,15} = 10001 and {8,9} = 00110. Option 1's 10101 = 2+8+15 = 25 and option 4's 00111 = 8+9+15 = 32, so they are wrong.

questions.question_en: Which of the following systems comprises word processing, electronic filing, electronic mail, message switching, data storage and data and voice communication?
questions.explanation_en: Office Automation Systems (OAS) help office work through word processing, electronic filing, e-mail, message switching, data storage and voice/data communication. DSS and ESS help managers make decisions, and CRM manages customer relationships.

questions.question_en: Who among the following is known as Lokhitwadi?
questions.explanation_en: Gopal Hari Deshmukh, the 19th-century Maharashtrian social reformer, wrote under the pen name 'Lokhitwadi' through his 'Shatapatre' letters on social reform. Hence option 2.

questions.question_en:
For preparing a unit plan, which of the following procedure is followed?
I. Formation of proper units and sub-units if not prescribed in the syllabus.
II. Determination of methods of assessment.
questions.explanation_en: A unit plan involves organising content into suitable units and sub-units (when the syllabus does not give them) and deciding the methods of assessment/evaluation for the unit. Both steps are part of the procedure, so option 1.

questions.question_en: David Kolb's model of learning style is based on which type of learning?
questions.explanation_en: David Kolb's learning-style model rests on his Experiential Learning Theory, a four-stage cycle of concrete experience, reflective observation, abstract conceptualisation and active experimentation. Hence experiential learning.

questions.question_en: Inconsistency in the development of different type of conservation is called _____.
questions.explanation_en: Piaget used 'horizontal decalage' for the uneven acquisition of conservation tasks - a child conserves number first, then mass, weight and volume later, though the same logic applies. So option 1.

questions.question_en: Heuristic method of teaching science was introduced by_____.
questions.explanation_en: The heuristic (discovery) method, in which the learner finds things out for himself, was introduced by H. E. Armstrong. The word comes from Greek 'heurisko', meaning 'I find out'.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following statement is correct regarding vision of new-born babies?
I. Neonates can discriminate between stationary black and white stripe which is 1/8 of an inch wide
II. By three months babies can see stripes as narrow as 64th of an inch wide
questions.explanation_en: Developmental research (Fantz and others) shows newborns can discriminate black-and-white stripes about 1/8 inch wide, and visual acuity improves rapidly so that around three months infants detect much narrower stripes (about 1/64 inch). Thus both statements are treated as correct.

questions.question_en: In the context of Parenting, which of the following is correctly matched?

options.en: Clearly communicating parent – Child being less liked
Power assertive parents – Coercive tactics in peer used by child
Parents being harsh – Unattractive social behavior of child
Give and take relationship of parents – Children show same relationship with peer

questions.explanation_en: Children model the relationships they experience at home: when parents maintain a reciprocal, give-and-take relationship, children show similar cooperative relationships with peers. The other pairings are mismatched (e.g. clear communication leads to well-liked children).

questions.question_en:
Broca's area and wernicke's area are concerned with language. These are the areas of _____.
I. right hemisphere of brain.
II. left hemisphere of brain.
questions.explanation_en: Broca's area (speech production) and Wernicke's area (language comprehension) are located in the left cerebral hemisphere in most people. Hence only statement II is correct.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following is NOT a Neo-Freudian Theory of Development?
I. Henry Stack Sullivan's Interpersonal Theory
II. Erik Erikson Theory of Psycho-social Development
questions.explanation_en: Neo-Freudians kept Freud's basic ideas but stressed social and cultural factors. Both Harry Stack Sullivan's interpersonal theory and Erik Erikson's psychosocial theory are neo-Freudian, so neither is 'not neo-Freudian' (option 3).

questions.question_en:
Participation in which of the following activities can enable the community to accept a teacher as one of them?
I. Problems of unhygienic conditions.
II. Problems of agriculture.
questions.explanation_en: A teacher who participates in solving the community's real problems - unhygienic conditions as well as agricultural problems - wins its trust and is accepted as one of them. Hence both I and II.

tests.title: DSSSB TGT CS Official Paper — 25 June 2023 (Shift 1)
tests.subject: Computer Science
tests.description: Official DSSSB question paper (194 text questions; figure-based questions removed). Official answer key applied.

questions.question_en: Which ministry has launched the Digital India Awards?

options.en: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

questions.explanation_en: The Digital India Awards are instituted by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), with the National e-Governance Division (NeGD) running them. They honour exemplary digital initiatives by government bodies at all levels.

questions.question_en: How many scientists were awarded the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award, 2021 for Science and Technology?
questions.explanation_en: The Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology 2021 was announced by CSIR for 11 scientists across seven disciplines. It is India's top multidisciplinary science award for scientists below 45, named after CSIR's founding director.

questions.question_en: Which of the following terms is used for the rate at which commercial banks borrow money by selling their securities to the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.explanation_en: The repo (repurchase) rate is the rate at which commercial banks borrow short-term funds from the RBI by selling government securities with an agreement to buy them back. The reverse repo rate is the opposite: the rate at which the RBI borrows from banks.

questions.question_en: Under whose rule were the southern kingdoms annexed to the Delhi Sultanate?
questions.explanation_en: The official key gives Mubarak Shah Khalji (1316–1320), during whose reign Devagiri (Yadava kingdom) was formally annexed to the Delhi Sultanate in 1318. Under Alauddin Khalji, southern kingdoms such as Devagiri, Warangal and Dwarasamudra had only been made to pay tribute, not annexed.

questions.question_en: Which of the following was set up by the Exim Bank and SIDBI in 2021 for identifying potential mid-sized and small companies as India's new champions in exports?
questions.explanation_en: The 'Ubharte Sitaare' Fund was set up by Exim Bank and SIDBI in 2021 to find and support mid-sized and small Indian companies that could become future export champions. It provides equity, debt and technical help to such firms.

questions.question_en: As of 2022, which of the following states has the highest number of assembly constituencies?
questions.explanation_en: Uttar Pradesh has the largest legislative assembly in India with 403 constituencies. Maharashtra has 288, Tamil Nadu 234 and Gujarat 182.

questions.question_en: What is the minimum age requirement, as prescribed by the Constitution, to become a member of a Panchayat?
questions.explanation_en: Under Article 243F, a person must be at least 21 years old to be chosen as a member of a Panchayat. This minimum age for Panchayat elections was introduced by the 73rd Amendment Act, 1992.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a vector borne disease?
questions.explanation_en: Malaria is a vector-borne disease: the Plasmodium parasite is spread by the bite of an infected female Anopheles mosquito. Diabetes and cancer are non-communicable diseases, and Covid-19 spreads directly through respiratory droplets.

questions.question_en: Who among the following won the Golden Boot award during the 2022 FIFA World Cup awards?
questions.explanation_en: France's Kylian Mbappé won the Golden Boot at the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar with 8 goals, including a hat-trick in the final. Lionel Messi won the Golden Ball and Emiliano Martínez the Golden Glove.

questions.question_en: The final match of Ranji Trophy, 2022 was played between which two teams?
questions.explanation_en: The 2022 Ranji Trophy final was played between Madhya Pradesh and Mumbai in Bengaluru. Madhya Pradesh won by 6 wickets to lift its first Ranji Trophy title.

questions.question_en: With reference to the constitutional provisions regarding Rajya Sabha, which of the following statements is correct?

options.en: The Attorney General of India is the ex-officio chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
The Prime Minister of India is the ex-officio chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
The President of India is the ex-officio chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

questions.explanation_en: Under Articles 64 and 89, the Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha. The Deputy Chairman is elected by the members of the House.

questions.question_en: Which of the following man-made objects was the first one to cross the heliosphere of our solar system?
questions.explanation_en: NASA's Voyager 1, launched in 1977, was the first man-made object to cross the heliopause into interstellar space, in August 2012. Voyager 2 followed in 2018.

questions.question_en: Which of the following aims to create a competent civil service, rooted in Indian ethos, with a shared understanding of India's priorities, working in harmonisation for effective and efficient public service delivery?
questions.explanation_en: Mission Karmayogi (the National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building), launched in 2020, aims to build a competent, citizen-centric civil service rooted in Indian ethos. It relies on online training through the iGOT Karmayogi platform.

questions.question_en: Who among the following is NOT amongst the Trinity of Carnatic music?
questions.explanation_en: The Trinity of Carnatic music is Tyagaraja, Muthuswami Dikshitar and Syama Sastri, all 18th–19th century composers from Thiruvarur. Tenali Raman was a poet and wit in the court of Vijayanagara ruler Krishnadevaraya, not a Carnatic composer.

questions.question_en: Who among the following planned to launch a military expedition to bring the Khurasan region under Delhi Sultanate's submission?
questions.explanation_en: Muhammad bin Tughluq planned an expedition to conquer Khurasan (in Central Asia) and raised a large army for it, but the plan was dropped and the army disbanded. It is often counted among his 'ambitious projects', along with shifting the capital to Daulatabad and issuing token currency.

questions.question_en:
The given pairs represent movements with the respective leaders. Which of these pairs is/are matched correctly?
i.Koya Rebellion - Tomma Dora
ii. Pabna Peasant Uprising - Bhagirath Manjhi
iii. Kharwar Uprising - Shambhunath Pal
questions.explanation_en: The Koya Rebellion (1879–80) in the Godavari hill tracts was led by Tomma Dora, so pair i is correct. The Kharwar uprising was led by Bhagirath Manjhi, and the Pabna peasant uprising (1873) by leaders like Ishan Chandra Roy, Shambhu Pal and Keshab Chandra Roy. Pairs ii and iii have their leaders swapped, so only i is matched correctly.

questions.question_en: The temples at Khajuraho, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, were built during the reign of which of the following dynasties?
questions.explanation_en: The Khajuraho group of temples (Madhya Pradesh) was built by the Chandela Rajputs, mainly between 950 and 1050 CE. They are famous for their Nagara-style architecture and intricate sculptures, and became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1986.

questions.question_en: Terms such as 'Pada Bheda', 'Chalis' and 'Bhramaris' are associated with the techniques of which of the following dance forms?
questions.explanation_en: 'Pada Bheda' (foot movements), 'Chalis' (gaits) and 'Bhramaris' (turns) are technical elements of Odissi, the classical dance of Odisha. Odissi is known for its tribhangi (three-bend) posture and the chowk stance.

questions.question_en: Which of the following Indian monuments is NOT a UNESCO World Heritage Site?
questions.explanation_en: The Charminar in Hyderabad (built in 1591 by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah) is not a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Red Fort Complex, Taj Mahal and Humayun's Tomb are all inscribed World Heritage Sites.

questions.question_en: In terms of power generation from renewable sources, which of the following sectors has the highest installed capacity in India as per the Annual Report, 2021-22 of the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Government of India?
questions.explanation_en: According to MNRE's Annual Report 2021-22, solar power had the largest installed renewable capacity in India (about 50 GW), ahead of wind (about 40 GW), bio-energy and small hydro. Solar overtook wind as the top renewable source around 2020.

questions.question_en:
If
A + B means A is the brother of B,
A − B means A is the sister of B and
A × B means A is the father of B,
then how is P related to S in the expression 'P × Q − R + S'?

options.en: P is the father of S
P is the son of S
P is the brother of S
P is the uncle of S

questions.explanation_en: P × Q: P is the father of Q. Q − R: Q is the sister of R. R + S: R is the brother of S. So Q, R and S are siblings, all children of P, which makes P the father of S.

questions.question_en:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.
Statement:
Health is the best wealth of an individual.
Conclusions:
I. People do not think too much about health while making efforts to earn.
II. Wealth is of no use without health.

options.en: Either conclusion I or II follows.

questions.explanation_en: The statement says health matters more than wealth. Such advice is usually given because people tend to neglect health while chasing money, so conclusion I is accepted as implied. Conclusion II goes too far: calling health the 'best' wealth does not mean wealth is of 'no use' without it. Hence only conclusion I follows (as per the official key).

questions.question_en:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?
105 ÷ 21 + 67 − 64 × 16 = 287
questions.explanation_en: Swap × and +: 105 ÷ 21 × 67 − 64 + 16. By BODMAS: 105 ÷ 21 = 5, then 5 × 67 = 335, then 335 − 64 + 16 = 287, which equals the right-hand side.

questions.question_en:
ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
If the 1st, 3rd, 5th, 8th, 12th, 15th and 18th letters of the English alphabet (given above) are chosen to form a meaningful word (name of a disease), which letter will come in the middle of all? Each letter must be used and only once.
questions.explanation_en: The chosen letters are A(1), C(3), E(5), H(8), L(12), O(15) and R(18). They form the disease name CHOLERA. The word has 7 letters, so the middle (4th) letter is L.

questions.question_en: Four letter-cluster pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.explanation_en: In options 1, 3 and 4 the letters change alternately by +2 and −1 (e.g. INSPIRING: I+2=K, N−1=M, S+2=U, P−1=O …; ABANDONED: A+2=C, B−1=A …). In CABALETTA : ABZBJFRUY the pattern is reversed, −2 and +1 (C−2=A, A+1=B, B−2=Z, A+1=B …). So option 2 is the odd one.

questions.question_en: Ramesh secured the 15th position from the top and is just 3 positions behind of his best friend Arvind in a class of 50 students. What will be the rank of Arvind from the bottom?
questions.explanation_en: Ramesh is 15th from the top and 3 places behind Arvind, so Arvind is 15 − 3 = 12th from the top. Rank from bottom = total − rank from top + 1 = 50 − 12 + 1 = 39th.

questions.question_en: Four number-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.explanation_en: In each pair the second number is 5 times the first: 55 × 5 = 275, 35 × 5 = 175 and 25 × 5 = 125. But 45 × 5 = 225, not 235, so 45-235 is the odd one.

questions.question_en:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.
37 * 42 * 21 * 37 * 67 * 44
questions.explanation_en: Try option 4: 37 + 42 ÷ 21 × 37 − 67 = 44. By BODMAS, 42 ÷ 21 = 2, then 2 × 37 = 74, then 37 + 74 − 67 = 44. Both sides are equal, so the sign sequence +, ÷, ×, −, = balances the equation.

questions.question_en:
A question is given followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.
Question: Who is the shortest of all?
Statements:
I. Sachin is taller than Mohan and shorter than Vipin.
II. Devika is shorter than Gangan.

options.en: Both the statements I and II are insufficient to answer the question.
Either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question.
Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question, while statement I alone is not sufficient to answer the question.
Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question, while statement II alone is not sufficient to answer the question.

questions.explanation_en: Statement I gives only Mohan < Sachin < Vipin. Statement II gives only Devika < Gangan. There is no link between the two groups, so even together they cannot tell us who is shortest of all. Both statements are insufficient.

questions.question_en:
Read the given statement and courses of action carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given courses of action logically follow(s) from the statement.
Statement:
In the last few years, the condition of roads in the state has continuously deteriorated.
Courses of Action:
I. State Government should take strict action against all the employees of Road Development Authority.
II. State Government should instruct Road Development Authorities to take regular inspection and necessary action to maintain roads.
questions.explanation_en: Course II is a practical step that tackles the problem through regular inspection and maintenance of roads. Course I is too harsh and unfair: punishing every employee without fixing responsibility is not a sensible remedy. So only II follows.

questions.question_en:
How many even numbers are immediately followed by an odd number but not immediately preceded by an even number in the following series?
3 4 3 2 5 6 7 4 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 6 5 4 3 2 2 4 5 6 7 8 9 9 7 6 0 7 6 5 4 3
questions.explanation_en: Scan each even number and check two things: the next number is odd and the previous number is not even. The qualifying ones are the 4 (2nd), 2 (4th), 6 (6th), 4 (8th), 4 (10th), 6 (12th), 8 (14th), 6 (16th), 4 (18th), 6 (24th), 8 (26th), 6 (33rd) and 4 (35th). Cases like '2 4 5' and '6 0 7' fail because the even number is preceded by an even number. Total = 13.

questions.question_en:
What approximate value should come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?
56.43 ÷ 27.89 − 67.78 + 98.19 × 13.67 = ?
questions.explanation_en: Round to the nearest whole numbers: 56 ÷ 28 − 68 + 98 × 14 = 2 − 68 + 1372 = 1306. (Exact working gives about 1276, and 1306 is still the nearest option.)

questions.question_en: In the early morning after sunrise, the football coach of Argentina is discussing the strategies for the next match with Messi on the ground such that the coach's shadow falls exactly in front of Messi. In which direction is Messi facing?
questions.explanation_en: Just after sunrise the sun is in the east, so shadows fall towards the west. The coach's shadow falls westward and lies in front of Messi, so Messi stands west of the coach and faces him, i.e. Messi faces East.

questions.question_en: There are six persons, P, Q, R, S, T and U. T is older than no one. S is older than P. Q is younger than P. U is older than T but younger than Q. S is older than R. Who is the third youngest among all?
questions.explanation_en: T is older than no one, so T is the youngest. U is older than T but younger than Q, so U is second youngest in the intended order. From S > P > Q and S > R, the order taken is S > R/P > Q > U > T, which makes Q the third youngest (as per the official key).

questions.question_en:
Select the option with the second term related to the first term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term in the given pair.
MATTER: BNUUSF
questions.explanation_en: MATTER: shift each letter +1 to get NBUUFS, then swap each pair of letters (NB→BN, UU→UU, FS→SF) to get BNUUSF. HOTELS +1 = IPUFMT; swapping pairs (IP→PI, UF→FU, MT→TM) gives PIFUTM.

questions.question_en: The ratio of spirit and water in solution A is 3 : 4, and the ratio of spirit and water in solution B is 5 : 9. Later, 5 L of A is mixed with 6 L of B. In 462 mL of the resulting solution, how much water (in mL) should be added so that the ratio of spirit and water in it becomes 1 : 2?
questions.explanation_en: In 5 L of A (3 : 4): spirit = 15/7 L, water = 20/7 L. In 6 L of B (5 : 9): spirit = 15/7 L, water = 27/7 L. The mix has spirit : water = 30 : 47 (total 77 parts). In 462 mL, spirit = 180 mL and water = 282 mL. For a 1 : 2 ratio, water must be 360 mL, so add 360 − 282 = 78 mL.

questions.question_en: When 3336, 4188 and 5679 are divided by a 2-digit number p, the remainder in each case is q. What is the value of (p – q)?
questions.explanation_en: p must divide the differences: 4188 − 3336 = 852 = 4 × 213 and 5679 − 4188 = 1491 = 7 × 213, so the HCF is 213 = 3 × 71. The only 2-digit divisor is p = 71. The remainder is q = 3336 − 71 × 46 = 70. So p − q = 71 − 70 = 1.

questions.question_en: A is 60% more than B. C is 55% more than the difference between A and B. If A is decreased by 40% and C is increased by 33 1/3 %, then C is what percentage more than A (correct to one decimal place)?

Study the following graph and answer the question.
[Line graph: Percent Profit (y-axis, 0-60) vs Year (2018-2021). Company A: 2018 = 30, 2019 = 40, 2020 = 55, 2021 = 35. Company B: 2018 = 45, 2019 = 50, 2020 = 35, 2021 = 44]
Percent profit = (Income − Expenditure)/Expenditure × 100
Profit = Income − Expenditure
In 2018, if the expenditure of the company B is ₹300 crores and the income of company A is 390 crores, then by what percentage was the profit of company B more than that of A in that year?
questions.explanation_en: Company B (2018): profit = 45% of the expenditure of ₹300 cr = ₹135 cr. Company A (2018): income = 1.30 × expenditure = 390, so expenditure = ₹300 cr and profit = ₹90 cr. B's profit is more than A's by (135 − 90)/90 × 100 = 50%.

questions.question_en: The volume of a right circular cylinder of height 32 cm and base diameter 36 cm is equal to the volume of a right circular cone of height 24 cm. What is the curved surface area (in cm^2) of the cone?
questions.explanation_en: Cylinder volume = π × 18² × 32 = 10368π. For the cone, (1/3)πr² × 24 = 10368π gives r² = 1296, so r = 36 cm. Slant height l = √(36² + 24²) = √1872 = 12√13. Curved surface area = πrl = π × 36 × 12√13 = 432√13π cm².

questions.question_en: P varies directly as Q and inversely as R. When Q = 2.7 and R = 1.6, then P = 4.5. What is the value of R when P = 6 and Q = 15?
When Savita sells 46 articles for ₹2,070, she suffers a loss of 10%. To earn a profit of 20%, she should sell 46 articles for:
questions.explanation_en: A 10% loss means ₹2,070 = 90% of CP, so CP of the 46 articles = ₹2,300. For a 20% profit, SP = 1.2 × 2300 = ₹2,760.

questions.question_en: An article is sold for ₹1,683 after giving three successive discounts of x %, 10% and 12% on its marked price of ₹2,500. If a single discount of 3x % is given on the same marked price, then the selling price (in ₹) of the article will be:
What is the area (in cm^2) of a circle that circumscribes a triangle with sides 28 cm, 45 cm and 53 cm?
questions.explanation_en: 28² + 45² = 784 + 2025 = 2809 = 53², so the triangle is right-angled. The circumcircle of a right triangle has the hypotenuse as its diameter, so R = 53/2 = 26.5 cm. Area = π × 26.5² = 702.25π cm².

questions.question_en:
Study the following table and answer the question.
Production and Export of cement by companies A and B from 2017 to 2020 (in million tonnes)
Year | A Production | A Export | B Production | B Export
2017 | 250 | 170 | 320 | 190
2018 | 340 | 275 | 360 | 280
2019 | 370 | 220 | 425 | 320
2020 | 450 | 245 | 470 | 275
The total export of cement by both the companies in 2017 and 2019 is what percentage less than the total production of cement by the two companies in 2018 and 2020 (correct to one decimal place)?

A man covers a distance of 180 km at a speed of 45 km/h, the next 150 km at a speed of 50 km/h and the next 120 km at a speed of x km/h. If his average speed for the whole journey is 47 7/19 km/h, then what is the value of x ?
questions.explanation_en: Times taken: 180/45 = 4 h and 150/50 = 3 h, and the third part takes 120/x h. Total distance = 450 km and average speed = 900/19 km/h, so total time = 450 × 19/900 = 9.5 h. Then 120/x = 9.5 − 7 = 2.5, which gives x = 48 km/h.

questions.question_en: The height of a cylinder inscribed in a sphere is 1.2 times the radius of the sphere. The radius of the sphere is 10 cm, and the volume of the cylinder is x% of the volume of the sphere. The value of x is:
questions.explanation_en: Cylinder height h = 1.2 × 10 = 12 cm, so half-height = 6. The cylinder's radius r satisfies r² = 10² − 6² = 64, so r = 8. Cylinder volume = π × 64 × 12 = 768π. Sphere volume = (4/3)π × 1000 = 4000π/3. x = 768π ÷ (4000π/3) × 100 = 57.6.

questions.question_en: A loan of ₹13,500 is to be paid back in two equal annual instalments. If the rate of interest is 16% p.a. compounded annually, then what is the total interest paid in this instalment scheme?

A and B started a business by investing their capitals in the ratio 5/8 : 3/5. After 6 months, A reduced his capital by 20% and B increased his capital by 50%. After 1 year, the share of A in the total profit was ₹15 lakhs. The total profit (in ₹ lakhs) was:
questions.explanation_en: Capital ratio 5/8 : 3/5 = 25 : 24. A: 25 × 6 + 20 × 6 = 270 (reduced by 20%). B: 24 × 6 + 36 × 6 = 360 (raised by 50%). Profit ratio = 270 : 360 = 3 : 4. A's share 3 parts = 15 lakh, so the total of 7 parts = ₹35 lakh.

questions.question_en: The speed of a boat going upstream is 40% of its speed going downstream. It takes a total time of 4 2/3 hours in going 15 km upstream and the same distance downstream. What is the speed (in km/h) of the boat in still water?
questions.explanation_en: Let the downstream speed be d, so upstream = 0.4d. Then 15/(0.4d) + 15/d = 14/3, i.e. 52.5/d = 14/3, so d = 11.25 km/h and upstream = 4.5 km/h. Speed in still water = (11.25 + 4.5)/2 = 7.875 = 7 7/8 km/h.

questions.question_en: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 18 hours and 27 hours, respectively. Pipe C is an outlet pipe. When all the three pipes are opened for 15 hours, then 5/36 part of the tank is filled. How much time (in hours) will C alone take to empty one-third of the tank?
questions.explanation_en: A + B fill 1/18 + 1/27 = 5/54 per hour. With C open, 5/36 is filled in 15 h, so the net rate = 1/108 per hour. C's emptying rate = 5/54 − 1/108 = 9/108 = 1/12, so C empties the full tank in 12 h and one-third of it in 4 h.

questions.question_en: In a test consisting of 150 questions, a candidate correctly answers 60% of the first 90 questions. What percentage of the remaining questions does he need to answer correctly so that he has 64% of all the questions answered correctly in the test?
questions.explanation_en: 64% of 150 = 96 correct answers are needed. He has 60% of 90 = 54 correct already, so he needs 96 − 54 = 42 more from the remaining 60 questions. 42/60 × 100 = 70%.

questions.question_en: If x = √(19 + 4√15) − √(19 − 4√15), then what is the value of x ?
A certain sum invested at 10% p.a. simple interest amounts to ₹9,417 in 4 years 4 months. What will be the amount of the same sum at 12 1/2 % p.a. in 2 2/5 years at simple interest?

‘तीन बेर खातीं थीं ते वे तीन बेर खाती हैं।’
उक्त पंक्तियाँ, निम्न में से किस अलंकार का उदाहरण हैं?
questions.explanation_en: The word 'teen ber' is repeated with different meanings: first 'three times (meals)' and then 'three ber fruits'. Repetition of the same word with different meanings is Yamak alankar.
questions.explanation_hi: जहाँ एक ही शब्द बार-बार आए पर हर बार उसका अर्थ भिन्न हो, वहाँ यमक अलंकार होता है। यहाँ पहले 'तीन बेर' का अर्थ 'तीन बार (भोजन)' और दूसरे 'तीन बेर' का अर्थ 'बेर के तीन फल' है, अतः यमक अलंकार है।

questions.question_en: ‘बायीं ओर को घूमा हुआ’ - इस वाक्यांश के लिए उपयुक्त शब्द का चयन करें।
questions.explanation_en: 'Vamavart' (vaam = left, aavart = turning) means turned or revolving towards the left. Vayavya refers to the north-west direction and vamoru means a woman with beautiful thighs.
questions.explanation_hi: 'वामावर्त' (वाम = बायाँ + आवर्त = घुमाव) का अर्थ है बायीं ओर को घूमा हुआ। 'वायव्य' उत्तर-पश्चिम दिशा तथा 'वामोरू' सुंदर जंघाओं वाली स्त्री के लिए प्रयुक्त होता है।

questions.question_en: ‘ठोकर लगी पहाड़ की, तोड़े घर की सील’ - उक्त लोकोक्ति का कोई एक खंड अशुद्ध है। शुद्ध भाग का चयन करें।
questions.explanation_en: The correct proverb is 'thokar lagi pahad ki, tode ghar ki sil': when someone is hurt by a powerful person, he vents his anger on the weak at home. 'Sil' (the grinding stone) is the right word, not 'seel' (dampness).
questions.explanation_hi: सही लोकोक्ति है 'ठोकर लगी पहाड़ की, तोड़े घर की सिल', अर्थात् बलवान से चोट खाकर अपना क्रोध घर के निर्बल पर उतारना। यहाँ 'सिल' (मसाला पीसने का पत्थर) शुद्ध है, 'सील' (नमी) नहीं।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वाक्य का चयन करें।

options.en: सेठ माणिकचंद के घर रोज लड़ाई-झगड़ा हुआ करता था।
जागुआ कहकर पुकारते जग्गू को लोग थे।
लड़का जैसा सुन्दर है, सुशील भी और वैसा बुद्धिमान है।
निकट का गुणी व्यक्ति कम सम्मान पर दूर का ज्यादा पाता है।

questions.explanation_en: Option 1 is correct in word order and agreement. Option 2 has a jumbled order, option 3 breaks the 'jaisa ... vaisa' correlation, and option 4 places 'kam samman' wrongly.
questions.explanation_hi: विकल्प 1 का पदक्रम और अन्विति दोनों शुद्ध हैं। विकल्प 2 में पदक्रम बिगड़ा है, विकल्प 3 में 'जैसा...वैसा' का प्रयोग असंगत है और विकल्प 4 में 'कम सम्मान' का स्थान गलत है।

questions.question_en: ‘मात्रुपदेश’ शब्द के शुद्ध सन्धि-विच्छेद का चयन कीजिये।
questions.explanation_en: 'Matrupadesh' is a yan sandhi: when 'ri' is followed by a dissimilar vowel it changes to 'r', so matri + upadesh = matrupadesh. Hence option 1.
questions.explanation_hi: 'मात्रुपदेश' में यण संधि है - 'ऋ' के बाद भिन्न स्वर आने पर 'ऋ' का 'र्' हो जाता है: मातृ + उपदेश = मात्रुपदेश (ऋ + उ = रु)। अतः शुद्ध संधि-विच्छेद 'मातृ + उपदेश' है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: ‘मेरे घर में एक ______ है। निम्न में से विदेशज शब्द चुनकर उक्त वाक्य को पूर्ण करें।
questions.explanation_en: 'Naukar' (servant) is a Persian-origin word, so it is videshaj. Ghonsla, lota and jharokha are deshaj/tadbhav words of Indian origin.
questions.explanation_hi: 'नौकर' फ़ारसी भाषा से आया शब्द है, अतः यह विदेशज है। 'घोंसला', 'लोटा' और 'झरोखा' देशज शब्द हैं, इसलिए विकल्प 4 सही है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
उपयुक्त ‘करण कारक’ चुनकर निम्न वाक्य को पूर्ण करें।
‘______ सुनी बात हमेशा सत्य होती है।’
questions.explanation_en: Karan karak denotes the instrument by which an action is done (sign 'se'). In 'kanon suni baat' the ears are the instrument of hearing (kanon se suni), so 'kanon' is in karan karak; meri/aapki show sambandh.
questions.explanation_hi: करण कारक क्रिया के साधन को बताता है (विभक्ति 'से')। 'कानों सुनी बात' अर्थात् कानों से सुनी गई बात - यहाँ सुनने का साधन कान है, अतः 'कानों' करण कारक है। 'मेरी', 'आपकी' संबंध कारक हैं।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से उस वाक्य का चयन करें जिसका पदक्रम शुद्ध हो?

options.en: व्यापक और संकीर्ण अर्थों में इसकी परिभाषा निश्चित करने की चेष्टा की गयी है।
इन शब्द्शाक्तियों पर आधार के काव्य की रचना होती है।
इन आचार्यों ने रस को प्रधानता न देकर अलंकार में काव्य में प्रधानता दी है।
अलंकृत करे किसी वस्तु को वह जो अलंकार है।

questions.explanation_en: Option 1 has a natural and grammatical order of adverbial phrase, object and verb. The others are faulty: 'aadhar ke' should be 'aadhar par', 'alankar mein kavya mein' is garbled, and option 4 has a jumbled order.
questions.explanation_hi: विकल्प 1 का पदक्रम सही और स्वाभाविक है। विकल्प 2 में 'आधार के' के स्थान पर 'आधार पर' होना चाहिए, विकल्प 3 में 'अलंकार में काव्य में' असंगत है और विकल्प 4 का पदक्रम बिखरा हुआ है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
‘पीपर पात सरिस मन डोला’
उपर्युक्त पंक्ति में मुख्यतः कौन सा अलंकार है?
questions.explanation_en: The mind is compared to a peepal leaf trembling in the wind, and 'saris' (like) is the comparison word. An explicit comparison using a vachak shabd like sa/si/saris is Upama alankar.
questions.explanation_hi: यहाँ मन (उपमेय) की तुलना पीपल के पत्ते (उपमान) से की गई है, 'सरिस' वाचक शब्द है और 'डोलना' साधारण धर्म है। चारों अंग होने से यहाँ उपमा अलंकार है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: दिए गए शब्दों में से ‘गरल’ के विलोमार्थी शब्द की पहचान करें।
questions.explanation_en: 'Garal' means poison; its opposite is 'sudha' (nectar, amrit). Kalkoot is a synonym of poison, and viral means sparse.
questions.explanation_hi: 'गरल' का अर्थ है विष और इसका विलोम 'सुधा' (अमृत) है। 'कालकूट' विष का ही पर्याय है, 'विरल' का अर्थ है कम/छितरा हुआ।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
‘अथक ______ और सतत लगन से कोई भी व्यवसाय चरमसीमा प्राप्त कर सकता है।’
स्व विवेकानुसार उचित शब्द चुनकर, उपरोक्त वाक्य में रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें।
questions.explanation_en: 'Athak' (tireless) naturally collocates with 'parishram' (hard work), and tireless labour with constant dedication leads any business to the peak. Gyan, vyavahar and jankari do not fit 'athak'.
questions.explanation_hi: 'अथक' (बिना थके) विशेषण के साथ 'परिश्रम' शब्द ही उपयुक्त है - अथक परिश्रम और सतत लगन से व्यवसाय चरम सीमा पर पहुँचता है। अन्य शब्द अर्थ की दृष्टि से संगत नहीं हैं।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: जीभ पर लक्ष्मी बसना – अशुद्ध मुहावरे के रेखांकित शब्द को सही शब्द से बदलें।
questions.explanation_en: The correct idiom is 'jeebh par Saraswati basna', meaning someone whose words come true or who speaks very sweetly and wisely. Saraswati is the goddess of speech, so she replaces Lakshmi.
questions.explanation_hi: सही मुहावरा है 'जीभ पर सरस्वती बसना', अर्थात् वाणी का सत्य होना या मधुर और ज्ञानपूर्ण बोलना। सरस्वती वाणी की देवी हैं, इसलिए 'लक्ष्मी' के स्थान पर 'सरस्वती' सही है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
‘जीवन तो क्षणभंगुर होता है।’
उचित पर्यायवाची शब्द चुनकर रेखांकित शब्द को प्रतिस्थापित करें।
questions.explanation_en: 'Kshanbhangur' means perishable or short-lived; 'nashvar' (that which perishes) is its synonym. Yaksh is a semi-divine being, swatva means ownership and krish means thin.
questions.explanation_hi: 'क्षणभंगुर' का अर्थ है क्षण में नष्ट होने वाला; इसका पर्याय 'नश्वर' है। 'यक्ष' देवयोनि, 'स्वत्व' अधिकार तथा 'कृश' दुबला-पतला के अर्थ में आते हैं।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
‘इस सोसाइटी में ______ रहते हैं।’
उस शब्द का चयन करके वाक्य पूर्ण करें जो ‘समाहार द्वंद्व’ का उदाहरण हो।
questions.explanation_en: In samahar dvandva the compound suggests the named items plus others of the same kind: 'seth-sahukar' means merchants, moneylenders and similar wealthy people. 'Stri-purush' is itaretar dvandva (just the two), and hrisht-pusht is a paired adjective.
questions.explanation_hi: समाहार द्वंद्व में दोनों पदों के साथ उसी प्रकार के अन्य का भी बोध होता है - 'सेठ-साहूकार' अर्थात् सेठ, साहूकार और ऐसे ही अन्य धनी लोग। 'स्त्री-पुरुष' इतरेतर द्वंद्व है (स्त्री और पुरुष), अतः विकल्प 1 सही है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
‘वर्द्धकि -रेखांकित शब्द का उपयुक्त तद्भव रूप चुनकर निम्न वाक्य को पूर्ण करें।
‘इस ____के पैसे दे दो।’
questions.explanation_en: 'Vardhaki' is the Sanskrit (tatsam) word for a carpenter, and its tadbhav form is 'badhai'. Hence option 3 completes the sentence.
questions.explanation_hi: 'वर्द्धकि' संस्कृत का तत्सम शब्द है जिसका अर्थ लकड़ी का काम करने वाला है; इसका तद्भव रूप 'बढ़ई' है। अतः विकल्प 3 सही है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
Comprehension:
दिए गए गदयांश को ध्यान से पढ़े और प्रश्न के उत्तर दें।

डॉ. रामकुमार वर्मा ने ऐतिहासिक एवं समस्या मूलक एकांकियों रचना की है। उनके एकांकियों का मूल स्वर आदर्शवादी है। प्रेम, सेवा, उदारता, त्याग और बलिदान की भावनाओं से ओतप्रोत इन ऐतिहासिक एकांकियों में भारत के अतीत गौरव को प्रस्तुत करते हुए राष्ट्रीयता की भावना जगाने का प्रयास किया गया है। समस्यामूलक एकांकियों में वर्मा जी ने शिक्षित मध्यमवर्गीय दंपतियों की अनेक समस्याओं प्रेम, सहवास, संदेह, दंभ आदि को कथानक का विषय बनाया है, किंतु उनकी परिणति आदर्श में हुई है क्योंकि उनके की एकांकियों नायिकाएं अंततः अपने पति के सम्मान की रक्षा करती हुई दिखाई पड़ती हैं, यथा ‘रेशमी टाई’, ‘ललिता’ और ‘एक्ट्रेस’ एकांकी की नायिका प्रभा कुमारी। अतिशय आदर्शवाद के कारण वर्मा जी के एकांकी यथार्थ से दूर हो गए जान पड़ते हैं, किंतु एकांकी शिल्प की दृष्टि से वे हिंदी के युग प्रवर्तक एकांकी माने जा सकते हैं। आरंभ, कुतूहल, संकलन त्रय, चरम सीमा आदि तत्व उनके एकांकियों में बड़ी सूक्ष्मता से विद्यमान हैं। रंगमंचीयता एवं अभिनेयता के गुणों से भी उनके एकांकी संपन्न हैं तथा उनमें सरसता के साथ-साथ शिल्प की पौढ़ता भी विद्यमान है। वस्तुतः एकांकी कला को चरम पर पहुंचाने का श्रेय डॉ रामकुमार वर्मा को ही दिया जाता है।

Q.16 उपर्युक्त गद्यांश के लिए उचित शीर्षक का चयन करें।

options.en: एकांकी शिल्प और डॉ. रामकुमार वर्मा

questions.explanation_en: The whole passage discusses Dr. Ramkumar Varma's one-act plays - their themes, idealism and craft. So 'Dr. Ramkumar Varma ke ekanki' is the most comprehensive title; the others cover only one aspect.
questions.explanation_hi: पूरा गद्यांश डॉ. रामकुमार वर्मा के एकांकियों - उनकी विषय-वस्तु, आदर्शवाद और शिल्प - पर केंद्रित है। अतः 'डॉ. रामकुमार वर्मा के एकांकी' सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त शीर्षक है; अन्य शीर्षक केवल एक पक्ष को छूते हैं।

Q.17 ‘प्रौढ़ता’ के विपरीतार्थक शब्द का चयन कीजिये।
questions.explanation_en: 'Praudhta' means maturity; its antonym is formed with the negative prefix 'a-': 'apraudhta' (immaturity). Paripakvata is a synonym, so option 1.
questions.explanation_hi: 'प्रौढ़ता' का अर्थ है परिपक्वता; इसका विलोम 'अ' उपसर्ग लगाकर 'अप्रौढ़ता' बनता है। 'परिपक्वता' इसका पर्यायवाची है, अतः विकल्प 1 सही है।

Q.18 उपर्युक्त अवतरण किस शैली में लिखा गया है?
questions.explanation_en: The passage evaluates Varma's plays, pointing out strengths (craft, stageability) and weaknesses (excessive idealism, distance from reality). Such evaluative writing is in the critical (aalochanatmak) style.
questions.explanation_hi: गद्यांश में वर्मा जी के एकांकियों के गुण (शिल्प, अभिनेयता) और दोष (अतिशय आदर्शवाद, यथार्थ से दूरी) दोनों का मूल्यांकन किया गया है। गुण-दोष विवेचन वाली ऐसी शैली आलोचनात्मक शैली कहलाती है।

Comprehension:
दिए गए गदयांश को ध्यान से पढ़े और प्रश्न के उत्तर दें।

डॉ. रामकुमार वर्मा ने ऐतिहासिक एवं समस्या मूलक एकांकियों रचना की है। उनके एकांकियों का मूल स्वर आदर्शवादी है। प्रेम, सेवा, उदारता, त्याग और बलिदान की भावनाओं से ओतप्रोत इन ऐतिहासिक एकांकियों में भारत के अतीत गौरव को प्रस्तुत करते हुए राष्ट्रीयता की भावना जगाने का प्रयास किया गया है। समस्यामूलक एकांकियों में वर्मा जी ने शिक्षित मध्यमवर्गीय दंपतियों की अनेक समस्याओं प्रेम, सहवास, संदेह, दंभ आदि को कथानक का विषय बनाया है, किंतु उनकी परिणति आदर्श में हुई है क्योंकि उनके की एकांकियों नायिकाएं अंततः अपने पति के सम्मान की रक्षा करती हुई दिखाई पड़ती हैं, यथा ‘रेशमी टाई’, ‘ललिता’ और ‘एक्ट्रेस’ एकांकी की नायिका प्रभा कुमारी। अतिशय आदर्शवाद के कारण वर्मा जी के एकांकी यथार्थ से दूर हो गए जान पड़ते हैं, किंतु एकांकी शिल्प की दृष्टि से वे हिंदी के युग प्रवर्तक एकांकी माने जा सकते हैं। आरंभ, कुतूहल, संकलन त्रय, चरम सीमा आदि तत्व उनके एकांकियों में बड़ी सूक्ष्मता से विद्यमान हैं। रंगमंचीयता एवं अभिनेयता के गुणों से भी उनके एकांकी संपन्न हैं तथा उनमें सरसता के साथ-साथ शिल्प की पौढ़ता भी विद्यमान है। वस्तुतः एकांकी कला को चरम पर पहुंचाने का श्रेय डॉ रामकुमार वर्मा को ही दिया जाता है।

Q.19 निम्नलिखित में से किस वाक्य में ‘परिणति’ शब्द का उचित प्रयोग किया गया है?

options.en: दूल्हा-दुल्हन का परिणति संस्कार संपन्न हो गया।
आपके व्यवहार की परिणति है कि इतने लोग आपको पसंद करते हैं।
आपकी उम्र में परिणति हो जानी चाहिए।
उसने नौकरी पाने की अच्छी परिणति खो दी।

questions.explanation_en: 'Parinati' means outcome or end result. Option 2 uses it correctly: people liking you is the result of your behaviour. The other sentences confuse it with parinay (marriage), parinaam or avsar.
questions.explanation_hi: 'परिणति' का अर्थ है परिणाम या अंतिम फल। विकल्प 2 में 'आपके व्यवहार की परिणति' अर्थात् व्यवहार का परिणाम - सही प्रयोग है। अन्य वाक्यों में इसे 'परिणय', 'परिपक्वता' या 'अवसर' के अर्थ में गलत प्रयुक्त किया गया है।
