tests.subject: Computer Science
tests.description: Official DSSSB question paper (195 text questions; figure-based questions removed). Official answer key applied.

questions.question_en: After Kerala, which of the following states or union territories has the highest scheduled caste sex ratio?
questions.explanation_en: As per Census 2011, Kerala had the highest sex ratio among Scheduled Castes (1057 females per 1000 males), followed by Puducherry (about 1056). Tamil Nadu came next at about 1007.

questions.question_en: Who among the following gave the three laws of planetary motion?
questions.explanation_en: Johannes Kepler gave the three laws of planetary motion (1609–1619): planets move in elliptical orbits (law of orbits), sweep equal areas in equal times (law of areas), and T² ∝ a³ (law of periods). Newton later explained them with his law of gravitation.

questions.question_en: In which of the following diseases does a parasite develop in the red blood cells (RBCs) of humans?
questions.explanation_en: In malaria, the Plasmodium parasite first multiplies in the liver and then invades and multiplies inside red blood cells. The bursting of these RBCs causes the periodic fever and chills. Dengue, Covid-19 and avian influenza are viral diseases.

questions.question_en: The Ajanta caves of Maharashtra are the cave monuments connected with which of the following religions?
questions.explanation_en: The Ajanta caves (Aurangabad district, Maharashtra) are Buddhist rock-cut caves, made from about the 2nd century BCE to the 6th century CE. They are famous for murals depicting Jataka tales and became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1983.

questions.question_en: Who among the following Pala dynasty rulers was the founder of Vajrayana, Vikramashila and Somapura universities?
questions.explanation_en: Dharmapala (c. 770–810 CE), the Pala ruler, founded the Vikramashila Mahavihara (Bihar) and the Somapura Mahavihara (Paharpur, Bangladesh), which became great centres of Vajrayana Buddhism. He was the son of Gopala, the founder of the Pala dynasty.

questions.question_en: The grants in aid by the Union government to certain States, charged to the Consolidated Fund of India, are described in Article ______ of the Constitution of India, 1949.
questions.explanation_en: Article 275 of the Constitution provides statutory grants-in-aid from the Union to states that need assistance, charged on the Consolidated Fund of India. These grants are given on the recommendation of the Finance Commission, unlike the discretionary grants under Article 282.

questions.question_en: Which of the following dance forms was also known as 'Dasi Attam' in ancient times?
questions.explanation_en: Bharatanatyam was earlier known as 'Dasi Attam' or 'Sadir', because it was performed by devadasis in the temples of Tamil Nadu. It was renamed and revived in the 20th century by E. Krishna Iyer and Rukmini Devi Arundale.

questions.question_en: Recently India test fired the surface-to-surface ballistic missile, Agni-5. What type of fuel engine does the missile have?
questions.explanation_en: Agni-5 is a three-stage, solid-fuel intercontinental-range ballistic missile developed by DRDO, with a range above 5,000 km. Solid fuel lets it be stored and launched quickly from a canister.

questions.question_en: Ustad Zakir Hussain, the Indian music maestro, is known to play which of the following instruments?
questions.explanation_en: Ustad Zakir Hussain, son of Ustad Alla Rakha, was a world-renowned tabla maestro. He received the Padma Vibhushan (2023) and several Grammy Awards.

questions.question_en: The receipts which neither create any liability nor reduce the assets of the government are called ______.
questions.explanation_en: Revenue receipts are government receipts that neither create a liability nor reduce assets, for example tax revenue, and non-tax revenue such as fees, dividends and interest. Capital receipts, such as borrowings or disinvestment, either create a liability or reduce assets.

questions.question_en: Which state has recently, in November 2022, notified to implement the Panchayat Extension to Scheduled Areas (PESA) Act?
questions.explanation_en: Madhya Pradesh notified its PESA rules on 15 November 2022 (Janjatiya Gaurav Divas) to implement the Panchayats (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996. The Act gives gram sabhas in Fifth Schedule areas powers over local resources and governance.

questions.question_en: In December 2022, three women of Indian origin were selected as Australia's 'STEM Superstars'. Which of the following is NOT one of them?
questions.explanation_en: In December 2022, Science & Technology Australia named Dr. Indrani Mukherjee, Neelima Kadiyala and Dr. Ana Baburamani, all of Indian origin, among its 'Superstars of STEM'. Shruthi Bishnoi was not among them.

questions.question_en: Which state has major reserves of low-grade, brown coal called lignite, which is used for power generation?
questions.explanation_en: Tamil Nadu holds India's largest lignite (brown coal) reserves, mainly at Neyveli, where NLC India uses it for thermal power generation. Lignite is a low-grade coal with high moisture and low carbon content.

questions.question_en: As per the Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, 2019-20, published by RBI, which Indian state has highest GDP?
questions.explanation_en: As per the RBI Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy 2019-20, Maharashtra had the highest Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) among Indian states, followed by Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh/Karnataka.

questions.question_en: Where will the 2023 IBA Women's World Boxing Championships take place in India, in March 2023?
questions.explanation_en: The 2023 IBA Women's World Boxing Championships were held at the K.D. Jadhav Indoor Hall in New Delhi in March 2023. India won four golds, through Nikhat Zareen, Lovlina Borgohain, Nitu Ghanghas and Saweety Boora.

questions.question_en: Which of the following monuments is NOT located in Delhi?
questions.explanation_en: Bibi ka Maqbara is in Aurangabad (Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar), Maharashtra. It was built by Aurangzeb's son Azam Shah in memory of his mother and is called the 'Taj of the Deccan'. The Qutub Minar, the Alai Minar and Balban's tomb are all in Mehrauli, Delhi.

questions.question_en: Who was the first Asian to be elected for membership in the British Parliament in 1892?
questions.explanation_en: Dadabhai Naoroji, the 'Grand Old Man of India', was elected to the British House of Commons in 1892 from Finsbury Central as a Liberal Party candidate, becoming the first Asian MP. He is known for the 'Drain Theory' of colonial economic exploitation.

questions.question_en: 'Bangar' and 'Khadar' are the sub-types of which of the following soils?
questions.explanation_en: Alluvial soil is divided into Bangar (older alluvium, found on higher ground, with kankar nodules) and Khadar (newer alluvium, found in the floodplains and more fertile). It is the most widespread soil in India, covering the northern plains.

questions.question_en: Who is the first Indian woman to win a bronze medal in the Women's singles table tennis at the Asian Cup 2022?
questions.explanation_en: Manika Batra became the first Indian woman to win a medal (bronze) in women's singles at the ITTF-ATTU Asian Cup, in Bangkok in November 2022. She beat world No. 6 Hina Hayata of Japan in the bronze-medal match.

questions.question_en: As per the Sample Registration System (SRS) Statistical Report, 2019, released in February 2022 by the Registrar General of India (RGI), which state had the highest infant mortality rate in 2019?
questions.explanation_en: As per the SRS Statistical Report 2019, Madhya Pradesh had the highest infant mortality rate (46 per 1,000 live births), and Kerala had the lowest. The national IMR in 2019 was 30.

questions.question_en:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?
56 − 74 × 17 + 391 ÷ 23 = 1297
questions.explanation_en: Swap + and −: 56 + 74 × 17 − 391 ÷ 23. By BODMAS: 74 × 17 = 1258 and 391 ÷ 23 = 17. Then 56 + 1258 − 17 = 1297, which equals the right-hand side.

questions.question_en:
Select the term from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.
PMT, QOW, RQZ, SSC, ?
questions.explanation_en: Treat each letter position as its own series. First letters P, Q, R, S, T (+1); second letters M, O, Q, S, U (+2); third letters T, W, Z, C, F (+3, wrapping from Z to C). The next term is TUF.

questions.question_en:
A person placed the 9 letters from A to I of the English alphabet into a row such that
• There is exactly two letters' gap between two vowels.
• I and B are placed at the extreme ends.
• D and F are placed between A and E.
• C is placed to the right of B and second to the left of D.
• E is placed exactly between A and I.
Which letter is placed in the middle of the row?
questions.explanation_en: C must be to the right of B, so B is at the left end (position 1) and I at the right end (9). E is midway between A and I with two letters between each vowel, so E is at 6 and A at 3. D and F lie between A and E (positions 4 and 5), and C is second to the left of D, so C = 2 and D = 4, F = 5. The row is B C A D F E _ _ I, and the middle (5th) letter is F.

questions.question_en:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.
Statement:
Physical exercises are good for health.
Conclusions:
I. Mostly players are healthy because of the involvement of physical exercise in their profession.
II. Ravinder played tennis at the age of 70.

options.en: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Either conclusion I or II follows.

questions.explanation_en: If physical exercise is good for health, then players, whose profession involves regular exercise, are likely to be healthy, so conclusion I follows. Conclusion II is about one particular person (Ravinder) and has no link to the statement. Only I follows.

questions.question_en:
A statement is given followed by two arguments. Decide which of the arguments is/are strong with respect to the statement.
Statement:
Should a college run any course without seeking affiliation from the university?
Arguments:
I. Yes, it will provide more opportunities to individuals.
II. No, it will deteriorate the quality as college may not have all the equipment and resource to run any course.

options.en: Both arguments I and II are strong.
Neither argument I nor argument II is strong.

questions.explanation_en: Argument I is vague: unaffiliated courses do not create real opportunities, because their degrees are not recognised. Argument II rests on an assumption (that the college lacks equipment and resources) rather than on the actual purpose of affiliation, which is academic recognition and standards. As per the official key, neither argument is strong.

questions.question_en: Four number-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.explanation_en: In each pair the second number is 7 times the first: 59 × 7 = 413, 61 × 7 = 427 and 47 × 7 = 329. But 37 × 7 = 259, not 269, so 37-269 is the odd one.

questions.question_en:
What approximate value should come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?
78.69 ÷ 29.19 × 13.17 − 45.67 ÷ 22.89 = ?
questions.explanation_en: The key's value 454 comes from reading the first operator as '+': 79 + 29 × 13 − 46 ÷ 23 = 79 + 377 − 2 = 454. As printed (78.69 ÷ 29.19 × 13.17 − 45.67 ÷ 22.89), the expression gives only about 2.7 × 13.17 − 2 ≈ 34, which matches no option.

questions.question_en:
Select the option where the second word is related to the first word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word in the given pair.
IMAGINE: BLJGFMJ
questions.explanation_en: Rule from IMAGINE: split it as IMA | G | INE. Change each 3-letter block by +1, −1, +1 and reverse it (IMA → JLB → BLJ; INE → JMF → FMJ), keeping the middle letter G. Apply it to COLLEGE: COL → DNM → MND, L stays, EGE → FFF → FFF, giving MNDLFFF. The other options break the rule (e.g. SUCCESS should be DTTCTRF, not DTTCTRE).

questions.question_en: In a row of 50 students, Kajal is 8th to the left of Rashmi. If Rashmi is 25th from the left end of the row, what will be the position of Kajal from the right end of the row?
questions.explanation_en: Rashmi is 25th from the left and Kajal is 8 places to her left, so Kajal is 25 − 8 = 17th from the left. Position from the right = 50 − 17 + 1 = 34th.

questions.question_en:
A question is given, followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.
Question:
What will be the code of 'HUMAN' in the same language?
Statements:
I. 'FAHAD' is coded as '61814'.
II. 'WATER' is coded as '23120518'.

options.en: Information in both the statements I and II is necessary to answer the question.
Information in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question, while information in statement II alone is not sufficient to answer the question.
Information in either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question.
Information in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question, while information in statement I alone is not sufficient to answer the question.

questions.explanation_en: Statement I: FAHAD → 6 1 8 1 4, i.e. each letter is replaced by its alphabet position. Statement II: WATER → 23 1 20 5 18, which shows the same rule. Either statement alone reveals the rule, giving HUMAN = 8 21 13 1 14 (82113114). So either statement alone is sufficient.

questions.question_en: Four letter-cluster pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.explanation_en: Rule: split the word into 3 letters + middle letter + 3 letters; change each block by +1, −1, +1 and reverse it, keeping the middle letter. IMAGINE → BLJGFMJ, SUCCESS → DTTCTRF and COLLEGE → MNDLFFF follow it. For COMMAND, AND → BME → EMB, so the code should be NNDMEMB, not NNDMENB. Option 3 is the odd one.

questions.question_en:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.
34 * 69 * 23 * 37 * 23 * 882
questions.explanation_en: Try option 3: 34 − 69 ÷ 23 + 37 × 23 = 882. By BODMAS: 69 ÷ 23 = 3 and 37 × 23 = 851. Then 34 − 3 + 851 = 882, which balances the equation.

questions.question_en: Four letter-cluster pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.explanation_en: Rule: shift each letter by +1, then swap each adjacent pair. HOTELS → IPUFMT → PIFUTM; MATTER → NBUUFS → BNUUSF; ACTING → BDUJOH → DBJUHO. ACTUAL → BDUVBM → DBVUMB, but the given code is DBUVMB, so option 4 is the odd one.

questions.question_en: Four number-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.explanation_en: The rule is second = 3 × first + 2: 19 × 3 + 2 = 59, 17 × 3 + 2 = 53 and 23 × 3 + 2 = 71. But 29 × 3 + 2 = 89, not 91, so 29-91 is the odd one.

questions.question_en: There are six persons, P, Q, R, S, T and U. R is lighter than P but heavier than Q. S is lighter than U. T is heavier than P. U is lighter than Q. Who is the heaviest among them all?
questions.explanation_en: From the clues: Q < R < P, P < T, U < Q and S < U. Combined, S < U < Q < R < P < T, so T is the heaviest.

questions.question_en: A train completely passes a 200-m-long tunnel in 36 seconds and a pole in 20 seconds. How much time (in hours) will it take to cover a distance of 333 km?
questions.explanation_en: Passing a pole: L = 20v. Passing the tunnel: L + 200 = 36v. Subtracting, 16v = 200, so v = 12.5 m/s = 12.5 × 18/5 = 45 km/h. Time for 333 km = 333/45 = 7.4 hours.

questions.question_en: Ravi and Gaurav enter into a partnership with their capitals in the ratio of 1/2 : 5/6. After 4 months, Ravi doubles his capital and Gaurav reduces his capital by 40%. What is the share of Ravi in the profit if Gaurav's share in the profit is ₹1,32,000, after 1 year?
questions.explanation_en: Capital ratio 1/2 : 5/6 = 3 : 5. Ravi: 3 × 4 + 6 × 8 = 60 (doubled after 4 months). Gaurav: 5 × 4 + 3 × 8 = 44 (cut by 40%). Profit ratio = 60 : 44 = 15 : 11. Gaurav's 11 parts = ₹1,32,000, so one part = ₹12,000 and Ravi's share = 15 × 12000 = ₹1,80,000.

questions.question_en: The price of an item is increased successively by 20%, 10% and 5% and then decreased by 40%. If its final price is ₹415.80, then what was its initial price?
If x = √(23 + 6√10) − √(23 − 6√10), then the value of x lies between:
The cost of colouring a conical tomb at ₹80 per 100 m^2 is ₹440, and its slant height is 25 m. The volume (in m^3) of material contained in it is (use π = 22/7):
By selling an article for ₹374, a shopkeeper loses 6.5%. To gain 9.5%, he must sell it for:

The marked price of an article is ₹600. It is sold for ₹342.72, after allowing three successive discounts of 16%, 20% and x % on its marked price. If a single discount of 2 x % is given on its marked price, then the selling price (in ₹) of the article will be:

Study the following graph and answer the question.
Percentage profit earned by companies A and B during 2017 to 2020
[Line graph, Percentage Profit vs Years: Company A: 2017=35, 2018=30, 2019=40, 2020=50; Company B: 2017=40, 2018=50, 2019=30, 2020=45]
Percentage profit = (Income − Expenditure)/Expenditure × 100
Profit = Income − Expenditure
If the total income of both the companies in 2019 was ₹428.8 crores and the ratio of the expenditure of A to that of B in the same year was 2 : 3, then the expenditure (in ₹ crores) of A in that year was:
questions.explanation_en: In 2019, A's profit was 40% and B's was 30%. Let the expenditures be 2k and 3k. Total income = 1.4 × 2k + 1.3 × 3k = 6.7k = 428.8, so k = 64. A's expenditure = 2 × 64 = ₹128 crore.

questions.question_en: A computer is available for ₹75,300 cash or for ₹25,740 cash down payment and two equal half-yearly instalments. If the dealer charges interest at 20% p.a., compounded half-yearly, then the total interest to be paid by a customer who buys it in instalment scheme is:
Given that a + b + c = 3960. If a : (b + c) = 3 : 8 and c : (a + b) = 4 : 5, then what is the value of b?

Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 40 hours and x hours, respectively. Pipe C alone can empty the full tank in 10 hours. When all the three pipes are opened together, then 1/6 th part of the full tank is emptied in 4 hours. What is the value of x ?
questions.explanation_en: The net emptying rate is 1/6 tank in 4 h = 1/24 per hour. So 1/10 − 1/40 − 1/x = 1/24, which gives 1/x = 3/40 − 1/24 = (9 − 5)/120 = 1/30. Hence x = 30.

questions.question_en: The perimeter of a field in the shape of a rhombus is 116 m and one of its diagonals is 42 m. Its area is equal to the area of a rectangular garden whose sides are in the ratio of 30 : 7. The perimeter of the rectangular garden is:
questions.explanation_en: Side of the rhombus = 116/4 = 29 m. Half of the known diagonal = 21, so the other half = √(29² − 21²) = 20, making the other diagonal 40 m. Area = (42 × 40)/2 = 840 m². For the rectangle, 30k × 7k = 840 gives k = 2, so the sides are 60 m and 14 m and the perimeter = 2(60 + 14) = 148 m.

questions.question_en: The income of A is 32% less than the income of B, and the average income of A and B is 20% less than the income of C. If A's income increases by 25% and B's income decreases by 10%, then the income of C is what percentage less than the new total income of A and B?
questions.explanation_en: Let B = 100, so A = 68 and their average = 84 = 80% of C, giving C = 105. New A = 68 × 1.25 = 85 and new B = 90, so the new total = 175. C is less by (175 − 105)/175 × 100 = 40%.

questions.question_en: Solutions A, B and C contain alcohol and water in the ratio of 3 : 7, 4 : 11 and 2 : 3, respectively. Four litres of A, five litres of B and three litres of C are mixed in a vessel. The percentage of alcohol in the resulting solution in the vessel is closest to:
questions.explanation_en: Alcohol in each part: A = 4 × 3/10 = 1.2 L, B = 5 × 4/15 = 4/3 ≈ 1.333 L and C = 3 × 2/5 = 1.2 L. Total alcohol ≈ 3.733 L in 12 L. Percentage = 3.733/12 × 100 ≈ 31.1%, which is closest to 31%.

questions.question_en: A varies inversely with the product of B and C. When B = 9 and C = 5, then A = 12. When B = 15 and C = 4, then the value of A is:
The height of a solid right circular cylinder is 32 cm. Its total surface area is 370π cm^2. Its volume is equal to 3/5 of the volume of a sphere. The diameter of the sphere is:
questions.explanation_en: Total surface area 2πr(h + r) = 370π gives r(32 + r) = 185, so r = 5 cm (since 5 × 37 = 185). Cylinder volume = π × 25 × 32 = 800π. Then 800π = (3/5) × (4/3)πR³ = (4/5)πR³, so R³ = 1000 and R = 10 cm. Diameter = 20 cm.

questions.question_en: The amount of a certain sum invested at 7.4% p.a. for 2 1/2 years at simple interest is ₹1,701 less than the simple interest on the same sum for 10 years at 15% p.a. The sum (in ₹) is:
Let x be the least number which when divided by 30, 36, 40 and 54, leaves a remainder of 4 in each case, and x is divisible by 23. What is the sum of the digits of x ?
questions.explanation_en: LCM(30, 36, 40, 54) = 2³ × 3³ × 5 = 1080, so x = 1080k + 4. Since 1080 = 23 × 47 − 1, x ≡ −k + 4 (mod 23), and x is divisible by 23 when k = 4. So x = 4324 (= 23 × 188), and the digit sum is 4 + 3 + 2 + 4 = 13.

questions.question_en: A man travels from P to Q at a speed of 50 km/h and then from Q to R at a speed of 60 km/h, where Q is between P and R. The ratio of distances PQ and QR is 1 : 2. He travels from R to P at a speed of 45 km/h. What is his average speed (in km/h) for the whole journey?
questions.explanation_en: Let PQ = d and QR = 2d, so PR = 3d and the total distance = 6d. Total time = d/50 + 2d/60 + 3d/45 = d(3 + 5 + 10)/150 = 3d/25. Average speed = 6d ÷ (3d/25) = 50 km/h.

questions.question_en:
दिए गए शब्दों में से उचित तद्भव शब्द से वाक्य पूर्ण करें-

मनुष्य की सर्वोत्तम ______ उसके अच्छे कर्म हैं।
questions.explanation_en: 'Poonji' (capital, wealth) is a tadbhav word derived from Sanskrit 'punj'. The sentence means a person's best wealth is his good deeds; the other options are tatsam or unrelated.
questions.explanation_hi: 'पूँजी' तद्भव शब्द है (संस्कृत 'पुञ्ज' से)। वाक्य का अर्थ है - मनुष्य की सबसे बड़ी संपत्ति उसके अच्छे कर्म हैं। 'पुंज', 'पुच्छ', 'पृच्छन' तत्सम हैं और अर्थ की दृष्टि से भी उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: दूसरों के (सुख के) लिए अपने सुखों का त्याग।' दिए गए वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द होगा--
questions.explanation_en: 'Atmotsarg' (atma + utsarg = self-sacrifice) means giving up one's own pleasures for the happiness of others. Atmaghat is suicide and atmotkarsh is self-elevation, so option 3.
questions.explanation_hi: 'आत्मोत्सर्ग' (आत्म + उत्सर्ग) का अर्थ है दूसरों के सुख के लिए अपने सुखों का त्याग। 'आत्मघात' आत्महत्या को और 'आत्मोत्कर्ष' अपनी उन्नति को कहते हैं, अतः विकल्प 3 सही है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
'तो पर वारौं उरबसी, सुनु राधिके सुजान।

तू मोहन के उर बसी, ह्वै उरबसी समान॥' दोहे में अलंकार है-
questions.explanation_en: 'Urbasi' appears with different meanings: first as Urvashi the celestial nymph, and then as 'ur basi' (dwelling in Krishna's heart). Repetition of a word with different meanings is Yamak alankar.
questions.explanation_hi: इस दोहे में 'उरबसी' शब्द बार-बार आया है पर अर्थ भिन्न हैं - एक बार 'उर्वशी' अप्सरा और दूसरी बार 'उर बसी' (हृदय में बसी हुई)। एक शब्द की भिन्न अर्थों में आवृत्ति यमक अलंकार है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: निम्न में से कौन-सा विलोम युग्म असुमेलित है-
questions.explanation_en: Srijan and rachna both mean creation, so they are synonyms, not opposites. The other pairs are proper antonyms (sugati-durgati, saumya-ugra, srishti-pralay).
questions.explanation_hi: 'सृजन' और 'रचना' दोनों का अर्थ निर्माण है, अतः ये पर्यायवाची हैं, विलोम नहीं। सुगति-दुर्गति, सौम्य-उग्र और सृष्टि-प्रलय सही विलोम युग्म हैं।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: वाक्य विन्यास की दृष्टि से शुद्ध वाक्य का चयन कीजिए--

options.en: बाल गोपाल के सिर पर घुँघराले कुंतल दे रहे हैं शोभा।
बाल गोपाल के सिर पर घुँघराले कुंतल शोभा दे रहे हैं।
दे रहे हैं शोभा घुँघराले कुंतल बाल गोपाल के सिर पर।
शोभा दे रहे हैं बाल गोपाल के सिर पर घुँघराले कुंतल।

questions.explanation_en: In Hindi the verb comes at the end, with the subject and its modifiers before it. 'Bal Gopal ke sir par ghunghrale kuntal shobha de rahe hain' follows this order; the others displace the verb.
questions.explanation_hi: हिंदी वाक्य में क्रिया सामान्यतः अंत में आती है। 'बाल गोपाल के सिर पर घुँघराले कुंतल शोभा दे रहे हैं' में स्थानवाचक पद, कर्ता और क्रिया अपने सही क्रम में हैं; अन्य विकल्पों में क्रिया का स्थान गलत है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: निम्न में से शुद्ध मुहावरे का चयन कीजिए-
questions.explanation_en: The standard idiom is 'munh mein pani bhar aana', meaning to feel a strong desire (especially for tasty food). The other versions replace 'pani' with words not used in the idiom.
questions.explanation_hi: शुद्ध मुहावरा है 'मुँह में पानी भर आना', जिसका अर्थ है - किसी स्वादिष्ट वस्तु को देखकर उसे पाने की तीव्र इच्छा होना। अन्य विकल्पों में 'पानी' के स्थान पर गलत शब्द रखे गए हैं।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: 'बाजि बली रघुबंसिन के मनों सूरज के रथ चूमन चाहैं।' पंक्ति में अलंकार है-
questions.explanation_en: The horses of the Raghu clan are imagined as if they want to kiss the chariot of the Sun; 'manon' is a typical vachak word of possibility. Imagining the upmeya as the upman with words like manu/manon/janu is Utpreksha alankar.
questions.explanation_hi: यहाँ रघुवंशियों के बलवान घोड़ों के बारे में संभावना व्यक्त की गई है मानो वे सूर्य के रथ को चूमना चाहते हैं। 'मनों' (मानो) उत्प्रेक्षा का वाचक शब्द है; जहाँ उपमेय में उपमान की संभावना की जाए वहाँ उत्प्रेक्षा अलंकार होता है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: 'उल्लंघन' का संधि-विच्छेद है-
questions.explanation_en: 'Ullanghan' is a vyanjan sandhi: when 't' of 'ut' is followed by 'l', it changes to 'l', so ut + langhan = ullanghan. Hence option 1.
questions.explanation_hi: 'उल्लंघन' में व्यंजन संधि है - 'त्' के बाद 'ल' आने पर 'त्' का 'ल्' हो जाता है: उत् + लंघन = उल्लंघन (जैसे उत् + लास = उल्लास)। अतः विकल्प 1 सही है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: 'गिरहकट' का समास-विग्रह होगा-
questions.explanation_en: 'Girahkat' means one who cuts the knot (a pickpocket). The object 'girah' takes the 'ko' sign, so it is a karm tatpurush: 'girah ko katne wala'.
questions.explanation_hi: 'गिरहकट' का अर्थ है गाँठ (गिरह) काटने वाला अर्थात् जेबकतरा। यहाँ 'गिरह' कर्म है और कर्म कारक का चिह्न 'को' लुप्त है, अतः विग्रह 'गिरह को काटनेवाला' (कर्म तत्पुरुष) होगा।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: वाक्य विन्यास की दृष्टि से शुद्ध वाक्य का चयन कीजिए--

options.en: तुम्हारे पड़ोसी एक मात्र व्यक्ति हैं इस समय तुम्हारी सहायता करने वाले।
एक मात्र व्यक्ति हैं इस समय तुम्हारे पड़ोसी तुम्हारी सहायता करने वाले।
तुम्हारी सहायता करने वाले तुम्हारे पड़ोसी एक मात्र व्यक्ति हैं इस समय।
इस समय तुम्हारे पड़ोसी तुम्हारी सहायता करने वाले एक मात्र व्यक्ति हैं।

questions.explanation_en: Option 4 follows the natural Hindi order: time adverb (is samay), subject (tumhare padosi), complement phrase and verb at the end. The other options place the verb or adverb in the middle.
questions.explanation_hi: विकल्प 4 में कालवाचक पद (इस समय), कर्ता (तुम्हारे पड़ोसी), पूरक (तुम्हारी सहायता करने वाले एकमात्र व्यक्ति) और अंत में क्रिया (हैं) - यह स्वाभाविक हिंदी पदक्रम है। अन्य विकल्पों में क्रिया बीच में आ गई है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
दिए गए शब्दों में से सर्वोचित शब्द से वाक्य का रिक्त स्थान पूर्ण करें--

पुरानी 'कथा' की एक ______ विशेषता श्रावयिता-श्रोता अथवा किस्सागो और किस्सा सुनने वाले की आमने-सामने विद्यमानता होती थी।
questions.explanation_en: The face-to-face presence of the narrator and listener was an essential feature of the old oral 'katha' tradition. 'Anivarya' (essential) fits the sense; samanya, aakasmik and anavashyak do not.
questions.explanation_hi: पुरानी 'कथा' मौखिक परंपरा थी, जिसमें कहने वाले और सुनने वाले का आमने-सामने होना आवश्यक था। अतः 'अनिवार्य' विशेषता सर्वोचित है; 'सामान्य', 'आकस्मिक' और 'अनावश्यक' अर्थ से मेल नहीं खाते।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: निम्न में से शुद्ध लोकोक्ति का चयन कीजिए-

options.en: अपनी टाँग कटे तो कटे दूसरों का सगुन तो बिगड़े
अपनी ज़बान कटे तो कटे दूसरों का सगुन तो बिगड़े
अपनी गर्दन कटे तो कटे दूसरों का सगुन तो बिगड़े
अपनी नाक कटे तो कटे दूसरों का सगुन तो बिगड़े

questions.explanation_en: The correct proverb is 'apni naak kate to kate, doosron ka sagun to bigde' - harming oneself just to spoil another's good fortune. 'Naak' (honour) is the word used in this proverb.
questions.explanation_hi: शुद्ध लोकोक्ति है 'अपनी नाक कटे तो कटे, दूसरों का सगुन तो बिगड़े', अर्थात् अपनी हानि सहकर भी दूसरे का काम बिगाड़ना। इसमें 'नाक' (प्रतिष्ठा) शब्द ही प्रयुक्त होता है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
उचित विदेशी शब्द से दिया गया वाक्य पूर्ण करें–

______ की ज़िंदगी में कठिनाईयाँ बहुत अधिक होती हैं।
questions.explanation_en: 'Aurat' is an Arabic word, so 'auraton' is the foreign-origin option. Stri, naari and mahila are Sanskrit-origin (tatsam) words.
questions.explanation_hi: 'औरत' अरबी भाषा का शब्द है, अतः 'औरतों' विदेशी शब्द है। 'स्त्री', 'नारी' और 'महिला' संस्कृत के तत्सम शब्द हैं।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en: 'यथाशीघ्र' में समास है-
questions.explanation_en: In 'yathasheeghra' (as soon as possible) the first member 'yatha' is an indeclinable (avyay) and dominates the meaning, and the whole compound works as an adverb. This is avyayibhav samas.
questions.explanation_hi: 'यथाशीघ्र' (जितना शीघ्र हो सके) में पहला पद 'यथा' अव्यय है और वही प्रधान है; पूरा पद क्रियाविशेषण की तरह प्रयुक्त होता है। अतः यहाँ अव्ययीभाव समास है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
जो आँखों से संबंधित हो।'

दिए गए वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द होगा--
questions.explanation_en: 'Chakshush' (from chakshu = eye) means relating to the eyes or visual. Netrant means the corner of the eye, and the other two are not standard words.
questions.explanation_hi: 'चाक्षुष' (चक्षु = आँख) का अर्थ है आँखों से संबंधित या आँखों से देखा जाने वाला। 'नेत्रांत' आँख का कोना है, शेष शब्द मानक नहीं हैं, अतः विकल्प 4 सही है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
Comprehension:
निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।

1929 की अमरीका की आर्थिक मंदी से वहाँ और दूसरे पूँजीवादी देशों में भी उत्पादन और विदेशी व्यापार में बहुत बड़ी गिरावट आयी। जनता की आर्थिक स्थिति खराब हो गई और बड़े पैमाने पर बेरोज़गारी फैली। दूसरी ओर सोवियत संघ में गिरावट ही नहीं आई बल्कि 1929 और 1936 के बीच पहली दो पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं से सोवियत संघ का औद्योगिक उत्पादन चार गुना से भी अधिक हो गया। विश्वव्यापी मंदी के कारण पूँजीवादी प्रणाली बदनाम हो गई और लोगों का ध्यान मार्क्सवाद, समाजवाद और आर्थिक योजना के विचार की ओर गया। जनता खासकर युवक, मज़दूर और किसान समाजवादी विचारों की ओर खिंचने लगे। राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन के आरम्भिक दिनों से ही उनका झुकाव निर्धन जनता की ओर था। 1917 की रुसी क्रांति के प्रभाव से , राजनीतिक मंच पर गाँधीजी के उदय से, तथा दूसरे और तीसरे दशकों में शक्तिशाली वामपंथी गुटों के बनने से यह प्रवृत्ति और मज़बूत हुई। कांग्रेस ने कराची अधिवेशन में जवाहरलाल नेहरू के आग्रह पर एक प्रस्ताव पारित किया। प्रस्ताव में जनता को मूल नागरिक अधिकारों, जाति, पंथ, लिंग के भेद के बिना क़ानून के आगे सबकी समानता, सार्वभौमिक बालिग़ मताधिकार के आधार पर चुनाव तथा मुफ्त और अनिवार्य प्राथमिक शिक्षा की ज़मानत दी गई थी। लगान व मालगुज़ारी में काफी कमी, लाभहीन जोतों के लिए लगान माफी, खेतिहरों के क़र्ज़ों में तथा सूदखोरों के नियंत्रण से राहत, जीवनयापन योग्य-मज़दूरी समेत मज़दूरों के लिए बेहतर दशाओं, महिला मज़दूरों के लिए काम के सीमित घंटों और सुरक्षा, मज़दूरों तथा किसानों के लिए संगठित होने और यूनियन बनाने के अधिकार तथा प्रमुख उद्योगों, खदानों और यातायात के साधनों पर राज्य का स्वामित्त्व या नियंत्रण जैसे वादे भी इस प्रस्ताव में किए गए थे। 1934 में आचार्य नरेंद्र देव तथा जयप्रकाश नारायण के नेतृत्त्व में 'कांग्रेस समाजवादी पार्टी' की स्थापना हुई। 1939 में सुभाषचंद्र बोस ने 'फॉरवर्ड ब्लॉक' की स्थापना की।

SubQuestion No : 16
कांग्रेस के कराची अधिवेशन के संदर्भ में असत्य है-

options.en: जनता को मुफ्त एवं अनिवार्य शिक्षा मुहैया कराने का आश्वासन दिया गया।
महिलाओं तथा पुरुषों के लिए भिन्न-भिन्न क़ानून बनाये जाने को मान्यता दी गई।
इसमें जनता को मूल अधिकार प्रदान करने का प्रस्ताव रखा गया।
सार्वभौमिक बालिग़ मताधिकार के आधार पर चुनाव कराये जाने का प्रस्ताव पारित हुआ।

questions.explanation_en: The Karachi resolution promised equality of all before the law irrespective of caste, creed or sex. So the claim that separate laws for men and women were recognised is false (option 2).
questions.explanation_hi: गद्यांश के अनुसार कराची प्रस्ताव में जाति, पंथ और लिंग के भेद के बिना क़ानून के समक्ष सबकी समानता की बात कही गई थी। अतः महिलाओं और पुरुषों के लिए भिन्न-भिन्न क़ानून की बात असत्य है।

source.section_printed: Test of Hindi Language and Comprehension

questions.question_en:
Comprehension:
निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।

1929 की अमरीका की आर्थिक मंदी से वहाँ और दूसरे पूँजीवादी देशों में भी उत्पादन और विदेशी व्यापार में बहुत बड़ी गिरावट आयी। जनता की आर्थिक स्थिति खराब हो गई और बड़े पैमाने पर बेरोज़गारी फैली। दूसरी ओर सोवियत संघ में गिरावट ही नहीं आई बल्कि 1929 और 1936 के बीच पहली दो पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं से सोवियत संघ का औद्योगिक उत्पादन चार गुना से भी अधिक हो गया। विश्वव्यापी मंदी के कारण पूँजीवादी प्रणाली बदनाम हो गई और लोगों का ध्यान मार्क्सवाद, समाजवाद और आर्थिक योजना के विचार की ओर गया। जनता खासकर युवक, मज़दूर और किसान समाजवादी विचारों की ओर खिंचने लगे। राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन के आरम्भिक दिनों से ही उनका झुकाव निर्धन जनता की ओर था। 1917 की रुसी क्रांति के प्रभाव से , राजनीतिक मंच पर गाँधीजी के उदय से, तथा दूसरे और तीसरे दशकों में शक्तिशाली वामपंथी गुटों के बनने से यह प्रवृत्ति और मज़बूत हुई। कांग्रेस ने कराची अधिवेशन में जवाहरलाल नेहरू के आग्रह पर एक प्रस्ताव पारित किया। प्रस्ताव में जनता को मूल नागरिक अधिकारों, जाति, पंथ, लिंग के भेद के बिना क़ानून के आगे सबकी समानता, सार्वभौमिक बालिग़ मताधिकार के आधार पर चुनाव तथा मुफ्त और अनिवार्य प्राथमिक शिक्षा की ज़मानत दी गई थी। लगान व मालगुज़ारी में काफी कमी, लाभहीन जोतों के लिए लगान माफी, खेतिहरों के क़र्ज़ों में तथा सूदखोरों के नियंत्रण से राहत, जीवनयापन योग्य-मज़दूरी समेत मज़दूरों के लिए बेहतर दशाओं, महिला मज़दूरों के लिए काम के सीमित घंटों और सुरक्षा, मज़दूरों तथा किसानों के लिए संगठित होने और यूनियन बनाने के अधिकार तथा प्रमुख उद्योगों, खदानों और यातायात के साधनों पर राज्य का स्वामित्त्व या नियंत्रण जैसे वादे भी इस प्रस्ताव में किए गए थे। 1934 में आचार्य नरेंद्र देव तथा जयप्रकाश नारायण के नेतृत्त्व में 'कांग्रेस समाजवादी पार्टी' की स्थापना हुई। 1939 में सुभाषचंद्र बोस ने 'फॉरवर्ड ब्लॉक' की स्थापना की।

SubQuestion No : 17
फॉरवर्ड ब्लॉक की स्थापना कब और किसने की?
questions.explanation_en: The last line of the passage says that in 1939 Subhas Chandra Bose founded the Forward Bloc. Hence option 4.
questions.explanation_hi: गद्यांश की अंतिम पंक्ति के अनुसार 1939 में सुभाषचंद्र बोस ने 'फॉरवर्ड ब्लॉक' की स्थापना की। अतः विकल्प 4 सही है।

questions.explanation_en: People turned to Marxism and socialism because the worldwide depression discredited capitalism while Soviet industry grew fourfold. Capitalism's 'achievements' being highlighted was not a reason - the passage says the opposite.

options.en: लगान व मालगुज़ारी में काफी कमी करने का प्रस्ताव रखा गया।
मज़दूरों के लिए न्यूनतम मज़दूरी सहित कार्य करने की बेहतर दशा और वातावरण प्रदान किये जाने का प्रस्ताव रखा गया।
लाभहीन तथा बंजर जोतों के लिए भी समान लगान निर्धारित किये जाने का प्रस्ताव रखा गया।
मज़दूरों तथा किसानों के संगठनों को उनके हित में कार्य करने की स्वतंत्रता प्रदान करने का प्रस्ताव रखा गया।

questions.explanation_en: The resolution promised remission of rent for uneconomic holdings, not equal rent for them. So the statement that equal rent would be fixed even for unprofitable and barren holdings is false (option 3).
questions.explanation_hi: प्रस्ताव में लाभहीन जोतों के लिए लगान माफी का वादा था, समान लगान का नहीं। अतः 'लाभहीन तथा बंजर जोतों के लिए भी समान लगान' वाला कथन असत्य है।

1929 की अमरीका की आर्थिक मंदी से वहाँ और दूसरे पूँजीवादी देशों में भी उत्पादन और विदेशी व्यापार में बहुत बड़ी गिरावट आयी। जनता की आर्थिक स्थिति खराब हो गई और बड़े पैमाने पर बेरोज़गारी फैली। दूसरी ओर सोवियत संघ में गिरावट ही नहीं आई बल्कि 1929 और 1936 के बीच पहली दो पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं से सोवियत संघ का औद्योगिक उत्पादन चार गुना से भी अधिक हो गया। विश्वव्यापी मंदी के कारण पूँजीवादी प्रणाली बदनाम हो गई और लोगों का ध्यान मार्क्सवाद, समाजवाद और आर्थिक योजना के विचार की ओर गया। जनता खासकर युवक, मज़दूर और किसान समाजवादी विचारों की ओर खिंचने लगे। राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन के आरम्भिक दिनों से ही उनका झुकाव निर्धन जनता की ओर था। 1917 की रुसी क्रांति के प्रभाव से , राजनीतिक मंच पर गाँधीजी के उदय से, तथा दूसरे और तीसरे दशकों में शक्तिशाली वामपंथी गुटों के बनने से यह प्रवृत्ति और मज़बूत हुई। कांग्रेस ने कराची अधिवेशन में जवाहरलाल नेहरू के आग्रह पर एक प्रस्ताव पारित किया। प्रस्ताव में जनता को मूल नागरिक अधिकारों, जाति, पंथ, लिंग के भेद के बिना क़ानून के आगे सबकी समानता, सार्वभौमिक बालिग़ मताधिकार के आधार पर चुनाव तथा मुफ्त और अनिवार्य प्राथमिक शिक्षा की ज़मानत दी गई थी। लगान व मालगुज़ारी में काफी कमी, लाभहीन जोतों के लिए लगान माफी, खेतिहरों के क़र्ज़ों में तथा सूदखोरों के नियंत्रण से राहत, जीवनयापन योग्य-मज़दूरी समेत मज़दूरों के लिए बेहतर दशाओं, महिला मज़दूरों के लिए काम के सीमित घंटों और सुरक्षा, मज़दूरों तथा किसानों के लिए संगठित होने और यूनियन बनाने के अधिकार तथा प्रमुख उद्योगों, खदानों और यातायात के साधनों पर राज्य का स्वामित्त्व या नियंत्रण जैसे वादे भी इस प्रस्ताव में किए गए थे। 1934 में आचार्य नरेंद्र देव तथा जयप्रकाश नारायण के नेतृत्त्व में 'कांग्रेस समाजवादी पार्टी' की स्थापना हुई। 1939 में सुभाषचंद्र बोस ने 'फॉरवर्ड ब्लॉक' की स्थापना की।

questions.question_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A.This is the story of an unhappy telephone booth that woke up one morning with a headache.
B.A little later a small boy who was watching all this from a distance came and began singing in his lovely voice.
C.A young man came to make a call, but the door wouldn't open; then an old lady came and she also could not open it.
D.And lo and behold! The door opened on its own.
questions.explanation_en: A introduces the story of the unhappy telephone booth, C describes people failing to open its door, B brings in the boy who sang, and D gives the result - the door opened. Hence ACBD.

I appreciate her being honesty about all her mistakes.

questions.question_en:
Comprehension:
Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

No matter where you work, sometimes subtle and sometimes very obvious competition is a part and parcel of workplaces. In an environment where most workers are seeking good appraisals, awards, promotions and reputation, fairness is not always on the minds of those competing with each other.
I recall a story in elementary school about how to make a line smaller without cutting it. The answer to the challenge is drawing a bigger line beside the first line so that the one already drawn looks smaller automatically. The moral of the story is that in order to win over others, you don't necessarily need to cut them down. Instead, you can make yourself bigger by being better at the job or earning credibility fairly. Competition is inevitable, but to outshine others, one way is to do a better job or advance yourself by learning and demonstrating skills.
Some people resort to unfair means. They throw colleagues, take credit for others' work, gossip, backbite, go out of their way to please the bosses and do favours outside of work to earn favours at work, etc. When many employees at work take this approach, the culture of the place becomes toxic over time where it is hard for people to trust each other and contribute to a team environment.
Some workers either get frustrated and disengaged and 'quietly quit', that is, they stop caring about work without actually quitting and do the bare minimum to not get fired. Some others simply leave. But quitting is not an option for everyone, especially when their income supports the family. There are extreme scenarios where people have ended their lives or suffered chronic mental or other health problems because they are unable to cope.
Because job hopping is not easy and not always a solution for everyone, changing the toxic culture is important.
A human resources department that truly supports employees and their well-being, a strong leadership and psychological safety at work that allows employees to speak up when they see something wrong without the fear of being reprimanded are some important prerequisites to achieve a work culture that is conducive to equitable growth opportunities for all. Such a work environment would also make the organisation productive.

questions.explanation_en: The story shows a line can be made smaller by drawing a bigger one beside it, and the writer states the moral: to win you need not cut others down. So it conveys that one can win without defeating anyone.
