questions.question_en:
Choose the most appropriate option for the given blank.
You can't hear the chirping of the birds from outside, ______?
questions.question_hi:
Choose the most appropriate option for the given blank.
You can’t hear the chirping of the birds from outside, ______?
questions.explanation_en: A question tag repeats the auxiliary of the main clause with the same subject pronoun and opposite polarity. The main clause 'You can't hear...' is negative with 'can', so the tag is the positive 'can you?'.

The two main reasons of this chronic and unmanageable problem is rapidly ever increasing population and defective education system. questions.question_en:
Match the AI Ethics with its correct description.
AI Ethics | Description
I. Data privacy | 1. It is a standard metric that measures how many users in a database share a particular attribute.
II. K-anonymity | 2. It is a trade-off between the amount of data collected and the performance of a product or service.
III. L-diversity | 3. It extends the idea by merging several sensitive attributes together.
questions.question_hi: AI एथिक्स का उसके सही विवरण से मिलान करें।
questions.explanation_en: Data privacy involves a trade-off between how much data is collected and how well a product or service performs (I-2). K-anonymity measures how many records in a database share the same attribute values, so each person is hidden among at least k others (II-1). L-diversity extends k-anonymity by requiring diversity in the sensitive attributes of each group (III-3). So the match is I-2, II-1, III-3.

questions.question_en: What is the advantage of exploratory Data Analysis in Big Data and Analytics?

options.en: Usually does not provide definitive answers

questions.explanation_en: Exploratory Data Analysis is flexible and visual, letting analysts discover patterns and generate new hypotheses before formal modelling. Not giving definitive answers and less realistic statements of accuracy are drawbacks of EDA, not advantages.

questions.question_en: In computer networking, a Repeater is a device that operates only in the ______ layer.
questions.question_hi:
कंप्यूटर नेटवर
किंग में, रिपीटर एक उपकरण है जो केवल ______ लेयर में काम करता है।
questions.explanation_en: A repeater only regenerates and amplifies the signal bit by bit to extend the range of a cable. It does not read addresses, so it works only at the physical layer. Bridges and switches work at the data link layer, and routers at the network layer.

questions.question_en: Which of the following data function in SQL returns the current database system timestamp as a 'datetime' value without the database time zone offset?

questions.explanation_en: In SQL Server, GETDATE() returns the current database system timestamp as a datetime value without the time-zone offset (SYSDATETIMEOFFSET includes it). GETTIME, CASTDATE and CASTTIME are not standard functions.

questions.question_en: Which of the following type of function used with strings in the Python language returns the character with the highest ASCII value?
questions.question_hi: ASCII मान वाला कैरेक्टर लौटाता है?
questions.explanation_en: When given a string, Python's max() returns the character with the highest ASCII/Unicode value, for example max('apple') = 'p'. len() returns the length, and hvalue() and long() are not Python built-ins for strings.

questions.question_en: Which of the following command is used in the communication system call of an operating system?
questions.explanation_en: Communication system calls include create/delete connection, send/receive messages, transfer status information, and attach or detach remote devices. Request/release device belongs to device management, allocate/free memory to process control, and read/write/reposition to file management.

questions.question_en: A ______ index is an ordered file whose records are of fixed length with two fields primary key and a pointer to a disk block.
questions.question_hi:
______ इंडेक्स एक ऑर्डरड फ़ााइल है जिसके रिकॉर्ड दो फ़ील्ड प्रााइमरी क़ी तथा डिस्क ब्लॉक के लिए एक
पॉइंटर के साथ निश्चित लंबाई के होते हैं।
questions.explanation_en: A primary index is an ordered file of fixed-length records with two fields: the primary key value of the first record in a data block (the anchor) and a pointer to that disk block. A clustering index is built on a non-key ordering field, and a secondary index is built on a non-ordering field.

questions.question_en:

questions.explanation_en: Many AI models, especially deep neural networks, are 'black boxes': their internal reasoning is hard to interpret, so hidden biases are difficult to detect. Deepfakes are AI-generated fake media and k-anonymity is a privacy technique, so only II is correct.

questions.question_en: In cyber security, what remedy does the law provide?
questions.question_hi: साइबर सुरक्षाा में, कानून क्या उपाय प्रदान करता है?
questions.explanation_en: Cyber laws such as the IT Act, 2000 provide legal remedies including penalties, compensation and imprisonment for cyber offences. Technologies and computer networks are tools, not legal remedies, and an apology is not a remedy provided by law.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following statement is correct for DATEDIFF function in SQL?
I. This function reports difference between the arguments 'startdate' and 'enddate'.
II. In this, 'datepart' argument/value can be specified in a variable.
questions.question_hi:

questions.question_en: In the data link layer, _____ is based on automatic repeat request, which is the retransmission of data.
questions.question_hi: डेटा लिंक लेयर में, _____ आटोमेटिक रिपीट रिक्वेस्ट पर आधारित है, जो डेटा का पुनः प्रसारण है।
questions.explanation_en: Error control in the data link layer is based on Automatic Repeat reQuest (ARQ): damaged or lost frames are detected and retransmitted. Flow control only regulates how much data the sender can send before waiting for acknowledgement.

questions.question_en: In which of the following condition of Deadlock Prevention, at least one resource must be non-sharable?

डेडलॉक निवारण की निम्नलिखित में से किस स्थि

चाहिए?
questions.explanation_en: The mutual exclusion condition says at least one resource must be held in a non-sharable mode, so only one process can use it at a time. Hold and wait, no preemption and circular wait are the other three necessary conditions for deadlock.

questions.question_en: Which of the following statement is correct for a 'Volume Control block' in File-System Implementation?

It has a unique identifier number to allow association with a directory entry
It contains the number of block in the partition
It can contain information needed by the system to boot an operating system from that volume

questions.question_hi:
Python लैंग्वेज में, फ़ााइल खोलने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मोड, फ़ााइल को पढ़ने तथा लिखने दोनों
के लिए खोलता है तथा फ़ााइल पॉइंटर को फ़ााइल की शुरुआत में रखा जाएगा?
questions.explanation_en: Mode 'r+' opens an existing file for both reading and writing with the file pointer at the beginning. 'a+' also allows reading and writing, but writes go to the end of the file. 'rb' is read-only binary and 'ab' is append-only binary.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is characteristic of a RISC (Reduced Instruction Set Computer) processor?

options.en: Instruction that manipulate operands in memory
A large number (typically from 100 to 250) of instructions

questions.explanation_en: RISC processors use fixed-length, easily decoded instructions, few addressing modes, hardwired control and load/store-only memory access. Microprogrammed control, memory-operand instructions and 100-250 instructions are CISC characteristics.

questions.question_en: Which among the following given below is correct in context of privacy issues in social media and online platforms?
questions.question_hi:
सोशल मीडिया तथा ऑनलाइन प्लेटफ़ॉॉर्म में गोपनीयता के मुद्दों के संदर्भ में नीचे दिए गए निम्नलिखित में से
कौन सा सही है ?

options.en: The sharing on social media especially by children must be monitored at all times.
options.hi: सोशल मीडिया की लत किसी छात्र के शैक्षणिक प्रदर्शन में बाधा नहीं डालती है।

options.en: The addiction of social media does not hamper the academic performance of a student.
options.hi: सोशल मीडिया पर विशेष कर बच्चों द्वाारा साझा की जाने वाली बातों पर हर समय निगरानी रखी जानी चाहिए।

options.en: Rumours and fake news cannot put the administration at risk.
options.hi: अफवाहें तथा फर्जी खबरें प्रशासन को खतरे में नहीं डाल सकतीं।

options.en: Mishandling of social media cannot create tension in the law and order.
options.hi: सोशल मीडिया का दुरुपयोग कानून व्यवस्थाा में तनाव पैदा नहीं कर सकता।

questions.explanation_en: Children are especially at risk of privacy violations and cyberbullying, so what they share on social media should be monitored. The other options are false: social media addiction can hurt studies, and rumours, fake news and misuse of social media can disturb law and order.

questions.question_en: In which of the following type of addressing mode, the instruction specifies a register in the CPU whose contents give the address of the operand in memory?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रकार के एड्रेेसिंग मोड में, इंस्ट्रक्शन सी.पी.यू. में एक रजिस्टर निर्दिष्ट करता है जिसकी
कंटेट मेमोरी में ऑपरेंड का एड्रेेस देती है?
questions.explanation_en: In register indirect mode the instruction specifies a CPU register whose contents are the memory address of the operand. In indirect address mode the address field points to a memory word that holds the effective address, and immediate mode has the operand in the instruction itself.

questions.question_en: In HTML body tag, which of the following attribute indicates the colour of the hyperlinks after the mouse is clicked on it?
questions.question_hi: रंग को इंगित करता है?
questions.explanation_en: In the <body> tag, LINK sets the colour of unvisited links, ALINK sets the colour of a link while it is being clicked (active), and VLINK sets the colour of links that have already been visited (after they are clicked). So VLINK is the colour after the click. HLINK is not an attribute.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct regarding Assembly language?
I. An assembler converts (or assembles) the symbolic program of an Assembly language into its equivalent machine program.
II. A program written in an assembly language is machine dependent.
questions.question_hi:
असेंबली भाषा के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है/हैं?
I.असेंबलर एक असेंबली भाषा के प्रतीकात्मक प्रोोग्रााम को उसके समकक्ष मशीन प्रोोग्रााम में परिवर्तित (या
असेंबल) करता है।
II. असेंबली भाषा में लिखा गया प्रोोग्रााम मशीन पर निर्भर होता है।

options.hi: ना ही I ना ही II

questions.explanation_en: Both statements are correct: an assembler translates symbolic assembly code into equivalent machine code, and assembly language is machine-dependent because its mnemonics map directly onto a specific processor's instruction set.

questions.question_en: Which of the following Instruction format use an implied accumulator (AC) register for all data manipulation?
questions.question_hi: उपयोग करता है?
questions.explanation_en: One-address instructions (such as ADD X) use an implied accumulator: AC <- AC + M[X], so the AC is both the source and the result of every data operation. Zero-address instructions use a stack, and two- or three-address instructions name their operands explicitly.

questions.question_en: In context of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, which of the given following is correct?
questions.question_hi:
डिजिटल व्यक
गत डेटा संरक्षण अधिनियम, 2023 के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?

options.en: “Child” means an individual who has not completed the age of eighteen years
options.hi: "चेयरपर्सन" का मतलब बोर्ड का चेयरपर्सन नहीं है

options.en: “Digital personal data” means personal data in physical form
options.hi: "डिजिटल व्यक गत डेटा" का अर्थ भौतिक रूप में व्यक गत डेटा है

options.en: “Chairperson” does not mean the chairperson of the board
options.hi: "बालक" का तात्पर्य ऐसे व्यक से है जिसने अठारह वर्ष की आयु पूरी नहीं की है
"डेटा" का अर्थ केवल तथ्यों का प्रतिनिधित्व है

questions.explanation_en: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, a 'child' is an individual who has not completed eighteen years of age. Digital personal data means personal data in digital form (not physical), and 'Chairperson' does refer to the Chairperson of the Data Protection Board.

questions.question_en: Which of the following File operation need not involve any actual I/O (Input/Output) and is also known as 'File Seek'?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से किस फ़ााइल ऑपरेशन में किसी वास्तविक I/O (इनपुट/आउटपुट) की आवश्यकता नहीं होती
है तथा इसे 'फ़ााइल सीक' के रूप में भी जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: Repositioning within a file (file seek) only changes the current file-position pointer to a new value. It does not need any actual read or write on the disk. Reading, deleting and truncating all change or access the file's data or blocks.

questions.question_en: In CPU, which of the following type of register is required by the control unit and contains the instruction currently being executed?
questions.question_hi:
सी.पी.यू. में, कण्ट्रोोल यूनिट को निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रकार के रजिस्टर की आवश्यकता होती है तथा इसम
वर्तमान में निष्पादित इंस्ट्रक्शन शामिल होते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: The Instruction Register (IR) holds the instruction currently being executed so that the control unit can decode it. The accumulator holds operands/results, and the memory data register buffers data moving to and from memory.

questions.question_en: The values in a dictionary can be ______ but the keys in the dictionary should be ______ in Python programming languages
questions.question_hi: होनी चाहिए
questions.explanation_en: In a Python dictionary the values can repeat (for example {'a': 1, 'b': 1}), but the keys must be unique (and immutable). If a key is assigned again, the old value is replaced, so a key never appears twice.

questions.question_en: Which of the following part of operating system allocates the CPU to next scheduled process in the system?
questions.question_hi: आवंटित करता है?
questions.explanation_en: The dispatcher gives control of the CPU to the process selected by the short-term scheduler: it performs the context switch, switches to user mode and jumps to the right location. The scheduler only decides which process runs next; the dispatcher actually allocates the CPU.

questions.question_en: Which of the following printer is type of impact printer?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा प्रिंटर इम्पैैक्ट प्रिंटर का प्रकार है?
questions.explanation_en: A dot matrix printer is an impact printer: tiny pins strike an inked ribbon against the paper to make dots. Ink-jet, laser and thermal printers are non-impact printers because nothing strikes the paper.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following statement is correct regarding point-to-point connection in the data communication?
I. It provides a dedicated link between two devices.
II. It is a timeshared connection.
questions.question_hi:
डेटा संचार में पॉइंट-टू-पॉइंट कनेक्शन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है?
I. यह दो उपकरणों के बीच एक समर्पित लिंक प्रदान करता है।
II. यह एक टाइमशेयर्ड कनेक्शन है।

options.hi: ना ही I ना ही II

questions.explanation_en: A point-to-point connection provides a dedicated link between exactly two devices, so statement I is correct. A timeshared link is a feature of multipoint (multidrop) connections, where several devices share one link, so II is false.

questions.question_en: In Direct Memory Access (DMA) ______, a block sequence consisting of a number of memory words is transferred in a continuous burst.
questions.question_hi:
डायरेक्ट मेमोरी एक्सेस (डी.एम.ए.) ______ में, कई मेमोरी वर्ड्स से युक्त एक ब्लॉक अनुक्रम को निरंतर बर्स्ट म
स्थाानांतरित किया जाता है।
questions.explanation_en: In DMA burst transfer mode, the DMA controller takes the bus and transfers a whole block of memory words in one continuous burst before giving the bus back. In cycle stealing it transfers one word at a time, taking single bus cycles from the CPU.

questions.question_en: Which of the following normal form of normalization in relational model, disallows relations within relations or relations as attribute values within tuples?
questions.question_hi: के रूप में संबंधों या संबंधों के भीतर संबंधों को अस्वीकार करता है?
questions.explanation_en: 1NF requires atomic attribute values; it disallows multivalued and composite attributes, i.e. relations within relations (nested relations) as attribute values. 2NF and 3NF deal with partial and transitive dependencies.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT an attribute that included by the HR tag which puts a horizontal line on the page?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एट्रिब्यूट HR टैग में शामिल नहीं है जो पेज पर एक क्षैैतिज रेखा डालता है?
questions.explanation_en: The <HR> tag supports the attributes SIZE (thickness), WIDTH, ALIGN and NOSHADE (draws a solid line without shading). There is no attribute called SHADE; the real attribute is NOSHADE.

questions.question_en: ______ enables the creator owner to earn recognition or financial benefit by using their creation or invention.
questions.question_hi:
______ निर्माता मालिक को उनकी रचना या आविष्कार का उपयोग करके मान्यता या वित्तीीय लाभ अर
जित
करने में सक्षम बनाता है।
questions.explanation_en: Key doubt: the statement is the WIPO description of intellectual property rights - IP is protected by patents, copyright and trademarks, which 'enable people to earn recognition or financial benefit from what they invent or create'. Because it covers inventions as well as creations, option 3 (intellectual property right) is the correct general answer. Copyright protects only original creative works, not inventions (those are patented), so the official key is too narrow.

questions.question_en: Over half of the e-waste generated in the developed world are exported to developing countries, mainly to ______, where metals like copper, iron, silicon, nickel and gold are recovered during recycling process.
questions.question_hi:
मुख्य रूप से ______ को, जहां रीसाइक्लिंंग प्रक
या के दौरान तांबा, लोहा, सिलिकॉन, निकील तथा सोना
जैसी धातुएं बरामद की जाती हैं।
questions.explanation_en: Studies on e-waste report that a large share of the e-waste from developed countries is shipped to developing countries, with India (along with China and parts of Africa) a major destination. There, metals such as copper, iron, nickel and gold are recovered, often by unsafe informal recycling.

questions.question_en: ______ is a two-dimensional labelled data structure with columns of potentially different type, in data handling with pandas.
questions.question_hi: भिन्न प्रकार के कॉलम होते हैं।
questions.explanation_en: A DataFrame is a two-dimensional labelled data structure with rows and columns, where columns may hold different data types (like a spreadsheet or SQL table). A Series is one-dimensional.

questions.question_en: A semaphore is an integer variable that, apart from initialization, is accessed only through which of the following standard atomic operation?
questions.question_hi: एटॉमिक ऑपरेशन के माध्यम से एक्सेस किया जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: Apart from initialisation, a semaphore S is accessed only through two atomic operations: wait() (P, decrement) and signal() (V, increment). acquire()/release() and lock() are names used by some libraries for locks, not the standard semaphore operations.

questions.question_en: From the challenges given below, which of the challenge does IoT adoption include?
questions.explanation_en: Security (and privacy) is a major challenge of IoT adoption, because many connected devices have weak authentication and are hard to patch. Deepfakes and black-box models are AI issues, and cloud storage is a supporting technology, not an IoT challenge.

questions.question_en: Which of the following tag of HTML language is a container for the tags that contain information about the page?
questions.question_hi:
HTML भाषा का निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा टैग, उन टैग के लिए एक कंटेनर है जिसमें पेज के बारे म
जानकारी होती है?
questions.explanation_en: The <head> element is a container for metadata about the page: <title>, <meta>, <link>, <style> and <script>. <title> is only one tag inside the head, and <body> holds the visible content.

questions.question_en: Irreparable computer and other electronic goods are known as ______ in tech world.
questions.question_hi: तकनीक की दुनिया में अपूरणीय कंप्यूटर तथा अन्य इलेक्ट्रॉॉनिक सामानों को ______ कहा जाता है।
questions.explanation_en: Discarded, unusable or irreparable computers, phones and other electronic goods are called electronic waste (e-waste). They contain hazardous materials such as lead and mercury and need special recycling.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a one-dimensional labelled array capable of holding any data type (integers, strings, floating point numbers, python objects, etc) in data handling with pandas?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक-विमीय लेबल वाला ऐरे है जो Pandas के साथ डेटा हैंडलिंग में किसी भी डेटा
प्रकार (पूर्णांक, स्ट्रिंग, फ़्लोटिंग पॉइंट नंबर, Python ऑब्जेक्ट इत्यादि ) को रखने में सक्षम है?
questions.explanation_en: A pandas Series is a one-dimensional labelled array that can hold any data type, with an index as its labels. A DataFrame is two-dimensional (rows and columns, made of several Series).

questions.question_en:
The E-waste (management) rules 2016 of India, recognizes two broad categories: IT and telecommunication equipment and consumer electrical and electronics including which of the following material?
I. Fluorescent
II. Mercury
questions.question_hi:
भारत का ई-वेस्ट (प्रबंधन) नियम 2016 दो व्याापक श्रेेणियों को मान्यता देता है: आई.टी. तथा दूरसंचार
उपकरण तथा उपभोक्ताा इलेक्ट्रिकल तथा इलेक्ट्रॉॉनिक्स सहित निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी सामग्रीी?
I. फ्लोरोसेंट
II. मरकरी

options.hi: ना ही I ना ही II

questions.explanation_en: The E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2016 cover IT and telecom equipment and consumer electrical and electronics, and they also brought compact fluorescent lamps and other mercury-containing lamps under their scope. So both fluorescent and mercury items are included.

questions.question_en: Which of the following form is correct to show a 'comments' in the HTML language?
questions.explanation_en: An HTML comment is written as <!-- This is a comment -->: it starts with <!-- and ends with -->. Option 4 is this form (with spaces shown between the symbols). The other options either miss the ! at the start or wrongly put ! in the closing part.

questions.question_en:
If you encounter an import Error, what does it mean?
I. Python could find pandas in list of available libraries
II. Python couldn't find python in list of available libraries
III. Python couldn't find Pandas in list of available libraries
questions.question_hi:
यदि आपको कोई आयात त्रुुटि मिलती है, तो इसका क्या अर्थ है?
I. Python उपलब्ध लाइब्रेेरी की सूची में Pandas ढूंढ सकता है
II. Pandas को उपलब्ध लाइब्रेेरी की सूची में Python नहीं मिला
III. Python उपलब्ध लाइब्रेेरी की सूची में Pandas को नहीं ढूंढ सका
questions.explanation_en: An ImportError/ModuleNotFoundError while doing import pandas means Python could not find the pandas package among installed libraries (e.g. it is not installed). Statement I says it could find pandas, and II refers to 'python' instead of the library, so only III is correct.

questions.question_en: Data frame in Pandas has a method which takes a column name (for a regular index) or a list of column names to create a new, re-indexed data frame, which of the following is correct method?
questions.question_hi:
Pandas में डेटा फ्रेेम में एक विधि होती है जो एक नया, पुन: अनुक्रमित डेटा फ्रेेम बनाने के लिए एक कॉलम
नाम (नियमित इंडेक्स के लिए) या कॉलम नामों की एक सूची लेती है, निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी सही विधि
हैं?
questions.explanation_en: DataFrame.set_index() takes a column name (or a list of column names for a MultiIndex) and returns a new DataFrame indexed by those columns. reset_index() does the reverse. data.index is an attribute, not a method that re-indexes, and 'dFb'/'dFmi' are just variable names.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is correct for Identifiers name used in Python language?
questions.question_hi: Python लैंग्वेज में प्रयुक्त आइडेंटिफायर नाम के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?

options.en: An identifier can have underscore (_) symbol
options.hi: हमें आइडेंटिफायर के रूप में कीवर्ड का उपयोग करना चाहिए

options.en: We must use keywords as identifier
options.hi: आइडेंटिफायर की लंबाई पर प्रतिबंध होता है

options.en: There is restriction the length of an identifier
options.hi: एक आइडेंटिफायर में अंडरस्कोर (_) चिन्ह हो सकता है

options.en: An identifier must start with a digit
options.hi: आइडेंटिफायर को एक अंक से शुरू होना चाहिए

questions.explanation_en: A Python identifier can contain letters, digits and the underscore (_), and may start with an underscore. Keywords cannot be used as identifiers, there is no length limit, and an identifier cannot start with a digit.

questions.question_en: Which of the following rule is needed to be followed while declaring the XML (Extensible Markup Language) elements name?
questions.question_hi: पालन करना आवश्यक है?

options.en: Name must start with a number
options.hi: नाम xml अक्षर से प्राारंभ नहीं होना चाहिए
नाम में अक्षर, अंक तथा अन्य करैक्टर नहीं हो सकते

options.en: Name must not start with the letter xml
options.hi: नाम में रिक्त स्थाान हो सकते ह

options.en: Name cannot contain letter, numbers and other characters
options.hi: नाम किसी संख्या से प्राारंभ होने चाहिए

questions.explanation_en: XML naming rules: element names are case-sensitive, must start with a letter or underscore, cannot contain spaces, and must not start with the letters 'xml' (in any case), because that prefix is reserved. They can contain letters, digits, hyphens, underscores and periods, so the other options are false.

questions.question_en: In digital realm, which refers to the legal rights to protect invention or creation in intellectual property, are given to whom?
questions.question_hi:
डिजिटल क्षेेत्र में, जो बौद्धि
क संपदा में आविष्कार या सृजन की रक्षाा के कानूनी अधिकारों को संदर्भित करता
है, किसे दिए जाते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: Intellectual property rights are granted to the creator or inventor of the work, giving them exclusive rights over its use for a period of time. Employees, sellers or buyers get rights only if transferred by the creator.

questions.question_en: Which of the following symbol is used to add comments in the Python language?
questions.question_hi: Python लैंग्वेज में कमेंट जोड़ने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रतीक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: In Python a single-line comment starts with the hash symbol #, and everything after it on the line is ignored. // is used for comments in C/C++/Java, but in Python it is the floor-division operator.

questions.question_en: Which operation is provided in Pandas, when multiple tables can be concatenated both column wise and row wise as database?
questions.question_hi: अनुसार तथा रों के अनुसार दोनों तरह से संयोजित किया जा सकता है?
questions.explanation_en: Pandas provides database-style operations to combine tables: merge() (join on keys) and concat() for row-wise or column-wise joining. Among the options, MERGE is the combining operation; SUM, GROUP BY and SELECT aggregate or filter data rather than combining tables.

questions.question_en: IPR (Intellectual Property Right) is given for how much time, in digital realm?
questions.question_hi:
डिजिटल क्षेेत्र में IPR (बौद्धि
क संपदा अधिकार) कितने समय के लिए दिया जाता है?

options.hi: मामले दर मामले के आधार पर

options.en: Depending on case to case basis

questions.explanation_en: Intellectual property rights such as copyright, patents and designs, including those for digital works, are granted only for a limited, certain period. For example, a patent lasts 20 years and copyright lasts for the author's life plus 60 years in India. After that the work goes into the public domain, so the protection is not unlimited.

questions.question_en: In E-waste management, from which factors, there comes the exposure variability in electronic waste?

options.en: Quantity of the Pollutants in air
Management processes of the air pollution

questions.explanation_en: Exposure to e-waste hazards varies mainly with the type of e-waste (what device and which toxic components, e.g. lead, mercury, cadmium), along with how it is processed. Air pollutant quantities and air-pollution management are outcomes rather than the source of variability, and medical waste is a separate category.

questions.question_en: Which of the following HTML tag is used to puts a line break in the text?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस HTML टैग का उपयोग टेक्स्ट में लाइन ब्रेेक लगाने के लिए किया जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: is an empty tag that inserts a line break, so the following text starts on a new line. makes text bold, and and are not standard HTML tags.

questions.question_en: Which of the following maths function in SQL returns the smallest integer greater than, or equal to, the specified numeric expression?
questions.question_hi:
SQL में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा गणित फ़ंंक्शन निर्दिष्ट संख्यात्मक अभिव्यक
से बड़ाा या उसके बराबर
सबसे छोटा पूर्णांक लौटाता है?
questions.explanation_en: CEILING(x) returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to x, e.g. CEILING(4.2) = 5. FLOOR returns the largest integer less than or equal to x, ROUND rounds to the nearest value, and ABS gives the absolute value.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following page replacement algorithms(s) does not suffer from Belady's anomaly in Operating System?
I. Least-Recently Used (LRU) page replacement.
II. First-In, First-Out (FIFO) page replacement.
questions.question_hi:
ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा पेज रिप्लेसमेंट एल्गोरिदम बेलाडी की विसंगति से ग्रस्त नहीं है?
I. लीस्ट-रिसेंटली यूस्ड (एल.आर.यू.) पेज रिप्लेसमेंट।
II. फर्स्ट-इन, फर्स्ट-आउट (फीफो) पेज रिप्लेसमेंट।

options.hi: ना ही I ना ही II

questions.explanation_en: Belady's anomaly means that giving a process more frames causes more page faults. FIFO can show this anomaly (for example the string 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,1,2,3,4,5 gives 9 faults with 3 frames and 10 with 4). LRU is a stack algorithm, so it never suffers from it. So only I is correct.

questions.question_en:
String is a collection of one or more character which consists of ______ in programming language.
I. Letters
II. Numbers
III. Symbols
questions.question_hi:
स्ट्रिंग एक या एक से अधिक कैरेक्टर का संग्रह है जिसमें प्रोोग्राामिंग भाषा में ______ होता है।
I. अक्षर
II. संख्या
III. प्रतीक
questions.explanation_en: A string is a sequence of characters, which can include letters, digits (numbers as characters) and symbols such as @, # or spaces. So all three - I, II and III - are correct.

questions.question_en: Which of the following symbol is used with SELECT command of SQL, to retrieve all the attribute values of the selected tuples?
questions.question_hi:
चयनित टपल्स के सभी एट्रिब्यूट मानों को पुनः प्रााप्त करने के लिए, SQL के SELECT कमांड के साथ
निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रतीक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: SELECT * FROM table returns all attributes (columns) of the selected rows; * is the wildcard for 'all columns'. % is the LIKE wildcard for any sequence of characters, and # and : have no such role in standard SQL.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is commonly used in UNICODE encoding schemes and number system in computer science?
questions.question_hi: किसका उपयोग किया जाता है ?
questions.explanation_en: UTF-8 is the most widely used Unicode encoding scheme (variable length, 1-4 bytes, ASCII-compatible). The other standard encodings are UTF-16 and UTF-32; UTF-17, UTF-61 and UTF-35 do not exist.

questions.question_en: Extensions like .txt, .py, .CSV, etc in python language are example of ______.
questions.explanation_en: .txt, .py and .csv files store data as human-readable characters, so they are text files, unlike binary files such as .jpg or .exe. ASCII and Unicode are character encodings, not file types, and a text editor is a program used to edit these files.

questions.question_en: Which of the following phase of the compiler, gathers type information and saves it in either the syntax tree or the symbol table, for subsequent use during intermediate code generation?
questions.question_hi: जनरेशन के दौरान बाद के उपयोग के लिए सिंटैक्स ट्री या प्रतीक टेबल में सहेजता है?
questions.explanation_en: The semantic analyzer checks the parse tree for semantic consistency (type checking) and gathers type information, storing it in the syntax tree or symbol table for intermediate code generation. The syntax analyzer only builds the parse tree, and the lexical analyzer produces tokens.

questions.question_en: Number with decimal points is called ______ in programming language.
questions.question_hi: प्रोोग्राामिंग भाषा में दशमलव अंक वाली संख्या को ______ कहा जाता है।
questions.explanation_en: Numbers with a decimal point (like 3.14) are fractional numbers, stored as floating-point (real) numbers in programming languages such as float in Python. Among the given options 'fractional point numbers' is the matching term. Integers have no fractional part, and complex/imaginary numbers have a different meaning.

questions.question_en: Which of the following operation includes all tuples that are in R-set but not in S-set?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस ऑपरेशन में वे सभी टपल्स शामिल हैं जो R-सेट में हैं लेकिन S-सेट में नहीं हैं?
questions.explanation_en: The set difference R - S contains tuples that are in R but not in S. R ∩ S gives tuples in both, R ∪ S tuples in either, and R × S is the Cartesian product.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT an aggregate function in SQL?
questions.explanation_en: SQL aggregate functions such as COUNT, SUM, AVG, MAX and MIN take a group of rows and return a single value. 'MAXIMUM' in the options refers to MAX. A cross product (Cartesian product) is a join operation that combines rows of two tables, not an aggregate function.

questions.question_en: ______ has been developed to incorporate all the character of every written language of the world. It provides a unique number for every character, irrespective of device [server, desktop, mob], OS [linux, win] or software application
questions.question_hi:
______ को दुनिया की हर लिखित भाषा के सभी करैक्टर को शामिल करने के लिए विकसित किया गया है।
यह डिवाइस [सर्वर, डेस्कटॉप, मोब], ओ.एस. [लिनक्स , विन] या सॉफ़्टवेयर एप्लिकेशन के बावजूद, प्रत्येक
करैक्टर के लिए एक अद्वितीय नंबर प्रदान करता है ।
questions.explanation_en: Unicode assigns a unique number (code point) to every character of every written language, regardless of platform, device or program. ASCII covers only 128 English characters and ISCII covers only Indian scripts.

questions.question_en: ASCII (American Standard Code for Information Interchange) can only handle ______ or at most ______ languages and that shows its limitation to handle all world languages.
questions.question_hi:
ASCII (इनफार्मेशन इंटरचेंज के लिए अमेरिकी मानक कोड) केवल ______ या अधिकतम ______ भाषाओं
को संभाल सकता है तथा यह सभी विश्व भाषाओं को संभालने में इसकी सीमा को दर्शाता है।
questions.explanation_en: ASCII is a 7-bit code with only 128 characters, enough for the English alphabet, digits and symbols. So it can handle 1 language (English), or at most 2 with the extended 8-bit sets. It cannot represent scripts like Devanagari or Chinese, which is why Unicode was developed.

questions.question_en: In Database Management System (DBMS), which of the following term defines a collection of entities that have the same attributes in the database?
questions.question_hi: है जिनके डेटाबेस में समान एट्रिब्यूट हैं?
questions.explanation_en: In Elmasri-Navathe's terminology, an entity type defines a collection of entities that have the same attributes (e.g. EMPLOYEE). An entity set is the collection of entities of that type present in the database at a particular moment, and a value set is the domain of an attribute.

questions.question_en: Which symbol is used to add the comment in the code or program to make it more readable and understandable in Python programming language?
questions.question_hi: के लिए किस प्रतीक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: Python uses # for comments: everything after # on a line is ignored by the interpreter and is only for readers of the code. * is multiplication, - is subtraction and : starts a code block.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct for context switching in Operating System?
I. When a context switch occurs, the kernel saves the context of the old process in its PCB (Process Control Block).
II. Context-Switch time is pure overhead, because the system does no useful work while switching.
questions.question_hi:
ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम में कॉन्टेक्स्ट स्विचिंग के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है/हैं?
I. जब कोई कॉन्टेक्स्ट स्विच होता है, तो कर्नेल पुरानी प्रक
या के कॉन्टेक्स्ट को अपने पी.सी.बी. (प्रोोसेस कंट्रोोल
ब्लॉक) में सहेजता है।
II. कॉन्टेक्स्ट - स्विच टाइम शुद्ध ओवरहेड है, क्योंकि स्विच करते समय सिस्टम कोई उपयोगी कार्य नहीं करता
है।

options.hi: ना ही I ना ही II

questions.explanation_en: During a context switch the kernel saves the old process's state (registers, PC, etc.) in its PCB and loads the new process's saved state. Context-switch time is pure overhead because no useful user work is done during the switch. Both statements are correct.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct regarding AND logic gate?
I. The AND gate produces the output value 1 if input A and input B are both equal to 1.
II. The algebraic operation symbol of the AND function is the same as the multiplication symbol of ordinary arithmetic.
questions.question_hi:
AND लॉजिक गेट के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है/हैं?
I. यदि इनपुट A तथा इनपुट B दोनों 1 के बराबर हैं तो AND गेट आउटपुट मान 1 उत्पन्न करता है।
II. AND फ़ंंक्शन का बीजगणितीय ऑपरेशन प्रतीक सामान्य अंकगणित के गुणन प्रतीक के समान है।

options.hi: ना ही I ना ही II

questions.explanation_en: Both statements are true. An AND gate outputs 1 only when all inputs are 1, so A = B = 1 gives 1. AND is written like ordinary multiplication: A.B or AB. So the correct option is both I and II.

questions.question_en: Which of the following term of ER model (Entity – Relationship) is corresponding to the foreign key (or relationship relation) in the relational model of database?
questions.question_hi:
ई.आर. मॉडल (एंटिटी - रिलेशनशिप) का निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा टर्म डेटाबेस के रिलेशनल मॉडल में फॉरेन
क़ी (या रिलेशनशिप रिलेशन) के अनुरूप है?

options.hi: M : N (अनेक से अनेक) संबंध प्रकार

options.en: 1 : 1 (one to one) or 1 : N (one to many) relationship type
M : N (many to many) relationship type
options.hi: 1:1 (एक से एक) या 1: N (एक से अनेक) संबंध प्रकार

questions.explanation_en: In ER-to-relational mapping, a 1:1 or 1:N relationship type corresponds to a foreign key (or a relationship relation). An M:N relationship type needs a separate relationship relation with two foreign keys, and composite attributes map to sets of simple attributes.

questions.question_en: In relational databases, which of the following integrity constraint is specified between two relations and is used to maintain the consistency among tuples in the two relations?
questions.question_hi:
इसका तथा दो संबंधों में टपल्स के बीच स्थि
रता बनाए रखने के लिए किया जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: A referential integrity constraint is defined between two relations: a foreign key value in one table must match an existing primary key value in the referenced table (or be NULL). This keeps the tuples in the two relations consistent. Entity integrity applies within one relation (primary key not NULL).

questions.question_en:
Match the following Process states of Operating System with their definitions.
State | Definition
I. New | 1. The process is waiting to be assigned to a processor
II. Running | 2. Instructions are being executed
III. Ready | 3. The process is being created
questions.question_hi:
ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम की निम्नलिखित प्रक
या स्टेट को उनकी परिभाषाओं के साथ सुमेलित करें।
questions.explanation_en: New: the process is being created (3). Running: instructions are being executed (2). Ready: the process is waiting to be assigned to a processor (1). So I-3, II-2, III-1.

questions.question_en: Which of the following operator is used as concatenation operator in SQL?
questions.explanation_en: In standard SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL) || is the string concatenation operator, for example 'Data' || 'base' gives 'Database'. MySQL uses CONCAT() and SQL Server uses +, while ++, ## and quotes are not concatenation operators.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following statement is correct regarding unguided media (wireless)?
I. Unguided media transport electromagnetic waves without using a physical conductor.
II. Unguided signals can travel from the source to destination in ground propagation way.
questions.question_hi:
I. अनगाइडेड मीडिया किसी भौतिकी कंडक्टर का उपयोग किए बिना विद्युुत चुम्बकीय तरंगों का परिवहन करता
है।
II. भूमि संचरण के माध्यम से अनगाइडेड सिग्नल स्रोोत से गंतव्य तक यात्राा कर सकते हैं।

options.hi: ना ही I ना ही II

questions.explanation_en: Unguided (wireless) media carry electromagnetic waves without a physical conductor, so I is true. Wireless signals propagate by ground propagation, sky propagation or line-of-sight, so II is also true. Hence both I and II.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is correct formula for calculating wavelength (λ) of a signal in the data communication?
questions.explanation_en: Wavelength is the distance a signal travels in one period: lambda = propagation speed x period, which is the same as speed / frequency. Option 4 (speed x frequency) is wrong because frequency = 1/period, so the speed should be divided by it.

questions.question_en: In periodic analog signals, which of the following is NOT a parameter to describe a sine wave in data communication?
questions.question_hi:
आवधिक एनालॉग सिग्नल में, डेटा संचार में साइन तरंग का वर्णन करने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा
पैरामीटर नहीं है?
questions.explanation_en: A sine wave is fully described by three parameters: peak amplitude, frequency (or period) and phase. Wavelength is a derived characteristic (propagation speed ÷ frequency), not one of the three describing parameters.

questions.question_en: Which of the following operator of SQL is used in WHERE clause for match a character pattern in database?
questions.question_hi:
डेटाबेस में कैरेक्टर पैटर्न के मिलान के लिए WHERE क्लॉज में SQL के निम्नलिखित में से किस ऑपरेटर का
उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: LIKE is used in a WHERE clause to match a character pattern, with % standing for any sequence of characters and _ for exactly one character, for example WHERE name LIKE 'A%'. IN checks membership in a list of values, and IS NULL tests for missing values.

questions.question_en: In SQL, which of the following is correct command for schema evolution, if the RESTRICT option is chosen than the schema is dropped only if schema has no element in it?
questions.question_hi:
SQL में, स्कीमा विकास के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही कमांड है, यदि RESTRICT विकल्प चुना
जाता है तो स्कीमा को केवल तभी हटा दिया जाता है जब स्कीमा में कोई एलिमेंट न हो?
questions.explanation_en: Schema evolution commands include DROP SCHEMA name RESTRICT, which drops the schema only if it has no elements, and CASCADE, which drops it with all its elements. ALTER modifies existing schema elements but has no RESTRICT schema-drop behaviour, and DELETE/UPDATE are DML commands.

questions.question_en: ______ files are spreadsheet files in a text format of data when cell contents are separated by a character for example a comma or semi-colon.
questions.question_hi: किया जाता है, उदाहरण के लिए अल्पविराम या अर्ध-कोलन।

options.hi: अल्पविराम से अलग किये गए मान
सेमी-कॉलन से अलग किए गए मान

questions.explanation_en: CSV (Comma-Separated Values) files are plain-text spreadsheet files in which each line is a row and the cell values are separated by a delimiter, usually a comma (sometimes a semicolon). 'CVS' is a misspelling, and 'Semi-colon Separated Values' is not the standard name of the format.

questions.question_en: Unicode in the programming language can be represented using which of the bit format standards in computer science?
questions.explanation_en: Unicode is commonly represented with UTF-8, an 8-bit (byte-based) encoding format; UTF-16 and UTF-32 are the other standard forms. 17-, 65- and 9-bit formats do not exist for Unicode.

questions.question_en: Which of the following type of guided transmission media are categorized by their Radio Government (RG) ratings in computer networking?
questions.question_hi: (आर.जी.) रेटिंग द्वाारा वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
questions.explanation_en: Coaxial cables are classified by Radio Government (RG) ratings such as RG-59 (cable TV), RG-58 (thin Ethernet) and RG-11 (thick Ethernet). Each RG number specifies physical properties like conductor gauge and impedance. Twisted-pair cables are rated by categories (Cat 5, Cat 6) instead.

questions.question_en: Which of the following system call include 'wait for time' operation command in Operating System?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से किस सिस्टम कॉल में ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम में 'समय की प्रतीक्षाा करें' ऑपरेशन कमांड शामिल
है?
questions.explanation_en: Process-control system calls include end/abort, load/execute, create/terminate process, get/set attributes, wait for time, wait event/signal event, and allocate/free memory. Device management handles request/release device, and file management handles open/read/write files.

questions.question_en: Which of the following stage is used for child cognition development at the age from 2 years to 7 years?
questions.question_hi: जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: Piaget's pre-operational stage spans roughly 2 to 7 years, marked by symbolic thought, egocentrism and lack of conservation. Hence option 2.

questions.question_en: The Government of India adopted the National Policy for Empowerment of Women in ______.
questions.explanation_en: The Government of India adopted the National Policy for the Empowerment of Women in 2001, which was also declared the Year of Women's Empowerment.

questions.question_en:
In which of the following approach Pedagogy indicate learning by doing based on engagement of students through different activities?
I. Teacher centered approach
II. Student centered approach
questions.question_hi:
के आधार पर अभिगम का संकेत देता है?
I. शिक्षक केन्द्रित दृष्टिकोण
II. विद्याार्थी केंद्रित दृष्टिकोण

options.hi: ना ही I ना ही II

questions.explanation_en: Learning by doing through varied activities that actively engage learners is the hallmark of the student-centred (constructivist) approach. The teacher-centred approach relies mainly on lecture and transmission.

questions.question_en: Which of the following approach of Assessment for Learning is the assessment of classmates on the response and performance of the learner?
questions.question_hi:
अभिगम के लिए मूल्यांकन का निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा उपागम शिक्षाार्थी की प्रतिक
या तथा प्रदर्शन पर
सहपाठियों का मूल्यांकन है?
questions.explanation_en: Peer assessment is when classmates evaluate a learner's responses and performance, giving feedback to one another. Self-assessment is by the learner himself and teacher-led assessment is by the teacher.

questions.question_en: Which of the following language was included through the 71st constitutional amendment (1992) in 8th schedule of the Indian Constitution?
questions.question_hi:
भारतीय संविधान की 8वीं अनुसूची में 71वें संवैधानिक संशोधन (1992) के माध्यम से निम्नलिखित में से कौन
सी भाषा शामिल की गई थी?
questions.explanation_en: The 71st Constitutional Amendment (1992) added Konkani, Manipuri and Nepali to the Eighth Schedule. Boro was added later by the 92nd Amendment (2003), and Bengali and Gujarati were original languages.

questions.question_en:
Art education is the area of learning that is based upon which of the following?
I. The visual, tangible art
II. The performing arts
questions.question_hi:
कला शिक्षाा अभिगम का वह क्षेेत्र है जो निम्नलिखित में से किस पर आधारित है?
I. दृश्य, मूर्त कला
II. प्रदर्शन कलाएँ

options.hi: ना ही I ना ही II

questions.explanation_en: Art education covers both the visual/tangible arts (drawing, painting, sculpture, crafts) and the performing arts (music, dance, drama). Hence both I and II.

questions.question_en: In which of the following approach to learning and teaching, both the teacher and the students perform activities strictly confined to the prescribed contents/ textbooks in the subject being taught?
questions.question_hi:
में निर्धारित सामग्रीी/पाठ्यपुस्तकों तक ही सीमित क
याकलाप करते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: In the subject-centred approach, teaching and learning activities are strictly confined to the prescribed content or textbook of the subject. Learner-centred approaches go beyond the textbook to learners' needs and experiences.

questions.question_en: Piaget divided which of the following domain of development into four stages: The Sensorimotor Stage, The Pre-Operational Stage, Concrete Operational Stage and The Formal Operational Stage?
questions.question_hi:
पियाजे ने विकास के निम्नलिखित में से किस क्षेेत्र को चार अवस्थााओं में विभाजित किया: सवेंदी प्रेेरक
अवस्थाा, पूर्व-सक
यात्मक अवस्थाा, मूर्त सक
यात्मक अवस्थाा तथा औपचारिक सक
यात्मक अवस्थाा?
questions.explanation_en: Piaget's four stages - sensorimotor, pre-operational, concrete operational and formal operational - describe cognitive (intellectual) development. Hence option 3.

questions.question_en:
Match the following Classification Of Cognitive Disability (Mental Retardation) with their range of intelligence quotient (IQ).
Severity Levels | Range of IQ
I. Profound Mentally Retarded | 1. 20-34
II. Mild Mentally Retarded | 2. Below 20
III. Severe Mentally Retarded | 3. 50-75
questions.question_hi: साथ सुमेलित करें।
questions.explanation_en: Standard IQ ranges are: mild about 50/55-70/75, moderate 35-49, severe 20-34 and profound below 20. So profound = below 20, mild = 50-75, severe = 20-34, giving I-2, II-3, III-1.

questions.question_en: In the types of Learning resources, the term ______ denotes a partially three-dimensional, full-size replica or scale model of a landscape typically showing historical events, nature scenes or cityscapes, for purposes of education or entertainment.
questions.question_hi:
परिदृश्य के स्केल मॉडल को दर्शाता है जो आमतौर पर शिक्षाा या मनोरंजन के प्रयोजनों के लिए ऐतिहासिक
घटनाओं, प्रकृति के दृश्यों या शहर के दृश्यों को दर्शाता है।
questions.explanation_en: A diorama is a three-dimensional full-size or scale model of a scene (historical event, nature or cityscape), often displayed in museums. Realia are real objects, and globes are spherical maps.
