Comprehension:
दिए गए गदयांश को ध्यान से पढ़े और प्रश्न के उत्तर दें।

डॉ. रामकुमार वर्मा ने ऐतिहासिक एवं समस्या मूलक एकांकियों रचना की है। उनके एकांकियों का मूल स्वर आदर्शवादी है। प्रेम, सेवा, उदारता, त्याग और बलिदान की भावनाओं से ओतप्रोत इन ऐतिहासिक एकांकियों में भारत के अतीत गौरव को प्रस्तुत करते हुए राष्ट्रीयता की भावना जगाने का प्रयास किया गया है। समस्यामूलक एकांकियों में वर्मा जी ने शिक्षित मध्यमवर्गीय दंपतियों की अनेक समस्याओं प्रेम, सहवास, संदेह, दंभ आदि को कथानक का विषय बनाया है, किंतु उनकी परिणति आदर्श में हुई है क्योंकि उनके की एकांकियों नायिकाएं अंततः अपने पति के सम्मान की रक्षा करती हुई दिखाई पड़ती हैं, यथा ‘रेशमी टाई’, ‘ललिता’ और ‘एक्ट्रेस’ एकांकी की नायिका प्रभा कुमारी। अतिशय आदर्शवाद के कारण वर्मा जी के एकांकी यथार्थ से दूर हो गए जान पड़ते हैं, किंतु एकांकी शिल्प की दृष्टि से वे हिंदी के युग प्रवर्तक एकांकी माने जा सकते हैं। आरंभ, कुतूहल, संकलन त्रय, चरम सीमा आदि तत्व उनके एकांकियों में बड़ी सूक्ष्मता से विद्यमान हैं। रंगमंचीयता एवं अभिनेयता के गुणों से भी उनके एकांकी संपन्न हैं तथा उनमें सरसता के साथ-साथ शिल्प की पौढ़ता भी विद्यमान है। वस्तुतः एकांकी कला को चरम पर पहुंचाने का श्रेय डॉ रामकुमार वर्मा को ही दिया जाता है।

Q.19 निम्नलिखित में से किस वाक्य में ‘परिणति’ शब्द का उचित प्रयोग किया गया है?

options.en: दूल्हा-दुल्हन का परिणति संस्कार संपन्न हो गया।
आपके व्यवहार की परिणति है कि इतने लोग आपको पसंद करते हैं।
आपकी उम्र में परिणति हो जानी चाहिए।
उसने नौकरी पाने की अच्छी परिणति खो दी।

questions.explanation_en: 'Parinati' means outcome or end result. Option 2 uses it correctly: people liking you is the result of your behaviour. The other sentences confuse it with parinay (marriage), parinaam or avsar.
questions.explanation_hi: 'परिणति' का अर्थ है परिणाम या अंतिम फल। विकल्प 2 में 'आपके व्यवहार की परिणति' अर्थात् व्यवहार का परिणाम - सही प्रयोग है। अन्य वाक्यों में इसे 'परिणय', 'परिपक्वता' या 'अवसर' के अर्थ में गलत प्रयुक्त किया गया है।

questions.explanation_en: Pratishtha, aadar and aavbhagat all relate to honour or respectful treatment. 'Saranjam' means arrangement or equipment, so it is not a synonym of 'samman'.

questions.question_en:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Predictable
questions.explanation_en: 'Predictable' means able to be foreseen or expected. Its opposite is 'improbable' (unlikely to happen); foreseeable, certain and expected are all close in meaning to predictable.

questions.question_en:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
Miss the boat
questions.explanation_en: 'Miss the boat' means to lose an opportunity by being too slow to act. It has nothing to do with literal boat travel, so option 1, 'miss a chance', is correct.

questions.question_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
A.Two IAF MiG fighters from the Adampur base crashed following a mid-air collision.
B.As a result, a fire broke out in four houses, and four boys playing in a field were wounded when the debris fell on them.
C.The other fighter plane crashed in the fields of Chansu Jattan.
D.According to reports, one plane crashed near Pensara.
questions.explanation_en: A introduces the crash of two MiG fighters, D reports where one plane crashed, C follows with 'the other fighter plane', and B describes the result (fire and injuries). So ADCB is the logical order.

questions.question_en:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
It is so refreshing to walk through the beach early in the morning.
questions.explanation_en: We walk 'along' or 'on' a beach, i.e. over its surface; 'through' implies moving inside something enclosed like a forest or tunnel. Hence 'through the beach' contains the error.

Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.
A collection of weapons and military equipment
questions.explanation_en: An arsenal is a collection or store of weapons and military equipment. An archive stores records, an apiary is a place for keeping bees, and an asylum is a place of refuge.

questions.question_en:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.
My injured _____ will _____ soon.
questions.explanation_en: 'Heel' (noun) is the back part of the foot and 'heal' (verb) means to become healthy again. The sentence needs a noun first and a verb after 'will', so 'heel; heal' (option 3).

questions.question_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
A.We can request the public library to send us all the books that they will be replacing this year.
B.However, I think, I have solution to this problem.
C.That means, no books till the next academic session.
D.Yesterday I was told that we had exhausted our library funds for this year.
questions.explanation_en: D states the problem (library funds exhausted), C gives its consequence (no books till next session), B introduces a solution with 'However', and A states the solution. Hence DCBA.

Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.
Post covid, international air travel is hopping back to normalcy.
questions.explanation_en: 'Hopping' suggests lively, energetic movement, which contradicts the slow, struggling recovery of air travel after Covid. 'Limping back to normalcy' is the standard expression for a slow, difficult recovery, so option 1.

questions.explanation_en: A person with a 'short fuse' gets angry very quickly, just as a short fuse makes an explosive go off quickly. Hence option 4.

The Mysore palace is gearing up for the winter festival.

There is a _____ train from Mysore to Chennai.
questions.explanation_en: The fixed collocation is 'fast train' (as in fast food, fast car). Speedy, brisk and quick are not used idiomatically with 'train' in this sense, so option 4.

The study of evolution of mankind

questions.question_en:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
Whether I do not agree with her views, I respect her for her honesty.
questions.explanation_en: 'Whether' introduces alternatives or doubt and cannot express contrast. A concessive clause needs 'Though/Although': 'Though I do not agree with her views, I respect her...'. So segment 4 has the error.

questions.question_en: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.explanation_en: The correct spelling is 'allot' (double l, single t). Associate, attendance and accept are spelt correctly, so 'Alott' is the incorrectly spelt word.

questions.question_en:
Comprehension:
Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

“Any bicycle repair shop around? Can anyone share the location please?”
That was a desperate appeal from a woman in our residents’ association’s WhatsApp group. Her child’s bicycle needed urgent mending.
“There is one around 2 km away.” Soon came the first response.
“No. The shop shut long ago, even before COVID,” someone else chipped in.
Where have the bicycle repairers gone? The wayside mechanics who would do a gamut of works on your bicycles for a paltry sum have almost gone extinct. These days, only children use bicycles, and you know a mechanic needs regular customers to survive. There is a time in almost everyone’s life when they become proud owners of their first bicycle. And there comes a stage when we abandon the prized possession and graduate ourselves to a motorised vehicle. Unused and unattended, the bicycles rust and disintegrate and finally end up at scrap dealers.
City roads in Kerala have now become totally unfriendly for bicycles. A cyclist is an odd man out on the chaotic road, an unwelcome disruptor among the automobiles arrogantly jostling for space. There are people out there who love to bicycle to their workplaces but dare not, dreading the reckless traffic on the way.
Is speed synonymous with progress? The transition from bullock carts to bullet trains denotes mankind’s journey toward development. However, passion for speed and more speed could trigger a gasping race to nowhere. To find time to relish the fruits of development, the curve has to slow down and plateau somewhere.
A bicycle is silent like a butterfly, easy like a true friend to possess and maintain. A bicycle symbolises fine balancing, not just on its narrow wheels but a balanced living. This simple carbon-free mode of transport helps the rider to be healthy and heal the habitat. People who cycle to work tend to be less stressed out at workplaces. Motorcyclists whiz past, hiding their heads and thoughts in full-face helmets. Car owners roll up their glasses and cocoon their mind and body from the outside world. A cyclist pedals under the open sky, opens up to friends and fellows on the way and forgets one’s own worries. It seems egalitarianism is part and parcel of the cycling culture.

Q.16 Who is referred to as an ‘unwelcome disrupter’?
questions.explanation_en: The passage says 'A cyclist is an odd man out on the chaotic road, an unwelcome disruptor among the automobiles'. So the cyclist is referred to as the unwelcome disruptor.

questions.question_en: Too many packets present in (a part of) the network causes packet delay and loss that degrades performance. This situation is referred to as ______.
questions.explanation_en: When too many packets are present in (part of) a network, queues build up and packets are delayed or dropped; this is congestion. Choke packets and throttling are techniques to control congestion, and congestion collapse is its extreme outcome.

questions.question_en: With reference to CSS, which of the following allows to change property values smoothly over a given duration?
questions.explanation_en: CSS transitions (the transition property) change a property's value smoothly over a set duration, for example transition: width 2s. Masking hides parts of an element, web fonts load custom fonts, and text effects style text. None of these animate value changes.

questions.question_en: Which of the following identifies, controls, audits and reports modifications that invariably occur while software is being developed and after it has been released to a customer?
questions.explanation_en: Software Configuration Management (SCM) is the umbrella activity that identifies, controls, audits and reports changes to software during development and after release. SQA focuses on quality assurance activities, not change tracking.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is an illusion of an extremely large main memory?
questions.explanation_en: Virtual memory uses part of the disk together with paging/segmentation so that programs see a memory much larger than the physical RAM. This is an illusion of a very large main memory. Cache memory is a small fast buffer, and the hard disk is the backing store, not the illusion itself.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a relational operator in the C programming language?
questions.explanation_en: != (not equal to) is a relational operator in C, along with <, >, <=, >= and ==. &&, || and ! are logical operators.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following statements is/are true with reference to java servlets?
(i) A Servlet is a Java program that runs without a web server.
(ii) It receives the requests and responds to them using related protocols (usually HTTP).
questions.explanation_en: A servlet is a Java program that runs inside a web server or servlet container (such as Tomcat), so statement (i) is false. Statement (ii) is true: it receives client requests and sends responses, usually over HTTP. So only (ii) is correct.

questions.question_en: Which of the following refers to focusing on determining, organising, directing, facilitating and monitoring knowledge-related practices and activities required to achieve the desired business strategies and objectives with reference to knowledge management in organisations?
questions.explanation_en: From the management point of view, KM focuses on determining, organising, directing, facilitating and monitoring knowledge-related practices to achieve business strategies. The business point of view is about why/where the organisation should invest in knowledge, and the hands-on operational view is about applying expertise in daily work.

questions.question_en: Which of the following refers to a system test that forces a software to fail in a variety of ways and verifies that recovery is properly performed?
questions.explanation_en: Recovery testing deliberately makes the software fail in different ways (crashes, power loss, network failure) and checks that recovery is done properly. Stress testing checks behaviour under extreme load, not recovery from failure.

questions.question_en: By default, the BASH shell of the Linux environment has a ______ prompt.
questions.explanation_en: For an ordinary user, the bash shell shows the $ prompt by default. # is shown for the root (super) user, and % is the default C-shell prompt.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NV RAM memory that retains its data even when turned off?
questions.explanation_en: Flash memory is non-volatile (NV) RAM-type storage that keeps its data without power, as in pen drives, SSDs and memory cards. Cache, registers and main memory (DRAM) are volatile, so they lose their contents when the power is turned off.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a method of solving quadratic equations?
questions.explanation_en: Quadratic equations are solved by factorisation, completing the square, or the quadratic formula (also graphically). 'Convergence' refers to iterative numerical behaviour of sequences/series and is not a method of solving quadratics.

questions.question_en: The technology of .Net is developed by ______ and was launched in ______.
questions.explanation_en: The .NET Framework was developed by Microsoft. Version 1.0 was released in 2002 (beta versions came out in 2000-2001). Oracle and Google did not build .NET, and 2010 is when .NET 4.0 came out, not the launch.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a software application that helps developers to build attractive website layouts and apps with ease?
questions.explanation_en: Front-end development tools (e.g. Bootstrap, Sass, VS Code extensions) help developers build attractive layouts and user interfaces for websites and apps. Back-end tools deal with servers and databases, and database design tools model data.

questions.question_en: A cube is a square prism. If all the sides of a cube are x, then volume = ______ and surface area = ______.
questions.explanation_en: For a cube with edge x, volume = x * x * x = x^3. It has 6 square faces of area x^2 each, so total surface area = 6x^2. Option 2 swaps the powers.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a valid syntax for the XML element in a DTD?
questions.explanation_en: An element is declared in a DTD as <!ELEMENT element-name category> (or (content)). <!ATTLIST ...> declares attributes and <!ENTITY ...> declares entities, so they are valid but not for elements; <#ELEMENT> is invalid syntax.

questions.question_en: Which of the following statements is FALSE?

options.en: It is not easy to extend a Monolithic kernel.
In Monolithic kernel, both user services and kernel services are kept in a separate address space.
To design a Microkernel, more codes are required.

questions.explanation_en: In a monolithic kernel, user services and kernel services all run in the same (kernel) address space, which makes it fast but hard to extend. Keeping them in separate address spaces is the feature of a microkernel. So statement 3 is false. The other statements are true.

questions.question_en: Which of the following process models are the oldest software engineering paradigms and suggest a linear process flow that is often inconsistent with modern realities?
questions.explanation_en: Sequential (linear) process models such as the waterfall model are the oldest paradigm; they assume a linear flow that rarely matches real projects where requirements change. Incremental, evolutionary and concurrent models were introduced to handle iteration and change.

In Java an integer literal that starts with 0 is octal, so 017 = 1*8 + 7 = 15 in decimal. The loop prints each element followed by a space: 121 201 15. (The curly quotes in the question are just printing errors for normal " " quotes.) Option 1 forgets the octal rule.

questions.question_en: The demand is said to be ______ when a very insignificant change in price leads to an infinite change in quantity demanded.
questions.explanation_en: Demand is perfectly elastic (Ed = ∞) when a negligible change in price causes an infinite change in quantity demanded; the demand curve is horizontal. Perfectly inelastic (Ed = 0) is the opposite case where quantity does not change at all.

questions.subtopic: Random scan vs raster scan display
questions.question_en: Which of the following displays uses an electron beam that operates like a pencil to create a line image on the CRT screen?
questions.explanation_en: A random scan (vector) display moves the electron beam directly along the path of each line, like a pencil drawing, so only the needed parts of the screen are traced. A raster scan sweeps the whole screen row by row and builds the image from pixels. 'Roster' and 'Rotate' scan are not real display types.

questions.question_en: Consider the following data set: 6, 20, 25, 63, 92, 101. What is the range of the data set?
questions.explanation_en: Range = maximum - minimum = 101 - 6 = 95. Option 4 (101) is just the maximum value.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a graphical representation of an algorithm?
questions.explanation_en: A flowchart is a diagram that shows the steps of an algorithm using standard symbols joined by arrows. Pseudocode is a text form of an algorithm, and source code or a program is the actual implementation, not a graphical representation.

questions.question_en: In connectionless services offered by the network layer, packets are injected into the network individually and routed independently of each other. In this context, the packets are frequently called ______, and the network is called a ______ network.
questions.explanation_en: In a connectionless network-layer service, independently routed packets are called datagrams and the network is a datagram network. Virtual-circuit networks are connection-oriented, so options using 'virtual circuit' are wrong.

questions.question_en: Which of the following can be used for the frontend or user interface while developing a web application?
questions.explanation_en: JavaScript runs in the browser and is used with HTML and CSS to build the front end (user interface). PHP and Django (Python) are server-side back-end technologies, and SQL is used to query databases.

questions.question_en: Any process in the transport layer wishing to remotely retrieve mail from a host can connect to the destination host’s port ______ to contact its IMAP daemon.
questions.explanation_en: IMAP servers listen on TCP port 143 (993 for IMAPS). Port 80 is HTTP, 443 is HTTPS and 20 is FTP data.

questions.question_en: Which of the following refers to expertise and skills acquired by a person through experience or education, the theoretical or practical understanding of a subject?
questions.explanation_en: Knowledge is the expertise and skills a person gains through experience or education, that is, the theoretical or practical understanding of a subject. Synthesis means combining ideas, and problem solving is applying knowledge. Neither is the understanding itself.

questions.question_en: Which of the following software quality factors refers to the degree to which the software makes optimal use of system resources as indicated by the sub-attributes time behaviour and resource behaviour?
questions.explanation_en: In ISO 9126, Efficiency covers time behaviour and resource behaviour, i.e. optimal use of system resources. Maintainability, usability and portability have different sub-attributes (analysability, learnability, adaptability etc.).

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a type of Discrete Probability Distribution?
questions.explanation_en: The Poisson distribution is discrete: it gives the probability of a whole number of events (0, 1, 2, ...) in a fixed interval. Normal, exponential and log-normal distributions are continuous because they take any real value in a range.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a router in a foreign network to which the mobile node is currently connected with reference to mobile communication?
questions.explanation_en: In Mobile IP, the foreign agent is the router in the visited (foreign) network that serves the mobile node and delivers tunnelled packets to it. The home agent sits in the home network, and a care-of address (COA) is an address, not a router.

questions.question_en: Which of the following are two arguments that ‘chmod’ takes to change different permission configurations of files in KDE Linux shell?
questions.explanation_en: chmod takes two arguments: the permission change (for example u+x or 755) and the file name(s) to apply it to, as in chmod 755 script.sh. User names are changed with chown, not chmod.

questions.question_en: Which of the following curves is particularly a kind of spline generated from a set of control points by forming a set of polynomial functions with reference to computer graphics?
questions.explanation_en: A Bezier curve is a spline defined by a set of control points, built from Bernstein polynomial blending functions. 'Parametric' describes a general way of representing curves, not a specific spline generated from control points.

questions.question_en: Which of the following refers to messages sent from transport entity to transport entity in the transport layer of the ISO/OSI network model?
questions.explanation_en: In the OSI model the transport layer's data unit, exchanged between transport entities, is called a segment (also known as a TPDU). Packets belong to the network layer and frames to the data link layer.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is defined as that branch of economic analysis that studies the economic behaviour of the individual unit and may be a person, a particular household or a particular firm?
questions.explanation_en: Microeconomics studies the behaviour of individual units such as a consumer, household or firm. Macroeconomics studies the economy as a whole (national income, inflation, unemployment).

questions.question_en: In Cohen Sutherland Line clipping algorithm, if a line ______ the clipping window, then the line is required to clip as it is considered partially visible.
questions.explanation_en: Cohen-Sutherland gives each endpoint a 4-bit region code. If both codes are 0000 the line is fully inside and accepted. If the AND of the codes is non-zero it is fully outside and rejected. Otherwise the line intersects the window boundary, so it is partly visible and must be clipped.
y = &x, so *y = 8. The expression x * *y * x + *y = 8 * 8 * 8 + 8 = 512 + 8 = 520. There is no compilation or runtime error because y is a valid pointer to x.

questions.question_en: Which of the following options describes the desirable property of a good operating system?

options.en: Low throughput and low turnaround time
High throughput and high turnaround time
Low throughput and high turnaround time
High throughput and low turnaround time

questions.explanation_en: A good OS should finish many processes per unit time (high throughput) and finish each process quickly after it arrives (low turnaround time). High turnaround time means processes wait longer, which is not desirable.

questions.question_en: Which step of the knowledge management process involves adding value by discovering relationships, abstracting and sharing?
questions.explanation_en: Knowledge refining adds value to captured knowledge by discovering relationships, abstracting, synthesising and sharing it. Gathering/acquisition only collects knowledge, and organisation only stores/structures it.

questions.question_en: Which of the following ciphers reorders the letters but does NOT disguise them?
questions.explanation_en: A transposition cipher only rearranges the order of the plaintext letters; the letters themselves stay the same. A substitution cipher replaces each letter with another symbol, so it disguises the letters but keeps their order.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is an action or occurrence such as a mouse click, a key press, mouse movements or any system-generated notification in ASP.NET?
questions.explanation_en: In ASP.NET, an event is an action or occurrence such as a mouse click, key press, mouse movement or a system-generated notification, which triggers an event handler. Directives give compiler instructions, validators check input, and controls are UI elements.

questions.question_en: Which characteristic of business refers to ‘various components of a business system are highly interacting and interdependent’?
questions.explanation_en: Interdependence means the parts of a business system (production, finance, marketing, HR) interact closely and depend on each other, so a change in one affects the others. Complexity refers to the large number of variables involved, not to this mutual dependence.

questions.question_en: Suppose we are given values of y = f(x) for a set of values of x, the process of finding the value of y corresponding to any value of x = x_i between x_0 and x_n is called ______.
questions.explanation_en: Estimating y for an x lying between the given tabulated points x0 ... xn is interpolation. Estimating outside that range is extrapolation; bias, variance and hypothesis are statistics terms.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a front-end design tool?
questions.explanation_en: PHP is a server-side scripting language that runs on the web server, so it is a back-end tool. AngularJS and jQuery are JavaScript front-end libraries/frameworks, and Chrome DevTools is used to inspect and debug front-end pages.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is the proper sequence of the accounting cycle?

options.en: Recording of Transaction → Journal → Ledger → Trial Balance → Adjusted Trial Balance → Adjustment Entries → Closing Entries → Financial Statement
Recording of Transaction → Journal → Ledger → Trial Balance → Adjustment Entries → Adjusted Trial Balance → Closing Entries → Financial Statement
Recording of Transaction → Journal → Ledger → Trial Balance → Adjustment Entries → Closing Entries → Adjusted Trial Balance → Financial Statement
Recording of Transaction → Journal → Ledger → Trial Balance → Adjustment Entries → Adjusted Trial Balance → Financial Statement → Closing Entries

questions.explanation_en: Key doubt: the standard accounting cycle is Transactions → Journal → Ledger → Trial Balance → Adjustment Entries → Adjusted Trial Balance → Financial Statements → Closing Entries, which is option 4. Financial statements are prepared from the adjusted trial balance BEFORE closing entries, because closing entries reset revenue, expense and drawing accounts to zero. The official option 2 puts closing entries before financial statements, which is not the textbook order.

questions.question_en: Which of the following operators has the highest precedence in the C programming language?
questions.explanation_en: In C, parentheses () (function call/grouping) have the highest precedence. Next come unary operators, then *, /, %, and after them the relational, equality (!=) and bitwise XOR (^) operators. So () is evaluated first.

questions.question_en: Interpretability, Format, Coherence and Compatibility refer to which quality of information with reference to Management Information System?
questions.explanation_en: In the Wang-Strong framework, representational quality covers interpretability, ease of understanding, format/concise representation, coherence/consistency and compatibility. Intrinsic quality covers accuracy and believability, contextual quality covers relevance and timeliness, and accessibility covers access and security.

questions.question_en: The ‘DEFAULT constraint’ of SQL will ______.

options.en: ensure that a column cannot have a NULL value
ensure that all the values in a column satisfy certain conditions
ensure that all values in a column are different
provide a default value for a column when none is specified

questions.explanation_en: The DEFAULT constraint gives a column a value automatically when an INSERT does not supply one, for example city VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'Delhi'. NOT NULL stops NULL values, CHECK enforces a condition and UNIQUE keeps values different.

questions.question_en: Which of the following refers to the art of recoding, classifying and summarising in a significant manner, and in terms of money, transactions and events that are in part at least of a financial character, and interpreting the results thereof?
questions.explanation_en: This is the AICPA definition of accounting, which describes financial accounting: recording, classifying and summarising financial transactions in money terms and interpreting the results. Book keeping only records transactions and does not interpret results; cost and management accounting focus on internal cost control and decision making.

questions.question_en: Which of the following types of XML parsers is an object that contains all the information of an XML document and is composed like a tree structure?
questions.explanation_en: A DOM (Document Object Model) parser loads the whole XML document into memory as a tree of node objects that can be navigated and changed. SAX is an event-based streaming parser that does not build a tree. DOS and SAY are not XML parsers.

questions.question_en: Activities like packing goods, loading goods and shipping goods belong to which step of the e-commerce primary process?
questions.explanation_en: Packing, loading and shipping goods to the customer happen in the delivery/fulfilment step of the e-commerce process. Contract conclusion is placing/accepting the order, billing is invoicing and payment, and service/support is after-sales.

questions.question_en: Which of the following algebraic functions represents NAND gate?
questions.explanation_en: NAND = NOT(AND), so its output is (xy)'. (x + y)' is NOR, x + y is OR, and x*y is AND.

questions.question_en: Which of the following front-end tools is one of the most widely used CSS extension languages across the world?
questions.explanation_en: Sass (Syntactically Awesome Style Sheets) is a widely used CSS extension language that adds variables, nesting and mixins. VS Code is an editor, Git is version control and TypeScript extends JavaScript, not CSS.

questions.question_en: Which of the following methods is used for the function y = f(x), with the given discrete set of points (x_i, y_i), i = 0, 1, 2, 3, …, n where x_i’s are NOT equispaced?
questions.explanation_en: Newton's divided difference formula (and also Lagrange's formula) works for unequally spaced x values. Newton's forward/backward formulas and Gauss's formulas assume equally spaced points with a fixed step h, so they cannot be used here.

questions.question_en: In which of the following radio channel sharing methods several users share the same frequency channel of higher bandwidth by dividing it into different time slots?
questions.explanation_en: TDMA lets several users share one wide frequency channel by giving each user a different time slot. FDMA instead divides the bandwidth into separate frequency bands; NDMA and PDMA are not standard schemes.

questions.question_en: Which of the following with reference to digital electronics is a device that stores (and sometimes displays) the number of times a particular event or process has occurred, often in relationship to a clock signal?
questions.explanation_en: A counter is a sequential circuit, built from flip-flops, that counts the number of clock pulses or events and stores (and can display) that count. A latch or flip-flop stores only one bit, and a register stores a word of data but does not count.

questions.question_en: The operations of a ______ require that the first element that is inserted is the first one to be removed?
questions.explanation_en: A queue follows FIFO: the first element inserted is the first one removed. A stack follows LIFO, where the last inserted element is removed first.

questions.question_en: Which of the following belongs to the fixed and wireless configuration category of mobile devices?
questions.explanation_en: Mobile computing devices are grouped as fixed-wired (desktop), mobile-wired (laptop on a cable), fixed-wireless and mobile-wireless (smartphone). A Wi-Fi router stays in one place but gives wireless connectivity, so it is fixed and wireless. A Wi-Fi dongle is plugged into a portable device, so it is not a fixed device.

questions.question_en: The ______ economic system is characterised by free markets and the absence of government intervention in the economy.
questions.explanation_en: A capitalist (free-market) economy is characterised by private ownership, free markets and little or no government intervention. A socialist economy has state ownership and planning, while a mixed economy combines both.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is designed in such a way that all the stations are connected through a single cable known as a backbone cable in the computer network?
questions.explanation_en: In a bus topology every station is connected to one shared cable called the backbone, with terminators at both ends. Star topology uses a central hub, ring connects each node to two neighbours in a loop, and mesh links nodes to many others.

questions.question_en: The algorithm that manages routing tables and makes routing decisions in the network layer of the ISO/OSI model is called ______.
questions.explanation_en: The routing algorithm is the part of network-layer software that decides on which output line an incoming packet should be sent, and builds/maintains routing tables. The other names are not standard terms.

questions.question_en: With reference to Management Information System, which of the following categories refers to information that is concerned with long-term policy decisions that define the objectives of a business and check how well these objectives are met?
questions.explanation_en: Strategic information is used by top management for long-term policy decisions, such as setting business objectives and checking how well they are met. Tactical information is for middle management's medium-term control, and operational information is for day-to-day work.

questions.question_en: The semiconductor memory Dynamic RAM (DRAM) stores each bit of information in a/an ______.
questions.explanation_en: DRAM stores each bit as charge on a tiny capacitor (with one access transistor), which leaks and must be refreshed periodically. SRAM stores bits in flip-flops, which is why it is faster but costlier.

questions.question_en: C++ provides inline functions to facilitate a reduced function call overhead mainly for ______.
questions.explanation_en: An inline function's body is copied into the place where it is called, which saves the cost of a call (pushing arguments, jumping, returning). This is worth it only for small functions. For large functions it bloats the code, and the compiler may ignore the inline request.

questions.question_en: AB is a tangent to a circle at B. O is the centre of the circle. If the circle radius is 40 mm and AB = 150 mm, calculate the length of AO.
questions.explanation_en: A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact, so triangle OBA is right-angled at B. AO = √(OB² + AB²) = √(40² + 150²) = √(1600 + 22500) = √24100 ≈ 155.2 mm. Option 4 (235.6) is not consistent with Pythagoras.

questions.question_en: Which of the following effects is the phenomenon of emission of electrons from the surfaces of certain substances, mainly metals, when light of a shorter wavelength is incident upon them?
questions.explanation_en: The photoelectric effect is the emission of electrons from a metal surface when light of short enough wavelength (frequency above the threshold) falls on it, as explained by Einstein. The other terms are not names of physical effects.

questions.question_en: Which characteristic of an algorithm refers to ‘each instruction is clear and unambiguous’?
questions.explanation_en: Definiteness means every instruction of an algorithm is clear, precise and unambiguous. Finiteness means it terminates after a finite number of steps, and effectiveness means each step is basic enough to be carried out.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a java primitive data type?
questions.explanation_en: Java has 8 primitive types: byte, short, int, long, float, double, char and boolean. Arrays, String and classes are reference (non-primitive) types. So byte is the primitive type here.

questions.question_en: What will be the output of the Linux shell command ‘rm doc*’?

options.en: Erase all files beginning with the pattern ‘doc’
Erase all files ending with the pattern ‘doc’
List filenames ending with the pattern ‘doc’
List filenames beginning with the pattern ‘doc’

questions.explanation_en: rm deletes files, and the wildcard doc* matches every name that begins with 'doc' followed by any characters. To match names ending in doc you would write *doc; listing would need ls, not rm.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a Microsoft ActiveX control that will sort through a data file, extrapolate the necessary information and produce that information in specified areas on the web page?
questions.explanation_en: The Tabular Data Control (TDC) is a Microsoft ActiveX control that reads a delimited text data file and binds its data to elements of a web page (data binding in DHTML). Dialog bars, control bars and dialog boxes are UI elements and do not read data files.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is known as an association among several entities?
questions.explanation_en: A relationship is an association among two or more entities (e.g. Student ENROLLS-IN Course). An instance is a single occurrence, a key identifies entities uniquely, and participation describes whether every entity takes part in a relationship.

questions.question_en: Which of the following controls in VB.NET is used to select one option from a number of choices?
questions.explanation_en: RadioButtons in a group are mutually exclusive, so the user can pick exactly one option from several choices. A ListBox can also allow multiple selection, a Label only displays text, and a Button triggers an action.

questions.question_en: The Insert key in a keyboard of a computer system is used to toggle between ______ and ______ modes during data entry.
questions.explanation_en: The Insert key toggles between insert mode (new characters push existing text to the right) and overwrite mode (new characters replace existing text). Backspace and Delete are separate keys that erase characters.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a component of Management Information System?
questions.explanation_en: The components of an MIS are people, hardware, software, data (database) and procedures. 'Education procedures' is not a component of MIS. People, software and data are core components.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a symbolic name given to a memory location in any programming language?
questions.explanation_en: A variable is a symbolic name given to a memory location whose value can change during program execution. A constant/literal is a fixed value, and an attribute is a property of an object or entity.

questions.question_en: Which of the following helps to make predictions from data?
questions.explanation_en: Inferential statistics uses sample data to make predictions or generalisations about a population, through estimation, hypothesis testing and regression. Descriptive statistics only summarises the data you already have (mean, charts) and does not predict.

questions.question_en: What is the amount of rotation between two straight lines?
questions.explanation_en: An angle measures the amount of rotation between two straight lines (rays) meeting at a point. A degree is only a unit for measuring angles, and a transversal is a line cutting two or more lines.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is FALSE with reference to constructor in C#.NET?

options.en: It can have a return type.
All classes have constructors by default.
Constructor name must match the class name.
The constructor is called when the object is created.

questions.explanation_en: In C# a constructor cannot have any return type, not even void, so statement 1 is false. The other statements are true: a default constructor is provided if you write none, it has the same name as the class, and it runs when an object is created.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a storage class in the C programming language?
questions.explanation_en: C has four storage classes: auto, register, static and extern. 'intern' is not a storage class or keyword in C.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is FALSE with reference to peer-to-peer network?

options.en: This network has a dedicated server.
It is useful for small environments, usually up to 10 computers.
Special permissions are assigned to each computer for sharing the resources.
All the computers are linked together with equal privilege and responsibilities for processing data.

questions.explanation_en: A peer-to-peer network has no dedicated server; every computer is equal and can act as both client and server. So statement 1 is false. P2P suits small set-ups of about 10 computers, and each computer controls the sharing permissions for its own resources.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following is true with reference to Queue Data Structure in the C programming language?
(i) Insertion can take place from the front end.
(ii) Deletion can take place from the rear end.
questions.explanation_en: In a queue, insertion (enqueue) happens at the rear and deletion (dequeue) happens at the front. Statement (i) puts insertion at the front and (ii) puts deletion at the rear, so both are false: neither (i) nor (ii).

questions.question_en: What is the binary equivalent of the decimal number 10.25?
questions.explanation_en: Integer part: 10 = 8 + 2 = 1010. Fraction: 0.25 x 2 = 0.5 gives bit 0, then 0.5 x 2 = 1.0 gives bit 1, so the fraction is .01. So 10.25 = 1010.01. Option 2 (1011.01) equals 11.25.

questions.question_en:
Match the system with the respective unit to represent heat.
System | Unit
(a) CGS | (i) BTU
(b) FPS | (ii) Joule
(c) SI | (iii) Calorie
questions.explanation_en: In the CGS system heat is measured in calories, in the FPS system in British Thermal Units (BTU), and in the SI system in joules. Hence (a)-(iii), (b)-(i), (c)-(ii).

questions.question_en: What is the key length for the Triple DES cryptography algorithm?
questions.explanation_en: Triple DES runs DES three times with three independent 56-bit keys, so the key length is 3 x 56 = 168 bits (112 bits in the two-key version). 56 bits is the key length of single DES.

questions.question_en: Which of the following refers to the kind of problems that require the identification of the best solution to a search problem from a given set of solutions?
questions.explanation_en: An optimisation problem asks for the best solution (minimum or maximum by some measure) from the set of feasible solutions, e.g. shortest path. A decision problem has a yes/no answer and a counting problem asks how many solutions exist.

questions.question_en: Which of the following internet protocols provides a way for applications to send encapsulated IP datagrams without having to establish a connection?
questions.explanation_en: UDP (User Datagram Protocol, written as 'Unit Datagram Protocol' in the question) lets applications send encapsulated IP datagrams without setting up a connection (RFC 768). TCP is connection-oriented, and Telnet and rlogin are remote login applications.

questions.question_en: With reference to stakeholders of e-commerce, business organisations abbreviated by ‘B’ may include ______.
questions.explanation_en: In B2B/B2C notation, 'B' stands for business organisations such as producers, manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers. Consumers/customers are 'C' and government is 'G'.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is the fundamental state of business activity and involves the sale and purchase of goods and services?
questions.explanation_en: Trade, the buying and selling of goods and services, is the basic core activity of business. Industry produces goods, and supply and enterprise are broader or related ideas, not the act of sale and purchase itself.

questions.question_en: Which of the following refers to a planned system of collecting, storing and disseminating data in the form of information needed to carry out the functions of management?
questions.explanation_en: A Management Information System is a planned system for collecting, storing and disseminating data as information needed by managers to plan, organise and control. A DBMS only manages data storage and retrieval; it does not by itself serve management functions.

questions.question_en: ‘As the stock of a commodity increases with the consumer, its marginal utility to the consumer decreases’. To which of the following laws does the given statement refer to?
questions.explanation_en: The Law of Diminishing Marginal Utility says that as a consumer gets more units of a good, the extra satisfaction (marginal utility) from each additional unit falls. The Law of Demand links price and quantity demanded, not utility from stock held.

questions.question_en: In a Client/Server network, the central controller is known as a ______, while all other computers in the network are called ______.
questions.explanation_en: In a client/server network the central computer that provides services and controls resources is the server, and the other computers that request services are clients. 'Peers' are used in peer-to-peer networks where all nodes are equal.

questions.question_en:
Considering the benefits to children with disability, which of the following provisions of Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan is correct?
I. Stipend for girls with disabilities
II. Braille textbooks
questions.explanation_en: Under Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan's inclusive education component, children with special needs receive aids and appliances, Braille/large-print textbooks, and girls with disabilities are given stipends to support their schooling. Hence both are correct.

questions.question_en: Reinforcement strengthens the occurrence of the emitted behaviour in the students. Which of the following is the correct example of positive reinforcement?

options.en: Teacher detaining the student after class hours.

questions.explanation_en: Positive reinforcement adds a pleasant stimulus after a desired behaviour to increase its occurrence. Awarding high grades is a reward, while finding loopholes, detention and threats are punishments or aversive stimuli.

questions.question_en: Which of the following does not come under lower form of writing?
questions.explanation_en: Lower (controlled/guided) forms of writing include copying, dictation, picture composition and guided writing. Paragraph writing is treated as a higher form of composition requiring organisation of ideas, so per the official key it does not belong to the lower forms.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT correct in regard of Piagetian perspective of play?

options.en: Play is not possible for child without toys
The play is something which transcends both culture and time
The play is something related to nature

questions.explanation_en: Piaget saw play as natural, biologically based and universal across cultures and ages, arising from assimilation. Children can play without toys (pretend and imaginative play), so the claim that play is impossible without toys is not correct.

questions.question_en:
Which activity children’s do to expand their vocabulary?
I. Fast mapping
II. Sorting
questions.explanation_en: Fast mapping is the process by which children quickly connect a new word to its meaning after only one or two exposures, rapidly expanding vocabulary. Sorting is a classification skill, not a vocabulary-building process, so only I.

questions.question_en: In which method of learning by work, student themselves decide objective and prepare plan for an activity?
questions.explanation_en: In Kilpatrick's project method, students themselves purpose (set the objective), plan, execute and judge a purposeful activity, learning by doing. Hence the project method.

questions.question_en: The ‘Kesari’ newspaper was published in which language?
questions.explanation_en: 'Kesari' was started by Bal Gangadhar Tilak in 1881 in Marathi; its English counterpart was 'Mahratta'. Hence Marathi.

questions.question_en: According to the Indian Penal Code, an offence is not punishable for a child below ______ of age.
questions.explanation_en: Section 82 of the Indian Penal Code (doli incapax) states that nothing is an offence which is done by a child under seven years of age. Hence 7 years.

questions.question_en:
Parent and family involvement decreases student’s ______.
I. Achievement
II. Success
questions.explanation_en: Research consistently shows that parent and family involvement increases students' achievement and success; it does not decrease them. So neither statement is correct.

questions.question_en:
Read the following characteristics of one of the piaget’s stages of cognitive development given as A, B and C. Select the correct stage from the options.
A. Complete generality of thought.
B. Development of strong idealism.
C. Propositional thinking.
questions.explanation_en: Generality of thought, idealism and propositional (hypothetico-deductive) reasoning are characteristics of the formal operational stage (11+ years), when adolescents think abstractly.
