questions.question_en: Who were the chief guests at India's 77th Republic Day celebrations in 2026?

options.en: Ursula von der Leyen and Antonio Costa
Joe Biden and Ursula von der Leyen

questions.explanation_en: The Presidents of the European Commission and European Council were the guests of honour on 26 January 2026.

questions.question_en: The Nobel Peace Prize 2026 was awarded to which former UN human rights chief of South African origin?
questions.explanation_en: Navi Pillay, also a former ICC and ICJ judge, was announced as the 2026 peace laureate on 9 October 2026.

questions.question_en: Who is the Chief Minister of Delhi (as of October 2026)?
questions.explanation_en: Rekha Gupta of the BJP took oath on 20 February 2025 after the BJP won the Delhi Assembly election, ending AAP's rule.

questions.question_en: The 2025 Booker Prize was won by David Szalay for which novel?
questions.explanation_en: Hungarian-British author David Szalay won the 2025 Booker Prize (announced November 2025) for 'Flesh'.

questions.question_en: The FIFA World Cup 2026, the first with 48 teams, was jointly hosted by:
questions.explanation_en: FIFA's first three-nation World Cup was co-hosted by the USA, Canada and Mexico, with the final in New Jersey.

questions.question_en: INS Mangrol, commissioned in October 2026, is which type of Indian Navy vessel?
questions.explanation_en: INS Mangrol is the third ASW Shallow Water Craft built in India (the Mahe class) and was commissioned on 12 October 2026.

questions.question_en: The Standard Meridian of India (82°30' E), on which Indian Standard Time is based, passes near which city?
questions.explanation_en: IST is GMT+5:30; the 82°30' E meridian passes through Mirzapur in Uttar Pradesh.

questions.question_en: Which Article of the Constitution directs the State to organise village panchayats?
questions.explanation_en: Article 40 is a Directive Principle; Panchayati Raj was later given constitutional status by the 73rd Amendment.

questions.question_en: Rusting of iron requires the presence of:
questions.explanation_en: Rust is hydrated iron(III) oxide formed when iron is exposed to moist air; galvanisation prevents it.

questions.question_en: Black soil (regur), best suited for cotton cultivation, is mainly formed from the weathering of:
questions.explanation_en: The Deccan Trap's basaltic lava gives black soil, which is rich in lime, iron and potash and retains moisture well.

questions.question_en: Which was the first Indian state to accept Lord Wellesley's Subsidiary Alliance (1798)?
questions.explanation_en: The Nizam of Hyderabad was the first to sign the Subsidiary Alliance in 1798; Awadh followed in 1801.

questions.question_en: The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885; who was its first president?
questions.explanation_en: A. O. Hume helped found it, but the first session at Bombay was presided over by W. C. Bonnerjee.

questions.question_en: Who was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
questions.explanation_en: Ambedkar chaired the seven-member Drafting Committee; Rajendra Prasad was President of the Assembly and B. N. Rau its constitutional adviser.

questions.question_en: Which two architects are mainly associated with the design of New Delhi, inaugurated in 1931?

options.en: Charles Correa and B. V. Doshi
Robert T. Russell and Walter Sykes George

questions.explanation_en: The capital's shift from Calcutta was announced at the 1911 Durbar; Lutyens and Baker designed Rashtrapati Bhavan and the Secretariat.

questions.question_en: Who was the first Indian to travel into space (1984), aboard the Soviet Soyuz T-11?
questions.explanation_en: Wing Commander Rakesh Sharma spent about eight days in orbit in April 1984 as part of an Indo-Soviet mission.

questions.question_en: The Sundarbans, the largest mangrove forest of the world, is mainly the delta of which two rivers?
questions.explanation_en: The Sundarbans delta in West Bengal and Bangladesh is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and home to the Royal Bengal Tiger.

questions.question_en: Who was the first woman judge of the Supreme Court of India (appointed 1989)?
questions.explanation_en: Justice Fathima Beevi joined the Supreme Court in 1989; Leila Seth was the first woman Chief Justice of a High Court (Himachal Pradesh).

questions.question_en: Salivary amylase present in saliva helps in the digestion of:
questions.explanation_en: Salivary amylase breaks starch into maltose; pepsin acts on proteins and lipase on fats.

questions.question_en: Which of the following rivers flows westward into the Arabian Sea through a rift valley?
questions.explanation_en: The Narmada flows west through a rift valley between the Vindhyas and Satpura and drains into the Gulf of Khambhat.

questions.question_en: The winter rainfall in north-western India, useful for the rabi wheat crop, is caused by:

options.en: Cyclonic depressions of the Bay of Bengal

questions.explanation_en: Western disturbances are extra-tropical storms that originate in the Mediterranean region and bring winter rain to Punjab, Haryana and Delhi.

questions.question_en: Pen is to Write as Knife is to:
questions.explanation_en: A pen is used to write; a knife is used to cut. The relation is instrument : function.

questions.question_en: Select the odd one out: Whale, Dolphin, Shark, Seal
questions.explanation_en: Whale, dolphin and seal are mammals. A shark is a fish.

questions.question_en: In the word STORM, how many pairs of letters are there such that the gap between their positions in the word equals the gap between their positions in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation_en: S(1)-T(2): word gap 1, alphabet gap 1. T(2)-R(4): word gap 2, alphabet gap 20 − 18 = 2. O(3)-M(5): word gap 2, alphabet gap 15 − 13 = 2. No other pair matches. Total 3.

questions.question_en:
Statement: The number of road accidents on a highway has increased due to over-speeding.
Courses of action: I. Speed cameras and fines should be introduced. II. The highway should be closed forever.
questions.explanation_en: Speed monitoring and penalties directly address over-speeding. Closing the highway forever is an extreme step.

questions.question_en:
Statement: Should the retirement age of teachers be raised?
Arguments: I. Yes, experienced teachers can continue to contribute and ease the shortage of teachers. II. No, it will reduce job opportunities for young graduates.

options.en: Neither I nor II is strong
Both I and II are strong

questions.explanation_en: Each argument raises a real, relevant consequence: teacher shortage and fewer vacancies for the young. Both are strong.

questions.question_en: In a code, DELHI is written as EGOLN. How will PUNE be written in that code?
questions.explanation_en: The shifts are +1, +2, +3, +4, +5 from left to right: D+1 = E, E+2 = G, L+3 = O, H+4 = L, I+5 = N. For PUNE: P+1 = Q, U+2 = W, N+3 = Q, E+4 = I, giving QWQI.

questions.question_en:
Statement: A major fire broke out in a market due to a short circuit.
Courses of action: I. A fire-safety audit of the market should be conducted. II. The electrical wiring of the shops should be inspected and repaired.
questions.explanation_en: The cause is faulty wiring, so inspecting the wiring (II) and auditing fire safety to prevent a repeat (I) are both practical and relevant.

questions.question_en: Heart : Circulation :: Lungs : ?
questions.explanation_en: The heart is the main organ of circulation; the lungs are the main organs of respiration.

questions.question_en: Complete the series: ZYX, WVU, TSR, ?
questions.explanation_en: Letters run backwards continuously: ZYX, WVU, TSR, then QPO.

questions.question_en: Find the next letter: Z, X, U, Q, L, ?
questions.explanation_en: Positions: 26, 24, 21, 17, 12 with decreases 2, 3, 4, 5. Next decrease is 6: 12 - 6 = 6 = F.

questions.question_en: In a code, PAPER is written as OZODQ. How is STONE written in that code?
questions.explanation_en: Each letter is moved one step backward: S-R, T-S, O-N, N-M, E-D. So RSNMD.

questions.question_en: In a certain notation, A + B means A is the mother of B; A - B means A is the brother of B; A x B means A is the father of B. What does P - Q x R mean?

options.en: P is the father of R
P is the grandfather of R
P is the maternal uncle of R
P is the paternal uncle of R

questions.explanation_en: P - Q: P is the brother of Q. Q x R: Q is the father of R. So P is the brother of R's father: paternal uncle.

questions.question_en: How many odd days are there in 200 years?
questions.explanation_en: 100 years have 5 odd days, so 200 years have 10 odd days = 10 − 7 = 3 odd days.

questions.question_en: Find the next term: 3, 6, 11, 18, 27, ?
questions.explanation_en: Differences are 3, 5, 7, 9, so the next is 11: 27 + 11 = 38.

questions.question_en: Which letter is the 5th to the left of the 15th letter from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation_en: The 15th letter from the right is the 26 − 15 + 1 = 12th from the left, L. The 5th to its left is the 7th letter, G.

questions.question_en:
Matrix I (rows 0–4, columns 0–4):
Row 0: P E N T A
Row 1: E N T A P
Row 2: N T A P E
Row 3: T A P E N
Row 4: A P E N T
Matrix II (rows 5–9, columns 5–9):
Row 5: O R S I L
Row 6: R S I L O
Row 7: S I L O R
Row 8: I L O R S
Row 9: L O R S I
Each letter is coded by its row number followed by its column number (for example, P can be 00 or 14). The set 12, 99, 86, 33 represents which word?
questions.explanation_en: 12 = row 1, column 2 = T; 99 = I; 86 = L; 33 = E. So the word is TILE.

questions.question_en: A pointer initially points East. In each step it turns 90° anticlockwise. In which direction will it point after 5 steps?
questions.explanation_en: 5 × 90° = 450° anticlockwise. 450 − 360 = 90° anticlockwise from East, which is North.

questions.question_en:
Matrix I (rows 0–4, columns 0–4):
Row 0: P E N T A
Row 1: E N T A P
Row 2: N T A P E
Row 3: T A P E N
Row 4: A P E N T
Matrix II (rows 5–9, columns 5–9):
Row 5: O R S I L
Row 6: R S I L O
Row 7: S I L O R
Row 8: I L O R S
Row 9: L O R S I
Each letter is coded by its row number followed by its column number (for example, P can be 00 or 14). Which of the following sets does NOT represent the word RAIN?
questions.explanation_en: In the third set 44 is row 4, column 4 = T, not N, so it spells RAIT. All other sets decode to R-A-I-N (e.g. 88 = R, 31 = A, 85 = I, 34 = N).

questions.question_en: A row has 5 boxes numbered 1 to 5. In figure 1, box 1 is shaded. In each next figure the shading moves 2 boxes to the right, returning to the start after box 5 (box 5 → box 2). Which box is shaded in figure 6?
questions.explanation_en: Figures 1 to 6: box 1 → 3 → 5 → 2 → 4 → 1. So in figure 6 box 1 is shaded.

questions.question_en: For which of the following times does the mirror image of a clock show the same time as the actual time?
questions.explanation_en: 11:60 − 6:00 = 5:60 = 6:00, so 6:00 looks unchanged (both hands lie on the vertical axis). 3:00 appears as 9:00, 9:30 as 2:30 and 4:20 as 7:40.

questions.question_en: Ravi spends 80% of his income. If his income increases by 20% and his expenditure increases by 10%, what is the percentage increase in his savings?
questions.explanation_en: Take income = 100: expenditure 80, saving 20. New income 120, new expenditure 88, new saving 32. Increase = 12/20 × 100 = 60%.

questions.question_en: Simplify: 7/8 of 96 − 5/6 of 72
questions.explanation_en: 7/8 of 96 = 84 and 5/6 of 72 = 60. The difference is 84 − 60 = 24.

questions.question_en: A sum of money invested at 8% compound interest per annum amounts to ₹5,832 in 2 years. What is the sum?
The marked price of a shirt is ₹800. A discount of 15% is given. What is the selling price?
The simple interest on a sum of money for 2 years at 5% per annum is ₹500. What is the compound interest on the same sum at the same rate for 2 years?
Two persons start from the same point and walk in opposite directions at 5 km/h and 7 km/h. How far apart will they be after 3 hours?
questions.explanation_en: In opposite directions the speeds add: relative speed = 12 km/h. Distance = 12 × 3 = 36 km.

questions.question_en: A vessel contains 60 litres of pure milk. 12 litres are drawn out and replaced by water. The process is repeated once more. How much milk is now in the vessel?
questions.explanation_en: Milk left = 60 × (1 − 12/60)² = 60 × (4/5)² = 60 × 16/25 = 38.4 litres. (48 L after the first step; 48 × 4/5 = 38.4 after the second.)

questions.question_en: A boat's downstream speed is 15 km/h and its upstream speed is 9 km/h. What is the speed of the stream?
questions.explanation_en: Stream = (15 − 9)/2 = 3 km/h. (Still-water speed = (15 + 9)/2 = 12 km/h.)

questions.question_en: Three bells ring at intervals of 12, 18 and 30 minutes. If they ring together at 8:00 a.m., when will they next ring together?
questions.explanation_en: LCM of 12, 18, 30 = 180 minutes = 3 hours. So they ring together again at 11:00 a.m.

questions.question_en: Two trains of length 140 m and 160 m run on parallel tracks in opposite directions at 60 km/h and 40 km/h. In how many seconds will they cross each other?
questions.explanation_en: Relative speed = 100 km/h = 100 × 5/18 = 250/9 m/s. Distance = 300 m. Time = 300 × 9/250 = 10.8 s.

questions.question_en: A car covers 360 km in 4.5 hours. What is its speed?
questions.explanation_en: Speed = distance / time = 360 / 4.5 = 80 km/h.

questions.question_en: What is the difference between the compound interest and simple interest on ₹5,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years?
questions.explanation_en: For 2 years the difference = P(R/100)² = 5000 × (0.1)² = ₹50. (CI = 1050, SI = 1000.)

questions.question_en: A train running at 54 km/h takes 20 seconds to cross a platform and 12 seconds to pass a man standing on the platform. What is the length of the platform?
questions.explanation_en: Speed = 54 × 5/18 = 15 m/s. Train length = 15 × 12 = 180 m. Platform + train = 15 × 20 = 300 m, so platform = 120 m.

questions.question_en: A boat takes 1 hour to go downstream a certain distance but 1.5 hours to come back upstream. If the speed of the boat in still water is 5 km/h, what is the speed of the stream?
questions.explanation_en: Let the distance be d. Downstream speed = d, upstream = d/1.5 = 2d/3. Still water = (d + 2d/3)/2 = 5d/6 = 5, so d = 6. Downstream 6 km/h, upstream 4 km/h, stream = (6 − 4)/2 = 1 km/h.

questions.question_en: An exterior angle of a triangle is 110° and one of the two interior opposite angles is 45°. The other interior opposite angle is:
questions.explanation_en: Exterior angle = sum of the two interior opposite angles, so the other angle = 110° − 45° = 65°.

questions.question_en: The mode of the data 2, 3, 5, 3, 7, 5, 3, 8 is:
questions.explanation_en: 3 occurs three times, more than any other value (5 occurs twice), so the mode is 3.

questions.question_en: A solid metal sphere of radius 6 cm is melted and recast into small solid cones, each of base radius 3 cm and height 4 cm. How many cones are formed?
questions.explanation_en: Sphere volume = (4/3)π × 216 = 288π. Cone volume = (1/3)π × 9 × 4 = 12π. Number of cones = 288π / 12π = 24.

questions.question_en:
The table shows the production (in thousand units) of three items by a company.
Year | Laptops | Tablets | Printers
2020 | 40 | 25 | 15
2021 | 45 | 30 | 20
2022 | 50 | 35 | 18
2023 | 60 | 32 | 24
2024 | 55 | 40 | 30
In how many years (2021 to 2024) did tablet production fall compared with the previous year?
questions.explanation_en: Tablet figures: 25 → 30 (rise), 30 → 35 (rise), 35 → 32 (fall in 2023), 32 → 40 (rise). Only one year, 2023, shows a fall.

questions.question_en: If 2x + 3y = 13 and 3x − y = 3, then x + y equals:
questions.explanation_en: From the second equation y = 3x − 3. Substituting: 2x + 9x − 9 = 13 → 11x = 22 → x = 2, y = 3. So x + y = 5.

questions.subtopic: अनेक शब्दों के लिए एक शब्द
questions.question_en: 'जिसकी उपमा न दी जा सके' — इसके लिए एक शब्द चुनिए।
questions.question_hi: 'जिसकी उपमा न दी जा सके' — इसके लिए एक शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation_en: That which has no comparison = anupam.
questions.explanation_hi: जिसकी उपमा न हो = अनुपम (या अनुपमेय)। 'अतुल' = जिसकी तुलना न हो, अर्थ में निकट है पर मानक उत्तर 'अनुपम' है।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द 'समुद्र' का पर्यायवाची नहीं है?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द 'समुद्र' का पर्यायवाची नहीं है?
questions.explanation_en: Payod means cloud (water-giver); the others mean ocean.
questions.explanation_hi: रत्नाकर, जलधि और पयोधि (पयः = जल, धि = भंडार) समुद्र के पर्यायवाची हैं। 'पयोद' का अर्थ जल देने वाला अर्थात् बादल है।

questions.question_en: 'प्रमाण से सिद्ध' अर्थ वाले विशेषण की शुद्ध वर्तनी चुनिए।
questions.question_hi: 'प्रमाण से सिद्ध' अर्थ वाले विशेषण की शुद्ध वर्तनी चुनिए।
questions.explanation_en: Adding -ik lengthens the first vowel: pramaan becomes praamaanik.
questions.explanation_hi: 'प्रमाण' में 'इक' प्रत्यय जुड़ने पर पहले स्वर की वृद्धि होती है — प्रमाण → प्रामाणिक। इसी नियम से इतिहास → ऐतिहासिक, समाज → सामाजिक।

questions.question_en:
निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।

परिश्रम ही सफलता की कुंजी है। इतिहास साक्षी है कि जिन लोगों ने कठिन परिश्रम किया, वे साधनों के अभाव में भी ऊँचाइयों तक पहुँचे। भाग्य के भरोसे बैठे रहने वाला व्यक्ति अवसर आने पर भी उसका लाभ नहीं उठा पाता। परिश्रमी व्यक्ति असफलता से निराश नहीं होता; वह अपनी भूलों से सीखकर फिर प्रयास करता है। आलस्य मनुष्य का सबसे बड़ा शत्रु है, जो उसकी प्रतिभा को धीरे-धीरे नष्ट कर देता है।

प्रश्न: गद्यांश में आए 'परिश्रम' शब्द में कौन-सा उपसर्ग है?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।

परिश्रम ही सफलता की कुंजी है। इतिहास साक्षी है कि जिन लोगों ने कठिन परिश्रम किया, वे साधनों के अभाव में भी ऊँचाइयों तक पहुँचे। भाग्य के भरोसे बैठे रहने वाला व्यक्ति अवसर आने पर भी उसका लाभ नहीं उठा पाता। परिश्रमी व्यक्ति असफलता से निराश नहीं होता; वह अपनी भूलों से सीखकर फिर प्रयास करता है। आलस्य मनुष्य का सबसे बड़ा शत्रु है, जो उसकी प्रतिभा को धीरे-धीरे नष्ट कर देता है।

प्रश्न: गद्यांश में आए 'परिश्रम' शब्द में कौन-सा उपसर्ग है?
questions.explanation_en: Parishram = pari + shram; the prefix is 'pari'.
questions.explanation_hi: परि + श्रम = परिश्रम। 'परि' संस्कृत उपसर्ग है जिसका अर्थ 'चारों ओर/पूर्ण रूप से' है; इसी से परिक्रमा, परिपूर्ण जैसे शब्द बनते हैं।

questions.question_en: 'अधजल गगरी छलकत जाय' लोकोक्ति का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'अधजल गगरी छलकत जाय' लोकोक्ति का अर्थ क्या है?

options.en: संचय करने से धन बढ़ता है
options.hi: संचय करने से धन बढ़ता है

options.en: कम ज्ञान वाला अधिक दिखावा करता है
options.hi: कम ज्ञान वाला अधिक दिखावा करता है

questions.explanation_en: A person with little knowledge shows off the most.
questions.explanation_hi: आधी भरी गगरी अधिक छलकती है; इसी प्रकार अल्पज्ञ व्यक्ति अपने थोड़े ज्ञान का अधिक प्रदर्शन करता है, जबकि ज्ञानी गंभीर रहता है।

questions.question_en: 'राजपुत्र' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.question_hi: 'राजपुत्र' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation_en: Rajputra = son of the king; genitive marker dropped — tatpurush.
questions.explanation_hi: राजपुत्र = राजा का पुत्र। 'का' विभक्ति का लोप होने से यह संबंध (षष्ठी) तत्पुरुष समास है।

questions.question_en: 'हनुमान की पूँछ में लगन न पाई आग, लंका सिगरी जल गई, गए निसाचर भाग' — इसमें कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.question_hi: 'हनुमान की पूँछ में लगन न पाई आग, लंका सिगरी जल गई, गए निसाचर भाग' — इसमें कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.explanation_en: Lanka burning even before the tail caught fire is exaggeration, i.e. Atishayokti (hyperbole).
questions.explanation_hi: पूँछ में आग लगने से पहले ही पूरी लंका का जल जाना लोक-सीमा से बढ़ाकर किया गया वर्णन है। किसी बात को बहुत बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहना अतिशयोक्ति अलंकार है।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से करण तत्पुरुष समास का उदाहरण कौन-सा है?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से करण तत्पुरुष समास का उदाहरण कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation_en: Hastalikhit = written by hand; instrumental marker dropped — karan tatpurush.
questions.explanation_hi: हस्तलिखित = हाथ से लिखा हुआ; 'से' (करण) विभक्ति का लोप है। राजमहल और गंगाजल संबंध तत्पुरुष हैं, देशनिकाला अपादान तत्पुरुष है।

questions.question_en:
निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।

एक अच्छा शिक्षक केवल पाठ्यपुस्तक का ज्ञान नहीं देता, बल्कि विद्यार्थियों में सोचने की क्षमता जगाता है। वह प्रश्न पूछने को प्रोत्साहित करता है और गलती को सीखने का अवसर मानता है। कक्षा में भय का वातावरण होने पर विद्यार्थी अपनी शंकाएँ व्यक्त नहीं कर पाते, इसलिए शिक्षक को मित्रवत् व्यवहार करना चाहिए। राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति 2020 भी रटने के स्थान पर समझ पर आधारित शिक्षा पर बल देती है। वास्तव में शिक्षक वह दीपक है जो स्वयं जलकर दूसरों का मार्ग आलोकित करता है।

प्रश्न: गद्यांश के अनुसार एक अच्छा शिक्षक विद्यार्थियों में क्या जगाता है?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।

परिश्रम ही सफलता की कुंजी है। इतिहास साक्षी है कि जिन लोगों ने कठिन परिश्रम किया, वे साधनों के अभाव में भी ऊँचाइयों तक पहुँचे। भाग्य के भरोसे बैठे रहने वाला व्यक्ति अवसर आने पर भी उसका लाभ नहीं उठा पाता। परिश्रमी व्यक्ति असफलता से निराश नहीं होता; वह अपनी भूलों से सीखकर फिर प्रयास करता है। आलस्य मनुष्य का सबसे बड़ा शत्रु है, जो उसकी प्रतिभा को धीरे-धीरे नष्ट कर देता है।

questions.question_en:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Trees in cities do much more than make streets look pleasant. A single mature tree can absorb about twenty kilograms of carbon dioxide in a year and release enough oxygen for two people. Their leaves trap dust, while their shade can lower the temperature of a neighbourhood by several degrees, reducing the need for air conditioners. In many Indian cities, however, trees are felled for widening roads and constructing flyovers, often without any plan to replace them. Urban planners argue that development and greenery are not enemies; roads can be designed around existing trees, and every felled tree can be compensated by planting several saplings. Citizens, too, must take the initiative by protecting trees in their own colony instead of waiting for the government to act.

What is the view of urban planners according to the passage?

options.en: Development and greenery can go together.
Trees should be removed for flyovers.
Only the government can protect trees.

questions.explanation_en: Planners argue that development and greenery are not enemies, since roads can be designed around trees.

questions.question_en:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Sleep is often treated as a luxury by students and working adults, yet scientists consider it as essential as food and water. During sleep the brain does not simply switch off; it sorts the information gathered during the day, stores important memories and clears away harmful chemicals that accumulate while we are awake. Children who sleep for less than eight hours are more likely to have difficulty in concentrating and to show poor results in examinations. Adults who regularly sleep for only five or six hours face a higher risk of heart disease and depression. Experts therefore advise a fixed bedtime, avoiding screens an hour before sleeping and keeping the bedroom dark and quiet. Contrary to popular belief, sleeping late on weekends cannot fully repay the “sleep debt” collected during the week.

What is the main idea of the passage?

options.en: Weekends are meant for rest only.
Sleep is essential for health and learning.

questions.explanation_en: The passage opens by calling sleep as essential as food and water, then describes its effects on the brain, children and adults.

questions.explanation_en: A universal or scientific truth stays in the simple present even after a past-tense reporting verb.

questions.question_en: Using a K-map, the minimal form of F(A, B, C) = Σm(0, 2, 6) + d(4), where d denotes a don't-care, is:
questions.question_hi: K-मैप द्वारा F(A, B, C) = Σm(0, 2, 6) + d(4) (d = डोंट-केयर) का न्यूनतम रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Taking the don't-care m4 as 1 gives cells 0, 2, 4, 6 — all four cells where C = 0 — forming a quad, so F = C'. Without using the don't-care the best cover would be A'C' + BC', which is not minimal.

questions.question_en: If (121)b = (16)10, what is the value of the base b?
questions.explanation_en: (121)b = b² + 2b + 1 = (b + 1)². Setting (b + 1)² = 16 gives b + 1 = 4, so b = 3. Check: 9 + 6 + 1 = 16.

questions.question_en: What is the minimum number of flip-flops required to build a mod-10 (decade) counter?
questions.question_hi: मॉड-10 (डिकेड) काउंटर बनाने के लिए न्यूनतम कितने फ्लिप-फ्लॉप चाहिए?
questions.explanation_en: n flip-flops give 2^n states; 2^3 = 8 is less than 10 but 2^4 = 16 is enough, so 4 flip-flops are needed (the counter is reset after 1001). 10 would be the requirement of a ring counter, not a binary counter.

questions.question_en: MICR technology, which reads characters printed with magnetic ink, is mainly used by:
questions.explanation_en: Magnetic Ink Character Recognition reads the code line printed on cheques in iron-oxide ink, which stays readable even if the cheque is stamped over. OMR is used for answer sheets and barcode readers for retail.

questions.question_en: A two-input gate gives output 1 exactly when its two inputs are different. The gate is:
questions.explanation_en: The exclusive-OR gate outputs 1 for inputs 01 and 10 and 0 for 00 and 11, so it detects inequality. XNOR is its complement and outputs 1 when the inputs are equal.

questions.question_en: Among L1, L2 and L3 cache, which statement is correct?

options.en: L1 is the smallest and fastest, located closest to the CPU core
L1 is the largest and is shared by all cores
L3 is the smallest and fastest, located inside each core
L2 is always located on the motherboard, not the chip

questions.explanation_en: L1 cache (typically 32–64 KB per core) is built into each core and has the lowest latency; L2 is larger and slightly slower; L3 is the largest and is usually shared among all cores on the chip.

questions.question_en: The expression AB + AB' simplifies to:
questions.explanation_en: Factor out A: AB + AB' = A(B + B') = A·1 = A. The variable B appears in both true and complemented form with the same companion, so it is eliminated.

questions.question_en: The identity A(B + C) = AB + AC is an example of which Boolean law?
questions.explanation_en: The distributive law lets AND distribute over OR (and, unusually, in Boolean algebra OR also distributes over AND: A + BC = (A + B)(A + C)). The commutative law swaps operands (A + B = B + A) and the associative law regroups them.

questions.question_en: The Gray code 1101 corresponds to which binary number?
questions.question_hi: ग्रे कोड 1101 किस बाइनरी संख्या के संगत है?
questions.explanation_en: Binary MSB = Gray MSB = 1; each next binary bit = previous binary bit ⊕ current Gray bit: 1⊕1 = 0, 0⊕0 = 0, 0⊕1 = 1, giving 1001. Check: binary 1001 → Gray 1, 1⊕0, 0⊕0, 0⊕1 = 1101.

questions.question_en: What is the decimal equivalent of the base-5 number (1234)5?
What is the decimal value of the hexadecimal number (2F)16?
questions.explanation_en: In hexadecimal F = 15, so 2F = 2×16 + 15 = 32 + 15 = 47.

questions.question_en: Simplify the Boolean function F = A'B'C + A'BC + AB'C + ABC.
questions.explanation_en: Group the terms: A'C(B' + B) + AC(B' + B) = A'C + AC = C(A' + A) = C. All four minterms share C = 1 and cover every combination of A and B, so the function depends on C alone.

questions.question_en: A fraudster calls people pretending to be a bank's customer-care executive and uses an online form to cheat them of money. The specific IT Act section for 'cheating by personation by using computer resource' is:
questions.explanation_en: Section 66D punishes cheating by personation using a computer resource with imprisonment up to 3 years and fine up to ₹1 lakh. Section 66B concerns receiving stolen computer resources.

questions.question_en: Which shortcut opens the Find and Replace dialog box with the Replace tab active in MS Word?
questions.explanation_en: Ctrl + H opens Replace. Ctrl + F opens Find (Navigation pane), Ctrl + G opens Go To and Ctrl + R right-aligns text.

questions.question_en: UPI processes billions of transactions every month, with data arriving continuously in real time. Which 'V' of big data does the speed of this data generation represent?
questions.explanation_en: Velocity refers to the speed at which data is generated and must be processed. Volume is the total amount, Variety the range of formats and Veracity the trustworthiness of the data.

questions.question_en: While typing the chemical formula H2O in MS Word, the digit 2 should be lowered below the line. Which shortcut applies this formatting?
questions.explanation_en: Ctrl + = toggles subscript (H₂O). Ctrl + Shift + = gives superscript (x²), Ctrl + ] increases font size by 1 point and Ctrl + 2 sets double line spacing.

questions.question_en: Cell C2 contains the formula =$A1+B$1. If it is copied to cell D4, the formula in D4 will be:
questions.explanation_en: Moving from C2 to D4 shifts one column right and two rows down. In $A1 the column is locked and the row changes to 3 → $A3; in B$1 the row is locked and the column changes to C → C$1.

questions.question_en: Which feature on the Review tab of MS Word records every insertion, deletion and formatting change made by a reviewer so that the author can accept or reject each one?
questions.explanation_en: Track Changes (Ctrl + Shift + E) marks every edit with the reviewer's name; the author then accepts or rejects changes individually.

questions.question_en: The BharatNet project under Digital India aims to:

options.en: Set up a national cryptocurrency exchange
Provide optical-fibre broadband connectivity to all Gram Panchayats
Issue digital identity cards to rural citizens

questions.explanation_en: BharatNet, implemented by Bharat Broadband Network Ltd., lays optical fibre to connect Gram Panchayats with high-speed broadband, forming the backbone for rural e-services.

questions.question_en: A PowerPoint file is to be shared so that, when double-clicked, it opens directly in Slide Show mode instead of Normal (editing) view. It should be saved with the extension:
questions.explanation_en: .ppsx is the PowerPoint Show format that launches straight into the slide show. .pptx is the normal presentation, .potx a template and .pptm a macro-enabled presentation.

questions.question_en: An online store groups its customers into segments by buying behaviour without any predefined labels. Which type of machine learning technique is this?
questions.explanation_en: Grouping unlabelled data by similarity, e.g. using k-means, is clustering, an unsupervised technique. Classification and regression both need labelled training data.

questions.question_en: How many rows and columns does a worksheet have in MS Excel 2007 and later versions?
questions.explanation_en: Since Excel 2007 a sheet has 2^20 = 1,048,576 rows and 2^14 = 16,384 columns (last column XFD). 65,536 × 256 was the limit of Excel 2003.

options.en: Compilation error: interface methods cannot have a body

questions.explanation_en: Since Java 8, an interface may contain default methods with a body; implementing classes inherit them. T only has to implement the abstract method name(), so the output is Hi Ravi.

questions.question_en:
What does the following Python statement print?

print(7 // 2, 7 % 2, -7 // 2)
questions.explanation_en: // is floor division: 7 // 2 = 3 and 7 % 2 = 1. For -7 // 2 Python floors towards negative infinity, so -3.5 becomes -4 (C would truncate to -3).
i takes the odd values 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 and their sum is 25. (The even values would give 30.)

questions.question_en: Bundling data and the functions that operate on that data into a single unit (a class), while restricting direct outside access to the data, is called:
questions.explanation_en: Encapsulation wraps data and methods together and hides the data (data hiding) using private access, exposing it only through public methods. Abstraction is about showing only essential features and hiding implementation details.
Odd values 1, 3, 5 are printed because even ones are skipped by continue. A while loop's else clause runs when the loop ends normally (not through break), so E is printed afterwards.

questions.question_en:
What does the following Python code print?

d = {k: k * 2 for k in range(1, 5)}
d.pop(2)
d.update({5: 0, 1: 9})
print(d)
questions.explanation_en: The comprehension builds {1: 2, 2: 4, 3: 6, 4: 8}; pop(2) removes key 2. update() overwrites the existing key 1 in its original position and appends the new key 5 at the end. Keys are never duplicated.
x > 5 is true, so the inner if is checked. x > 10 is false, so the inner else prints B.

questions.question_en: Which of the following statements about method overloading and method overriding is TRUE?

options.en: Overloading requires inheritance, but overriding does not
Overloaded methods may differ only in their return type
Overloading is resolved at compile time, overriding at run time
Overriding methods must differ in their parameter lists

questions.explanation_en: Overloading (same name, different parameter lists, usually in one class) is static/compile-time polymorphism. Overriding (same signature in a subclass) is dynamic/run-time polymorphism. A change in return type alone is not enough to overload.

questions.question_en:
What does the following Python code print?

print(len(set("banana")), sorted(set([3, 1, 3, 2, 1])))
questions.explanation_en: A set keeps only unique elements: the letters of banana give {b, a, n}, size 3. The duplicates in the list are removed and sorted() returns a list, [1, 2, 3].

questions.question_en: Which of the following operators can NOT be overloaded in C++?
questions.explanation_en: C++ does not allow overloading of ::, . (member access), .*, ?: and sizeof. Operators such as +, [] and << are commonly overloaded, e.g. << for printing objects with cout.
p holds the address of x, so *p = *p + 10 writes 15 into x itself. Printing x therefore gives 15.
break exits only the inner loop. For each i the inner loop prints i1 and then breaks when j becomes 2, so the output is 11 21 31.

An abstract class cannot be instantiated, but a reference of its type can point to a concrete subclass object. info() is inherited and area() is Sq's implementation; side * side is a double, so 4.0 is printed.
The inner loop runs 3 times for i = 1, 2 times for i = 2 and once for i = 3, giving 3 + 2 + 1 = 6.
*s is the first character h and *(s + 4) is the fifth character o. %c prints single characters.

questions.question_en: In C++, a and b are two objects of class A that both already exist. Which of the following does NOT invoke the copy constructor of A?

options.en: Passing a to a function that takes A by value

questions.explanation_en: When both objects already exist, b = a calls the copy assignment operator, not the copy constructor. The copy constructor runs only when a new object is created from an existing one: A c = a;, A c(a); or pass-by-value.
sizeof(a) is the whole array (10 x 4 = 40 bytes) and sizeof(a[0]) is one element (4 bytes); dividing gives the number of elements, 10. This is the standard idiom for array length.

questions.question_en: The IPv6 loopback address is written as:
questions.explanation_en: In IPv6 the loopback is 0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1, abbreviated ::1. 127.0.0.1 is the IPv4 loopback; FF02::1 is the all-nodes multicast and FE80:: begins link-local addresses.

questions.question_en: The Session, Presentation and Application layers of the OSI model together correspond to which single layer of the TCP/IP model?
questions.explanation_en: The four-layer TCP/IP model merges OSI layers 5, 6 and 7 into one Application layer, and merges OSI layers 1 and 2 into the Network Access (Link) layer.

questions.question_en: A firewall protects a network mainly by:

options.en: Allowing or blocking traffic according to a set of security rules
Increasing the bandwidth of the Internet connection
Converting digital signals to analog signals

questions.explanation_en: A firewall (hardware or software) inspects incoming and outgoing traffic and permits or denies it based on rules such as IP address, port and protocol. Address assignment is DHCP's job and signal conversion is a modem's.

questions.question_en: Which OSI layer establishes, maintains, synchronises and terminates the dialogue between two communicating applications?
questions.explanation_en: Dialogue control, synchronisation points and session management are Session layer (layer 5) functions.

questions.question_en: The IPv4 address 172.16.5.4 belongs to which address class?
questions.explanation_en: The first octet 172 lies in the range 128–191, which is Class B. Class A is 1–126 and Class C is 192–223.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a correctly written IPv6 address?
questions.explanation_en: The double colon (::) may replace one run of zero groups and can appear only once, and only hexadecimal digits 0–9 and a–f are allowed. The second option uses :: twice and the third contains the non-hex letter g.

questions.question_en: Which statement correctly contrasts single-mode and multimode optical fibre?

options.en: Single-mode has a larger core and uses LEDs; multimode uses lasers for long distances
Single-mode has a very thin core, is usually driven by a laser and supports longer distances; multimode has a wider core and is used for shorter runs
Both have identical cores; they differ only in jacket colour
Multimode can carry only one wavelength while single-mode carries many

questions.explanation_en: Single-mode fibre (core ≈ 8–10 µm) carries a single light path with very low dispersion, so it works over tens of kilometres. Multimode (core ≈ 50–62.5 µm) allows many paths, causing modal dispersion, so it suits short campus/building links.

questions.question_en: In the Domain Name System, the label '.in' in 'ncert.nic.in' is called a:
questions.explanation_en: The right-most label is the top-level domain; '.in' is India's country-code TLD (ccTLD). Generic TLDs include .com, .org and .edu.

questions.question_en: To connect an organisation's IPX-based legacy network to a TCP/IP network, converting between the two protocol stacks, the appropriate device is a:
questions.explanation_en: A gateway translates between different protocol architectures and can operate up to the Application layer; the other devices work within a single protocol family.

questions.question_en: Using a Caesar cipher with a shift of 3, the plaintext word NET is encrypted as:
questions.explanation_en: Each letter is moved three places forward: N→Q, E→H, T→W, giving QHW. OFU uses a shift of 1 and KBQ shifts backward by 3.

questions.question_en: Twenty-four PCs are connected to a single 24-port switch, which is connected to a router. How many collision domains and broadcast domains does the switch create among the PCs?
questions.explanation_en: Each switch port is its own collision domain (24), but a switch forwards broadcasts to all ports, so all PCs share one broadcast domain. Only a router (or VLANs) separates broadcast domains; a hub would give 1 collision domain.

questions.question_en: The prefix /20 corresponds to which dotted-decimal subnet mask?
questions.explanation_en: /20 = 16 bits (255.255) plus 4 more one-bits in the third octet: 128 + 64 + 32 + 16 = 240. Hence 255.255.240.0.

questions.question_en: Which of the following best explains why the long-term scheduler should select a good mix of I/O-bound and CPU-bound processes?

options.en: I/O-bound processes need more memory than CPU-bound processes
If all processes are I/O-bound the ready queue is often empty and the CPU idles; if all are CPU-bound the I/O devices sit idle, so a mix keeps both busy
CPU-bound processes cannot be preempted, so they must be balanced with I/O-bound ones
The dispatcher can handle only a fixed number of each type

questions.explanation_en: An I/O-bound process spends most of its time waiting for devices, while a CPU-bound process spends it computing. Balancing the two keeps both the CPU and the devices utilised; otherwise one resource is idle while the other is a bottleneck.

questions.question_en: In a multilevel feedback queue scheduler, a process that uses its entire time quantum in a high-priority queue is usually:

options.en: Moved to a lower-priority queue with a larger quantum
Terminated for over-use of the CPU
Kept in the same queue permanently

questions.explanation_en: MLFQ demotes CPU-hungry processes to lower queues (often with longer quanta or FCFS) and leaves short/interactive jobs in the high-priority queues; ageing may later promote a starved process. Unlike a plain multilevel queue, processes can move between queues.

questions.question_en: Processes arrive as follows: P1 at 0 (burst 6), P2 at 1 (burst 3), P3 at 2 (burst 8), P4 at 3 (burst 2). Using Shortest Remaining Time First (preemptive SJF), the average waiting time is:
questions.explanation_en: Gantt: P1 (0-1), P2 (1-4, it preempts P1 since 3 < 5 remaining), P4 (4-6), P1 (6-11), P3 (11-19). Completion: P1 = 11, P2 = 4, P3 = 19, P4 = 6. Waiting = completion − arrival − burst: P1 = 5, P2 = 0, P3 = 9, P4 = 1; total 15; average 15/4 = 3.75 ms. (8.5 ms is the average turnaround time.)

questions.question_en: Which statement correctly distinguishes a hard real-time system from a soft real-time system?

options.en: A hard real-time system has no deadlines; a soft real-time system has strict deadlines
In a hard real-time system a missed deadline is a total system failure; in a soft real-time system a late result only degrades service
Hard real-time systems use virtual memory extensively, soft real-time systems never do
Soft real-time systems are used in aircraft control; hard real-time systems in video streaming

questions.explanation_en: In a hard real-time system (pacemaker, flight control, airbag) a missed deadline is unacceptable; a soft real-time system (multimedia streaming) tolerates occasional lateness with reduced quality. Option 4 swaps the examples.

questions.question_en: Which of the following best describes multiprogramming?

options.en: Running one program on several processors at the same time
Keeping several programs in main memory so the CPU always has a job to execute when one job waits for I/O
Allowing a single program to create several threads
Executing programs on several computers connected by a network

questions.explanation_en: Multiprogramming increases CPU utilisation by keeping several jobs in memory; when the running job blocks for I/O the OS switches to another. Option 1 is multiprocessing, option 3 multithreading and option 4 distributed computing.

questions.question_en: In which type of operating system are jobs with similar needs grouped together and executed one after another without any user interaction during execution?
questions.explanation_en: A batch OS collects similar jobs into batches and runs them sequentially with no interaction while they execute; the operator, not the user, submits them. Time-sharing systems are built precisely for interactive use, which rules out option 2.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is shared by all threads of the same process?

options.en: Code section, data section and open files

questions.explanation_en: Threads of one process share the address space (code and global data), heap and OS resources such as open files. Each thread has its own thread ID, program counter, register set and stack, so options 1-3 are per-thread items.

questions.question_en: A user's umask is 022. With the usual base permission of 666 for regular files, what permissions does a newly created regular file receive?
questions.explanation_en: umask removes bits: 666 with the 022 bits cleared = 644, i.e. rw-r--r--. 755 is what a new DIRECTORY gets (777 minus 022); files start from 666 so execute is never set by default.

questions.question_en: Four processes arrive at time 0: P1 (burst 6, priority 2), P2 (burst 3, priority 1), P3 (burst 8, priority 4), P4 (burst 2, priority 3). A smaller number means higher priority. With non-preemptive priority scheduling the average waiting time is:
questions.explanation_en: Order by priority: P2 → P1 → P4 → P3, starting at 0, 3, 9, 11. Waiting times: P2 = 0, P1 = 3, P4 = 9, P3 = 11; total 23; average 23/4 = 5.75 ms.

questions.question_en: In the producer–consumer (bounded buffer) problem with a buffer of n slots, the semaphores 'empty' and 'full' are initialised to:
questions.explanation_en: Initially all n slots are empty and none is full, so empty = n and full = 0. The producer does wait(empty) before inserting and signal(full) afterwards; the consumer does the reverse. A separate mutex (initialised to 1) guards the buffer itself.

questions.question_en: Which of these views is NOT updatable (rows cannot be inserted/updated through it) in MySQL?

options.en: CREATE VIEW V AS SELECT D_ID, COUNT(*) FROM EMP GROUP BY D_ID;
CREATE VIEW V AS SELECT E_ID, Name FROM EMP;
CREATE VIEW V AS SELECT * FROM EMP WHERE Salary > 20000;
CREATE VIEW V AS SELECT E_ID, Salary FROM EMP WHERE D_ID = 5;

questions.explanation_en: A view containing aggregate functions, GROUP BY, DISTINCT, UNION or subqueries in SELECT cannot be mapped back to individual base rows, so it is read-only. Simple single-table projections/selections remain updatable.

questions.question_en: Using the same tables (A.ID = 1, 2, 3; B.ID = 2, 3, 4), SELECT * FROM A LEFT JOIN B ON A.ID = B.ID; returns how many rows and what is B.ID for A.ID = 1?
questions.explanation_en: LEFT JOIN keeps every row of the left table A (3 rows). Row ID 1 has no match in B, so its B columns are filled with NULL.

questions.question_en: For the UNION of two relations to be valid, the relations must be:

options.en: Union-compatible (same number of attributes with compatible domains)

questions.explanation_en: Union, intersection and difference need the operands to have the same degree and corresponding attributes from compatible domains. The number of rows may differ.

questions.question_en: SALES(City, Amount): (Delhi 100), (Mumbai 200), (Delhi 300), (Pune 150), (Mumbai 50). Output of SELECT City, SUM(Amount) FROM SALES GROUP BY City HAVING SUM(Amount) > 200; is:
questions.explanation_en: Group totals: Delhi 400, Mumbai 250, Pune 150. HAVING filters groups after aggregation, keeping those above 200 — Delhi and Mumbai.

questions.question_en: Table EMP(ID, Name, Salary). The statement UPDATE EMP SET Salary = Salary * 1.10; (without WHERE) will:

options.en: Increase only the first row's salary
Increase the salary of every row by 10%
Return an error because WHERE is mandatory

questions.explanation_en: An UPDATE without a WHERE clause applies the SET expression to every row of the table. This is a frequent cause of accidental data changes; WHERE is optional, not mandatory.

questions.question_en: A join that automatically matches all columns having the same name in both tables and shows the common column only once is a:
questions.explanation_en: NATURAL JOIN uses all same-named columns as the join condition and removes the duplicate column from the result. An equi-join written with ON keeps both copies of the column.

questions.question_en: Which join returns all rows from the right table and the matching rows from the left table, with NULLs where there is no match?
questions.explanation_en: RIGHT (OUTER) JOIN preserves every row of the table named on the right of the JOIN keyword. LEFT JOIN preserves the left table; INNER JOIN keeps only matches.

questions.question_en: To list every department even if it has no employee, along with employee names where present, which query is correct?

options.en: SELECT D.D_Name, E.Name FROM DEPT D RIGHT JOIN EMP E ON D.D_ID = E.D_ID;
SELECT D.D_Name, E.Name FROM DEPT D LEFT JOIN EMP E ON D.D_ID = E.D_ID;
SELECT D.D_Name, E.Name FROM DEPT D INNER JOIN EMP E ON D.D_ID = E.D_ID;
SELECT D.D_Name, E.Name FROM DEPT D, EMP E;

questions.explanation_en: DEPT is the left table, so LEFT JOIN keeps all departments and shows NULL for Name where no employee exists. INNER JOIN drops empty departments; RIGHT JOIN would keep all employees instead.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a TCL (Transaction Control Language) command?
questions.explanation_en: TCL includes COMMIT, ROLLBACK and SAVEPOINT. TRUNCATE is DDL, REVOKE is DCL and SELECT is DQL/DML.

questions.question_en: A key made up of two or more attributes is known as a:
questions.explanation_en: A composite (compound) key uses several columns together, such as (Order_ID, Item_No). A surrogate key is an artificial single column like an auto-increment ID.

questions.question_en: Setting the HttpOnly flag on a session cookie mainly helps to:

options.en: Encrypt the cookie value on the server
Make the cookie expire when the browser closes
Prevent client-side JavaScript from reading the cookie, reducing theft through XSS
Force the cookie to be sent only over HTTP and never HTTPS

questions.explanation_en: HttpOnly hides the cookie from document.cookie, so an injected script cannot steal it. The Secure flag (not HttpOnly) restricts a cookie to HTTPS connections.

questions.question_en:
What is the output of this JavaScript?
console.log(JSON.stringify({a: 1, b: [true, null], c: undefined}));
questions.explanation_en: JSON has no undefined type, so properties whose value is undefined are omitted from objects by JSON.stringify. Keys are double-quoted, and numbers, booleans and null keep their types.

questions.question_en: Which attribute of <td> makes a single cell stretch horizontally across three columns?
questions.explanation_en: colspan merges cells across columns, while rowspan merges cells down across rows. cellspan does not exist, and span is used on <col>/<colgroup> elements, not on <td>.

questions.question_en: Inside a form's submit event handler, which call stops the browser from actually submitting the form and reloading the page?
questions.explanation_en: preventDefault() cancels the default action of the event (here, submission). stopPropagation() only stops the event from bubbling to ancestor elements; the form would still be submitted.

questions.question_en: JavaScript was originally created in 1995 by:
questions.explanation_en: Brendan Eich wrote the first version of JavaScript (initially called Mocha, then LiveScript) at Netscape in 1995. Gosling created Java, which is an unrelated language despite the name.

questions.question_en: Which rule is necessary for an XML document to be well-formed?

options.en: It must contain at least one attribute
Tags must be written in uppercase
It must have exactly one root element enclosing all other elements
It must be validated against a DTD

questions.explanation_en: A well-formed XML document has one root element, properly nested and closed tags, quoted attribute values, and case-matching tags. Validation against a DTD or XSD is what makes it 'valid', a stricter extra condition.

questions.question_en: Which attribute of the tag provides alternative text that is displayed if the image cannot be loaded and is read aloud by screen readers?
questions.explanation_en: The alt attribute supplies a text alternative for the image, important for accessibility and for broken images. src gives the image path, and title only shows a tooltip on hover.

options.en: A SyntaxError is reported only in older browsers
x stays 10 silently and no error occurs
A TypeError is thrown because a const binding cannot be reassigned

questions.explanation_en: A const variable must be initialised once and cannot be reassigned; the attempt throws 'TypeError: Assignment to constant variable'. (The contents of a const object or array can still be modified.)

questions.question_en: Each node of a singly linked list contains:

options.en: Data and pointers to the previous and next nodes
Data and a pointer to the next node

questions.explanation_en: A singly linked list node has a data field and one link (next). A node with both previous and next links belongs to a doubly linked list.

questions.question_en: Level-order traversal of a binary tree is implemented using which data structure?
questions.explanation_en: Nodes are enqueued level by level: dequeue a node, visit it, enqueue its children. This is BFS applied to a tree. Preorder, inorder and postorder use a stack (explicitly or via recursion).

questions.question_en: A recursive function that has no reachable base case will, when run, most likely end with:

options.en: An automatic conversion to a loop
An infinitely long but correct output

questions.explanation_en: Each call pushes a new activation record on the call stack; without a terminating condition the calls never return and the stack space runs out. The compiler cannot detect this in general.

questions.question_en: Quick sort with the Lomuto partition scheme (pivot = LAST element) partitions [7, 2, 9, 1, 5]. What is the array right after this first partition?
questions.explanation_en: Pivot = 5, i = −1. j=0: 7 > 5 skip; j=1: 2 ≤ 5 → i=0, swap → [2,7,9,1,5]; j=2: 9 skip; j=3: 1 ≤ 5 → i=1, swap → [2,1,9,7,5]; finally swap a[2] with the pivot → [2,1,5,7,9]. The pivot 5 is now at its final index 2.
The first printf runs on the way down (3, 2, 1); p(0) returns without printing; the second printf runs as the calls unwind (1, 2, 3). Output: 3 2 1 1 2 3.

questions.question_en: A directed graph that contains no cycles is called a:
questions.explanation_en: A DAG has directed edges and no directed cycle; such graphs model task dependencies and admit a topological order. A strongly connected graph, by contrast, has a path between every ordered pair and therefore has cycles.

questions.question_en: Which UML diagram shows the physical hardware nodes and how software artefacts are distributed across them?
questions.explanation_en: Deployment diagrams model the run-time configuration: servers, devices and the artefacts deployed on them. Activity and state machine diagrams model behaviour, not physical layout.

questions.question_en: Module A passes an entire student record structure to module B, but B uses only the roll number field. This is an example of:
questions.explanation_en: Passing a composite data structure when only part of it is needed is stamp coupling. Pure data coupling would pass only the roll number as an elementary parameter.

questions.question_en: In top-down integration testing, the lower-level modules that are not yet developed are replaced by:
questions.explanation_en: A stub is a dummy called module that simulates a lower-level module. In bottom-up integration, drivers are written instead to call the modules being tested.

questions.question_en: When two modules communicate by sharing the same global variables, the coupling between them is called:
questions.explanation_en: Common (global) coupling arises when modules read and write shared global data, so a change to that data can have unexpected effects in many modules. It is worse than data and stamp coupling.

questions.question_en: Statement coverage, branch coverage and path coverage are criteria used in:
questions.explanation_en: These coverage criteria measure how much of the internal code structure is exercised, so they belong to white-box testing. Acceptance and beta testing are done by users from an external viewpoint.

questions.question_en: A Computer Science test that samples questions from all units of the syllabus in proportion to their weightage is said to have high:
questions.explanation_en: Content validity is the extent to which a test adequately represents the whole content and objectives taught. Predictive validity concerns how well scores forecast future performance.

questions.question_en: The e-Pathshala portal and mobile app, which provide e-books and e-resources of school textbooks, have been developed by:
questions.explanation_en: e-Pathshala was launched by the Ministry of Education and developed by NCERT (through CIET) to host NCERT e-textbooks and audio-video resources. UGC and AICTE deal with higher and technical education.

questions.question_en: A CS teacher gives a worked example of a recursive function, then a partially completed example, and finally lets students solve one independently, gradually withdrawing support. This practice is best described as:
questions.explanation_en: Scaffolding (Wood, Bruner and Ross; based on Vygotsky's ZPD) means giving temporary support that is faded as competence grows. Shaping is a Skinnerian reinforcement of successive approximations; discovery learning gives minimal initial support.

questions.question_en: A student who believes that 'every sequence in Python can be changed in place' discovers that strings are immutable and revises this idea. In Piaget's terms, the revision of the existing schema is:
questions.explanation_en: Accommodation is changing an existing schema to fit new information that does not match it. Assimilation would be fitting new information into the schema without changing it.

questions.question_en: The National Education Policy 2020 was approved by the Union Cabinet on:
questions.explanation_en: The Union Cabinet approved NEP 2020 on 29 July 2020. It replaced the National Policy on Education of 1986 (modified in 1992).

questions.question_en: In the 'project method', the role of the teacher is mainly that of a:
questions.explanation_en: Kilpatrick's project method is learner-centred: students choose, plan, execute and evaluate a purposeful activity while the teacher guides, suggests resources and helps when needed.

questions.question_en: Kounin's term 'withitness' in classroom management refers to a teacher's ability to:

options.en: Handle several administrative files at the same time
Be aware of everything happening in the class and communicate that awareness to students
Use ICT tools fluently during a lesson
Remain strict and punish every misbehaviour

questions.explanation_en: Jacob Kounin (1970) found that teachers who seem to 'have eyes at the back of their head' (withitness) and can attend to overlapping events (overlapping) prevent misbehaviour better than those who merely react with punishment.

questions.question_en: In the 5+3+3+4 curricular structure of NEP 2020, the Middle Stage corresponds to:
questions.explanation_en: Foundational (age 3–8: pre-school + Classes 1–2), Preparatory (Classes 3–5), Middle (Classes 6–8) and Secondary (Classes 9–12). Classes 3–5 form the Preparatory Stage.

questions.question_en: Gagne's hierarchy of learning places which type of learning at the highest level?
questions.explanation_en: Gagne's eight types of learning, from simplest to most complex, are signal, stimulus–response, chaining, verbal association, discrimination, concept, rule learning and finally problem solving.

questions.question_en: Under NEP 2020, the Foundational Stage covers:

options.en: Three years of pre-school and Classes 1 and 2 (ages 3–8)

questions.explanation_en: The Foundational Stage of the 5+3+3+4 design is five years long: three years of Anganwadi/pre-school (ages 3–6) plus Classes 1 and 2 (ages 6–8), supported by the NCF for Foundational Stage 2022.

questions.question_en: Who presented the Delhi Budget 2026-27 in the Delhi Assembly?
questions.explanation_en: Rekha Gupta holds the Finance portfolio and presented her second budget on 24 March 2026.

questions.question_en: Who won the FIDE Women's Chess World Cup in July 2025, also earning the Grandmaster title?
questions.explanation_en: Teenager Divya Deshmukh beat Koneru Humpy in an all-Indian final at Batumi, Georgia, becoming India's 88th Grandmaster.

questions.question_en: After the GST reform effective 22 September 2025, the two main GST rate slabs are:
questions.explanation_en: 'GST 2.0' merged 12% and 28% slabs into 5% and 18%, with a special 40% rate for sin and luxury goods.

questions.question_en: The Nobel Peace Prize 2025 was awarded to which Venezuelan opposition leader?
questions.explanation_en: Machado was honoured for her work promoting democratic rights in Venezuela (announced 10 October 2025).

questions.question_en: Who became the Prime Minister of Bangladesh after the BNP's victory in the February 2026 general election?
questions.explanation_en: The BNP, led by Tarique Rahman, son of Khaleda Zia, won the first election after the 2024 uprising.

questions.question_en: Which country holds the BRICS chairship for 2026, hosting the 18th summit in New Delhi in September 2026?
questions.explanation_en: India chairs BRICS in 2026 under the theme of resilience, innovation, cooperation and sustainability; Brazil chaired in 2025.

questions.question_en: Who was the first Viceroy of India after the Government of India Act, 1858 transferred power to the Crown?
questions.explanation_en: Canning, the last Governor-General, became the first Viceroy in 1858.

questions.question_en: The Battle of Plassey (1757) was fought between the British East India Company and the Nawab of Bengal, who was:
questions.explanation_en: Robert Clive defeated Siraj-ud-Daulah on 23 June 1757, helped by the treachery of Mir Jafar.

questions.question_en: The Goods and Services Tax (GST) was introduced through which Constitutional Amendment Act?
questions.explanation_en: The 101st Amendment inserted Article 279A (GST Council); GST was rolled out on 1 July 2017.

questions.question_en: Gandhiji suspended the Non-Cooperation Movement in February 1922 after the violent incident at:
questions.explanation_en: A mob burned a police station at Chauri Chaura (UP) on 5 February 1922, killing policemen, so Gandhi called the movement off.

questions.question_en: The 44th Constitutional Amendment (1978) removed which right from the list of Fundamental Rights?
questions.explanation_en: Article 31 was deleted; property became a legal right under Article 300A in Part XII.

questions.question_en: Chilika Lake, the largest coastal lagoon of India, is located in:
questions.explanation_en: Chilika is a brackish water lagoon on the Odisha coast and a Ramsar site; Pulicat Lake lies on the Andhra Pradesh-Tamil Nadu border.

questions.question_en: India's first satellite, launched in 1975, was named:
questions.explanation_en: Aryabhata, named after the ancient mathematician, was launched on 19 April 1975 from the Soviet Union.

questions.question_en: The Partition of Bengal (1905), announced by Lord Curzon, was annulled in 1911 during the viceroyalty of:
questions.explanation_en: At the 1911 Delhi Durbar King George V annulled the partition and shifted the capital from Calcutta to Delhi; Hardinge was Viceroy.

questions.question_en: National Youth Day in India is observed on 12 January, the birth anniversary of:

options.en: Dr A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

questions.explanation_en: The Government of India declared it National Youth Day in 1984, and it has been celebrated from 1985.

questions.question_en: Under which Article can the President be removed from office by impeachment?
questions.explanation_en: Article 61 sets the procedure: a charge of 'violation of the Constitution' needs a two-thirds majority in both Houses.

questions.question_en: Which Article guarantees 'equality before the law and equal protection of the laws'?
questions.explanation_en: Article 14 applies to all persons; Articles 15 and 16 deal with non-discrimination and equal opportunity in public employment.

questions.question_en: The highest mountain peak located entirely within India is:
questions.explanation_en: Kangchenjunga (8,586 m, Sikkim) is the third highest in the world; K2 lies in Gilgit-Baltistan and Everest in Nepal-Tibet.

questions.question_en: In a dihybrid cross between two pure parents with two contrasting traits, the phenotypic ratio in the F2 generation is:
questions.explanation_en: Mendel's dihybrid cross of round-yellow and wrinkled-green seeds gave 9:3:3:1; a monohybrid cross gives 3:1.

questions.question_en: Human Rights Day is observed worldwide on:
questions.explanation_en: It marks the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights by the UN General Assembly on 10 December 1948.

questions.question_en: Rohan ranks 12th from the top in a class of 40 students. What is his rank from the bottom?
questions.explanation_en: Rank from bottom = total - rank from top + 1 = 40 - 12 + 1 = 29.

questions.question_en: Complete the series: AMZ, BNY, COX, ?
questions.explanation_en: The first letters go A, B, C, D; the middle letters M, N, O, P; the last letters go backward Z, Y, X, W. So DPW.

questions.question_en:
Statement: Ravi scored 95% in Mathematics this year, whereas last year he scored 60%.
Conclusions: I. Ravi worked harder this year. II. Ravi's marks in Mathematics improved this year.
questions.explanation_en: The improvement in marks is stated directly (II). The reason for it (harder work) is an assumption; he could have improved for other reasons, so I does not follow.

questions.question_en:
Statement: The prices of vegetables have shot up due to poor supply.
Courses of action: I. All vegetable shops should be closed. II. People should stop eating vegetables.
questions.explanation_en: Closing shops would worsen the problem, and stopping vegetables from diets is impractical and harmful. Neither is a sensible course of action.

questions.question_en: Select the odd number: 17, 23, 29, 39
questions.explanation_en: 17, 23 and 29 are prime. 39 = 3 x 13 is composite.

questions.question_en: In a class of 50 students, 30 play cricket, 25 play football and 10 play both. How many students play neither game?
questions.explanation_en: Students playing at least one game = 30 + 25 - 10 = 45. Neither = 50 - 45 = 5.

questions.question_en:
Statement: Only candidates holding a graduate degree can apply for the post of TGT.
Conclusions: I. A person without a graduate degree cannot apply for the post. II. Every graduate will get the post.
questions.explanation_en: The statement sets a necessary condition, so I follows. Being eligible to apply does not guarantee selection, so II does not follow.

questions.question_en:
Statement: Should plastic bags be banned in India?
Arguments: I. Yes, they cause pollution and clog drains. II. No, because they are cheap.

options.en: Both I and II are strong
Neither I nor II is strong

questions.explanation_en: Environmental damage is a valid and weighty reason (strong). Low cost is not a sufficient reason to keep a harmful item, so II is weak.

questions.question_en:
Statement: Public toilets at the railway station are very dirty.
Courses of action: I. Railway should ask passengers to avoid using them. II. Railway authorities should appoint more cleaners and monitor cleanliness regularly.
questions.explanation_en: Toilets exist to be used, so telling passengers to avoid them does not solve the problem (I). More cleaners and monitoring directly remove the problem (II).

questions.question_en:
Statement: A survey shows that school students spend more than five hours daily on mobile phones.
Courses of action: I. Parents and teachers should guide students on limited and productive use of mobiles. II. Mobile phones should be completely banned for all citizens.
questions.explanation_en: Guidance targets the problem group in a realistic way (I). A complete ban for all citizens is out of proportion to a problem concerning students (II).

questions.question_en: If + means ×, × means −, − means ÷ and ÷ means +, then the value of 12 + 3 × 5 − 5 ÷ 4 is:
questions.explanation_en: Substitute the real signs: 12 × 3 − 5 ÷ 5 + 4. BODMAS: 12 × 3 = 36 and 5 ÷ 5 = 1, so 36 − 1 + 4 = 39.

questions.question_en:
Statement: A leading newspaper reported that the price of onions has fallen in the wholesale market.
Conclusions: I. The retail price of onions has also fallen. II. Farmers will earn less from onions.
questions.explanation_en: A wholesale fall does not guarantee a retail fall because retailers may not pass on the drop, and farmers' income depends on the quantity sold as well as price. Neither can be concluded.

questions.question_en: If CAT is coded as 24 (using the alphabet positions A = 1, B = 2, ...), then DOG will be coded as:
questions.explanation_en: CAT = 3 + 1 + 20 = 24, i.e. the sum of positions. DOG = 4 + 15 + 7 = 26.

questions.question_en: If the letters of the word FRIEND are arranged in alphabetical order, how many letters remain in the same position as in the original word?
questions.explanation_en: FRIEND sorted is D, E, F, I, N, R. Comparing position by position with F, R, I, E, N, D, only the fifth letter (N) is unchanged.

questions.question_en: Find the next term: 5, 6, 14, 45, 184, ?
questions.explanation_en: Rule: multiply by n and add n. 5x1+1 = 6, 6x2+2 = 14, 14x3+3 = 45, 45x4+4 = 184, so 184x5+5 = 925. Option 920 forgets the +5.

questions.question_en: A rectangle is divided into 2 rows and 4 columns of equal small squares (8 small squares). How many squares of all sizes are there?
questions.explanation_en: 1 × 1 squares: 2 × 4 = 8. 2 × 2 squares: (2 − 1) × (4 − 1) = 3. No larger squares fit in 2 rows. Total = 8 + 3 = 11.

questions.question_en: An arrow initially points North. In step 1 it turns 45° clockwise, in step 2 it turns 90° clockwise, in step 3 it turns 135° clockwise, and in step 4 it turns 180° clockwise. In which direction does it point after step 4?
questions.explanation_en: Total rotation = 45 + 90 + 135 + 180 = 450° clockwise. 450 − 360 = 90° clockwise from North = East.

questions.question_en: How many squares of all sizes are there on a standard 8 × 8 chessboard?
questions.explanation_en: Total = 1² + 2² + … + 8² = 8 × 9 × 17 / 6 = 204. 64 counts only the unit squares.

questions.question_en: In a 3 × 3 grid, Row 1 is A B C, Row 2 is D E F and Row 3 is G H I. Each letter is coded by its row number followed by its column number, so BAD is coded 12 11 21. What is the code for HIDE?
questions.explanation_en: H = row 3, column 2 = 32; I = 33; D = row 2, column 1 = 21; E = 22. Option 2 reverses row and column; option 4 uses G (31) for H.

questions.question_en: Five distinct points are marked on a straight line. How many line segments with end points among these points are there?
questions.explanation_en: Each pair of points defines one segment: C(5,2) = 5 × 4 / 2 = 10.

questions.question_en: Six years ago the ratio of the ages of A and B was 6 : 5. Four years from now it will be 11 : 10. What is the present age of B?
questions.explanation_en: Let their ages six years ago be 6k and 5k. Four years hence: (6k + 10)/(5k + 10) = 11/10, so 60k + 100 = 55k + 110 and k = 2. Present ages: A = 18, B = 16.

questions.question_en: What is the LCM of 12, 18 and 24?
A 40-litre mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 3 : 1. How much water must be added to make the ratio 3 : 2?
questions.explanation_en: Milk = 30 L, water = 10 L. For ratio 3 : 2 the water must be 30 × 2/3 = 20 L. Water to add = 20 − 10 = 10 L.

questions.question_en: A can do a work in 20 days and B in 30 days. They start together, but A leaves 5 days before the work is completed. In how many days is the whole work completed?
questions.explanation_en: Let the total time be x days. B works for x days and A for (x − 5) days: (x − 5)/20 + x/30 = 1. Multiply by 60: 3(x − 5) + 2x = 60, so 5x = 75 and x = 15.

questions.question_en: The average age of a family of 5 members is 24 years. The youngest member is 8 years old. What was the average age of the family at the time of the birth of the youngest member?
questions.explanation_en: Present total = 120. Excluding the youngest, the other four total 112 now. Eight years ago they totalled 112 − 4 × 8 = 80. Average of those four = 20 years.

questions.question_en: Two trains of length 100 m and 150 m run in the same direction at 72 km/h and 54 km/h respectively. How long does the faster train take to completely overtake the slower one?
questions.explanation_en: Relative speed = 18 km/h = 5 m/s. Distance to be covered = 100 + 150 = 250 m. Time = 250/5 = 50 s.

questions.question_en: Two alloys contain gold and silver in the ratios 5 : 3 and 1 : 3. They are mixed in equal weights. What is the ratio of gold to silver in the new alloy?
questions.explanation_en: Take 8 units of each alloy. Alloy 1: gold 5, silver 3. Alloy 2: gold 2, silver 6. Total gold = 7, silver = 9. Ratio = 7 : 9.

questions.question_en: A and B can do a work in 8 days, B and C in 12 days, and A and C in 24 days. In how many days can all three together do the work?
What is the sum of the first 20 natural numbers?

questions.explanation_en: The expression is a² + b² + 2ab with a = 0.8, b = 0.2, which equals (a + b)² = (1.0)² = 1. Directly: 0.64 + 0.04 + 0.32 = 1.

questions.question_en: The average weight of 8 persons increases by 2.5 kg when a new person replaces one weighing 65 kg. What is the weight of the new person?
questions.explanation_en: Total weight increases by 8 × 2.5 = 20 kg. New person's weight = 65 + 20 = 85 kg.

questions.question_en: After 15 years Rohit will be 4 times as old as he was 6 years ago. What is his present age?
questions.explanation_en: Let the present age be x. x + 15 = 4(x − 6) gives 3x = 39, so x = 13. Check: 28 = 4 × 7.

questions.question_en: A pipe can fill a tank in 15 hours. Because of a leak, it takes 20 hours. How long will the leak take to empty the full tank?
questions.explanation_en: Leak rate = 1/15 − 1/20 = (4 − 3)/60 = 1/60. The leak empties the full tank in 60 hours.

questions.question_en: The average of the first three of four numbers is 7 and the average of the last three is 5. If the last number is 4, what is the first number?
questions.explanation_en: Sum of first three = 21; sum of last three = 15. Last number = 4, so the 2nd + 3rd = 11. First number = 21 − 11 = 10.

questions.question_en: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 12 and 16 minutes respectively. Both are opened together, but A is closed after 4 minutes. How much more time will B need to fill the rest?
questions.explanation_en: In 4 minutes both fill 4 × (1/12 + 1/16) = 4 × 7/48 = 7/12 of the tank. Remaining 5/12 is filled by B at 1/16 per minute: (5/12) × 16 = 20/3 min = 6 min 40 sec.

questions.question_en: The roots of the quadratic equation 2x² − 7x + 3 = 0 are:
questions.explanation_en: Split the middle term: 2x² − 6x − x + 3 = 2x(x − 3) − 1(x − 3) = (2x − 1)(x − 3). So x = 3 or x = 1/2. Check: sum 7/2 = −b/a and product 3/2 = c/a.

questions.question_en: For what values of k does the equation x² + kx + 16 = 0 have two equal real roots?
questions.explanation_en: Equal roots need discriminant b² − 4ac = 0: k² − 64 = 0, so k = ±8. Taking only the positive root (8) misses k = −8.

questions.question_en: If sec θ + tan θ = 4, then sin θ equals:
questions.explanation_en: sec θ − tan θ = 1/4 (since sec²θ − tan²θ = 1). Adding: 2 sec θ = 17/4 → sec θ = 17/8; subtracting: tan θ = 15/8. sin θ = tan θ / sec θ = 15/17.

questions.question_en: The diagonal of a rectangle of length 24 cm and breadth 7 cm is:
The area of an equilateral triangle of side 8 cm is:
'सुंदरता' के अर्थ वाले शब्द की शुद्ध वर्तनी कौन-सी है?
questions.question_hi: 'सुंदरता' के अर्थ वाले शब्द की शुद्ध वर्तनी कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation_en: Correct spelling is saundarya.
questions.explanation_hi: शुद्ध रूप 'सौंदर्य' (सौन्दर्य) है — 'सुंदर' में 'उ' की वृद्धि होकर 'औ' बनता है। अनुस्वार और पंचमाक्षर दोनों एक साथ ('सौंन्') लगाना अशुद्ध है।

questions.question_en: 'भुलक्कड़' शब्द में कौन-सा प्रत्यय है?
questions.question_hi: 'भुलक्कड़' शब्द में कौन-सा प्रत्यय है?
questions.explanation_en: Bhulakkad = bhool + akkad; 'akkad' forms agent adjectives.
questions.explanation_hi: भुलक्कड़ = भूल + अक्कड़। 'अक्कड़' कृत् प्रत्यय से कर्तृवाचक विशेषण बनता है, जैसे पियक्कड़, घुमक्कड़।

questions.question_en: 'भतीजा' शब्द का तत्सम रूप क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'भतीजा' शब्द का तत्सम रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Bhatija comes from bhraatrij; bhraatrija means niece.
questions.explanation_hi: 'भ्रातृज' (भाई से उत्पन्न) से 'भतीजा' बना है। 'भ्रातृजा' का अर्थ भतीजी है और 'भ्राता' भाई का तत्सम है; 'भातृज' वर्तनी की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध है।

questions.question_en: 'सूर्योदय' शब्द में कौन-सी संधि है?
questions.question_hi: 'सूर्योदय' शब्द में कौन-सी संधि है?
questions.explanation_en: Surya + uday: a + u = o, so it is gun sandhi.
questions.explanation_hi: सूर्य + उदय = सूर्योदय। अ + उ = ओ होने से यह गुण संधि है। दीर्घ संधि में समान स्वर मिलते हैं, इसलिए वह विकल्प गलत है।

questions.question_en:
निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।

पुस्तकें मनुष्य की सबसे अच्छी मित्र होती हैं। वे बिना किसी स्वार्थ के हमें ज्ञान देती हैं और कठिन समय में धैर्य बँधाती हैं। जो व्यक्ति नियमित रूप से अच्छी पुस्तकें पढ़ता है, उसके विचारों में गहराई आती है तथा उसकी भाषा समृद्ध होती है। आज के डिजिटल युग में भी पुस्तकों का महत्त्व कम नहीं हुआ है, केवल उनका रूप बदल गया है। अब ई-पुस्तकें और ऑडियो-पुस्तकें भी पाठकों तक पहुँच रही हैं। आवश्यकता इस बात की है कि विद्यार्थी केवल परीक्षा के लिए नहीं, बल्कि आनंद और जिज्ञासा के लिए भी पढ़ें।

प्रश्न: गद्यांश के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शीर्षक कौन-सा है?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।

पुस्तकें मनुष्य की सबसे अच्छी मित्र होती हैं। वे बिना किसी स्वार्थ के हमें ज्ञान देती हैं और कठिन समय में धैर्य बँधाती हैं। जो व्यक्ति नियमित रूप से अच्छी पुस्तकें पढ़ता है, उसके विचारों में गहराई आती है तथा उसकी भाषा समृद्ध होती है। आज के डिजिटल युग में भी पुस्तकों का महत्त्व कम नहीं हुआ है, केवल उनका रूप बदल गया है। अब ई-पुस्तकें और ऑडियो-पुस्तकें भी पाठकों तक पहुँच रही हैं। आवश्यकता इस बात की है कि विद्यार्थी केवल परीक्षा के लिए नहीं, बल्कि आनंद और जिज्ञासा के लिए भी पढ़ें।

परिश्रम ही सफलता की कुंजी है। इतिहास साक्षी है कि जिन लोगों ने कठिन परिश्रम किया, वे साधनों के अभाव में भी ऊँचाइयों तक पहुँचे। भाग्य के भरोसे बैठे रहने वाला व्यक्ति अवसर आने पर भी उसका लाभ नहीं उठा पाता। परिश्रमी व्यक्ति असफलता से निराश नहीं होता; वह अपनी भूलों से सीखकर फिर प्रयास करता है। आलस्य मनुष्य का सबसे बड़ा शत्रु है, जो उसकी प्रतिभा को धीरे-धीरे नष्ट कर देता है।

questions.question_en:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Sleep is often treated as a luxury by students and working adults, yet scientists consider it as essential as food and water. During sleep the brain does not simply switch off; it sorts the information gathered during the day, stores important memories and clears away harmful chemicals that accumulate while we are awake. Children who sleep for less than eight hours are more likely to have difficulty in concentrating and to show poor results in examinations. Adults who regularly sleep for only five or six hours face a higher risk of heart disease and depression. Experts therefore advise a fixed bedtime, avoiding screens an hour before sleeping and keeping the bedroom dark and quiet. Contrary to popular belief, sleeping late on weekends cannot fully repay the “sleep debt” collected during the week.

The tone of the author in the passage is best described as:
questions.explanation_en: The author presents scientific facts and gives expert advice, so the tone is informative and advisory.
