questions.question_en: Census 2027 will, for the first time since 1931, enumerate which category of data for the whole population?
questions.explanation_en: The Union government decided in 2025 to include caste enumeration in the upcoming Census.

questions.question_en: Which former tennis star received the Padma Bhushan in 2026?
questions.explanation_en: Vijay Amritraj was among the 2026 Padma Bhushan awardees along with Mammootty, Alka Yagnik and Uday Kotak.

questions.question_en: The Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in Hindi (announced March 2026) went to Mamta Kalia for her memoir:

options.en: Bahut Door Kitna Door Hota Hai

questions.explanation_en: Mamta Kalia received the Rs 1 lakh award for the memoir 'Jeete Jee Allahabad'.

questions.question_en: In the Delhi Budget 2026-27, which sector received the largest allocation (about Rs 19,300 crore)?
questions.explanation_en: Education got about Rs 19,326 crore, followed by health at about Rs 13,034 crore.

questions.question_en: Who scored the only goal in the FIFA World Cup 2026 final?
questions.explanation_en: Ferran Torres scored in the 106th minute of extra time to give Spain a 1-0 win over Argentina.

questions.question_en: India observed the 150th birth anniversary of which leader on 31 October 2025, celebrated as Rashtriya Ekta Diwas?
questions.explanation_en: Sardar Patel, born 31 October 1875, was the 'Iron Man of India'; the Statue of Unity honours him.

questions.question_en: The NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission on:
questions.explanation_en: NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) is a think tank chaired by the Prime Minister.

questions.question_en: The Delhi High Court was established in the year:
questions.explanation_en: It was set up on 31 October 1966 with the Delhi High Court Act, 1966; earlier Delhi came under the Punjab High Court.

questions.question_en: National Science Day in India is celebrated on 28 February to mark the discovery of:
questions.explanation_en: C. V. Raman announced the Raman Effect (scattering of light) on 28 February 1928 and won the 1930 Nobel Prize in Physics.

questions.question_en: The south-west monsoon normally sets in over the Indian mainland first on the coast of:
questions.explanation_en: The monsoon normally arrives at Kerala around 1 June and covers the whole country by about 8 July.

questions.question_en: Under the flexible inflation targeting framework adopted in 2016, the RBI targets which inflation measure at 4 per cent (with a band of plus or minus 2 per cent)?
questions.explanation_en: The Monetary Policy Committee works with a CPI-based target of 4 per cent, tolerance band 2 to 6 per cent.

questions.question_en: Which metal is stored under kerosene oil because it reacts vigorously with air and water?
questions.explanation_en: Sodium and potassium are highly reactive, so they are kept immersed in kerosene to avoid fire.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a tertiary sector activity?
questions.explanation_en: Tertiary (service) sector includes banking, transport and education; farming and mining are primary and manufacturing is secondary.

questions.question_en: The power of a convex lens of focal length 50 cm is:
questions.explanation_en: P = 1/f in metres = 1/0.5 = +2 D; a convex lens has positive power.

questions.question_en: India Gate in New Delhi commemorates soldiers of the British Indian Army who died in:

options.en: Second World War and Burma Campaign
First World War and the Third Anglo-Afghan War

questions.explanation_en: Designed by Lutyens, the memorial has 13,300 names inscribed from 1914-21; the National War Memorial nearby honours post-Independence martyrs.

questions.question_en: The Revolt of 1857 began on 10 May 1857 at:
questions.explanation_en: Sepoys at Meerut rebelled and marched to Delhi, proclaiming Bahadur Shah Zafar as their leader.

questions.question_en: The Company obtained the Diwani (revenue collection rights) of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa in 1765 through the Treaty of Allahabad from:
questions.explanation_en: After winning Buxar (1764), Clive secured the Diwani from the Mughal emperor Shah Alam II.

questions.question_en: The writ of Habeas Corpus literally means:
questions.explanation_en: The writ is issued to produce a detained person before the court to test legality of detention; 'Mandamus' means 'we command'.

questions.question_en: President's Rule in a State, on failure of constitutional machinery, is imposed under which Article?
questions.explanation_en: Article 352 deals with National Emergency and Article 360 with Financial Emergency.

questions.question_en: Which Constitutional Amendment is popularly called the 'Mini-Constitution' because of the wide changes it made?
questions.explanation_en: The 42nd Amendment, passed during the Emergency, altered the Preamble, added Fundamental Duties and curbed judicial review.

questions.question_en: Select the odd one out: Mango, Banana, Potato, Apple
questions.explanation_en: Mango, banana and apple are fruits; potato is a vegetable (a tuber).

questions.question_en: Complete the series: AB, DE, HI, MN, ?
questions.explanation_en: First letters are at positions 1, 4, 8, 13 (gaps 3, 4, 5); next gap is 6, giving 19 = S. Second letter follows it: T. So ST.

questions.question_en:
Statement: In the last election the voter turnout in the city was 62%, compared with 55% five years earlier.
Conclusions: I. A larger share of voters turned out than five years ago. II. The number of voters has doubled.
questions.explanation_en: 62% against 55% shows a higher turnout rate (I). Turnout rates alone say nothing about the doubling of voters (II).

questions.question_en: Rahul faces east. He turns 90 degrees clockwise and then 135 degrees anticlockwise. In which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation_en: East turned 90 degrees clockwise is south. Turning 135 degrees anticlockwise from south passes east (90 degrees) and reaches north-east (a further 45 degrees).

questions.question_en:
Statements: All teachers are scholars. Some scholars are doctors.
Conclusions: I. Some teachers are doctors. II. Some doctors are scholars.
questions.explanation_en: 'Some scholars are doctors' converts to 'Some doctors are scholars', so II follows. The doctors may be scholars who are not teachers, so I is not certain.

questions.question_en: In a survey of 120 students, 70 like tea, 60 like coffee and 30 like both. How many students like exactly one of the two drinks?
questions.explanation_en: Only tea = 70 - 30 = 40; only coffee = 60 - 30 = 30. Exactly one = 40 + 30 = 70.

questions.question_en: Pointing to a boy, Meena said, 'He is the son of my mother's only son.' How is the boy related to Meena?
questions.explanation_en: Meena's mother's only son is Meena's brother. The brother's son is Meena's nephew.

questions.question_en: Complete the series: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.explanation_en: The first letter goes forward (A, B, C, D, E) and the second goes backward (Z, Y, X, W, V). So EV.

questions.question_en: In a row of 40 students, Aman is 14th from the left and Bharat is 18th from the right. How many students are between them?
questions.explanation_en: Bharat's position from the left = 40 - 18 + 1 = 23. Students between = 23 - 14 - 1 = 8.

questions.question_en:
Statement: Many students of Class X prefer science to arts.
Conclusions: I. All students of Class X prefer science. II. Some students of Class X prefer science.
questions.explanation_en: 'Many' implies at least some, so II follows. 'All' is too strong, so I does not follow.

questions.question_en: Find the next term: 2, 3, 5, 9, 17, ?
questions.explanation_en: Differences are 1, 2, 4, 8, so the next is 16: 17 + 16 = 33.

questions.question_en: Find the next term: 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, ?
questions.explanation_en: These are cubes of 1 to 5, so the next is 6^3 = 216.

questions.question_en:
Statement: Should smoking be banned in public places?
Arguments: I. Yes, passive smoking harms the health of non-smokers. II. No, smokers have the right to smoke anywhere they like.

options.en: Both I and II are strong
Neither I nor II is strong

questions.explanation_en: I gives a strong public-health reason. II claims an unlimited right, which ignores harm to others, so it is weak.

questions.question_en:
Statement: All the roads leading to the stadium were blocked after heavy rain.
Conclusions: I. People found it difficult to reach the stadium by road. II. The match was cancelled.
questions.explanation_en: Blocked roads make road access difficult (I). Nothing in the statement says the match was cancelled (II).

questions.question_en: One morning after sunrise, Mohan stood facing a pole. The shadow of the pole fell on his right side. Which direction was he facing?
questions.explanation_en: In the morning the sun is in the east, so shadows fall towards the west. The shadow was on his right, so west is on his right: he faced north.

questions.question_en: A cube of side 10 cm is painted on all faces and cut into smaller cubes of side 2 cm. How many smaller cubes have no face painted?
questions.explanation_en: Cubes along each edge = 10 / 2 = 5, so n = 5. Unpainted cubes = (n − 2)³ = 3³ = 27.

questions.question_en: A cuboid of size 5 cm × 4 cm × 3 cm is painted on all faces and cut into 1 cm cubes. How many cubes have no face painted?
questions.explanation_en: Unpainted cubes form an inner cuboid (5 − 2) × (4 − 2) × (3 − 2) = 3 × 2 × 1 = 6.

questions.question_en: A cube net has two rows of three squares. The upper row has squares 1, 2, 3 from left to right. The lower row has squares 4, 5, 6 from left to right, with square 4 directly below square 3 (so the lower row continues to the right). Which number is opposite 2 when the cube is folded?
questions.explanation_en: In a straight run of three squares the end squares are opposite: 1–3 in the upper row and 4–6 in the lower row. The two middle squares, 2 and 5, are left and must be opposite each other.

questions.question_en: A square has both of its diagonals drawn. How many triangles are there in the figure?
questions.explanation_en: The diagonals create 4 small triangles meeting at the centre. Each diagonal also splits the square into 2 large triangles, giving 2 + 2 = 4 more. Total = 4 + 4 = 8.

questions.question_en: In a series of figures, each figure shows a letter and a number: A2, C4, F8, J16. What will the fifth figure show?
questions.explanation_en: Letters advance by +2, +3, +4, so next is +5: J → O. Numbers double: 16 × 2 = 32. Hence O32.

questions.question_en: The ratio of the present ages of A and B is 3 : 5. After 5 years the ratio will be 2 : 3. What is the present age of B?
questions.explanation_en: Let the ages be 3x and 5x. (3x + 5)/(5x + 5) = 2/3 gives 9x + 15 = 10x + 10, so x = 5. B = 25 years (A = 15).

questions.question_en: A 110 m long train passes a man walking in the opposite direction at 6 km/h in 6 seconds. What is the speed of the train?
questions.explanation_en: Relative speed = 110/6 m/s = 110/6 × 18/5 = 66 km/h. Since they move in opposite directions, train speed = 66 − 6 = 60 km/h.

questions.question_en: The sum of the ages of a mother and her daughter is 56 years. Four years ago the mother's age was 7 times the daughter's age. What is the mother's present age?
questions.explanation_en: Let the daughter be D, mother M = 56 − D. M − 4 = 7(D − 4) gives 52 − D = 7D − 28, so D = 10 and M = 46. Check: 42 = 7 × 6.

questions.question_en: A pipe can fill a tank in 6 hours. A leak at the bottom can empty the full tank in 8 hours. If both are open, how long will the tank take to fill?
questions.explanation_en: Net rate = 1/6 − 1/8 = (4 − 3)/24 = 1/24 per hour. So it takes 24 hours.

questions.question_en: In an examination, the pass mark is 40%. A student scores 120 marks and fails by 20 marks. What are the maximum marks?
A boat goes 30 km upstream and 44 km downstream in 10 hours. It goes 40 km upstream and 55 km downstream in 13 hours. What is the speed of the boat in still water?
questions.explanation_en: Let upstream speed u and downstream speed d. 30/u + 44/d = 10 and 40/u + 55/d = 13. Multiply the first by 4 and the second by 3: 120/u + 176/d = 40 and 120/u + 165/d = 39. Subtracting: 11/d = 1, so d = 11. Then 30/u = 10 − 4 = 6, so u = 5. Boat speed = (11 + 5)/2 = 8 km/h (stream = 3 km/h).

questions.question_en: ₹1,200 is divided between A and B in the ratio 3 : 5. What is B's share?
questions.explanation_en: Total parts = 8, so one part = 1200/8 = 150. B gets 5 × 150 = ₹750.

questions.question_en: A 120 m long train crosses a pole in 6 seconds. What is the speed of the train?
A man can row at 6 km/h in still water. In a river flowing at 2 km/h it takes him 3 hours to row to a place and come back. How far is the place?
questions.explanation_en: Downstream speed = 8 km/h, upstream = 4 km/h. d/8 + d/4 = 3 gives 3d/8 = 3, so d = 8 km.

questions.question_en: What is the mean proportional between 4 and 36?
questions.explanation_en: Mean proportional = √(4 × 36) = √144 = 12.

questions.question_en: A shopkeeper marks his goods 25% above the cost price and allows a discount of 10%. What is his profit percentage?
questions.explanation_en: Let CP = 100. Marked price = 125. SP = 125 × 0.9 = 112.5. Profit = 12.5%.

questions.question_en: A sum of money amounts to ₹6,600 in 5 years at 10% per annum simple interest. What is the sum?
Two vessels contain milk and water in the ratios 2 : 3 and 3 : 4. If equal quantities of the two mixtures are poured into a third vessel, what is the ratio of milk to water in it?
questions.explanation_en: Take 35 units from each vessel. Vessel 1: milk 14, water 21. Vessel 2: milk 15, water 20. Total milk = 29, water = 41. Ratio = 29 : 41.

questions.question_en: 20 kg of sugar costing ₹30 per kg is mixed with 30 kg of sugar costing ₹40 per kg. What is the average cost per kg of the mixture?
questions.explanation_en: Total cost = 20 × 30 + 30 × 40 = 600 + 1200 = ₹1,800 for 50 kg. Average = ₹36 per kg.

questions.question_en: In a circle of radius 13 cm, a chord is 24 cm long. The distance of the chord from the centre is:
questions.explanation_en: The perpendicular from the centre bisects the chord: half-chord = 12 cm. Distance = √(13² − 12²) = √25 = 5 cm.

questions.question_en: If a + b + c = 0 and abc = 4, then a³ + b³ + c³ is:
questions.explanation_en: Identity: a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca). With a + b + c = 0, a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc = 3 × 4 = 12.

questions.question_en: The volume of a cube is 343 cm³. Its total surface area is:
questions.explanation_en: Side = ∛343 = 7 cm. Total surface area = 6a² = 6 × 49 = 294 cm². 196 cm² is the lateral surface area (4a²).

questions.question_en: The arithmetic mean of the first 10 natural numbers is:
questions.explanation_en: Sum = 10 × 11 / 2 = 55, so the mean = 55 / 10 = 5.5. In general the mean of the first n natural numbers is (n + 1)/2.

questions.question_en: If x − 1/x = 4, then x⁴ + 1/x⁴ equals:
'अमृत' का पर्यायवाची शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.question_hi: 'अमृत' का पर्यायवाची शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation_en: Sudha means nectar; halahal and garal mean poison, neer means water.
questions.explanation_hi: सुधा और पीयूष अमृत के पर्यायवाची हैं। हलाहल और गरल 'विष' के पर्यायवाची हैं, नीर का अर्थ जल है।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से किस शब्द में दो उपसर्ग प्रयुक्त हुए हैं?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस शब्द में दो उपसर्ग प्रयुक्त हुए हैं?
questions.explanation_en: Nirabhimaan has two prefixes: nir + abhi + maan.
questions.explanation_hi: निरभिमान = निर् + अभि + मान, जिसमें 'निर्' और 'अभि' दो उपसर्ग हैं। शेष शब्दों में एक-एक उपसर्ग (अभि, अप, सम्) है।

questions.question_en: 'मौखिक' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'मौखिक' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Maukhik (oral) vs likhit (written).
questions.explanation_hi: मौखिक (मुँह से कहा गया) का विलोम लिखित है। वाचिक मौखिक का पर्यायवाची है।

questions.question_en: 'त्रिभुवन' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.question_hi: 'त्रिभुवन' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation_en: First member is a numeral denoting a group of three worlds — dvigu.
questions.explanation_hi: त्रिभुवन = तीन भुवनों का समाहार। पहला पद संख्यावाचक होने और समूह का बोध कराने से यह द्विगु समास है।

questions.question_en: 'तद्भव' शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'तद्भव' शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Tadbhav literally means 'born from it' (from Sanskrit).
questions.explanation_hi: तत् + भव = उससे उत्पन्न; अर्थात् संस्कृत से विकसित होकर रूप बदल चुके शब्द तद्भव कहलाते हैं। 'उसके समान' तत्सम का अर्थ है, जबकि देश में उत्पन्न शब्द देशज कहलाते हैं।

questions.question_en: 'अंधों में काना राजा' लोकोक्ति का सही अर्थ क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'अंधों में काना राजा' लोकोक्ति का सही अर्थ क्या है?

options.en: मूर्खों के बीच थोड़ा जानने वाला भी श्रेष्ठ माना जाता है
options.hi: मूर्खों के बीच थोड़ा जानने वाला भी श्रेष्ठ माना जाता है

questions.explanation_en: Among the ignorant, a person with a little knowledge is treated as superior.
questions.explanation_hi: जहाँ सब अंधे हों वहाँ एक आँख वाला भी राजा बन जाता है; अर्थात् अज्ञानियों के बीच अल्प ज्ञानी भी विद्वान समझा जाता है।

questions.question_en: 'चारु चंद्र की चंचल किरणें, खेल रही हैं जल-थल में' — इस पंक्ति में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.question_hi: 'चारु चंद्र की चंचल किरणें, खेल रही हैं जल-थल में' — इस पंक्ति में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.explanation_en: Repetition of the consonant 'ch' makes it Anupras (alliteration).
questions.explanation_hi: इस पंक्ति में 'च' वर्ण की बार-बार आवृत्ति हुई है (चारु, चंद्र, चंचल), अतः यहाँ अनुप्रास अलंकार है। यमक में पूरा शब्द भिन्न अर्थ में दोहराया जाता है, जो यहाँ नहीं है।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द स्त्रीलिंग है?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द स्त्रीलिंग है?
questions.explanation_en: Chai is feminine; dahi, paani and moti are masculine despite ending in -i.
questions.explanation_hi: 'चाय' स्त्रीलिंग है — 'चाय ठंडी हो गई'। दही, पानी और मोती ईकारांत होते हुए भी पुल्लिंग हैं — 'दही खट्टा है', 'पानी ठंडा है'।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वाक्य चुनिए: (आदरसूचक 'आप')
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वाक्य चुनिए: (आदरसूचक 'आप')
questions.explanation_en: Respectful 'aap' takes the polite verb form 'aaiyega'.
questions.explanation_hi: 'आप' आदरसूचक सर्वनाम है, इसलिए इसके साथ आदरसूचक क्रिया रूप 'आइए/आइएगा' आता है। 'आना' 'तुम' के साथ और 'आ' 'तू' के साथ प्रयुक्त होता है।

questions.question_en: 'दशानन' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.question_hi: 'दशानन' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation_en: Dashanan denotes Ravana (one with ten faces) — bahuvrihi, not dvigu.
questions.explanation_hi: दशानन = दस हैं आनन (मुख) जिसके, अर्थात् रावण। पद किसी अन्य (रावण) की ओर संकेत करता है, अतः बहुव्रीहि है। केवल 'दस मुखों का समूह' अर्थ होता तो द्विगु होता।

questions.question_en: 'अनुवाद' शब्द में कौन-सा उपसर्ग है?
questions.question_hi: 'अनुवाद' शब्द में कौन-सा उपसर्ग है?
questions.explanation_en: Anuvaad = anu + vaad; 'anu' means after/following.
questions.explanation_hi: अनुवाद = अनु + वाद। 'अनु' उपसर्ग का अर्थ 'पीछे/बाद में' है, जैसे अनुकरण, अनुशासन, अनुज।

questions.question_en: 'कनक कनक ते सौ गुनी, मादकता अधिकाय' — इस पंक्ति में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.question_hi: 'कनक कनक ते सौ गुनी, मादकता अधिकाय' — इस पंक्ति में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.explanation_en: 'Kanak' is repeated with two meanings (datura, gold), so it is Yamak.
questions.explanation_hi: 'कनक' शब्द दो बार आया है और दोनों बार अर्थ भिन्न है — पहला 'धतूरा', दूसरा 'सोना'। एक ही शब्द की भिन्न अर्थों में आवृत्ति यमक अलंकार है; श्लेष में शब्द एक ही बार आता है।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से किस वाक्य में आदरार्थ बहुवचन का प्रयोग हुआ है?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस वाक्य में आदरार्थ बहुवचन का प्रयोग हुआ है?

options.en: बच्चे कमरे में सो रहे हैं।
options.hi: बच्चे कमरे में सो रहे हैं।

options.en: पेड़ आँधी में हिल रहे हैं।
options.hi: पेड़ आँधी में हिल रहे हैं।

options.en: पिताजी दफ़्तर से आ रहे हैं।
options.hi: पिताजी दफ़्तर से आ रहे हैं।

options.en: लड़के मैदान में खेल रहे हैं।
options.hi: लड़के मैदान में खेल रहे हैं।

questions.explanation_en: Pitaji is one person but takes a plural verb out of respect.
questions.explanation_hi: 'पिताजी' एक ही व्यक्ति हैं, पर सम्मान प्रकट करने के लिए क्रिया बहुवचन ('आ रहे हैं') में प्रयुक्त हुई है — यही आदरार्थ बहुवचन है। अन्य वाक्यों में कर्ता वास्तव में अनेक हैं।

questions.question_en: 'गरीबों को कंबल दो।' — इस वाक्य में 'गरीबों को' में कौन-सा कारक है?
questions.question_hi: 'गरीबों को कंबल दो।' — इस वाक्य में 'गरीबों को' में कौन-सा कारक है?
questions.explanation_en: 'Ko' in the sense of giving marks sampradaan (dative) case; the object is the blanket.
questions.explanation_hi: जिसके लिए कुछ किया जाए या जिसे कुछ दिया जाए, वह संप्रदान कारक होता है; देने के अर्थ में 'को' संप्रदान का चिह्न है। यहाँ कर्म 'कंबल' है, 'गरीबों' नहीं।

questions.question_en: 'अनुराग' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'अनुराग' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Anurag (attachment) vs virag (detachment).
questions.explanation_hi: अनुराग (प्रेम/आसक्ति) का विलोम विराग (वैराग्य/अनासक्ति) है। राग और अनुरक्ति अनुराग के पर्यायवाची हैं।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द 'गंगा' का पर्यायवाची नहीं है?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द 'गंगा' का पर्यायवाची नहीं है?
questions.explanation_en: Kalindi is a name of the Yamuna, not the Ganga.
questions.explanation_hi: भागीरथी, जाह्नवी, सुरसरि, देवनदी और मंदाकिनी गंगा के पर्यायवाची हैं। 'कालिंदी' यमुना का पर्यायवाची है।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द सदा बहुवचन में प्रयुक्त होता है?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द सदा बहुवचन में प्रयुक्त होता है?
questions.explanation_en: Praan is always used in the plural.
questions.explanation_hi: 'प्राण' सदैव बहुवचन में प्रयुक्त होता है — 'उसके प्राण निकल गए'। इसी प्रकार दर्शन, हस्ताक्षर, होश, आँसू भी प्रायः बहुवचन में आते हैं।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द पुल्लिंग है?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द पुल्लिंग है?
questions.explanation_en: Hastakshar is masculine; aatma, sarson and aayu are feminine.
questions.explanation_hi: 'हस्ताक्षर' पुल्लिंग है — 'मेरे हस्ताक्षर'। आत्मा, सरसों और आयु स्त्रीलिंग हैं — 'आत्मा अमर है', 'लंबी आयु'।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से तत्सम शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से तत्सम शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation_en: Karpoor is the original Sanskrit word; the others are tadbhav forms.
questions.explanation_hi: 'कर्पूर' संस्कृत का मूल (तत्सम) शब्द है, जिससे 'कपूर' बना। 'खेत' (क्षेत्र) और 'आँसू' (अश्रु) तद्भव शब्द हैं।

questions.question_en: 'स्थावर' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'स्थावर' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Sthavar (immovable) vs jangam (movable) — a fixed pair.
questions.explanation_hi: स्थावर (अचल, जैसे वृक्ष/भूमि) का शास्त्रीय विलोम जंगम (चलने-फिरने वाला) है। 'स्थावर–जंगम' एक रूढ़ युग्म है।

questions.question_en: Select the word opposite in meaning to TRANSPARENT.
questions.explanation_en: Transparent allows light to pass through; opaque does not.

questions.question_en:
Identify the segment that contains an error. If there is no error, select option 4.
The book that / I bought yesterday / is very interesting.
questions.explanation_en: The sentence is grammatically correct; the relative clause and verb agree properly.

questions.question_en: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation_en: The correct spelling is P-R-I-V-I-L-E-G-E; there is no d.

questions.question_en: Select the word closest in meaning to METICULOUS.
questions.explanation_en: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail; painstaking is the nearest synonym.

questions.question_en: Select the word closest in meaning to EPHEMERAL.
questions.explanation_en: Ephemeral things last for a very short time.

questions.question_en: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation_en: “Embarrassment” has double r and double s.

questions.question_en: The number of applicants ______ increasing every year.
questions.explanation_en: “The number of” is singular (the number is increasing); “a number of” would be plural.

questions.question_en: Select the meaning of the idiom: ‘To break the ice’.

options.en: To start a conversation in a social setting

questions.explanation_en: “Break the ice” means to ease the initial awkwardness between people who have just met.

questions.question_en: She is suffering ______ high fever.
questions.explanation_en: We suffer from a disease or illness, so “suffering from” is used.

questions.question_en: Change the voice: ‘Who wrote this letter?’

options.en: By whom was this letter written?
Whom was this letter written by?
By whom is this letter written?

questions.explanation_en: For a ‘Who’ question in the active voice, the passive begins ‘By whom’, with the tense kept (simple past → was written).

questions.question_en: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation_en: “Accommodation” has double c and double m.

questions.question_en: Select the word closest in meaning to PERNICIOUS.
questions.explanation_en: Pernicious means having a gradual but destructive, harmful effect.

questions.question_en: Change into direct speech: He asked me if I had finished my work.

options.en: He said to me, “Have I finished your work?”
He said to me, “Did you finish your work?”
He said to me, “Had I finished my work?”
He said to me, “Have you finished your work?”

questions.explanation_en: The ‘if’ clause shows a yes/no question; past perfect in the report returns to present perfect, and I changes to you.

questions.question_en: Change the voice: ‘She is writing a novel.’

options.en: A novel is written by her.
A novel was being written by her.
A novel is being written by her.
A novel has been written by her.

questions.explanation_en: Present continuous passive = is/am/are + being + V3.

questions.question_en:
Identify the segment that contains an error.
She gave me / a very good advices / on how to / prepare for the interview.
questions.explanation_en: “Advice” is uncountable and has no plural form. Correct: a piece of advice / very good advice.

questions.question_en:
Identify the segment that contains an error.
I have been knowing / him since / we were children / in the same school.
questions.explanation_en: “Know” is a stative verb and is not used in continuous tenses. Correct: I have known him since ...

questions.question_en: Select the word opposite in meaning to ZENITH.
questions.explanation_en: Zenith is the highest point; nadir is the lowest point.

questions.question_en: Select the word opposite in meaning to DILIGENT.
questions.explanation_en: Diligent means hard-working; indolent means habitually lazy.

questions.question_en: Change into indirect speech: “Alas! I have failed,” said the boy.

options.en: The boy exclaimed that I had failed.
The boy exclaimed sorrowfully that he had failed.
The boy said that alas he has failed.
The boy asked sorrowfully whether he had failed.

questions.explanation_en: Exclamations are reported with ‘exclaimed with joy/sorrow’; present perfect shifts to past perfect.

questions.question_en: Change into indirect speech: The captain said to the team, “Let us play carefully.”

options.en: The captain asked the team that we play carefully.
The captain proposed to the team that they should play carefully.
The captain said to the team that let us play carefully.
The captain ordered the team to play carefully.

questions.explanation_en: ‘Let us’ expresses a suggestion and is reported with ‘proposed/suggested that ... should’.

questions.question_en: Which of the following devices works as both an input and an output device?
questions.explanation_en: A touch screen displays information (output) and accepts finger or stylus touches (input). A light pen and trackball are input-only; a projector is output-only.

questions.question_en: In which cache mapping technique can each block of main memory be placed in exactly one cache line?
questions.explanation_en: In direct mapping the cache line is fixed by (block number mod number of lines), so there is no choice of location; it is simple but causes conflict misses. Fully associative allows any line, and set-associative allows any line within one set.

questions.question_en: The Excess-3 code of the decimal number 47 is:
questions.question_hi: दशमलव संख्या 47 का एक्सेस-3 कोड क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Add 3 to each decimal digit and write it in 4-bit binary: 4 + 3 = 7 = 0111 and 7 + 3 = 10 = 1010, giving 0111 1010. 0100 0111 is plain BCD of 47.

questions.question_en: What is the sum of the binary numbers 1011 and 0110?
Which statement about Unicode and its UTF-8 encoding is correct?
questions.question_hi: यूनिकोड और उसकी UTF-8 एन्कोडिंग के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?

options.en: UTF-8 uses 1 to 4 bytes and keeps ASCII characters as 1 byte
UTF-8 is a 7-bit code identical to ASCII
UTF-8 uses a fixed 2 bytes for every character

questions.explanation_en: UTF-8 is a variable-length encoding of Unicode using 1–4 bytes; the first 128 code points (ASCII) take one byte, so ASCII text is valid UTF-8. Unicode covers scripts such as Devanagari (U+0900–U+097F).

questions.question_en: Convert the decimal number 156 to octal.
questions.explanation_en: 156 ÷ 8 = 19 remainder 4; 19 ÷ 8 = 2 remainder 3; 2 ÷ 8 = 0 remainder 2. Reading remainders bottom-up gives 234. Check: 2×64 + 3×8 + 4 = 128 + 24 + 4 = 156.

questions.question_en: How many distinct Boolean functions can be defined on three input variables?
questions.explanation_en: A 3-variable truth table has 2^3 = 8 rows, and each row's output can independently be 0 or 1, giving 2^8 = 256 possible functions. In general the count is 2^(2^n); 8 (option 2) is only the number of input combinations.

questions.question_en: The 8-bit pattern 11110100 is a 2's complement signed number. What is its decimal value?
questions.explanation_en: The MSB is 1, so the number is negative. Take the 2's complement: invert → 00001011, add 1 → 00001100 = 12. Hence the value is −12. +244 would be the unsigned reading.

questions.question_en: The number of bits that a CPU can process in a single operation is known as its:
questions.explanation_en: Word length (e.g. 32-bit or 64-bit) is the natural data width of the processor's registers and ALU. Clock speed measures cycles per second, not bits per operation.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is an output device?
questions.question_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा आउटपुट डिवाइस है?
questions.explanation_en: A plotter draws vector graphics such as engineering drawings on paper, so it is an output device. OMR, joystick and scanner all send data into the computer and are input devices.

questions.question_en: The characteristic equation of a D flip-flop is:
questions.question_hi: D फ्लिप-फ्लॉप का अभिलाक्षणिक समीकरण क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: A D (data/delay) flip-flop simply copies its input to the output at the clock edge, so Q(n+1) = D. D ⊕ Q is the T flip-flop equation with T replaced by D.

questions.question_en: The rows and columns of a Karnaugh map are labelled in Gray-code order (00, 01, 11, 10) so that:
questions.question_hi: कार्नो मैप की पंक्तियाँ और स्तंभ ग्रे कोड क्रम (00, 01, 11, 10) में क्यों लिखे जाते हैं?

options.en: The map has fewer cells to fill
Adjacent cells differ in only one variable

questions.explanation_en: In Gray-code ordering consecutive labels differ in exactly one bit, so physically adjacent cells differ in one variable and can be grouped to eliminate it. That is why cells 3 and 2 sit next to each other, not in numeric order.

questions.question_en: The cryptocurrency Bitcoin, the first major application of blockchain technology, was introduced in 2008–09 by a person or group using the name:
questions.explanation_en: Satoshi Nakamoto published the Bitcoin white paper in 2008 and launched the network in January 2009. Vitalik Buterin co-founded Ethereum.

questions.question_en: In MS PowerPoint, F5 starts the slide show from the first slide. Which shortcut starts the show from the CURRENT slide?
questions.explanation_en: Shift + F5 begins the presentation at the currently selected slide, which is useful for rehearsing a particular section. F7 runs the spell check.

questions.question_en: In an IoT-based automatic irrigation system, the component that physically opens the water valve when soil moisture is low is the:
questions.explanation_en: A sensor measures the soil moisture; an actuator converts the controller's command into physical action, such as opening a valve or starting a motor.

questions.question_en: A student types =SUMM(B2:B10) in MS Excel. Which error is displayed?
questions.explanation_en: Excel does not recognise SUMM as a function name, so it returns #NAME?. #VALUE! arises from a wrong data type and #N/A when a lookup value is not found.

questions.question_en: Which lightweight publish–subscribe messaging protocol is widely used by low-power IoT devices on unreliable networks?
questions.explanation_en: MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport) uses a broker and very small headers, making it ideal for constrained IoT sensors. FTP, SMTP and Telnet are heavy, general-purpose protocols.

questions.question_en: Cell C1 contains =A1*$B$1. If C1 is copied to C3, the formula in C3 becomes:
questions.explanation_en: Copying two rows down adjusts the relative reference A1 to A3, while the absolute reference $B$1 stays fixed.

questions.question_en: In the Bitcoin network, 'miners' compete to solve a computationally hard puzzle in order to add the next block. This consensus mechanism is called:
questions.explanation_en: Proof of Work requires finding a nonce whose block hash meets a difficulty target, which costs real computing effort and secures the chain. Proof of Stake (used by Ethereum since 2022) selects validators by staked coins instead.

questions.question_en: Which shortcut inserts a new slide in MS PowerPoint?
questions.explanation_en: Ctrl + M adds a new slide after the current one. Ctrl + N creates a new presentation, Ctrl + S saves and Ctrl + D duplicates the selected object or slide.

questions.question_en: Records in a blockchain are considered tamper-resistant mainly because:

options.en: Blocks are deleted automatically after one day
Only the government can read the records
All data is stored on one highly secure central server
Each block stores the cryptographic hash of the previous block, so altering one block breaks the chain

questions.explanation_en: Changing a block changes its hash, which no longer matches the value stored in the next block; an attacker would have to recompute all later blocks on most copies of the distributed ledger.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is an example of unstructured data?

options.en: Videos and images posted on social media
A table of student roll numbers and marks
Rows of a railway reservation database

questions.explanation_en: Unstructured data has no predefined row–column schema, such as photos, videos, audio and free text. Database tables and spreadsheets are structured data.

"Hel" + "lo" is a compile-time constant, so b refers to the same pooled literal as a (a == b is true). new String creates a separate object, so a == c is false, but equals compares content and is true.

Overload resolution picks the exact match for each argument: 'A' is a char, so show(char) prints CA; 7 is an int, printing I7; 2.5 is a double, printing D2.5. The character is printed as a character, not as its ASCII code 65.

questions.question_en:
What does the following Python code print?

print(5 / 5, 5 // 5, 5 % 5)
questions.explanation_en: In Python 3 the / operator always returns a float (1.0), // returns an int for int operands (1), and % gives the remainder 0.

questions.question_en:
What is the output of the following Python statement?

print(2 ** 3 ** 2)
questions.explanation_en: The exponent operator ** is right-associative, so 2 ** 3 ** 2 = 2 ** (3 ** 2) = 2 ** 9 = 512. Left-to-right evaluation would wrongly give (2**3)**2 = 64.

questions.question_en:
What does the following Python code print?

class Bank:
    def __init__(self):
        self._branch = "Delhi"
        self.__pin = 1234

b = Bank()
print(b._branch, hasattr(b, "__pin"), hasattr(b, "_Bank__pin"))
questions.explanation_en: A single underscore is only a convention, so _branch is accessible. A double-underscore name is mangled to _ClassName__name, so the object has _Bank__pin but no attribute literally called __pin.

questions.question_en: Which of the following can NOT be used as a key in a Python dictionary?
questions.explanation_en: Dictionary keys must be hashable (immutable). A list is mutable and unhashable, so d[[1, 2]] = 0 raises TypeError. Tuples of immutable items, strings and frozensets are valid keys.
6 = 110 and 4 = 100 in binary. Bitwise AND = 100 (4), OR = 110 (6), XOR = 010 (2).

questions.question_en:
What does the following Python code print?

d = {"a": 1, "b": 2}
d["c"] = 3
d["a"] = 10
print(len(d), list(d.keys())[0], d.get("z", 0))
questions.explanation_en: Assigning to an existing key updates its value without adding a new entry, so there are 3 keys. Dictionaries keep insertion order (Python 3.7+), so the first key is still a. get() returns the default 0 for a missing key instead of raising KeyError.
Looking up a missing key in a dictionary raises KeyError. One except clause can handle several exception types given as a tuple, and type(e).__name__ gives the exception's class name.

questions.question_en:
What is the final value printed by the following Python code?

a = 5
a += 2 * 3
a //= 2
print(a)
questions.explanation_en: a += 2 * 3 adds 6 (multiplication first), giving 11. Then a //= 2 is floor division: 11 // 2 = 5.
Python does not support method overloading by signature. The second def simply rebinds the name add, replacing the first. So add(2, 3) runs the second version: 2 + 3 + 0 + 1 = 6.

questions.question_en:
What does the following Python code print?

grid = [[0] * 2] * 3
grid[0][1] = 7
print(grid)
questions.explanation_en: Multiplying the outer list by 3 copies the reference to the same inner list three times, so all three rows are one object and the change shows in each. Use [[0] * 2 for _ in range(3)] to create independent rows.

questions.question_en:
What does the following Python code print?

a = [1, 2, 3]
b = a
c = a[:]
a.append(4)
print(len(b), len(c))
questions.explanation_en: b = a makes b another name for the same list object, so b sees the appended element (length 4). a[:] creates a new shallow copy, so c keeps its original 3 elements.

options.en: Compilation error: Dog cannot be stored in Animal[]

questions.explanation_en: A superclass reference may hold a subclass object. Java instance methods are virtual by default, so dynamic method dispatch calls the version of the actual object: Woof, Meow and then Hmm.
m[1][2] is the last element of the second row (6) and m[0][1] is the second element of the first row (2); 6 + 2 = 8.

questions.question_en: Which of the following C operators has the highest precedence?
questions.explanation_en: Postfix operators (++, --, (), []) sit at the top of the C precedence table, above multiplicative operators; && is lower still and assignment is near the bottom.

x and y are constructed (CC); y is a local of the inner block, so its destructor runs when that block ends (D). Then M is printed, and x is destroyed when main returns (D). Destructors run as soon as an object goes out of scope, not all at the end.

questions.question_en: What are the header sizes of UDP and of TCP (without options)?
questions.explanation_en: The UDP header has only four 2-byte fields (source port, destination port, length, checksum) = 8 bytes. The TCP header has a minimum of 20 bytes because it carries sequence and acknowledgement numbers, flags and window size.

questions.question_en: Port numbers are 16-bit values. The range 0–1023 is known as:
questions.explanation_en: IANA classifies ports as well-known (0–1023, e.g. 80, 443), registered (1024–49151) and dynamic/ephemeral (49152–65535). Being 16-bit, there are 65,536 ports in total.

questions.question_en: A company such as BSNL or Airtel that provides customers with access to the Internet is known as a(n):
questions.explanation_en: An ISP connects homes and organisations to the Internet. A registrar sells domain names and an Internet Exchange Point is where ISPs interconnect.

questions.question_en: A hierarchical topology in which several star networks are connected to a linear backbone is called a:
questions.explanation_en: Tree topology combines star groups joined through a bus backbone; it is widely used in large buildings and campus networks.

questions.question_en: A modem is required for a dial-up or DSL connection because it:

options.en: Increases the clock speed of the processor
Blocks viruses coming from the Internet
Converts digital signals of the computer to analog signals for the telephone line and back

questions.explanation_en: MODEM = MOdulator-DEModulator. It modulates digital data onto an analog carrier for transmission and demodulates the received signal.

questions.question_en: An organisation has the Class C block 200.10.5.0/24 and needs at least 6 subnets. Using the smallest suitable mask, what is the mask and the number of usable hosts per subnet?
questions.explanation_en: 2 borrowed bits give only 4 subnets, so 3 bits are needed (2^3 = 8 ≥ 6). Mask = /27 = 255.255.255.224, leaving 5 host bits: 2^5 − 2 = 30 hosts per subnet.

questions.question_en: Segmentation of application data, end-to-end error recovery and flow control between two hosts are functions of the:
questions.explanation_en: The Transport layer (layer 4, e.g. TCP) breaks data into segments and provides process-to-process reliable delivery. The Data Link layer also does error detection, but only hop-to-hop, not end-to-end.

questions.question_en: Which of the following IPv4 addresses is a private (RFC 1918) address that is not routed on the public Internet?
questions.explanation_en: Private ranges are 10.0.0.0/8, 172.16.0.0–172.31.255.255 and 192.168.0.0/16. 172.20.x.x falls in the 172.16–31 block; 172.32 and 192.169 are just outside the private ranges.

questions.question_en: In a full mesh network of 8 devices, how many I/O ports must each device have, and what is the total number of links?
questions.explanation_en: Each device connects to the other n−1 = 7 devices, so it needs 7 ports. Total links = n(n−1)/2 = 8×7/2 = 28.

questions.question_en: Alice wants to send Bob a message that only Bob can read, and also prove that she is the sender. She should:

options.en: Sign with Bob's private key and encrypt with her own public key
Sign with her own private key and encrypt with Bob's public key
Encrypt with a shared key and sign with Bob's public key
Sign with her public key and encrypt with Bob's private key

questions.explanation_en: A digital signature is created with the sender's private key and verified with her public key, proving authorship. Confidentiality comes from encrypting with the receiver's public key, since only Bob's private key can decrypt it.

questions.question_en: A bus topology requires a terminator at each end of the main cable in order to:
questions.explanation_en: Terminators absorb the signal at the ends of the backbone cable so that it does not bounce back and corrupt new transmissions.

questions.question_en: ICMP, the protocol used by the ping command to report errors and reachability, operates at which layer?
questions.explanation_en: ICMP is carried inside IP packets and is considered part of the Network/Internet layer along with IP, ARP and IGMP.

questions.question_en: Which memory-management scheme divides a program into variable-sized logical units such as main program, functions, stack and arrays, matching the programmer's view of memory?
questions.explanation_en: Segments are variable-length logical units addressed as (segment number, offset). Paging uses fixed-size pages that have no relation to the program's logical structure.

questions.question_en: The technique of shuffling memory contents so that all free memory is brought together into one large block is called:
questions.explanation_en: Compaction moves allocated blocks together to merge scattered holes, curing external fragmentation. It is possible only when relocation is dynamic (done at run time).

questions.question_en: Temporarily moving a whole process from main memory to a backing store (disk) and later bringing it back for continued execution is called:
questions.explanation_en: Swapping lets the OS run more processes than fit in RAM by moving entire processes between memory and the swap area. Spooling refers to queuing I/O for devices such as printers.

questions.question_en: In Round Robin scheduling the time quantum is 20 ms and each context switch costs 5 ms. If every process always uses its full quantum, the fraction of CPU time spent on useful work is:
questions.explanation_en: Each cycle = 20 ms of work + 5 ms switch = 25 ms, so useful fraction = 20/25 = 80%. 20% is the overhead fraction, not the useful fraction.

questions.question_en: The command  kill -9 2345  sends which signal to process 2345?

options.en: SIGTERM — asks the process to terminate gracefully
SIGKILL — terminates the process immediately and cannot be caught
SIGHUP — tells the process its terminal was closed

questions.explanation_en: Signal 9 is SIGKILL, which the process cannot catch, block or ignore. Plain kill without a number sends SIGTERM (15), which a program may handle to clean up first.

questions.question_en: In Round Robin scheduling, if the time quantum is made very large (larger than every CPU burst), the algorithm behaves like:
questions.explanation_en: With a quantum longer than any burst no process is ever preempted, so processes run to completion in arrival order, exactly FCFS. A very small quantum, on the other hand, causes excessive context-switch overhead.

questions.question_en: A system has 15 units of a single resource type. Current allocation / maximum need: P1 4/9, P2 3/6, P3 4/8, P4 1/5. Which of the following is a safe sequence?
questions.explanation_en: Allocated = 4+3+4+1 = 12, so Available = 3. Need = Max − Alloc = P1 5, P2 3, P3 4, P4 4. Only P2 (need 3) can start; it finishes → Available 6 → P1 (5) → Available 10 → P3, P4. The other sequences start with a process whose need exceeds 3.

questions.question_en: Why do modern systems use multi-level (hierarchical) paging?

options.en: To avoid having to keep a huge page table in one contiguous block of memory
To let pages have different sizes
To remove the need for a TLB

questions.explanation_en: With large address spaces a single-level table becomes megabytes long. Paging the page table itself lets only the needed parts of it be kept in memory, in non-contiguous frames. Internal fragmentation and the need for a TLB remain.

questions.question_en: Processes arrive: P1 at 0 (burst 7), P2 at 2 (burst 4), P3 at 4 (burst 1), P4 at 5 (burst 4). Using non-preemptive SJF (ties broken by arrival), the average waiting time is:
questions.explanation_en: P1 runs 0–7 (only one present). At 7: P3 (1) 7–8, then P2 and P4 tie at 4 → P2 8–12, P4 12–16. WT = 0, 8−2, 7−4, 12−5 = 0, 6, 3, 7 → 16/4 = 4 ms. FCFS gives 4.75 ms and preemptive SRTF gives 3 ms.

questions.question_en: A machine has 64 MB of physical memory and a frame size of 4 KB. How many frames does physical memory contain?
questions.explanation_en: Frames = 64 MB / 4 KB = 2^26 / 2^12 = 2^14 = 16384. So a frame number needs 14 bits.

questions.question_en: Relation R has 5 tuples and relation S has 4 tuples. The Cartesian product R × S contains how many tuples?
questions.explanation_en: Cartesian product pairs every tuple of R with every tuple of S, giving 5 × 4 = 20 tuples. Its degree is the sum of the degrees of R and S.

questions.question_en: A dense index differs from a sparse index in that a dense index:

options.en: Has entries only for some blocks of the file
Has an entry for every search-key value in the file
Can only be built on the primary key

questions.explanation_en: A dense index contains one entry per record (or per distinct key), while a sparse index stores entries only for some records (typically the first of each block) and requires the file to be sorted on the key.

questions.question_en: A 'Phone_numbers' attribute that can hold several values for one student is called a:
questions.explanation_en: An attribute with more than one value per entity instance is multivalued and is drawn as a double ellipse. A composite attribute (e.g., Name = First + Last) is divided into parts, not repeated.

questions.question_en: EMP table: (101, Asha, Mgr=NULL), (102, Ravi, Mgr=101), (103, Neha, Mgr=101). Query: SELECT e.Name, m.Name AS Manager FROM EMP e JOIN EMP m ON e.Mgr = m.E_ID; What is the output?

options.en: No rows, since a table cannot join itself

questions.explanation_en: This is a self join: each employee row is matched to the row whose E_ID equals its Mgr. Asha has Mgr NULL, which matches nothing in an inner join, so only Ravi and Neha appear with Manager = Asha. A LEFT JOIN would give 3 rows including Asha–NULL.

questions.question_en: Which function returns the number of characters in the string 'DSSSB TGT'?
questions.explanation_en: CHAR_LENGTH counts characters and LENGTH counts bytes; for ASCII text both give 9 (the space is counted). COUNT is an aggregate over rows, and SIZE/LEN are not MySQL functions.

questions.question_en: Relation EMP(Emp_ID, Dept_ID, Dept_Name) with Emp_ID → Dept_ID and Dept_ID → Dept_Name violates which normal form?

options.en: 3NF, because of the transitive dependency Emp_ID → Dept_ID → Dept_Name

questions.explanation_en: Dept_Name depends on the key only through the non-key attribute Dept_ID — a transitive dependency. The key is single-attribute so 2NF holds; decomposing into EMP(Emp_ID, Dept_ID) and DEPT(Dept_ID, Dept_Name) gives 3NF.

questions.question_en: CREATE TABLE ORDERS (O_ID INT PRIMARY KEY, C_ID INT, FOREIGN KEY (C_ID) REFERENCES CUSTOMER(C_ID)); Inserting an ORDERS row with C_ID = 99 when no customer 99 exists will:

options.en: Succeed and mark the row as orphan
Fail with a referential integrity (foreign key) error
Succeed with C_ID stored as NULL

questions.explanation_en: A foreign key value must exist in the referenced parent table (or be NULL). InnoDB rejects the insert; the DBMS never auto-creates parent rows.

questions.question_en: What does SELECT SUBSTR('COMPUTER', 4, 3); return?
questions.explanation_en: SUBSTR(string, start, length) with 1-based positions: characters 4, 5, 6 of 'COMPUTER' are P, U, T → 'PUT'. Starting at position 0 is the common error.

questions.question_en: The EXISTS operator in a WHERE clause returns TRUE when:

options.en: The subquery returns at least one row
The subquery returns exactly one row
All rows of the outer table match

questions.explanation_en: EXISTS tests for the presence of any row in the subquery result, regardless of the column values. NOT EXISTS is true when the subquery is empty.

questions.question_en: Total participation of an entity set in a relationship is shown in an ER diagram by:

options.en: A double line connecting entity and relationship

questions.explanation_en: A double line means every entity instance must participate in the relationship (total participation); a single line means partial participation. Arrows are used for cardinality (one side) in some notations.

questions.question_en: In older HTML, the table attribute cellpadding controls:

options.en: The space between a cell's border and its content
The thickness of the table border
The width of the whole table

questions.explanation_en: cellpadding is the internal space inside each cell, whereas cellspacing is the gap between neighbouring cells. In modern pages both are done with CSS padding and border-spacing.

questions.question_en: Which of the following form fields will NOT be sent to the server when the form is submitted?
questions.explanation_en: Disabled controls are excluded from form submission. A readonly field cannot be edited but its value is still submitted, and hidden fields are submitted even though they are not shown.

questions.question_en: JSON stands for:
questions.explanation_en: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a lightweight, text-based data-interchange format based on JavaScript object literal syntax but usable from almost any language.

questions.question_en:
What does the following print?
console.log(5 == "5", 5 === "5");
questions.explanation_en: == compares after type conversion, so the string "5" becomes 5 and the result is true. === is strict equality and also compares types (number vs string), so it gives false.

questions.question_en:
How does the following table render?
AB
C

options.en: A, B and C appear side by side in one row
A is on top spanning two columns; B and C are below it
B and C are on the left, A is on the right spanning both rows
A occupies the left column across both rows; B is top-right and C is bottom-right

questions.explanation_en: rowspan="2" makes A occupy the first column of both rows. In the second row, the first column is already filled by A, so C moves to the second column below B.

questions.question_en:
What is the output of the following JavaScript?
console.log(typeof null);
questions.explanation_en: typeof null returns "object" — a well-known legacy bug kept for backward compatibility. typeof undefined returns "undefined".

questions.question_en: An attack that tricks a logged-in user's browser into sending an unwanted request (such as a fund transfer) to a site where the user is already authenticated is:
questions.explanation_en: CSRF abuses the fact that the browser automatically attaches the user's cookies to requests. It is countered with anti-CSRF tokens and SameSite cookies. XSS, by contrast, injects script into the trusted site itself.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a pseudo-ELEMENT (not a pseudo-class) in CSS?
questions.explanation_en: Pseudo-elements style a part of an element (first letter, first line, ::before, ::after) and use a double colon in CSS3. :first-child, :hover and :checked are pseudo-classes describing the element's state or position.

questions.question_en: In hashing, a 'collision' occurs when:

options.en: A key is searched for but not found
Two different keys are mapped by the hash function to the same index
The hash function returns a negative value
The hash table becomes completely full

questions.explanation_en: Since many possible keys map onto a small number of slots, different keys can share a home address. Collisions are resolved by chaining or by open addressing (linear, quadratic probing, double hashing).

questions.question_en: What is the time complexity of merge sort in the best, average and worst cases?

options.en: O(n log n) in all three cases
O(log n) in all three cases

questions.explanation_en: Merge sort always halves the array (log n levels) and merges each level in O(n), whatever the input order. Its drawback is the O(n) extra space needed for merging.

questions.question_en: A tree with n nodes has exactly how many edges?
questions.explanation_en: Every node except the root has exactly one edge to its parent, so there are n − 1 edges. Adding any further edge would create a cycle.

questions.question_en: The worst-case time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of n elements is:
questions.explanation_en: Each comparison halves the remaining range, so at most about log₂ n + 1 comparisons are needed. Linear search needs O(n).

questions.question_en: Insertion sort is applied to [4, 3, 1, 2]. How many element shifts (moves of an element one place to the right) are performed in total?
questions.explanation_en: Insertion sort makes exactly one shift per inversion. Inversions: (4,3), (4,1), (4,2), (3,1), (3,2) = 5. Trace: insert 3 (1 shift), insert 1 (2 shifts), insert 2 (2 shifts) → 5.

questions.question_en: In the list 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6 → 7, pointers slow and fast both start at the head. In each loop step slow moves 1 node and fast moves 2 nodes; the loop runs while fast != NULL and fast->next != NULL. When the loop ends, slow points to the node with value:
questions.explanation_en: Positions (slow, fast): (1,1) → (2,3) → (3,5) → (4,7); now fast->next is NULL, so the loop stops with slow at 4, the middle of 7 nodes. The same two-pointer idea (Floyd's) detects cycles.

questions.question_en: Fixing a bug reported by a user after the software has been delivered is an example of:
questions.explanation_en: Corrective maintenance removes faults discovered after delivery. Adaptive deals with environment changes and perfective with new or improved features.

questions.question_en: Which type of maintenance usually accounts for the LARGEST share of maintenance effort?
questions.explanation_en: Studies (e.g. Lientz and Swanson) show that roughly half of maintenance effort goes into perfective work — enhancements and performance improvements requested by users — rather than bug fixing.

questions.question_en: A function contains two independent 'if' statements and one 'while' loop, with no compound conditions. Its cyclomatic complexity is:
questions.explanation_en: For structured code, V(G) = number of decision (predicate) nodes + 1. Here there are 3 decisions (two ifs and one while), so V(G) = 3 + 1 = 4.

questions.question_en: The Daily Scrum (stand-up) meeting is time-boxed to:
questions.explanation_en: The Scrum Guide time-boxes the Daily Scrum to 15 minutes so developers can inspect progress toward the sprint goal and plan the next 24 hours. Longer time boxes belong to sprint planning, review and retrospective.

questions.question_en: Which Scrum role is responsible for maximising the value of the product and ordering the product backlog?
questions.explanation_en: The Product Owner owns and prioritises the product backlog. The Scrum Master coaches the team and removes impediments, while Developers build the increment; 'project sponsor' is not a Scrum role.

questions.question_en: A lesson plan mainly helps the teacher to:

options.en: Proceed in an organised, systematic manner within the time available

questions.explanation_en: A lesson plan sets objectives, sequences content and activities, chooses aids and plans evaluation so that teaching is purposeful and economical. It does not replace the textbook or remove questioning.

questions.question_en: Networked software that lets a teacher view all student screens from one console, lock them, and broadcast the teacher's screen during a lab class is called:

options.en: Classroom (lab) management software such as Veyon or NetSupport School

questions.explanation_en: Classroom management software works over the lab LAN to monitor, lock, broadcast and distribute files, helping the teacher keep a large lab on task. Compilers, antivirus and DBMS have no screen-monitoring role.

questions.question_en: While teaching 'binary number system' a trainee teacher moves around the class, changes voice pitch, pauses, and shifts from board to chart. The trainee is practising the skill of:
questions.explanation_en: Stimulus variation includes teacher movement, gestures, change in speech pattern, pausing, focusing and shifting sensory channels to hold attention. Reinforcement is rewarding responses; closure is summarising at the end.

questions.question_en: The 'Holistic Progress Card' recommended by NEP 2020 is best described as:

options.en: A 360-degree, multidimensional report including self-, peer and teacher assessment
A record of fees paid and attendance only
An identity card required for appearing in board examinations
A card showing only the marks scored in term-end examinations

questions.explanation_en: NEP 2020 replaces the marks-only report card with a holistic, 360-degree progress card covering cognitive, affective and psychomotor progress, including self- and peer assessment. Marks alone would be the old summative report card.

questions.question_en:
Which of the following targets is stated in NEP 2020?
I. Achieving universal Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) in primary school.
II. Raising the Gross Enrolment Ratio in higher education to 50% by 2035.
questions.explanation_en: NEP 2020 makes FLN by Grade 3 an urgent national mission (implemented as NIPUN Bharat, 2021) and targets a 50% GER in higher education by 2035 (from about 26% in 2018). Both statements are correct.

questions.question_en: The correct sequence of the micro-teaching cycle is:

options.en: Plan → Teach → Feedback → Re-plan → Re-teach → Re-feedback
Plan → Feedback → Teach → Re-plan → Re-feedback → Re-teach
Teach → Plan → Feedback → Re-teach → Re-plan → Re-feedback
Plan → Teach → Re-teach → Feedback → Re-plan → Re-feedback

questions.explanation_en: The micro-teaching cycle is plan, teach (about 6 minutes to 5–10 pupils), feedback, re-plan, re-teach, re-feedback. Feedback must come immediately after teaching and before re-planning.

questions.question_en: A rubric used to evaluate a student's Python project lists criteria such as 'correctness', 'code readability' and 'documentation', each with four performance levels. Such a rubric is called:
questions.explanation_en: An analytic rubric scores each criterion separately on a scale, giving detailed feedback; a holistic rubric gives one overall score. A checklist records only presence/absence, with no performance levels.

questions.question_en: Bloom's 'mastery learning' and Morrison's unit plan both share which assumption?

options.en: Teaching should be identical for all students regardless of feedback
Students should not be tested at all
Almost all students can master a unit if given enough time and appropriate instruction
Only gifted students can master abstract units

questions.explanation_en: Morrison's unit method (pretest → teach → test → re-teach → retest) and Bloom's mastery learning both hold that with suitable time and corrective instruction nearly all learners can achieve mastery before moving to the next unit.

questions.question_en: 'Learning by doing' and 'education as life itself, not a preparation for life' are ideas associated with:
questions.explanation_en: John Dewey's pragmatism emphasises experiential learning, learning by doing and the school as a miniature society. Pavlov and Thorndike are behaviourists; Piaget is a cognitive developmentalist.

questions.question_en: The phase of micro-teaching in which a trainee combines several individually practised skills while teaching a normal-length lesson is called:
questions.explanation_en: After mastering individual skills in isolation, the trainee goes through 'link practice' or integration, where two or more skills are combined in longer lessons to bridge the gap between micro-lessons and real classroom teaching.

tests.title: Most Expected Questions — Set 1
tests.subject: Computer Science

questions.question_en: A cube is painted on all six faces and then cut into 64 identical smaller cubes. How many small cubes have exactly two faces painted?
questions.explanation_en: 64 = 4³, so n = 4. Cubes with exactly two painted faces lie on the 12 edges, excluding corners: 12 × (n − 2) = 12 × 2 = 24.

questions.question_en: Find the next term: 1, 2, 6, 24, 120, ?
questions.explanation_en: Each term is multiplied by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 in turn (factorials). Next: 120 x 6 = 720.

questions.question_en: A cube is folded from a net made of six squares: four squares A, B, C, D in a horizontal row (left to right), with square E attached above B and square F attached below B. Which face is opposite A?
questions.explanation_en: In a row of four squares that wraps around the cube, alternate squares are opposite: A–C and B–D. E and F, attached on either side of the row, become top and bottom and are opposite each other.

questions.question_en: A cube painted on all faces is cut into 125 identical smaller cubes. How many small cubes have exactly one face painted?
questions.explanation_en: 125 = 5³, n = 5. One-face cubes are the inner part of each face: 6 × (n − 2)² = 6 × 9 = 54. 36 is the two-face count 12 × 3; 27 is the unpainted count 3³.

questions.question_en: If + means ÷, − means ×, × means + and ÷ means −, then 36 + 9 − 4 × 5 ÷ 3 = ?
questions.explanation_en: Replace the signs: 36 ÷ 9 × 4 + 5 − 3. BODMAS: 36 ÷ 9 = 4, then 4 × 4 = 16, so 16 + 5 − 3 = 18.

questions.question_en: A triangle ABC has three straight lines drawn from vertex A to three different points on side BC, so that BC is divided into 4 parts. How many triangles are there in the figure?
questions.explanation_en: There are 5 points on BC (B, the three new points and C). Every pair of points on BC with apex A forms a triangle, so the count is C(5,2) = 10.

questions.question_en: Pointing to a man, a woman says, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation_en: The only daughter of the woman's mother is the woman herself. So the man's mother is the woman: she is his mother.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Delhi?
questions.explanation_en: Delhi has three World Heritage Sites; the Jantar Mantar World Heritage Site is the one in Jaipur.

questions.question_en: Which country won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026, co-hosted by India and Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation_en: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs in the final on 8 March 2026 at Ahmedabad, becoming the first team to win three T20 World Cup titles.

questions.question_en: India hosted the first global AI summit in the Global South in February 2026. It was called the:
questions.explanation_en: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi ended with the adoption of the New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact.

questions.question_en: Which country won the FIFA World Cup 2026?
questions.explanation_en: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final at MetLife Stadium on 19 July 2026, their second World Cup after 2010.

questions.question_en: Operation Sindoor, launched on 7 May 2025, was India's military response to which attack?
questions.explanation_en: India struck terror infrastructure in Pakistan and PoK after the 22 April 2025 Pahalgam attack on tourists.

questions.question_en: The VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 replaced which rural employment law?
questions.explanation_en: The Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act received Presidential assent in Dec 2025 and replaced MGNREGA from 1 July 2026.

questions.question_en: National Education Day in India is celebrated on 11 November, the birth anniversary of:
questions.explanation_en: Azad was independent India's first Education Minister; the day has been observed since 2008.

questions.question_en: The Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) was constituted in:
questions.explanation_en: DSSSB was set up by the Government of NCT of Delhi in 1996 to recruit for Group B and C posts of Delhi departments and bodies.

questions.question_en: The 'basic structure' doctrine, limiting Parliament's power to amend the Constitution, was laid down in:

options.en: Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973)
A. K. Gopalan v. State of Madras (1950)
Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India (1978)

questions.explanation_en: A 13-judge bench ruled 7:6 that Parliament can amend but cannot destroy the basic structure; Golaknath had denied any power to amend Part III.

questions.question_en: The Right to Education for children aged 6 to 14 years became a Fundamental Right under Article 21A through which amendment?
questions.explanation_en: The 86th Amendment inserted Article 21A; the RTE Act, 2009 gave it effect from 1 April 2010.

questions.question_en: The 60th Jnanpith Award (for 2025), announced in March 2026, was given to which writer?
questions.explanation_en: Tamil poet-lyricist R. Vairamuthu won the 2025 Jnanpith, becoming the first Tamil poet to receive it; the award carries Rs 11 lakh and a Vagdevi statuette.

questions.question_en: In its October 2026 policy, the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee raised the repo rate to:
questions.explanation_en: On 7 October 2026 the MPC hiked the repo rate by 25 bps from 5.25% to 5.50%, the first increase since February 2023.

questions.question_en: The sum of the interior angles of a hexagon is:
questions.explanation_en: Sum of interior angles = (n − 2) × 180° = (6 − 2) × 180° = 720°.

questions.question_en: The circumference of a circle is 44 cm. Its area is (take π = 22/7):
From a point on the ground 30 m away from the foot of a tower, the angle of elevation of the top of the tower is 60°. The height of the tower is:
questions.explanation_en: tan 60° = height / 30 → height = 30 × √3 = 30√3 m (≈ 51.96 m). 10√3 m would result from using tan 30° by mistake.

questions.question_en: What is the unit digit of 7^243?
questions.explanation_en: Unit digits of powers of 7 repeat in a cycle of 4: 7, 9, 3, 1. 243 = 4 × 60 + 3, so the unit digit is the 3rd in the cycle, 3.

questions.question_en:
The table shows the number of students who appeared and passed in a Computer Science examination from five schools.
School | Appeared | Passed
P | 240 | 180
Q | 300 | 255
R | 180 | 117
S | 360 | 288
T | 220 | 198
Which school has the highest pass percentage?
questions.explanation_en: Pass % = passed/appeared × 100: P 75%, Q 85%, R 65%, S 80%, T 90%. T is highest; S has the most passes but not the highest rate.

questions.question_en: A boat's speed in still water is 15 km/h and the stream flows at 5 km/h. How much time does it take to go 60 km downstream and come back?
questions.explanation_en: Downstream speed = 20 km/h, time = 3 h. Upstream speed = 10 km/h, time = 6 h. Total = 9 hours.

questions.question_en: The area of a triangle with sides 13 cm, 14 cm and 15 cm is:
What is the compound interest on ₹10,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years?
A number is first increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. What is the net change?
questions.explanation_en: Let the number be 100. After +20% → 120. After −20% of 120 (= 24) → 96. Net = 4% decrease. (Rule: x − y − xy/100 = 20 − 20 − 4 = −4.)

questions.question_en: If a + b = 10 and ab = 21, then a² + b² is:
A point P is 25 cm from the centre of a circle of radius 7 cm. The length of the tangent drawn from P to the circle is:
questions.explanation_en: The radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of contact, so tangent = √(25² − 7²) = √(625 − 49) = √576 = 24 cm.

questions.question_en: For a moderately skewed distribution, the mean is 25 and the median is 24. Using the empirical relation, the mode is:
questions.explanation_en: Empirical relation: Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean = 3 × 24 − 2 × 25 = 72 − 50 = 22.

questions.question_en: The product of two numbers is 1620 and their HCF is 9. What is their LCM?
questions.explanation_en: HCF × LCM = product of the numbers. LCM = 1620 / 9 = 180.

questions.question_en: If x + 1/x = 5, then the value of x² + 1/x² is:
questions.explanation_en: Square both sides: x² + 2 + 1/x² = 25, so x² + 1/x² = 25 − 2 = 23. The trap answer 27 adds 2 instead of subtracting it.

questions.question_en: A 180 m long train crosses a 270 m long platform in 30 seconds. What is the speed of the train?
questions.explanation_en: Distance covered = 180 + 270 = 450 m in 30 s, so speed = 15 m/s = 15 × 18/5 = 54 km/h.

questions.question_en: Neither the manager nor the employees ______ present in the meeting.
questions.explanation_en: In “neither...nor”, the verb agrees with the noun nearest to it. “Employees” is plural, so “were”.

questions.question_en:
Identify the segment that contains an error.
Rahul is one of the boys / who has / won medals / in the national games.

options.en: Rahul is one of the boys

questions.explanation_en: In “one of the + plural noun + who”, the relative pronoun refers to the plural noun, so the verb is “have”.

questions.question_en: Select the meaning of the idiom: ‘To burn the midnight oil’.

options.en: To work late into the night

questions.explanation_en: The idiom refers to studying or working until late at night.

questions.question_en: Select the one word that can replace: ‘The scientific study of birds’.
questions.explanation_en: Ornithology is the study of birds; entomology is of insects, etymology of word origins.

questions.question_en: Many a student ______ failed in this test.
questions.explanation_en: “Many a” is followed by a singular noun and a singular verb: Many a student has failed.

questions.question_en: Select the meaning of the idiom: ‘Once in a blue moon’.
questions.explanation_en: “Once in a blue moon” means something that happens extremely rarely.

questions.question_en: 'पीतांबर' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.question_hi: 'पीतांबर' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation_en: Pitambar refers to Vishnu (one whose garment is yellow) — bahuvrihi.
questions.explanation_hi: पीतांबर = पीला है अंबर (वस्त्र) जिसका, अर्थात् विष्णु। जब दोनों पद मिलकर किसी तीसरे की ओर संकेत करें तो बहुव्रीहि समास होता है। 'पीला अंबर' मात्र अर्थ लेने पर कर्मधारय होता, पर यहाँ विष्णु अभिप्रेत हैं।

questions.question_en: 'आँख का तारा' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'आँख का तारा' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Aankh ka taara means a very dear person.
questions.explanation_hi: 'आँख का तारा' का अर्थ है अत्यंत प्रिय व्यक्ति — 'इकलौता बेटा माँ की आँख का तारा है।'

questions.question_en: 'उत्कर्ष' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'उत्कर्ष' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Utkarsh (rise) is opposed by apkarsh (decline).
questions.explanation_hi: उत्कर्ष (उन्नति) का विलोम अपकर्ष (अवनति) है। निष्कर्ष का अर्थ परिणाम है, वह विलोम नहीं।

questions.question_en: 'चमकदार/स्वच्छ' अर्थ वाले शब्द की शुद्ध वर्तनी चुनिए।
questions.question_hi: 'चमकदार/स्वच्छ' अर्थ वाले शब्द की शुद्ध वर्तनी चुनिए।
questions.explanation_en: Correct spelling is ujjval (ut + jval).
questions.explanation_hi: शुद्ध शब्द 'उज्ज्वल' है (उत् + ज्वल)। संधि के कारण 'ज्' के बाद 'ज्व' आता है, इसलिए 'ज्ज्व' लिखा जाता है; 'उज्जवल' सबसे आम भूल है।

questions.subtopic: अनेक शब्दों के लिए एक शब्द
questions.question_en: 'जिसे जीता न जा सके' — इस वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए।
questions.question_hi: 'जिसे जीता न जा सके' — इस वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation_en: One who cannot be conquered = ajey.
questions.explanation_hi: जिसे जीता न जा सके = अजेय। 'अजित' का अर्थ 'जो जीता नहीं गया' है, 'अपराजित' = जो हारा नहीं; परीक्षा में मानक उत्तर 'अजेय' है।

questions.question_en: Which HTML tag, placed in the <head>, correctly links an external stylesheet named style.css?
questions.explanation_en: External CSS is attached with <link rel="stylesheet" href="…">. The <style> element holds internal CSS written directly in the page and has no src attribute.
Execution jumps to case 2 and, because there is no break after it, falls through into case 3 and prints C before the break stops it. D is not reached.

questions.question_en: A stack follows which order of insertion and deletion?
questions.explanation_en: Both push and pop happen at the same end (the top), so the element inserted last is removed first. FIFO describes a queue.

questions.question_en: Which attribute value of the <a> tag makes the linked page open in a new browser tab or window?
questions.explanation_en: target="_blank" opens the link in a new browsing context. _self (the default) opens it in the same tab, and _parent opens it in the parent frame.

questions.question_en: Recursive function calls are managed internally by the compiler using which data structure?
questions.explanation_en: Each call pushes an activation record (parameters, locals, return address) onto the call stack; it is popped when the call returns. Too deep a recursion causes stack overflow.

questions.question_en: Using Gmail or Google Docs through a web browser, without installing or maintaining any software, is an example of which cloud service model?
questions.explanation_en: In SaaS the provider runs the complete application and the user simply uses it over the Internet. IaaS gives raw virtual machines and storage; PaaS gives a platform for developing and deploying one's own applications.

questions.question_en: In the relational model, a row of a table is called a ______ and a column is called a/an ______.
questions.explanation_en: A relation (table) consists of tuples (rows) and attributes (columns). The set of permitted values of an attribute is its domain.

questions.question_en: Which type of cohesion is considered the BEST (most desirable)?
questions.explanation_en: In functional cohesion all elements contribute to one well-defined task. The order from best to worst is functional, sequential, communicational, procedural, temporal, logical, coincidental.

questions.question_en: Table MARKS(Student, Score): (A, 80), (B, NULL), (C, 60). What do SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(Score), AVG(Score) FROM MARKS; return?
questions.explanation_en: COUNT(*) counts all rows (3). COUNT(Score) and AVG(Score) ignore NULLs, so they use only 80 and 60: count 2, average 70. Treating NULL as 0 is the common mistake.

questions.question_en: A 2-D array A[0..4][0..9] of integers (4 bytes each) is stored in row-major order starting at address 1000. What is the address of A[3][7]?
questions.explanation_en: Row-major: address = base + (i × number of columns + j) × size = 1000 + (3 × 10 + 7) × 4 = 1000 + 148 = 1148. Column-major would give 1000 + (7 × 5 + 3) × 4 = 1152.

questions.question_en: Which CPU scheduling algorithm gives the minimum average waiting time for a given set of processes that all arrive at the same time?
questions.explanation_en: SJF is provably optimal for average waiting time because moving a short job before a long one reduces the waiting of the short job more than it increases the waiting of the long one. Its practical problem is that CPU burst lengths must be predicted.

questions.question_en: A well-designed software system should have:
questions.explanation_en: High cohesion keeps each module focused on a single task, and low coupling keeps modules independent, making the system easier to understand, test and maintain.

questions.question_en: In the V-model, unit testing is planned and carried out against which development phase on the left arm of the 'V'?
questions.explanation_en: The V-model pairs each development phase with a test phase: requirements ↔ acceptance testing, system/high-level design ↔ system or integration testing, and detailed module design ↔ unit testing.

questions.question_en: The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) was developed and is operated by:

options.en: Reserve Bank Information Technology Pvt. Ltd.

questions.explanation_en: NPCI, an initiative of RBI and the Indian Banks' Association, launched UPI in 2016 for instant mobile-based transfers between bank accounts. It also runs RuPay, BHIM and IMPS.

questions.question_en: A router makes its forwarding decision by examining the:

options.en: Destination port number of the segment
Source MAC address of the frame
Destination IP address of the packet

questions.explanation_en: Routers work at the Network layer and consult a routing table using the destination IP address. Switches use MAC addresses and firewalls may look at port numbers.

questions.question_en: Processes P1, P2, P3 with burst times 10, 5 and 8 ms all arrive at time 0. Using Round Robin with a time quantum of 4 ms, the average turnaround time is:
