Binary search needs the data to be in a stack
Comparisons are not allowed on linked-list nodes

questions.explanation_en: Binary search relies on jumping to the middle in O(1). In a linked list, reaching the middle needs a traversal of n/2 nodes, so the overall cost becomes O(n) and linear search is just as good.

questions.question_en: A process that is waiting to be assigned to the CPU and has everything it needs except the processor is in which state?
questions.explanation_en: The ready state means the process is in main memory and runnable, only waiting for the scheduler to dispatch it. A waiting/blocked process cannot run until an event such as I/O completion occurs.

questions.question_en: When a form is submitted with method="get", the form data is:

options.en: Stored in a cookie on the client
Appended to the URL as a query string
Sent in the body of the HTTP request and never visible in the URL

questions.explanation_en: With GET, name=value pairs are added after a '?' in the URL, so they are visible, bookmarkable and limited in length. POST sends data in the request body, which is preferred for passwords and large data.

questions.question_en: The document that formally records what a software system must do, and which acts as an agreement between client and developer, is the:
questions.explanation_en: The SRS states the functional and non-functional requirements of the system and serves as the baseline contract. Test reports and user manuals come much later in the life cycle.
The inner statement executes n times for each of the n outer iterations, i.e. n × n = n² times. Two loops one AFTER another would be O(n), but nested loops multiply.

questions.question_en: A C program on Linux executes the statement fork() three times in sequence (none of the calls fails). How many processes exist in total after the third call, counting the original?
questions.explanation_en: Each fork() duplicates every existing process, so n sequential forks produce 2^n processes: 2 after the first, 4 after the second and 8 after the third (7 children plus the original).

questions.question_en: If an int pointer p holds the address 1000 and int occupies 4 bytes, what is the value of p + 1?
questions.explanation_en: Pointer arithmetic is scaled by the size of the pointed-to type. p + 1 moves to the next int, i.e. 1000 + 4 = 1004. For a char pointer the answer would be 1001.

questions.question_en: Which OSI layer is responsible for routing packets from the source host to the destination host across multiple networks?
questions.explanation_en: Routing and logical (IP) addressing belong to the Network layer (layer 3). The Data Link layer delivers frames only within one physical network segment.

questions.question_en: The Agile Manifesto (2001) values 'working software' over:
questions.explanation_en: The four Agile values are: individuals and interactions over processes and tools, working software over comprehensive documentation, customer collaboration over contract negotiation, and responding to change over following a plan. The other three options are themselves values on the preferred side.

questions.question_en: Testing in which the tester designs test cases only from the specification, without looking at the internal code, is called:
questions.explanation_en: Black-box (functional/behavioural) testing treats the program as a closed box and checks outputs for given inputs. White-box, glass-box and structural testing are names for code-based testing.

questions.question_en: After the Linux command chmod 754 report.sh, the permissions of report.sh are:
questions.explanation_en: Each octal digit is r = 4, w = 2, x = 1 for owner, group, others: 7 = rwx, 5 = r-x, 4 = r--. So the owner can do everything, the group can read and execute, others can only read.

questions.question_en: Quick sort that always picks the FIRST element as pivot shows its worst-case O(n²) behaviour when the input array is:

options.en: Made up of distinct prime numbers

questions.explanation_en: On sorted input the first element is the smallest, so every partition is maximally unbalanced (0 and n − 1 elements), giving n + (n − 1) + … ≈ n²/2 comparisons. Random or median-of-three pivots avoid this in practice.

questions.question_en: The binary number (1011)2 is equal to which decimal number?
questions.question_hi: बाइनरी संख्या (1011)2 का दशमलव मान क्या है?

questions.question_en: An online store such as Amazon or Flipkart selling products directly to individual shoppers is an example of which e-commerce model?
questions.explanation_en: In B2C a business sells directly to end consumers. B2B is trade between businesses, such as a manufacturer buying from a wholesaler.

questions.question_en: Java does not allow a class to extend more than one class. Multiple inheritance of type is achieved in Java by using:
questions.explanation_en: A Java class can extend only one class but can implement any number of interfaces, e.g. class C extends A implements X, Y. Abstract classes are still classes, so only one can be extended.

questions.question_en: Which of the following sorting algorithms is NOT stable in its standard form?
questions.explanation_en: A stable sort keeps equal keys in their original relative order. Heap sort's swaps with the root can move equal keys past each other; quick sort and selection sort are also unstable, while merge, insertion and bubble sort are stable.

questions.question_en: A situation in which the final result depends on the exact order in which several processes access and modify shared data is called a:
questions.explanation_en: A race condition arises when concurrent processes access shared data without proper synchronisation, so the outcome depends on timing. The critical-section problem is about preventing exactly this.

questions.question_en: Which transport-layer protocol is connection-oriented and guarantees reliable, in-order delivery of data?
questions.explanation_en: TCP sets up a connection, numbers segments, uses acknowledgements and retransmission, so delivery is reliable and ordered. UDP is connectionless and gives no such guarantee; IP and ICMP are network-layer protocols.

questions.question_en: In the relational model, a row of a table is called a ______ and a column is called a/an ______.
questions.explanation_en: A relation (table) consists of tuples (rows) and attributes (columns). The set of permitted values of an attribute is its domain.

questions.question_en: Which attribute value of the <a> tag makes the linked page open in a new browser tab or window?
questions.explanation_en: target="_blank" opens the link in a new browsing context. _self (the default) opens it in the same tab, and _parent opens it in the parent frame.

questions.question_en: Second Normal Form (2NF) removes which kind of dependency from a 1NF relation?

options.en: Partial dependency of non-key attributes on part of a composite key

questions.explanation_en: 2NF requires every non-prime attribute to be fully functionally dependent on the whole primary key. Partial dependency can only exist when the key is composite, so a 1NF relation with a single-attribute key is automatically in 2NF.

questions.question_en: A relation is in First Normal Form (1NF) if:

options.en: Every determinant is a candidate key
Every attribute holds only atomic (indivisible) values

questions.explanation_en: 1NF forbids repeating groups and multivalued cells; each cell must contain a single atomic value. Removing partial dependency gives 2NF, transitive dependency 3NF, and 'every determinant is a candidate key' is BCNF.

questions.question_en: Keys 14, 25, 36 and 47 are inserted in this order into a hash table of size 11 using h(k) = k mod 11 and linear probing. At which index is 47 stored?
questions.explanation_en: All four keys hash to 3 (14, 25, 36, 47 mod 11 = 3). 14 → 3; 25 → 3 taken → 4; 36 → 3, 4 taken → 5; 47 → 3, 4, 5 taken → 6.

questions.question_en: The most distinguishing feature of the spiral model, compared with the waterfall model, is its explicit emphasis on:
questions.explanation_en: Each loop (cycle) of the spiral includes a dedicated risk-identification and risk-resolution step, so the spiral model is called a risk-driven model. The waterfall model has no explicit risk-handling phase.

questions.question_en: Table MARKS(Student, Score): (A, 80), (B, NULL), (C, 60). What do SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(Score), AVG(Score) FROM MARKS; return?
questions.explanation_en: COUNT(*) counts all rows (3). COUNT(Score) and AVG(Score) ignore NULLs, so they use only 80 and 60: count 2, average 70. Treating NULL as 0 is the common mistake.

questions.question_en: How many usable host addresses are available in a subnet with prefix /27?
questions.explanation_en: Host bits = 32 − 27 = 5, so 2^5 = 32 addresses. Subtracting the network and broadcast addresses gives 32 − 2 = 30 usable hosts.

questions.question_en: The Gray code equivalent of the binary number 1011 is:
questions.question_hi: बाइनरी संख्या 1011 का ग्रे कोड क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Keep the MSB (1), then XOR each pair of adjacent binary bits: 1⊕0 = 1, 0⊕1 = 1, 1⊕1 = 0, giving 1110. 1101 is the result of converting 1011 the wrong way (Gray→binary).

questions.question_en: What is the maximum number of comparisons binary search needs to find a key (or report failure) in a sorted array of 1000 elements?
questions.explanation_en: Worst case = ⌊log₂ n⌋ + 1 = ⌊log₂ 1000⌋ + 1 = 9 + 1 = 10, because 2^10 = 1024 ≥ 1000. 500 is the average for linear search, not binary search.

questions.question_en: Which CPU scheduling algorithm gives the minimum average waiting time for a given set of processes that all arrive at the same time?
questions.explanation_en: SJF is provably optimal for average waiting time because moving a short job before a long one reduces the waiting of the short job more than it increases the waiting of the long one. Its practical problem is that CPU burst lengths must be predicted.

questions.question_en: In the V-model, unit testing is planned and carried out against which development phase on the left arm of the 'V'?
questions.explanation_en: The V-model pairs each development phase with a test phase: requirements ↔ acceptance testing, system/high-level design ↔ system or integration testing, and detailed module design ↔ unit testing.

questions.question_en: The connector normally used to terminate Cat 5e / Cat 6 twisted-pair Ethernet cables is:
questions.explanation_en: RJ45 is the 8-pin connector for Ethernet twisted-pair cables. RJ11 is for telephone lines, BNC for coaxial cable and SC/ST/LC for optical fibre.

questions.question_en: Table A has rows with ID values 1, 2, 3 and table B has rows with ID values 2, 3, 4. How many rows does SELECT * FROM A INNER JOIN B ON A.ID = B.ID; return?
questions.explanation_en: An inner join keeps only matching IDs: 2 and 3, i.e., 2 rows. A LEFT JOIN would give 3 rows, a FULL OUTER JOIN 4 rows and a CROSS JOIN 9 rows.

tests.description: 50 questions, Computer Science only, exam pattern.

tests.title: Section Test — English Language 1
tests.subject: English Language

questions.question_en: Hardly ______ the room when the phone rang.
questions.explanation_en: “Hardly/Scarcely/No sooner” is followed by the past perfect, with auxiliary–subject inversion: Hardly had she entered ... when ...

questions.question_en: Select the meaning of the idiom: ‘To burn the midnight oil’.

options.en: To work late into the night

questions.explanation_en: The idiom refers to studying or working until late at night.

questions.question_en: Many a student ______ failed in this test.
questions.explanation_en: “Many a” is followed by a singular noun and a singular verb: Many a student has failed.

questions.question_en: Each of the boys ______ given a prize.
questions.explanation_en: “Each” is singular and takes a singular verb, even when followed by “of + plural noun”.

questions.question_en:
Identify the segment that contains an error.
Between you and I, / the project / is not likely / to succeed.
questions.explanation_en: A preposition takes the objective case: “Between you and me”.

questions.question_en: Neither the manager nor the employees ______ present in the meeting.
questions.explanation_en: In “neither...nor”, the verb agrees with the noun nearest to it. “Employees” is plural, so “were”.

questions.question_en: Select the one word that can replace: ‘The scientific study of birds’.
questions.explanation_en: Ornithology is the study of birds; entomology is of insects, etymology of word origins.

questions.question_en:
Select the option that best replaces the part in square brackets. If no change is needed, select ‘No improvement’.
Neither the teacher [or the students] were aware of the changes.
questions.explanation_en: “Neither” is paired with “nor”, not “or”.

questions.question_en: Select the meaning of the idiom: ‘Once in a blue moon’.
questions.explanation_en: “Once in a blue moon” means something that happens extremely rarely.

questions.question_en:
Identify the segment that contains an error.
Rahul is one of the boys / who has / won medals / in the national games.

options.en: Rahul is one of the boys

questions.explanation_en: In “one of the + plural noun + who”, the relative pronoun refers to the plural noun, so the verb is “have”.

questions.question_en: How long ______ you ______ for the bus?
questions.explanation_en: “How long” with an action that began in the past and continues now takes the present perfect continuous: have you been waiting.

questions.question_en:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Reading is a habit that (1) ______ the mind and improves imagination. A student who reads regularly (2) ______ better vocabulary and writing skills than one who does not. Unfortunately, the (3) ______ of mobile phones has reduced the time young people (4) ______ on books. Teachers should (5) ______ students to visit libraries and discuss what they read.

Select the most appropriate option to fill blank (1).
Relevant sentence: Reading is a habit that (1) ______ the mind and improves imagination.
questions.explanation_en: “Enriches” is the positive verb that agrees with “improves imagination”.

questions.question_en: Select the word closest in meaning to CANDID.
questions.explanation_en: Candid means truthful and straightforward, i.e. frank.

questions.question_en: Select the word opposite in meaning to EXPAND.
questions.explanation_en: Expand means to become larger; contract means to become smaller.

questions.question_en: Select the word opposite in meaning to SCARCE.
questions.explanation_en: Scarce means in short supply; abundant means plentiful.

questions.question_en: Bread and butter ______ my usual breakfast.
questions.explanation_en: Two nouns that form one idea (bread and butter, rice and curry) take a singular verb.

questions.question_en: Rohan goes to ______ school by bus every day.
questions.explanation_en: When a place is visited for its primary purpose (school for studying), no article is used: goes to school.

questions.question_en:
Select the option that best replaces the part in square brackets. If no change is needed, select ‘No improvement’.
The teacher asked the boy [why was he late].
questions.explanation_en: In reported questions the word order becomes that of a statement (subject before verb): why he was late.

questions.question_en: Change into indirect speech: She said, “I will come tomorrow.”

options.en: She said that she will come tomorrow.
She said that she would come tomorrow.
She said that I would come tomorrow.
She said that she would come the next day.

questions.explanation_en: Will becomes would and tomorrow becomes the next day / the following day.

questions.question_en:
Identify the segment that contains an error.
My uncle / is working / in this company / since 2010.
questions.explanation_en: “Since 2010” needs the present perfect continuous: has been working.

tests.description: 20 questions, English Language only, exam pattern.

tests.title: Section Test — English Language 2
tests.subject: English Language

questions.question_en: Select the one word that can replace: ‘A place where bees are kept’.
questions.explanation_en: An apiary houses bees; an aviary houses birds.

questions.question_en: Select the word closest in meaning to FRUGAL.
questions.explanation_en: Frugal means careful about spending money, i.e. thrifty.

questions.question_en:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Sleep is often treated as a luxury by students and working adults, yet scientists consider it as essential as food and water. During sleep the brain does not simply switch off; it sorts the information gathered during the day, stores important memories and clears away harmful chemicals that accumulate while we are awake. Children who sleep for less than eight hours are more likely to have difficulty in concentrating and to show poor results in examinations. Adults who regularly sleep for only five or six hours face a higher risk of heart disease and depression. Experts therefore advise a fixed bedtime, avoiding screens an hour before sleeping and keeping the bedroom dark and quiet. Contrary to popular belief, sleeping late on weekends cannot fully repay the “sleep debt” collected during the week.

Choose the word closest in meaning to ‘accumulate’ as used in the passage.
questions.explanation_en: “Accumulate” means to build up gradually, i.e. gather.

questions.question_en: Select the one word that can replace: ‘The killing of a king’.
questions.explanation_en: Regicide (Latin rex = king) is the killing of a king; fratricide is killing of a brother.

questions.question_en: Select the word opposite in meaning to INEVITABLE.
questions.explanation_en: Inevitable means unable to be avoided; avoidable is its opposite.

questions.question_en:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Water is (1) ______ for all living beings. However, in recent years many cities have been (2) ______ from acute water shortage. The main reason is the (3) ______ use of groundwater by industries and households. If we do not take steps to (4) ______ water, future generations will have to pay a heavy price. Every citizen should therefore (5) ______ responsibility and avoid wastage.

Select the most appropriate option to fill blank (2).
Relevant sentence: ... many cities have been (2) ______ from acute water shortage.
questions.explanation_en: “Suffer from” is the correct collocation, and the sense (problems of shortage) is negative.

questions.question_en:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Reading is a habit that (1) ______ the mind and improves imagination. A student who reads regularly (2) ______ better vocabulary and writing skills than one who does not. Unfortunately, the (3) ______ of mobile phones has reduced the time young people (4) ______ on books. Teachers should (5) ______ students to visit libraries and discuss what they read.

Select the most appropriate option to fill blank (3).
Relevant sentence: Unfortunately, the (3) ______ of mobile phones has reduced the time ...
questions.explanation_en: Only the growing popularity of phones could reduce time for books; “absence/shortage/dislike” would not.

questions.question_en: The train ______ before we reached the station.
questions.explanation_en: The train’s departure happened earlier than our arrival (both in the past), so the past perfect is used for the earlier action.

questions.question_en: She plays ______ guitar very well.
questions.explanation_en: “The” is used before the names of musical instruments when we speak of playing them: play the guitar.

questions.question_en:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Trees in cities do much more than make streets look pleasant. A single mature tree can absorb about twenty kilograms of carbon dioxide in a year and release enough oxygen for two people. Their leaves trap dust, while their shade can lower the temperature of a neighbourhood by several degrees, reducing the need for air conditioners. In many Indian cities, however, trees are felled for widening roads and constructing flyovers, often without any plan to replace them. Urban planners argue that development and greenery are not enemies; roads can be designed around existing trees, and every felled tree can be compensated by planting several saplings. Citizens, too, must take the initiative by protecting trees in their own colony instead of waiting for the government to act.

According to the passage, how does the shade of trees help a neighbourhood?

options.en: It reduces the need for air conditioners.
It traps dust in the air.

questions.explanation_en: The passage says shade lowers the temperature and reduces the need for air conditioners; trapping dust is done by leaves.

questions.question_en: The Principal was annoyed ______ the students for coming late.
questions.explanation_en: “Annoyed with” is used for a person (annoyed at/about a thing).

questions.question_en: Change into indirect speech: She said to me, “Where do you live?”

options.en: She asked me where do you live.
She told me where did I live.
She asked me that where I lived.
She asked me where I lived.

questions.explanation_en: A wh-question is reported with ‘asked’, statement word order and no ‘that’.

questions.question_en: Select the meaning of the idiom: ‘To cry over spilt milk’.

options.en: To regret something that cannot be undone

questions.explanation_en: The idiom warns against useless grief over past mistakes that cannot be corrected.

questions.question_en:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Sleep is often treated as a luxury by students and working adults, yet scientists consider it as essential as food and water. During sleep the brain does not simply switch off; it sorts the information gathered during the day, stores important memories and clears away harmful chemicals that accumulate while we are awake. Children who sleep for less than eight hours are more likely to have difficulty in concentrating and to show poor results in examinations. Adults who regularly sleep for only five or six hours face a higher risk of heart disease and depression. Experts therefore advise a fixed bedtime, avoiding screens an hour before sleeping and keeping the bedroom dark and quiet. Contrary to popular belief, sleeping late on weekends cannot fully repay the “sleep debt” collected during the week.

According to the passage, what can sleeping late on weekends NOT do?

options.en: Fully repay the sleep debt of the week

questions.explanation_en: The last sentence says weekend sleep cannot fully repay the sleep debt collected during the week.

questions.question_en: Select the meaning of the idiom: ‘Under the weather’.
questions.explanation_en: “Under the weather” means slightly ill or in low spirits.

tests.title: Section Test — General Awareness 1
tests.subject: General Awareness

questions.question_en: India and the European Union announced the conclusion of free trade agreement negotiations in:
questions.explanation_en: The India-EU FTA, called the 'mother of all deals', was concluded on 27 January 2026 after nearly two decades of talks.

questions.question_en: The XXV Olympic Winter Games, held in February 2026, were hosted by:
questions.explanation_en: The 2026 Winter Olympics were co-hosted by Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo in Italy; the next Winter Games (2030) go to the French Alps.

questions.question_en: In Census 2027 houselisting, which Delhi areas were among the first to open self-enumeration?
questions.explanation_en: The first self-enumeration phase covered some states/UTs plus areas under NDMC and the Delhi Cantonment Board.

questions.question_en: 'Mission Sudarshan Chakra', announced by PM Modi on Independence Day 2025, is aimed at building:
questions.explanation_en: The mission envisages an indigenous multi-layered air defence system to protect strategic and civilian sites by 2035.

questions.question_en: In October 2026 the MPC changed its policy stance from neutral to:
questions.explanation_en: Along with the 25 bps repo hike, the stance was shifted to 'calibrated tightening'; the SDF rate became 5.25% and MSF 5.75%.

questions.question_en: The Delhi Budget 2026-27, presented on 24 March 2026, was projected as a:
questions.explanation_en: CM Rekha Gupta presented a roughly Rs 1.04 lakh crore budget with heavy focus on pollution control and environment.

questions.question_en: The Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences 2026 was awarded to which pair of American economists?

options.en: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford

questions.explanation_en: The Royal Swedish Academy honoured them on 12 October 2026 for their work on macroeconomic stabilisation.

questions.question_en: Which country holds the G20 presidency for 2026?
questions.explanation_en: The USA took over the G20 presidency from South Africa (Johannesburg summit, Nov 2025) for 2026.

questions.question_en: NISAR, launched in July 2025 on a GSLV-F16 rocket, is a joint earth-observation satellite of ISRO and:
questions.explanation_en: NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar maps Earth's land and ice changes with dual-frequency L and S band radar.

questions.question_en: Which Indian city has been awarded the 2030 Commonwealth Games, the centenary edition?
questions.explanation_en: The Commonwealth Sport General Assembly in Glasgow (Nov 2025) chose Ahmedabad over Abuja; India last hosted in Delhi in 2010.

questions.question_en: ISRO's first uncrewed Gaganyaan mission (G1) is to carry which humanoid robot?
questions.explanation_en: Vyommitra, a half-humanoid, will test life-support and re-entry systems; G1 has been targeted for late 2026 (subject to delays).

questions.question_en: Rekha Gupta is the how-manyth woman Chief Minister of Delhi?
questions.explanation_en: After Sushma Swaraj (1998), Sheila Dikshit (1998-2013) and Atishi (2024-25), Rekha Gupta became the fourth woman CM of Delhi.

questions.question_en: Who became Japan's first woman Prime Minister in October 2025?
questions.explanation_en: Sanae Takaichi of the LDP was elected Prime Minister of Japan in October 2025.

questions.question_en: 'Biopharma SHAKTI', announced in the Union Budget 2026-27, aims to position India as a global hub for:
questions.explanation_en: Biopharma SHAKTI is the Budget 2026-27 initiative to build India into a global biopharmaceutical manufacturing and research hub.

questions.question_en: The VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 replaced which rural employment law?
questions.explanation_en: The Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act received Presidential assent in Dec 2025 and replaced MGNREGA from 1 July 2026.

questions.question_en: Who took oath as the 53rd Chief Justice of India on 24 November 2025?
questions.explanation_en: Justice Surya Kant succeeded Justice B. R. Gavai and is due to retire on 9 February 2027.

questions.question_en: Operation Sindoor, launched on 7 May 2025, was India's military response to which attack?
questions.explanation_en: India struck terror infrastructure in Pakistan and PoK after the 22 April 2025 Pahalgam attack on tourists.

questions.question_en: India hosted the first global AI summit in the Global South in February 2026. It was called the:
questions.explanation_en: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi ended with the adoption of the New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact.

questions.question_en: Which state elected its first BJP government in the Assembly election results declared in May 2026?
questions.explanation_en: The BJP won about 206-207 of 294 seats in West Bengal, ending the Trinamool Congress's 15-year rule; Suvendu Adhikari was sworn in on 9 May 2026.

questions.question_en: Which country won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026, co-hosted by India and Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation_en: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs in the final on 8 March 2026 at Ahmedabad, becoming the first team to win three T20 World Cup titles.

questions.question_en: The 60th Jnanpith Award (for 2025), announced in March 2026, was given to which writer?
questions.explanation_en: Tamil poet-lyricist R. Vairamuthu won the 2025 Jnanpith, becoming the first Tamil poet to receive it; the award carries Rs 11 lakh and a Vagdevi statuette.

questions.question_en: Which country won the FIFA World Cup 2026?
questions.explanation_en: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final at MetLife Stadium on 19 July 2026, their second World Cup after 2010.

questions.question_en: In its October 2026 policy, the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee raised the repo rate to:
questions.explanation_en: On 7 October 2026 the MPC hiked the repo rate by 25 bps from 5.25% to 5.50%, the first increase since February 2023.

questions.question_en: Dr Ambedkar called which Article the 'heart and soul' of the Constitution?
questions.explanation_en: Article 32 gives the right to approach the Supreme Court for enforcement of Fundamental Rights.

questions.question_en: The new Income Tax Act, 2025 replacing the Income-tax Act, 1961 came into effect from:
questions.explanation_en: The Income Tax Act, 2025 is in force from 1 April 2026 and introduces 'tax year' in place of previous year/assessment year.

questions.question_en: The Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) was constituted in:
questions.explanation_en: DSSSB was set up by the Government of NCT of Delhi in 1996 to recruit for Group B and C posts of Delhi departments and bodies.

questions.question_en: Runa Khan, a 2026 Ramon Magsaysay Award winner announced on 31 August 2026, is from which country?
questions.explanation_en: The 2026 awardees: Tommy Koh (Singapore), Runa Khan (Bangladesh) and Bo Kyi (Myanmar).

questions.question_en: Who won the men's singles title at Wimbledon 2026?
questions.explanation_en: Sinner defended his Wimbledon title, beating Alexander Zverev in four sets in the July 2026 final.

questions.question_en: How many persons were honoured with the Padma Awards announced on 25 January 2026?
questions.explanation_en: The 2026 list had 131 awardees (5 Vibhushan, 13 Bhushan, 113 Shri per most reports); 2025 had 139 and 2024 had 132.

questions.question_en: Who was the first Indian woman to reach the summit of Mount Everest (1984)?
questions.explanation_en: Bachendri Pal climbed Everest on 23 May 1984; Santosh Yadav later became the first woman to climb it twice.

questions.question_en: Who is the Vice President of India (elected in September 2025 after Jagdeep Dhankhar's resignation)?
questions.explanation_en: C. P. Radhakrishnan, former Maharashtra Governor, was elected the 15th Vice President on 9 September 2025.

questions.question_en: The Right to Education for children aged 6 to 14 years became a Fundamental Right under Article 21A through which amendment?
questions.explanation_en: The 86th Amendment inserted Article 21A; the RTE Act, 2009 gave it effect from 1 April 2010.

questions.question_en: With the Union Budget 2026-27 presented on 1 February 2026, how many consecutive Union Budgets has Nirmala Sitharaman presented?
questions.explanation_en: The 2026-27 Budget was her ninth in a row, counting the July 2019 budget and both 2024 budgets (interim and full).

questions.question_en: The GST Council, set up under Article 279A, is headed by:
questions.explanation_en: The Union Finance Minister chairs it and State finance ministers are members; decisions need a three-fourths weighted majority.

questions.question_en: The words 'Socialist', 'Secular' and 'Integrity' were added to the Preamble by which Constitutional Amendment?
questions.explanation_en: The 42nd Amendment is the only one to have changed the Preamble.

questions.question_en: The final of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 was played at which venue?
questions.explanation_en: The 8 March 2026 final between India and New Zealand was held at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad.

questions.question_en: The Jantar Mantar observatory in Delhi was built in 1724 by:
questions.explanation_en: Jai Singh II of Amber built five Jantar Mantars (Delhi, Jaipur, Ujjain, Varanasi, Mathura).

questions.question_en: National Education Day in India is celebrated on 11 November, the birth anniversary of:
questions.explanation_en: Azad was independent India's first Education Minister; the day has been observed since 2008.

questions.question_en: Plaster of Paris is obtained by heating gypsum at 373 K. Its chemical formula is:
questions.explanation_en: Gypsum is CaSO4.2H2O and loses 1.5 water molecules on heating; CaOCl2 is bleaching powder.

questions.question_en: How many Fundamental Duties are listed in Article 51A at present?
questions.explanation_en: Ten duties were added by the 42nd Amendment (1976) and the 11th (duty of parents to educate children aged 6-14) by the 86th Amendment (2002).

tests.description: 20 questions, General Awareness only, exam pattern.

tests.title: Section Test — General Intelligence & Reasoning 1
tests.subject: General Intelligence & Reasoning

questions.question_en: The mirror image of a clock shows the time as 9:15. What is the actual time?
questions.explanation_en: Actual time = 11:60 − mirror time = 11:60 − 9:15 = 2:45. The relation works both ways.

questions.question_en: A square is divided into a 3 × 3 grid of 9 equal small squares. How many rectangles (including squares) are there in the figure?
questions.explanation_en: A rectangle is fixed by choosing 2 of the 4 vertical lines and 2 of the 4 horizontal lines: C(4,2) × C(4,2) = 6 × 6 = 36. The answer 14 counts only squares (9 + 4 + 1).

questions.question_en: The vertices of a regular octagon are numbered 1 to 8 clockwise. In a series of figures a star sits on vertices 1, 2, 4, 7, … (it moves 1, 2, 3, … places clockwise). On which vertex will it be in the fifth figure?
questions.explanation_en: From 7 it moves 4 places: 7 + 4 = 11, and 11 − 8 = 3. So the star is on vertex 3.

questions.question_en: A cube net has four squares P, Q, R, S in a horizontal row (left to right), square T attached above P and square U attached below S. When folded into a cube, which face is opposite T?
questions.explanation_en: The row P–Q–R–S wraps around the cube, so P–R and Q–S are opposite. The two squares attached off the row (T and U) form the two remaining faces, which are opposite each other, whichever row square they are attached to.

questions.question_en:
Matrix I (rows 0–4, columns 0–4):
Row 0: P E N T A
Row 1: E N T A P
Row 2: N T A P E
Row 3: T A P E N
Row 4: A P E N T
Matrix II (rows 5–9, columns 5–9):
Row 5: O R S I L
Row 6: R S I L O
Row 7: S I L O R
Row 8: I L O R S
Row 9: L O R S I
Each letter is coded by its row number followed by its column number (for example, P can be 00 or 14). Which set of numbers correctly represents the word STONE?
questions.explanation_en: S = 66, T = 30, O = 87, N = 20, E = 42. The first and third sets end with N (02, 11) instead of E; the fourth has 24 = E in place of N.

questions.question_en: A standard die (opposite faces add up to 7) rests on a table with 3 on the top face. What is the sum of the numbers on the four vertical side faces?
questions.explanation_en: Total of all faces = 1 + 2 + … + 6 = 21. Top 3 and bottom 4 (opposite of 3) add to 7, so the four sides add to 21 − 7 = 14. The sides of a standard die always total 14.

questions.question_en: Find the next term: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation_en: Differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, so the next difference is 12: 30 + 12 = 42. (Also n(n+1): 6 x 7 = 42.)

questions.question_en: A square sheet of paper is folded in half, and then folded in half again to form a smaller square. One hole is punched through all the layers. How many holes will there be when the sheet is unfolded?
questions.explanation_en: Two folds make 2 × 2 = 4 layers, and a hole punched through all layers appears once in each layer. So 4 holes.

questions.question_en: CAT : DBU :: DOG : ?
questions.explanation_en: Every letter moves one step forward: C-D, A-B, T-U. So D-E, O-P, G-H gives EPH.

questions.question_en: Find the next letter: A, C, F, J, O, ?
questions.explanation_en: Position gaps are +2, +3, +4, +5, then +6. O is the 15th letter; 15 + 6 = 21 = U.

questions.question_en: A wall clock shows 4:20. What time will its image in a plane mirror (placed vertically beside it) appear to show?
questions.explanation_en: Mirror time = 11:60 − actual time = 11:60 − 4:20 = 7:40.

questions.question_en:
Statements: Some men are kings. No king is a thief.
Conclusions: I. Some men are not thieves. II. No man is a thief.
questions.explanation_en: The men who are kings are not thieves, so some men are not thieves (I). Nothing is known about the other men, so II does not follow.

questions.question_en:
Matrix I (rows 0–4, columns 0–4):
Row 0: P E N T A
Row 1: E N T A P
Row 2: N T A P E
Row 3: T A P E N
Row 4: A P E N T
Matrix II (rows 5–9, columns 5–9):
Row 5: O R S I L
Row 6: R S I L O
Row 7: S I L O R
Row 8: I L O R S
Row 9: L O R S I
Each letter is coded by its row number followed by its column number (for example, P can be 00 or 14). Which set of numbers correctly represents the word PEARL?
questions.explanation_en: P = 00, E = 10, A = 22, R = 65, L = 77 are all correct. In the other sets 69 = O, 58 = I and 03 = T, so each has one wrong letter.

questions.question_en: A triangle ABC has three straight lines drawn from vertex A to three different points on side BC, so that BC is divided into 4 parts. How many triangles are there in the figure?
questions.explanation_en: There are 5 points on BC (B, the three new points and C). Every pair of points on BC with apex A forms a triangle, so the count is C(5,2) = 10.

questions.question_en: A cube is folded from a net made of six squares: four squares A, B, C, D in a horizontal row (left to right), with square E attached above B and square F attached below B. Which face is opposite A?
questions.explanation_en: In a row of four squares that wraps around the cube, alternate squares are opposite: A–C and B–D. E and F, attached on either side of the row, become top and bottom and are opposite each other.

questions.question_en: If + means ÷, − means ×, × means + and ÷ means −, then 36 + 9 − 4 × 5 ÷ 3 = ?
questions.explanation_en: Replace the signs: 36 ÷ 9 × 4 + 5 − 3. BODMAS: 36 ÷ 9 = 4, then 4 × 4 = 16, so 16 + 5 − 3 = 18.

questions.question_en: A large square is divided into a 4 × 4 grid of 16 equal small squares. How many squares of all sizes are there in the figure?
questions.explanation_en: Squares of side k in an n × n grid = (n − k + 1)². For n = 4: 16 + 9 + 4 + 1 = 30. The answer 16 counts only the smallest squares.

questions.question_en: What is the minimum number of straight cuts needed to divide a cube into 64 identical smaller cubes?
questions.explanation_en: 64 = 4 × 4 × 4 pieces need 3 cuts in each of the three directions: 3 + 3 + 3 = 9.

questions.question_en: A cube is painted on all six faces and then cut into 64 identical smaller cubes. How many small cubes have exactly two faces painted?
questions.explanation_en: 64 = 4³, so n = 4. Cubes with exactly two painted faces lie on the 12 edges, excluding corners: 12 × (n − 2) = 12 × 2 = 24.

questions.question_en: A cube painted on all faces is cut into 125 identical smaller cubes. How many small cubes have exactly one face painted?
questions.explanation_en: 125 = 5³, n = 5. One-face cubes are the inner part of each face: 6 × (n − 2)² = 6 × 9 = 54. 36 is the two-face count 12 × 3; 27 is the unpainted count 3³.

tests.description: 20 questions, General Intelligence & Reasoning only, exam pattern.

tests.title: Section Test — General Intelligence & Reasoning 2
tests.subject: General Intelligence & Reasoning

questions.question_en: In a row of girls, Neha is 7th from the left end and 12th from the right end. How many girls are there in the row?
questions.explanation_en: Total = 7 + 12 - 1 = 18 (Neha is counted in both ranks).
In the other pairs the second number is the square of the first (8^2 = 64, 5^2 = 25, 7^2 = 49). 6^2 = 36, not 48.

questions.question_en: A sheet of paper is folded in half three times, each fold halving the previous size. Two separate holes are then punched through all the layers. How many holes appear when the sheet is opened out?
questions.explanation_en: Three folds give 2³ = 8 layers. Each punch makes 8 holes, so 2 punches make 2 × 8 = 16 holes.

questions.question_en: On which day of the week did India become independent on 15 August 1947?
questions.explanation_en: Odd-day method: 1600 years = 0, next 300 years = 1, next 46 years (11 leap years) = 57 days = 1, so 1946 years = 2 odd days. Days from 1 Jan to 15 Aug 1947 = 227 = 3 odd days. Total 5 odd days, and 5 corresponds to Friday (0 = Sunday).

questions.question_en: A standard die (opposite faces add up to 7) shows 1 on top, 2 facing you (front) and 3 on the right. It is rolled one quarter-turn to the right, so that the top face goes to the right side. Which number is now on top?
questions.explanation_en: When a die rolls to the right, the left face comes to the top. Left is opposite right (3), so left = 7 − 3 = 4. Hence 4 is on top.

questions.question_en: A cuboid of size 4 cm × 3 cm × 2 cm is painted on all faces and cut into 1 cm cubes. How many cubes have exactly one face painted?
questions.explanation_en: One-face cubes on an a × b face = (a − 2)(b − 2). The 4 × 3 faces give 2 × 1 = 2 each (two faces → 4); the 4 × 2 and 3 × 2 faces give 0 because 2 − 2 = 0. Total = 4.

questions.question_en: Find the missing number in the grid. Row 1: 4, 5, 41; Row 2: 6, 2, 40; Row 3: 3, 7, ?
questions.explanation_en: Third number = (first)² + (second)²: 16 + 25 = 41, 36 + 4 = 40, so 9 + 49 = 58.

questions.question_en: If TABLE is coded as UBCMF, then how is CHAIR coded?
questions.explanation_en: Each letter is shifted one step forward: C-D, H-I, A-B, I-J, R-S. So DIBJS.

questions.question_en: A square sheet is folded top-half onto bottom-half, and then right-half onto left-half. A small triangle is cut off at the corner of the folded square that is diagonally opposite to the corner where the two fold lines meet. What will the sheet look like when unfolded?

options.en: All four corners of the sheet are cut off
Only one corner of the sheet is cut off
A diamond-shaped hole appears at the centre
Two adjacent corners are cut off

questions.explanation_en: The fold-line corner is the centre of the sheet, so the opposite corner of the folded square holds all four original corners stacked together. One cut therefore removes all four corners of the sheet.

questions.question_en: Raj is 9th from the top in a class. Amit is 14th from the bottom. If they exchange positions, Raj becomes 19th from the top. How many students are in the class?
questions.explanation_en: Raj now stands where Amit stood, so Amit's original position is 19th from the top and 14th from the bottom. Total = 19 + 14 - 1 = 32.

questions.question_en: Which letter is the 7th to the right of the 12th letter from the left end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation_en: The 12th letter is L. Moving 7 to the right gives the 19th letter, S.

questions.question_en: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 3:30?
How many letters of the word EXAMINATION (counting repeated letters each time) look the same in a vertical mirror?
questions.explanation_en: Vertically symmetric letters: X, A, M, I, A, T, I, O = 8. E and the two Ns are not symmetric about a vertical axis.

questions.question_en: Select the odd one out (capitals of states): Lucknow, Jaipur, Surat, Bhopal
questions.explanation_en: Lucknow, Jaipur and Bhopal are state capitals. Surat is a city in Gujarat but not the capital (Gandhinagar is).

questions.question_en: Which word will look exactly the same in its water image (reflection in water below the word)?
questions.explanation_en: A water image keeps the letter order but flips each letter top-to-bottom. All letters of CHOICE (C, H, O, I, E) are symmetric about a horizontal axis. R, V, P, L, M, U, S are not.

questions.question_en: Three different positions of the same die show these numbers on the three visible (mutually adjacent) faces — Position 1: 1, 2, 3; Position 2: 1, 3, 6; Position 3: 1, 6, 5. Which number is on the face opposite 2?
questions.explanation_en: 1 is opposite 4, so 2, 3, 6, 5 form the ring around 1. In the ring, 3 is next to 2 (position 1) and next to 6 (position 2), and 6 is next to 5 (position 3), so the ring order is 2–3–6–5. Faces two steps apart in the ring are opposite: 2 is opposite 6 (and 3 is opposite 5).

questions.question_en: A is the sister of B. C is the mother of B. D is the father of C. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation_en: A and B are children of C. D is C's father, so A is D's granddaughter.

questions.question_en: A wooden cube has only its four vertical side faces painted (top and bottom are left unpainted). It is cut into 27 identical small cubes. How many small cubes have no paint at all?
questions.explanation_en: In the 3 × 3 top view, only the centre column is away from all four painted sides. That column contains 3 cubes (one per layer), and since the top and bottom are unpainted, all 3 are paint-free. Answer 1 would be the case if all six faces were painted.

questions.question_en:
Statement: Should the government provide free education up to Class 12?
Arguments: I. Yes, education is a basic need and builds the nation's human capital. II. Yes, because everything should be free.

options.en: Both I and II are strong
Neither I nor II is strong

questions.explanation_en: I gives a specific, relevant reason. II is a vague overgeneralisation that does not relate to education, so it is weak.

questions.question_en:
Statement: Many people in a colony are suffering from dengue.
Courses of action: I. The municipal corporation should start fogging and remove stagnant water. II. People should be asked to leave the colony permanently.
questions.explanation_en: Fogging and removing breeding sites tackle the cause (I). Asking people to leave permanently is impractical and extreme (II).

tests.description: 20 questions, General Intelligence & Reasoning only, exam pattern.

tests.title: Section Test — Hindi Language 1
tests.subject: Hindi Language

questions.question_en: 'उत्कर्ष' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'उत्कर्ष' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Utkarsh (rise) is opposed by apkarsh (decline).
questions.explanation_hi: उत्कर्ष (उन्नति) का विलोम अपकर्ष (अवनति) है। निष्कर्ष का अर्थ परिणाम है, वह विलोम नहीं।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वाक्य चुनिए: (अनेक)
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वाक्य चुनिए: (अनेक)
questions.explanation_en: 'Anek' is already plural, so 'anekon' is incorrect.
questions.explanation_hi: 'अनेक' स्वयं बहुवचन (एक से अधिक) का बोध कराता है, इसलिए 'अनेकों' अशुद्ध है। 'समस्याओं' विभक्ति-रहित स्थिति में प्रयोग नहीं होगा।

questions.question_en: 'यथाशक्ति' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.question_hi: 'यथाशक्ति' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation_en: First member 'yatha' is an indeclinable — avyayibhav samas.
questions.explanation_hi: यथाशक्ति = शक्ति के अनुसार। पहला पद 'यथा' अव्यय है और पूरा पद भी अव्यय की तरह प्रयुक्त होता है, अतः अव्ययीभाव समास है।

questions.subtopic: अनेक शब्दों के लिए एक शब्द
questions.question_en: 'जिसे जीता न जा सके' — इस वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए।
questions.question_hi: 'जिसे जीता न जा सके' — इस वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation_en: One who cannot be conquered = ajey.
questions.explanation_hi: जिसे जीता न जा सके = अजेय। 'अजित' का अर्थ 'जो जीता नहीं गया' है, 'अपराजित' = जो हारा नहीं; परीक्षा में मानक उत्तर 'अजेय' है।

questions.question_en: 'विद्यालय' शब्द का सही संधि-विच्छेद क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'विद्यालय' शब्द का सही संधि-विच्छेद क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Vidya + aalay = Vidyalay; aa + aa gives aa (deergh swar sandhi).
questions.explanation_hi: विद्या + आलय = विद्यालय। यहाँ आ + आ मिलकर 'आ' बनता है, अतः यह दीर्घ स्वर संधि है।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द 'कमल' का पर्यायवाची नहीं है?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द 'कमल' का पर्यायवाची नहीं है?
questions.explanation_en: Neerad means cloud, not lotus; the other three are synonyms of lotus.
questions.explanation_hi: पंकज, जलज और सरोज तीनों 'कमल' के पर्यायवाची हैं। 'नीरद' का अर्थ बादल (नीर देने वाला) है, कमल नहीं।

questions.question_en: 'पीतांबर' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.question_hi: 'पीतांबर' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation_en: Pitambar refers to Vishnu (one whose garment is yellow) — bahuvrihi.
questions.explanation_hi: पीतांबर = पीला है अंबर (वस्त्र) जिसका, अर्थात् विष्णु। जब दोनों पद मिलकर किसी तीसरे की ओर संकेत करें तो बहुव्रीहि समास होता है। 'पीला अंबर' मात्र अर्थ लेने पर कर्मधारय होता, पर यहाँ विष्णु अभिप्रेत हैं।

questions.question_en: 'चमकदार/स्वच्छ' अर्थ वाले शब्द की शुद्ध वर्तनी चुनिए।
questions.question_hi: 'चमकदार/स्वच्छ' अर्थ वाले शब्द की शुद्ध वर्तनी चुनिए।
questions.explanation_en: Correct spelling is ujjval (ut + jval).
questions.explanation_hi: शुद्ध शब्द 'उज्ज्वल' है (उत् + ज्वल)। संधि के कारण 'ज्' के बाद 'ज्व' आता है, इसलिए 'ज्ज्व' लिखा जाता है; 'उज्जवल' सबसे आम भूल है।

questions.question_en: 'चरण-कमल बंदौं हरि राई' — इस पंक्ति में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.question_hi: 'चरण-कमल बंदौं हरि राई' — इस पंक्ति में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.explanation_en: Feet are identified with lotuses without a comparison word, which is Rupak (metaphor).
questions.explanation_hi: यहाँ चरणों (उपमेय) पर कमल (उपमान) का अभेद आरोप किया गया है — 'कमल रूपी चरण'। बिना वाचक शब्द के उपमेय-उपमान को एक मान लेना रूपक अलंकार है।

questions.question_en: 'ने' परसर्ग (विभक्ति-चिह्न) किस कारक का है?
questions.question_hi: 'ने' परसर्ग (विभक्ति-चिह्न) किस कारक का है?
questions.explanation_en: 'Ne' marks the karta (subject/agent) case.
questions.explanation_hi: 'ने' कर्ता कारक का चिह्न है — 'राम ने पत्र लिखा'। कर्म का चिह्न 'को', करण का 'से/के द्वारा' और संप्रदान का 'को/के लिए' है।

questions.question_en: 'स्वप्न' शब्द का तद्भव रूप क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'स्वप्न' शब्द का तद्भव रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Sapna is the tadbhav of svapna; khwab is a Persian loanword.
questions.explanation_hi: संस्कृत 'स्वप्न' से हिंदी का 'सपना' बना है। 'ख़्वाब' फ़ारसी (विदेशज) शब्द है और 'स्वप्निल' विशेषण है, तद्भव नहीं।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द 'रात' का पर्यायवाची नहीं है?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द 'रात' का पर्यायवाची नहीं है?
questions.explanation_en: Vasar means day; the others mean night.
questions.explanation_hi: रजनी, यामिनी, विभावरी, निशा और रात्रि 'रात' के पर्यायवाची हैं। 'वासर' का अर्थ दिन है।

questions.question_en: 'ऊपर कहा गया' अर्थ वाले शब्द का शुद्ध रूप चुनिए।
questions.question_hi: 'ऊपर कहा गया' अर्थ वाले शब्द का शुद्ध रूप चुनिए।
questions.explanation_en: Upari + ukt = uparyukt; 'uparokt' is a common but incorrect form.
questions.explanation_hi: उपरि + उक्त = उपर्युक्त (यण संधि)। 'उपरोक्त' बोलचाल में प्रचलित है, पर व्याकरण की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध है।

questions.question_en: 'अग्नि' शब्द का तद्भव रूप क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'अग्नि' शब्द का तद्भव रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Aag is the tadbhav form of agni; the other options are Sanskrit synonyms.
questions.explanation_hi: संस्कृत 'अग्नि' से विकसित होकर हिंदी में 'आग' बना है, अतः 'आग' तद्भव है। ज्वाला, अनल और पावक अग्नि के तत्सम पर्यायवाची हैं, तद्भव रूप नहीं।

questions.question_en: 'कोयल' शब्द का तत्सम रूप क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'कोयल' शब्द का तत्सम रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: The tatsam form of koyal is kokil.
questions.explanation_hi: 'कोयल' संस्कृत 'कोकिल' का तद्भव रूप है। 'काकी' कौए की मादा के लिए प्रयुक्त होता है और 'कुहुक' कोयल की बोली है।

questions.question_en: 'कृतज्ञ' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'कृतज्ञ' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Kritagya (grateful) vs kritaghna (ungrateful).
questions.explanation_hi: कृतज्ञ (उपकार मानने वाला) का विलोम कृतघ्न (उपकार न मानने वाला) है। 'अकृतज्ञ' प्रचलित मानक विलोम नहीं है।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द उत्प्रेक्षा अलंकार का वाचक शब्द है?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द उत्प्रेक्षा अलंकार का वाचक शब्द है?
questions.explanation_en: 'Mano' (as if) signals Utpreksha; sam, saris and sa are simile markers.
questions.explanation_hi: उत्प्रेक्षा में संभावना दिखाने के लिए मनु, मनहुँ, जनु, जनहुँ, मानो, जानो आदि वाचक शब्द आते हैं। सम, सरिस, सा आदि उपमा अलंकार के वाचक शब्द हैं।

questions.subtopic: अनेक शब्दों के लिए एक शब्द
questions.question_en: 'जानने की इच्छा' — इसके लिए एक शब्द क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'जानने की इच्छा' — इसके लिए एक शब्द क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Desire to know = jigyasa.
questions.explanation_hi: जानने की इच्छा = जिज्ञासा। पिपासा = पीने की इच्छा, लालसा/अभिलाषा = सामान्य इच्छा।

questions.question_en: 'दाँतों तले उँगली दबाना' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'दाँतों तले उँगली दबाना' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: It means to be astonished.
questions.explanation_hi: 'दाँतों तले उँगली दबाना' का अर्थ है बहुत अचंभित होना — 'बालक की प्रतिभा देखकर सब दाँतों तले उँगली दबा गए।' पछताने के लिए 'हाथ मलना' मुहावरा है।

questions.question_en:
निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।

पुस्तकें मनुष्य की सबसे अच्छी मित्र होती हैं। वे बिना किसी स्वार्थ के हमें ज्ञान देती हैं और कठिन समय में धैर्य बँधाती हैं। जो व्यक्ति नियमित रूप से अच्छी पुस्तकें पढ़ता है, उसके विचारों में गहराई आती है तथा उसकी भाषा समृद्ध होती है। आज के डिजिटल युग में भी पुस्तकों का महत्त्व कम नहीं हुआ है, केवल उनका रूप बदल गया है। अब ई-पुस्तकें और ऑडियो-पुस्तकें भी पाठकों तक पहुँच रही हैं। आवश्यकता इस बात की है कि विद्यार्थी केवल परीक्षा के लिए नहीं, बल्कि आनंद और जिज्ञासा के लिए भी पढ़ें।

प्रश्न: गद्यांश में आए 'स्वार्थ' शब्द का सही संधि-विच्छेद और संधि का प्रकार क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Sva + arth = svaarth; a + a gives aa (deergh sandhi).
questions.explanation_hi: स्व + अर्थ = स्वार्थ; यहाँ अ + अ मिलकर 'आ' बना है, इसलिए दीर्घ स्वर संधि है।

questions.question_en: 'उदित उदयगिरि मंच पर, रघुवर बाल पतंग। बिकसे संत सरोज सब, हरषे लोचन भृंग॥' — इसमें कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.question_hi: 'उदित उदयगिरि मंच पर, रघुवर बाल पतंग। बिकसे संत सरोज सब, हरषे लोचन भृंग॥' — इसमें कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.explanation_en: Several parts are identified with parts of a sunrise scene, so it is Sangrupak (extended metaphor).
questions.explanation_hi: यहाँ मंच पर उदयगिरि, रघुवर पर बाल सूर्य, संतों पर कमल और नेत्रों पर भौंरों का अंगों सहित आरोप किया गया है। उपमेय पर उपमान का अंग-उपांग सहित आरोप सांगरूपक (रूपक का भेद) कहलाता है।

questions.question_en: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वाक्य चुनिए: (मुझे/मेरे को)
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वाक्य चुनिए: (मुझे/मेरे को)
questions.explanation_en: Standard Hindi uses 'mujhe', not 'mere ko'.
questions.explanation_hi: मानक हिंदी में 'मेरे को' का प्रयोग अशुद्ध माना जाता है; 'मुझे' या 'मुझको' लिखा जाता है। 'मुझको को' में परसर्ग का दोहराव है।

questions.question_en: 'आदान' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.question_hi: 'आदान' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: Aadaan (taking) vs pradaan (giving).
questions.explanation_hi: आदान (लेना) का विलोम प्रदान (देना) है; 'आदान-प्रदान' युग्म प्रसिद्ध है। अनुदान का अर्थ सहायता-राशि और निदान का अर्थ रोग-पहचान है।
